Ilang dekada na itong itinuturing na mahalagang paraan para makaiwas sa aksidente. Pero, lumalabas na may mas malalim itong mga epekto na tumatagal kahit tapos na ang taglamig. Matagal nang alam ng mga siyentipiko na bagama’t nakakatulong ang asin sa kalsada sa taglamig, nakakasama ito sa yamang-tubig at kalidad ng inuming tubig. Ngayon, napatunayan din ng mga pag-aaral na naaapektuhan din nito ang balanse ng oxygen at nutrients sa mga lawa at pond. Ang asin sa kalsada (rock salt) ay pangunahing sodium chloride (NaCl). Inilalagay ito sa kalsada tuwing taglamig para mapigilan ang pagbuo ng yelo at gawing hindi madulas. Pero dahil matibay ang kemikal na ito at dahil paulit-ulit ginagamit, nananatili ito sa ating kapaligiran. Mula sa kalsada, napupunta ang asin sa mga ilog, lawa, at groundwater, at nananatili roon ng matagal dahil hindi ito madaling masira. Dahil dito, tinagurian ang sodium chloride na 'forever contaminant.' Dumarami na ang nababahala: dapat bang unahin ang kaligtasan ng motorista o ang kalikasan? Mga Negatibong Epekto Kilalang-kilala na ang masamang epekto ng asin sa kalsada sa mga anyong-tubig at pinagkukunan ng inuming tubig. Kapag marami ang asin tuwing taglamig, tumataas ang konsentrasyon nito sa lupa at tubig, pinapalitan ang natural na kemikal ng mga ito. Maaaring mamatay ang mga halaman at hayop sa tabang na tubig, maapektuhan ang lupa, at mapanganib ang inuming tubig kapag napasok ng asin ang groundwater. Ayon sa mga bagong pag-aaral, may dagdag pang epekto: nakababa ang asin sa kalsada ng oxygen sa mga lawa. Tinatawag na hypoxia ang matinding bagsak ng oxygen sa tubig, kadalasang bunga ng sobrang nutrients, lalo na ng posporus. Kapag sumobra ang nutrients, bumubulwak ang algae na lalong nagpapababa ng oxygen sa ilalim ng lawa. Lumalala ang hypoxic na kondisyon at puwedeng magdulot ng mass die-off ng mga nabubuhay dito. Ang eutrophication na ito ay problema na ngayon sa maraming lawa sa buong mundo. Asin at Oxygen Ang posporus, madalas sanhi ng eutrophication, ay mas naaapektuhan kapag mataas ang alat ng tubig. Dahil dito, mas bumibigat ang tubig at nababawasan ang paghahalo, kaya hindi makalusot ang oxygen sa malalalim na bahagi. Kapag kulang sa oxygen, higit pang nailalabas na posporus mula sa sediments sa ilalim ng lawa, kaya lalong tumataas ang nutrients. Mas pinapabilis ito ng malawakang gamit ng asin sa kalsada. Mga Tugon at Solusyon Nagtagumpay na ang Canada, tulad ng pagbawas ng posporus sa Lake Erie noong 1980s at 1990s na nagpapabuti sa kalidad ng tubig. Pero dahil tumataas ang alat ng mga lawa, kailangan ng mas makabago at epektibong solusyon. Bukod sa asin sa kalsada, galing din ang sobrang alat sa mga sakahan, panlinis ng tubig sa bahay, minahan, at natural na deposito. Problema ito sa buong mundo, hindi lang sa mga malamig na lugar. Ang chloride, na pangunahing bahagi ng asin sa kalsada, ay tinatawag na 'forever contaminant' dahil mahirap itong alisin sa kalikasan. Madali itong matunaw sa tubig kaya naiipon ito sa surface at groundwater nang matagal. Puwede ring magmula sa ilalim ng lupa ang chloride, lalo na tuwing tag-init. Kahit nakagawa na ng mga aksyon, mahal at matagal alisin ang asin at sodium na naipon na sa lupa o tubig. Mga Hakbang Para Umabante Kailangan ng mga solusyong base sa ebidensya para mabawasan ang masamang epekto ng alat. Dapat magpatupad ng mga programa para limitahan ang pag-agos ng alat at masusing pagmamanman. Ang mga leksyon mula sa nutrient pollution ay puwedeng gabay sa mas epektibong pamamahala ng asin at pagpapabuti ng kalidad ng tubig. Puwede ring subukan ang ibang pang-de-ice, pero siguraduhing napag-aralan ito nang husto para walang madagdag na bagong problema sa kalikasan. Proteksyon Para sa Tao at Kalikasan Mataas ang panganib ng asin sa kalsada: puwedeng madumihan ang inuming tubig, lumiit ang tirahan ng mga hayop sa tubig, at tumagal ang polusyon na mahirap tanggalin. Mahalaga ang pagtutulungan ng pananaliksik, pamumuhunan, at kamalayan ng publiko para dito. Ang epekto ng asin sa kalsada ay mas malawak kaysa sa simpleng pagpapa-siguro ng ligtas na daan tuwing taglamig. Habang bumabalik ang malamig na panahon, dapat isaalang-alang ng mga polisiya ang kalikasan at mga serbisyo nitong mahalaga sa lahat.

article_content: Thierry de la Villehuchet, a hedge fund adviser and investor, was found dead in his New York office on Tuesday in what police described as an apparent suicide. Villehuchet, 65, was discovered at 7:29 a.m. in the Madison Avenue office of Access International Advisors, the firm he managed. According to police reports, he had sustained cuts to his wrist and bicep area with a box cutter found at the scene. Pills were also present, but authorities could not confirm whether he ingested any, and no suicide note was recovered. Villehuchet’s company reportedly lost $1.5 billion investing with Bernard Madoff, a Wall Street adviser now accused of running a $50 billion Ponzi scheme. Prominent individuals, including Liliane Bettencourt—the world’s richest woman and heiress to the L’Oreal fortune—are believed to have invested with Madoff through Villehuchet’s firm, though details of her investment remain private. Other wealthy individuals such as Spanish billionaire Alicia Koplowitz, filmmaker Steven Spielberg, and Nobel Prize winner Elie Wiesel are also thought to have been affected. Police Commissioner Ray Kelly provided these updates in a news conference. The body will undergo examination and a toxicology report will be issued, according to Ellen Borakove, a spokesperson for the New York medical examiner. Access International Advisors is no longer registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission, and Madoff’s lawyer declined to comment.

Si Villehuchet, 65, ay natagpuan bandang 7:29 ng umaga sa Madison Avenue office ng Access International Advisors, ang kumpanyang kanya ring pinamamahalaan. Ayon sa ulat ng pulisya, nagtamo siya ng mga sugat sa pulsuhan at braso gamit ang isang box cutter na natagpuan sa pinangyarihan. May mga natagpuang tableta ngunit hindi tiyak ng mga awtoridad kung siya ay uminom ng alinman dito, at walang suicide note na naiwan. Ang kumpanya ni Villehuchet ay iniulat na nawalan ng $1.5 bilyon matapos mag-invest kay Bernard Madoff, isang Wall Street adviser na kasalukuyang inaakusahan ng pagpapatakbo ng $50 bilyong Ponzi scheme. Pinaniniwalaang kabilang sa mga nag-invest kay Madoff sa pamamagitan ng kumpanya ni Villehuchet si Liliane Bettencourt—ang pinakamayamang babae sa mundo at tagapagmana ng L’Oreal—bagamat pribado ang detalye ng kanyang investment. Sinabing naapektuhan din ng scam ang iba pang mayayamang indibidwal tulad ni Spanish billionaire Alicia Koplowitz, filmmaker Steven Spielberg, at Nobel Prize winner na si Elie Wiesel. Ibinigay ang mga update na ito ni Police Commissioner Ray Kelly sa isang press conference. Ang bangkay ay sasailalim sa pagsusuri at magkakaroon ng toxicology report, ayon kay Ellen Borakove, tagapagsalita ng New York medical examiner. Hindi na rehistrado sa Securities and Exchange Commission ang Access International Advisors, at tumanggi magbigay ng pahayag ang abogado ni Madoff.

article_content: At WWE Crown Jewel 2023, Seth Rollins retained his World Heavyweight Championship after an intense contest with Drew McIntyre, maintaining his top position on Monday Night Raw. McIntyre’s WWE contract ends early next year, and he is reportedly seeking a higher-paying agreement, though an extension has not been signed. With WWE’s recent merger with UFC, the company's approach to contract renewals has changed, making lucrative deals less likely for talent like McIntyre. Although McIntyre continually delivers strong performances, his loss at Crown Jewel has created more uncertainty about his future in WWE. Despite stating he plans to remain focused and give his best in every match, McIntyre’s future remains unresolved, as contract talks stall. WWE’s strategy now emphasizes the overall brand instead of individual stars, as demonstrated by Adam ‘Edge’ Copeland’s move to AEW after his contract negotiations fell through—an example of the industry’s evolving dynamics. With star power from wrestlers like Gunther, Jey Uso, Cody Rhodes, and Rollins, WWE’s Raw brand seems prepared to thrive regardless of McIntyre’s status. As his character appears to be shifting—possibly toward a heel turn—McIntyre is at a crossroads. His pursuit of a major contract comes at a time of significant changes in WWE, and despite his talent, it is unclear if he will secure the terms he wants or achieve another world title run.

Magtatapos na ang kontrata ni McIntyre sa WWE sa unang bahagi ng susunod na taon, at hinihiling umano niya ang mas mataas na bayad, pero wala pa ring bagong kasunduang napagkasunduan. Kasunod ng pinagsamang kumpanya ng WWE at UFC, nag-iba ang patakaran ng WWE sa pagpapanibago ng kontrata, kaya’t mas mahirap para sa mga tulad ni McIntyre makakuha ng malaking deal. Bagama’t mahusay pa rin ang mga performance ni McIntyre, ang kanyang pagkatalo sa Crown Jewel ay nagdala ng mas maraming tanong tungkol sa kanyang kinabukasan sa WWE. Kahit sinasabi niyang tutok siya at ibinibigay ang lahat sa bawat laban, nananatiling hindi malinaw ang kanyang susunod na hakbang habang tila hindi umuusad ang negosasyon. Mas binibigyang-diin ngayon ng WWE ang lakas ng brand kaysa indibidwal na superstar, gaya ng paglisan ni Adam 'Edge' Copeland papuntang AEW matapos mabigo ang kontrata—isang palatandaan ng pagbabagong nagaganap sa propesyonal na wrestling. Dahil sa mga malalaking pangalan gaya nina Gunther, Jey Uso, Cody Rhodes, at Rollins, tila handa ang Raw ng WWE na magpatuloy kahit mawala si McIntyre. Habang tila nagiging kontrabida ang kanyang karakter, nasa mahalagang punto si McIntyre ngayon. Habang hinahangad niya ang mas mataas na kontrata sa gitna ng malalaking pagbabago sa WWE, hindi pa rin tiyak kung mararating niya ang kanyang mga layunin o makakabalik pa sa pagiging world champion.

article_content: David Warner, Australia's opening batter, will not participate in the upcoming T20I series against India. According to ESPNcricinfo, Warner has been withdrawn from the squad following the ODI World Cup 2023. Warner, 37, joins other teammates—Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood, and Mitchell Starc—who will also miss the three-match T20I series ahead of Australia's Test series against Pakistan starting December 14. All-rounders Cameron Green and Mitchell Marsh are also sitting out. During the ODI World Cup 2023, Warner had an excellent showing, scoring 535 runs in 11 innings at a strike rate of 108.29. All-rounder Aaron Hardie has been included in the T20I squad. Kane Richardson replaces Spencer Johnson, who is out due to a hamstring injury. Despite beginning just four days after the ODI World Cup final, the T20I series is part of preparations for next year’s T20 World Cup in the West Indies and USA. Australia will play six more T20I series before the tournament. Matthew Wade, aged 35, will captain Australia for the upcoming T20I matches against India. The first match will be held in Visakhapatnam on November 23, just days after Australia’s World Cup final win over India in Ahmedabad.

Si Warner, 37, ay kasama rin nina Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood, at Mitchell Starc na hindi rin maglalaro sa tatlong laban na T20I series bago ang Test series ng Australia kontra Pakistan na magsisimula sa Disyembre 14. Hindi rin maglalaro ang mga all-rounder na sina Cameron Green at Mitchell Marsh. Sa ODI World Cup 2023, maganda ang naging takbo ni Warner, naka-score siya ng 535 runs sa 11 innings na may strike rate na 108.29. Kasama na sa T20I squad si all-rounder Aaron Hardie. Papalitan naman ni Kane Richardson si Spencer Johnson, na hindi makakalaro dahil sa hamstring injury. Bagamat magsisimula lang apat na araw matapos ang ODI World Cup final, ang T20I series ay bahagi ng paghahanda para sa T20 World Cup sa West Indies at USA sa susunod na taon. Maglalaro pa ang Australia ng anim pang T20I series bago ang torneo. Si Matthew Wade, 35 taong gulang, ang magiging kapitan ng Australia sa mga darating na T20I laban sa India. Gaganapin ang unang laban sa Visakhapatnam sa Nobyembre 23, ilang araw lang matapos talunin ng Australia ang India sa World Cup final sa Ahmedabad.

article_content: A high school teacher at Forestville High School in Maryland was injured last week after a male student punched him following a perceived racist remark. The teacher, who has not been officially identified but was named as James Hemmen on social media, sustained minor injuries in the incident. The school described what happened last Thursday as a 'misinterpretation of a comment' made during class, while some students and parents said the teacher's remark was racially insensitive. Prince George's County Public Schools told Daily Mail Online on Tuesday that, to protect the confidentiality of students and staff, the district could not comment on any consequences related to the incident. According to NBC, the student will be disciplined for the attack, and authorities stated that this was an isolated incident, with no current plans to increase security at the school. As of Tuesday, it was unclear whether the student would face criminal charges. A spokeswoman for the school district said, 'On January 29, a misinterpretation of a comment in a classroom at Forestville High School resulted in an assault against a teacher. The teacher was treated for injuries at a local medical facility and released. School administrators and security staff are working together to investigate the incident. Prince George’s County Public Schools (PGCPS) is committed to ensuring a safe and supportive environment in all schools.' Parents and guardians of students at Forestville High School received a letter informing them about the incident and encouraging them to reinforce the importance of safe and responsible conduct and to seek assistance if they need help resolving conflicts.

Inilarawan ng paaralan ang nangyari noong Huwebes bilang isang 'maling pag-unawa sa isang komento' sa klase, habang sinabi ng ilang estudyante at magulang na naging insensitive umano ang guro tungkol sa lahi. Sinabi ng Prince George's County Public Schools sa Daily Mail Online noong Martes na upang maprotektahan ang privacy ng mga mag-aaral at guro, hindi sila maaaring magbigay ng detalye ukol sa mga consequence ng insidente. Ayon sa NBC, madidisiplina ang estudyante dahil sa nangyari, at sinabi ng mga opisyal na ito ay isang isolated na pangyayari, kaya’t wala pang balak dagdagan ang seguridad sa paaralan. Hanggang Martes, hindi pa malinaw kung mahaharap sa kasong kriminal ang estudyante. Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng school district: 'Noong Enero 29, isang maling pag-unawa sa komento sa loob ng silid-aralan sa Forestville High School ang nagresulta sa pananakit sa isang guro. Ang guro ay ginamot sa lokal na ospital at pinauwi rin agad. Ang mga administrador ng paaralan at security staff ay nagtutulungan para imbestigahan ang insidente. Ang Prince George’s County Public Schools (PGCPS) ay naninindigan para sa isang ligtas at suportadong kapaligiran para sa lahat ng paaralan.' Nagpadala ng liham ang paaralan sa mga magulang at guardian ng mga estudyante sa Forestville High School para ipaalam ang insidente at hikayatin silang paalalahanan ang mga anak na maging ligtas at responsable, at humingi ng tulong kung may suliranin sa pagresolba ng mga alitan.

article_content: A California woman is suing a reality TV show after nearly severing her finger when her hand was taped to a sledgehammer and struck against a countertop. Courtney Muro is taking legal action against the DIY Network and Bathroom Crashers host Matt Muenster, alleging she was injured during filming in July 2012. Ms. Muro, from Sacramento, said she was assisting a friend whose home was being featured on the show when the injury occurred. Matt Muenster, host of Bathroom Crashers, is named in the lawsuit after Ms. Muro was hurt during production. With her right hand bleeding, Ms. Muro claims she was asked to sign a standard liability waiver with her left hand. During a Sacramento County Court appearance on Tuesday, Ms. Muro accused the show and network of negligence. Court documents cited by Kron 4 state that 'Bathroom Crashers host Matt Muenster wrapped duct tape around her hand to attach the sledgehammer. The plaintiff then swung the sledgehammer at the counter, and the impact partially severed her right index finger against a broken piece of countertop.' The injury broke the skin and muscle in Ms. Muro's finger, causing her to go into shock at seeing her exposed tendon. According to Ms. Muro, she was only asked to sign the liability waiver after being injured. 'While still in shock and bleeding from her right hand, the plaintiff signed the liability waiver with her left hand,' Court News reported. Ms. Muro is suing for emotional distress and alleges that Muenster should have ensured her safety during filming.

Naghain si Muro ng kaso dahil sa emotional distress at sinabing dapat inasikaso pa siya ni Muenster habang kinukunan ng programa.

article_content: Google has agreed to update its privacy rules after criticism for not providing clear information about how users’ personal data is collected and used. The UK's data protection authority, the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), called Google’s policies 'too vague' regarding the large amounts of information collected from web users. After pressure from the ICO, Google will revise its privacy policies to simplify how internet users can find out how their data is collected and stored. The order comes two years after the ICO determined that Google’s privacy policy was confusing and failed to comply with UK law. Google could have faced a fine of up to £500,000 or court action, but Kent Walker, a senior vice-president at Google, has now signed a formal undertaking to begin making changes by June 30. Privacy advocates have raised concerns over how online platforms, especially search engines and social media such as Facebook, gather and use customer data. The ICO and European regulators began investigating Google after a widely criticized update to its privacy policy in March 2012, which combined separate documents for over 70 services, including YouTube and Gmail, into a single policy. The ICO found that the merged policy was less clear and did not help ordinary users understand how data like email addresses or browsing histories would be used. Google, which owns YouTube and Gmail, has promised to provide clear, comprehensive information about data processing, including detailed lists of what data is processed and why. The ICO noted that this agreement may influence other companies that collect information online. Steve Eckersley, head of enforcement at the ICO, described the decision as a significant step forward. He stated: 'While our investigation found no substantial harm to consumers, it is essential that organizations recognize the impact of their actions and comply with data protection law.' Renate Samson, chief executive of privacy group Big Brother Watch, commented: 'As more of our lives move online, it is vital to understand how our data is used, who can access it, and how we can control our privacy. Clear and accessible terms and conditions are crucial.' A Google spokesperson said: 'We are pleased the ICO has closed its investigation. We have committed to improving our privacy policy and will continue to work with the Commissioner.' In July 2013, Google faced criticism for failing to delete all sensitive information unintentionally collected from unsecured home Wi-Fi networks by its Street View cars, affecting millions of UK households. It was discovered that personal data was deliberately downloaded using specialized equipment in those vehicles.
translated_content: Sumang-ayon ang Google na baguhin ang mga panuntunan nito sa privacy matapos makatanggap ng batikos dahil sa hindi malinaw na pagpapaliwanag kung paano kinokolekta at ginagamit ang personal na datos ng mga gumagamit. Sinabi ng Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) ng UK na masyadong 'malabo' ang mga polisiya ng Google tungkol sa dami ng impormasyong kinokolekta mula sa mga gumagamit ng web. Dahil sa presyon mula sa ICO, babaguhin ng Google ang privacy policy nito upang gawing mas simple para sa mga internet user na malaman kung paano kinokolekta at iniimbak ang kanilang datos. Iniutos ito dalawang taon matapos matukoy ng ICO na nakakalito ang privacy policy ng Google at hindi sumusunod sa batas ng UK. Maaaring naharap ang Google sa multa na hanggang £500,000 o kasong legal, ngunit lumagda na si Kent Walker, senior vice-president ng Google, ng isang pormal na kasunduan na sisimulan nila ang pagbabago bago mag-Hunyo 30. Nagpahayag naman ng pag-aalala ang mga tagapagtaguyod ng privacy sa paraan ng pagkolekta at paggamit ng datos ng mga kumpanyang online, lalo na ng search engines at social media kagaya ng Facebook. Sinimulan ng ICO at mga European regulator ang imbestigasyon sa Google matapos ang kontrobersyal na pag-update ng privacy policy nito noong Marso 2012, kung saan pinagsama-sama ang magkakahiwalay na dokumento para sa higit 70 serbisyo, kabilang ang YouTube at Gmail, sa isang policy lang. Natuklasan ng ICO na naging mas malabo ang pinagsamang policy at hindi ito nakakatulong sa karaniwang gumagamit na maintindihan kung paano gagamitin ang datos tulad ng email address o kasaysayan ng pagba-browse. Nangakong magbibigay ang Google, na may-ari ng YouTube at Gmail, ng malinaw at detalyadong impormasyon tungkol sa data processing, kabilang ang listahan ng mga uri ng datos na pinoproseso at ang dahilan nito. Sabi ng ICO, maaaring magdulot ng epekto ang kasunduang ito sa iba pang kumpanyang nangongolekta ng impormasyon online. Ayon kay Steve Eckersley, head of enforcement ng ICO, ito ay isang mahalagang hakbang pasulong. Sabi niya: 'Bagama't wala namang malaking pinsalang natuklasan para sa mga consumer, mahalaga pa ring maunawaan ng mga organisasyon ang epekto ng kanilang mga kilos at sumunod sa data protection law.' Ayon kay Renate Samson, chief executive ng Big Brother Watch, isang grupo ng privacy advocate: 'Habang mas dumadami ang aspeto ng buhay natin online, mahalaga na alam natin kung paano ginagamit ang ating datos, sino ang may access dito, at paano natin mapaprotektahan ang ating privacy. Importante talaga na simple at madaling maintindihan ang terms and conditions.' Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng Google: 'Natutuwa kami na isinara na ng ICO ang kanilang imbestigasyon. Nangako kaming gagandahan pa ang aming privacy policy at tuloy-tuloy na makikipagtulungan sa Commissioner.' Noong Hulyo 2013, binatikos ang Google dahil hindi nito na-delete ang lahat ng sensitibong impormasyong hindi sinasadyang nakolekta mula sa unsecured home Wi-Fi networks ng Street View cars, na nakaapekto sa milyon-milyong kabahayan sa UK. Natuklasan na sadyang na-download ang personal na datos gamit ang espesyal na kagamitan sa mga sasakyan na ito.

Australia’s women’s soccer team, the Matildas, will move to a new pay structure similar to the men’s team under a four-year collective bargaining agreement (CBA) announced on Wednesday. This follows their historic run to the Women’s World Cup semi-finals on home soil, which broke attendance and TV rating records.

According to The Guardian, the Matildas could receive an annual pay increase of up to $80,000, on top of club salaries and tournament earnings. The CBA covers major tournaments: the Asian Cups (2023, 2027), Paris Olympics (2024), AFC Women’s Asian Cup (2026), and the FIFA Men’s and Women’s World Cups (2026, 2027).

Key elements include a stronger commercial partnership between Football Australia and players, with revenue-sharing: 70% match fees, 30% annual commercial payments. The Matildas will be treated equally to the men’s team, the Socceroos, with access to single rooms and business class travel for preparation and recovery.

The parental policy now allows accommodation for carers of mothers with children up to four years old, up from two. At least 5% of national team-generated revenue will go to youth programs, and around $2 million over four years will support Professional Footballers Australia initiatives.

Football Australia also commits to developing a human rights policy for the sport and ongoing support for the PFA’s Past Players Program. PFA co-chief executive Kathryn Gill says the agreement builds on a foundation that will drive growth and reward performance as Australian football continues to advance.
translated_content:
Ang pambansang koponan ng kababaihan sa soccer ng Australia, ang Matildas, ay lilipat sa bagong sistema ng sahod na katulad ng sa men's team sa ilalim ng apat na taong collective bargaining agreement (CBA) na inanunsyo nitong Miyerkules. Nangyari ito kasunod ng kanilang makasaysayang pagpasok sa semi-finals ng Women’s World Cup sa sariling bansa, kung saan nagkaroon ng record-breaking na dami ng mga manonood at mataas na TV ratings.

Ayon sa The Guardian, maaaring makakuha ang Matildas ng dagdag na hanggang $80,000 bawat taon, bukod pa sa kanilang suweldo sa club at premyo sa mga torneo. Sinasaklaw ng CBA ang mga pangunahing torneo: Asian Cups (2023, 2027), Paris Olympics (2024), AFC Women’s Asian Cup (2026), at FIFA Men’s at Women’s World Cup (2026, 2027).

Kabilang sa mga pangunahing bahagi ang mas pinatibay na komersyal na partnership sa pagitan ng Football Australia at mga manlalaro, na may revenue-sharing: 70% match fees at 30% taunang komersyal na bayad. Bibigyan ng Matildas ng pantay na trato gaya ng Socceroos (men’s team), kabilang na ang single rooms at business class na biyahe para sa mas maayos na paghahanda at pag-recover.

Pinalawak din ang polisiya para sa mga magulang: papayagan na ngayon ang accommodation para sa mga carers ng ina na may batang hanggang apat na taong gulang (mula sa dating dalawang taon). Hindi bababa sa 5% ng kinikita ng national team ay ilalaan sa mga kabataang programa, at humigit-kumulang $2 milyon sa loob ng apat na taon ang ilalaan para sa mga inisyatiba ng Professional Footballers Australia.

Nangako rin ang Football Australia na bubuo ng patakaran sa karapatang pantao para sa isport at tutuloy sa suporta para sa Past Players Program ng PFA. Ayon kay Kathryn Gill, co-chief executive ng PFA, ang kasunduang ito ay magsisilbing matibay na pundasyon para sa patuloy ng paglago at pagkilala sa mga manlalaro, kasabay ng pag-asenso ng football sa Australia.

The Argentine ambassador to the UK, Alicia Castro, has accused Britain of violating international law with its handling of the Julian Assange case. Castro, who assumed her post earlier this year and is recognized for her nationalistic stance, compared the UK's 'arrogant' approach to Assange’s extradition to its position on the disputed Falkland Islands.

Assange, the founder of Wikileaks, sought political asylum in Ecuador’s London embassy to avoid extradition to Sweden over alleged sexual offences, which he denies. Earlier this month, hundreds of supporters, journalists, and police gathered outside the embassy as Assange addressed the crowd.

In an interview with Argentine radio, Castro said the UK's diplomatic behavior toward Assange mirrored its approach to the Malvinas (Falkland Islands). She stated, 'For Argentines, this latest move shows us the arrogance of British diplomacy. It is very similar to their actions regarding the Malvinas Islands. London is being urged by the United Nations to negotiate and participate in dialogue with Argentina.'

Castro also alleged that by threatening to seize Assange from the embassy, the UK was violating international law, and noted that the Organisation of American States had joined together to 'defend international law against the British challenge.'

A diplomatic dispute arose between the UK and Ecuador after Ecuador granted asylum to Assange. The UK, represented by Foreign Secretary William Hague, insists it is 'determined to carry out our legal obligation' to extradite Assange to Sweden, and denies making any threats against the embassy. Ecuadorian President Rafael Correa initially accused the UK of threatening to enter the embassy, but later stated that the UK had dropped this threat. The Foreign and Commonwealth Office maintains that if Assange leaves the embassy, he will be arrested, but stresses that no threats have been made against the embassy.

Castro revealed that she and other Latin American representatives met with Assange at the embassy last week during a live OAS meeting broadcast from Washington, discussing the inviolability of embassies and consulates. She described how Assange greeted the diplomats and remained to follow the debate.

Argentina had left the position of UK ambassador vacant since 2008, in protest of the UK's refusal to discuss the sovereignty of the Falkland Islands, until Castro’s appointment in March.
translated_content:
Inakusahan ng embahador ng Argentina sa UK na si Alicia Castro ang Britain ng paglabag sa internasyonal na batas dahil sa paraan ng paghawak nito sa kaso ni Julian Assange. Si Castro, na nagsimula ng kanyang tungkulin ngayong taon at kilala sa kanyang makabansang paninindigan, ay ikinumpara ang 'mayabang' na istilo ng UK sa pagkaso kay Assange at sa posisyon nito tungkol sa pinag-aagawang Falkland Islands.

Si Assange, ang nagtatag ng Wikileaks, ay humingi ng political asylum sa embahada ng Ecuador sa London upang maiwasan ang extradition sa Sweden dahil sa mga alegasyon ng sexual na paglabag, na kanyang itinatanggi. Nitong unang bahagi ng buwan, daan-daang tagasuporta, mamamahayag, at pulis ang nagtipon sa labas ng embahada habang nagtatalumpati si Assange.

Sa isang panayam sa radyo sa Argentina, sinabi ni Castro na ang aksyon ng UK kay Assange ay hawig sa kanilang pagtrato sa Malvinas (Falkland Islands). Aniya, 'Para sa mga Argentine, ang hakbang na ito ay nagpapakita ng kayabangan ng diplomasyang British. Katulad ito ng kanilang aksyon sa Malvinas Islands. Hinikayat ng United Nations ang London na makipag-negosasyon at makipagdayalogo sa Argentina.'

Idinagdag pa ni Castro na sa umano'y pagbabanta ng UK na hulihin si Assange mula sa embahada, nilabag nito ang internasyonal na batas. Binanggit din niya na nagkaisa ang Organisation of American States upang 'ipagtanggol ang internasyonal na batas laban sa hamon ng UK.'

Nagkaroon ng diplomatikong hindi pagkakaunawaan ang UK at Ecuador matapos bigyang asylum ng huli si Assange. Ayon kay Foreign Secretary William Hague, obligado ang UK na i-extradite si Assange sa Sweden at itinanggi ang anumang banta laban sa embahada. Inakusahan din ni Pangulong Rafael Correa ng Ecuador ang UK ng pagbabanta na pasukin ang embahada, ngunit sinabi niya ring inatras na ng UK ang banta. Ayon sa Foreign and Commonwealth Office, aarestuhin si Assange kapag umalis siya sa embahada, ngunit binigyang-diin na walang banta laban sa embahada.

Isiniwalat din ni Castro na siya at iba pang opisyal mula Latin America ay nakipagkita kay Assange sa embahada kamakailan habang may live broadcast ng pagpupulong ng OAS mula Washington ukol sa inviolability ng mga embahada at konsulado. Inilarawan niya kung paano binati at kinamayan ni Assange ang mga delegado at nanatili upang sumubaybay sa debate.

Iniwan ng Argentina na bakante ang posisyon ng embahador sa UK simula 2008 bilang protesta sa pagtanggi ng UK na makipagdayalogo tungkol sa soberanya ng Falkland Islands, hanggang sa italaga si Castro noong Marso.

article_content: Robert Greene's 'The 48 Laws of Power' is a well-known guide to understanding power dynamics. Drawing from history, psychology, and strategy, Greene outlines principles that influence relationships and authority. If you are leading a business with multiple stakeholders, the lessons from this book can offer valuable insights. Since its publication in 1998, it has sold more than 1.2 million copies in the United States and has been translated into 24 languages. The book's laws can be grouped into seven core themes, each relevant to business strategy and success. Below are suggested ChatGPT prompts you can adapt to align with your current business objectives: 1. Understanding Motivations: If you comprehend the motivations and fears of business partners, employees, and competitors, you gain an edge in decisions. For example, Law 1 ('Never outshine the master'), Law 9 ('Win through your actions, never through argument'), and Law 32 ('Play to people’s fantasies') can help you influence others constructively. Prompt Example: 'I want to apply Laws 1, 9, and 32 from Robert Greene's book to my business: [describe your business] and [your team, clients, direct reports]. Specifically with [one relationship], how could these insights help me achieve [desired outcome]?' 2. Defending Against Manipulation: You may not want to use manipulation, but it's important to recognize tactics so you won't be manipulated. Laws 3 ('Conceal your intentions'), 7 ('Get others to do the work for you, but always take the credit'), and 11 ('Learn to keep people dependent on you') highlight common strategies for hidden motives. Prompt Example: 'I'm interested in applying Laws 3, 7, and 11 from the 48 Laws of Power in my business: [describe your business]. With regard to [specific relationship], how can I use these laws to achieve [business goal]?' 3. Safeguarding Reputation: Your reputation can open doors and bring you opportunities. Laws 5 ('Guard your reputation with your life') and 46 ('Never appear too perfect') emphasize the importance of reputation management. Prompt Example: 'To protect and enhance my business reputation using Laws 5 and 46, my business specializes in [sector and activities]. How can I apply these laws in scenarios like [negotiation, PR, customer interactions] to attract or retain [partnerships/investments/customers]?' 4. Timing: Strategic timing is crucial for success in business. Laws 28 ('Enter action with boldness') and 35 ('Master the art of timing') guide decision-making for product launches, investments, or partnerships. Prompt Example: 'Based on Laws 28 and 35, I’m deciding on [specific action, e.g., launching a product]. Considering [market conditions, competition], how can I determine the best moment to act and carry out my decision boldly to maximize [sales/growth]?' 5. Strategic Withdrawal: Sometimes being less available increases respect and demand for your services. Laws 4 ('Always say less than necessary') and 16 ('Use absence to increase respect and honor') suggest effective withdrawal strategies. Prompt Example: 'In line with Laws 4 and 16, I plan to step back from certain business aspects for three months. What strategies could help me be more absent while improving respect and productivity?' 6. Protecting Personal Interests: It’s important to be aware of dependence on others. Law 19 ('Know who you're dealing with') and Law 20 ('Do not commit to anyone') can help safeguard autonomy. Prompt Example: 'Following Laws 19 and 20, I want to reassess my business's reliance on others in the [industry]. Can you help identify areas of dependence and propose ways to restore autonomy while maintaining healthy relationships?' 7. Building Social Capital: Expanding your network brings more opportunities. Law 6 ('Court attention at all costs') and Law 24 ('Play the perfect courtier') highlight increasing visibility and building relationships. Prompt Example: 'As I aim to grow my network in [industry], what actionable steps, following Laws 6 and 24, can I take to enhance my brand presence and arrange my schedule for new connections? How can I also foster genuine and mutually beneficial relationships?' Applying these seven themes from 'The 48 Laws of Power' can strengthen your position in business. Even if you do not use every law, understanding these principles can help you anticipate others’ actions and respond strategically. By mastering human psychology and power dynamics, you can manage business situations more effectively and, as outlined in Law 30, aim to make your successes appear effortless.

Paano ko maaaring magamit ang mga batas na ito sa [negotiation, PR, pakikitungo sa customer] para mas maka-attract o makapanatili ng [partnerships/investments/customers]?' 4. Timing: Mahalaga ang timing sa tagumpay ng negosyo. Ginagabayan ng Laws 28 ('Enter action with boldness') at 35 ('Master the art of timing') ang paggawa ng tamang desisyon sa paglulunsad ng produkto, investments, o partnerships. Halimbawa ng Prompt: 'Batay sa Laws 28 at 35, nagdedesisyon ako tungkol sa [konkretong aksyon, gaya ng pag-launch ng produkto]. Isinasaalang-alang ang [market condition, competition], paano ko malalaman ang pinaka-angkop na oras upang kumilos at maipatupad iyon nang may tapang para mapalaki ang [sales/growth]?' 5. Strategic Withdrawal: Minsan, ang pagiging hindi palaging available ay nakakadagdag respeto at demand sa serbisyo mo. Itinuturo ng Laws 4 ('Always say less than necessary') at 16 ('Use absence to increase respect and honor') ang tamang diskarte sa pagdistansiya. Halimbawa ng Prompt: 'Ayon sa Laws 4 at 16, plano kong umatras muna sa ilang aspeto ng negosyo sa loob ng tatlong buwan. Anong estratehiya ang puwedeng gamitin para mapakinabangan ang pagliban habang nadaragdagan ang respeto at productivity?' 6. Pagprotekta sa Personal na Interes: Mahalagang makita kung saan ka umaasa sa iba. Ang Law 19 ('Know who you're dealing with') at Law 20 ('Do not commit to anyone') ay tutulong sa iyo na mapanatili ang iyong autonomy. Halimbawa ng Prompt: 'Sa pagsunod sa Laws 19 at 20, gusto kong suriin muli ang pag-asa ng business ko sa iba sa [industriya]. Maaari mo ba akong tulungan tukuyin ang mga bahagi ng sobrang pagdepende at magmungkahi ng paraan para maibalik ang autonomy habang patuloy ang magandang relasyon?' 7. Pagtatag ng Social Capital: Ang pagpapalawak ng koneksyon ay nagdadala ng mas maraming opportunity. Ipinapayo ng Law 6 ('Court attention at all costs') at Law 24 ('Play the perfect courtier') ang pagtaas ng visibility at pagpapatatag ng relasyon. Halimbawa ng Prompt: 'Habang tinatarget kong palakihin ang network sa [industriya], anong hakbang ang puwede kong gawin ayon sa Laws 6 at 24 para mapalakas ang brand presence at maplano ang schedule para sa bagong koneksyon? Paano ko masisiguro na makakatulong ito sa pagbuo ng tunay at kapaki-pakinabang na relasyon?' Ang paggamit ng pitong tema na ito mula sa 'The 48 Laws of Power' ay puwedeng magpatibay ng iyong posisyon sa negosyo. Kahit hindi mo gamitin lahat ng batas, makakatulong ang pag-intindi sa mga prinsipyong ito para makita ang galaw ng iba at makaresponde nang wasto. Sa pag-master ng sikolohiya ng tao at mga galaw ng kapangyarihan, mas magiging epektibo kang mag-handle ng business situations at, tulad ng Law 30, magmukhang effortless ang tagumpay mo.

article_content: While on an official five-day trip to the United Kingdom, India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met in London with former British Prime Minister Tony Blair. Their conversation focused on the state of India-UK relations, events in West Asia, and African affairs. Jaishankar’s visit aims to bolster cooperation and bring new energy to the partnership between the nations. Blair, who served as Britain’s Prime Minister from 1997 to 2007, also acted as Middle East Quartet envoy—a coalition of the UN, US, EU, and Russia—seeking progress on Israeli-Palestinian peace efforts. Though the Quartet is now largely dormant, there are recent media claims that Blair is being considered for a humanitarian role in Gaza. Additionally, Jaishankar and his wife Kyoko were invited by UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak and his wife Akshata Murty to a Diwali tea at Downing Street.
translated_content: Habang nasa limang-araw na opisyal na pagbisita sa United Kingdom, nakipagkita si Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar kay dating British Prime Minister Tony Blair sa London. Tinalakay nila ang estado ng ugnayan ng India at UK, mga kaganapan sa West Asia, at mga isyung may kaugnayan sa Africa. Layunin ng pagbisita ni Jaishankar na lalo pang palakasin at bigyan ng bagong sigla ang relasyon ng dalawang bansa. Si Blair, na nagsilbi bilang Prime Minister ng Britain mula 1997 hanggang 2007, ay dating naging envoy ng Middle East Quartet—binubuo ng UN, US, EU, at Russia—na naghangad ng kapayapaan sa pagitan ng Israel at Palestine. Bagama’t hindi na aktibo ang Quartet ngayon, may mga ulat na isinusulong si Blair bilang humanitarian coordinator para sa Gaza. Bukod dito, inimbitahan din sina Jaishankar at ang kanyang asawang si Kyoko ng UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak at ng kanyang asawang si Akshata Murty para sa Diwali tea sa Downing Street.

article_content: On Tuesday, U.S. President Barack Obama commended the significant progress made during the Nuclear Security Summit, noting that countries like Belgium and Italy had eliminated their extra stocks of highly enriched uranium and plutonium. Speaking alongside Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte, Obama highlighted that many nations had committed to improving nuclear security within their borders and supporting international efforts. Obama emphasized that the summit saw real action, not just discussions. Shortly after arriving in the Netherlands for the event, the White House announced a major deal for the disposal of substantial nuclear materials from Japan. He credited world leaders and their teams for driving these achievements forward. The President also outlined measures the United States is taking, such as installing advanced radiation detectors at transport hubs, developing cybersecurity standards for nuclear energy facilities, and producing medical isotopes that don't require materials usable in weapons. However, Obama warned that more remains to be done to secure all nuclear and radioactive materials, to prevent them from threatening global safety, and cautioned against complacency given the potentially devastating results of even one nuclear incident. He pointed out that Ukraine's agreement in 2010 to remove its highly enriched uranium significantly reduced risks there—an important move given current instability in the region. Obama urged participants to clearly define practical tasks to accomplish before the next summit, set for 2016 in Chicago. This was the third gathering of global leaders under this nuclear security initiative, which began in 2009. A previous report from the Center for Nonproliferation Studies noted the U.S. would spend at least $179 billion on its nuclear arsenal between 2010 and 2018.
translated_content: Noong Martes, pinuri ni Pangulong Barack Obama ng Estados Unidos ang malaking progreso na nakamit sa Nuclear Security Summit, kung saan inalis ng mga bansa gaya ng Belgium at Italy ang kanilang sobrang highly enriched uranium at plutonium. Sa press conference kasama si Punong Ministro Mark Rutte ng Netherlands, binigyang-diin ni Obama na maraming bansa ang nangakong paghihigpitan pa ang seguridad ng kanilang mga pasilidad pang-nukleyar at sumusuporta sa mga pandaigdigang hakbang. Binanggit ni Obama na ang summit na ito ay nagbunga ng konkretong mga aksyon, hindi lang puro salita. Matapos niyang dumating sa Netherlands para sa pulong, inanunsyo kaagad ng White House ang isang malaking kasunduan para itapon ang malaking dami ng nuclear material mula sa Japan. Pinuri niya ang mga pinuno at kanilang mga grupo sa pagsulong ng mga tagumpay na ito. Ipinunto rin ng Pangulo ang ilang hakbang ng Estados Unidos, tulad ng paglalagay ng mga makabagong radiation detector sa mga daungan at iba pang transit site, pagbuo ng mga alituntunin sa cybersecurity para sa mga nuclear power plant, at produksyon ng mga medical isotope na hindi nangangailangan ng materyales na kayang gawing armas. Pinaalalahanan ni Obama na marami pang kailangang gawin para tuluyang maprotektahan ang lahat ng nuclear at radiological na materyales upang hindi maging banta sa kaligtasan ng tao, at binalaan ang lahat laban sa pagiging kampante dahil nakapipinsala ang posible kahit isang insidenteng nukleyar. Binanggit niya ang napagkasunduan ng Ukraine noong 2010 na alisin ang kanilang highly enriched uranium, na nakabawas ng panganib—isang mahalagang hakbang lalo na dahil sa kasalukuyang kaguluhan sa lugar. Nanawagan si Obama sa mga kalahok na linawin at tuparin ang mga konkretong tungkulin bago ang susunod na summit sa 2016 sa Chicago. Ito ang ikatlong summit simula nang magsimula ang inisyatibang ito noong 2009. article_content: The Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU) has called on the Federal Government to exclude universities from the list of agencies required to remit 40% of their Internally Generated Revenue (IGR). In a statement signed by its National President, Prof. Emmanuel Osodeke, after the National Executive Council (NEC) meeting at Kaduna State University, ASUU emphasized that universities are not revenue-generating agencies. According to the union, student fees are intended to provide the necessities for quality education. The NEC meeting, held from November 11 to 12, 2023, addressed matters concerning the university system and the nation at large. Prof. Osodeke insisted that deducting 40% of IGR from universities would further impoverish them. The statement read: 'NEC reviewed the implications of the recent directive for federal universities to remit 40% of their Internally Generated Funds to the government treasury. NEC condemns the directive entirely as it would further weaken the Nigerian university system.' ASUU expressed concern over the Accountant General’s continued refusal to pay members’ promotion arrears since 2018. The NEC also highlighted the unsatisfactory handling of the withheld eight months’ salaries from the 2022 strike and urged the government to release these funds unconditionally. The statement noted ongoing victimization of ASUU members at several universities, naming Federal University of Technology Owerri, Ambrose Alli University Ekpoma, Kogi State University Anyigba, Ebonyi State University Abakaliki, and Lagos State University Ojo. NEC praised the resilience of affected members and called on authorities to respect their rights. The NEC also condemned the National Universities Commission’s continued push to impose the Core Curriculum Minimum Academic Standards (CCMAS) on universities, despite its rejection by university senates and academic associations. ASUU reiterated its opposition to the dissolution of university Governing Councils without due legal process, and criticized successive governments for not honoring previous agreements, particularly the 2009 FGN/ASUU agreement. The NEC meeting coincided with Heroes Day—a day to honor ASUU members who greatly contributed to the union or lost their lives in service. Highlights included a lecture delivered by Professor Sheriffdeen Tella titled “Economic Crises, Government Responses and Tertiary Education in Nigeria” and scholarships awarded to outstanding but underprivileged students in public universities.

Sa pahayag na nilagdaan ng kanilang Pambansang Pangulo, Prop. Emmanuel Osodeke, matapos ang National Executive Council (NEC) meeting sa Kaduna State University, binigyang-diin ng ASUU na hindi mga revenue-generating agency ang mga unibersidad. Ayon sa unyon, ang bayad ng mga estudyante ay nakalaan para sa mga kailangan sa de-kalidad na edukasyon. Ang NEC meeting na ginanap noong Nobyembre 11 hanggang 12, 2023, ay tumalakay sa mga isyung may kinalaman sa sistema ng unibersidad at bansa. Iginiit ni Prof. Osodeke na ang pagbabawas ng 40% ng IGR mula sa mga unibersidad ay lalo pang magpapahirap sa mga ito. Ayon sa pahayag: 'Sinuri ng NEC ang epekto ng kamakailang utos sa mga pederal na unibersidad na mag-remit ng 40% ng kanilang Internally Generated Funds sa gobyerno. Mariing tinutulan ito ng NEC dahil lalo lang nitong pahihinain ang sistema ng unibersidad sa bansa.' Ipinahayag ng ASUU ang pagkabahala sa patuloy na hindi pagbabayad ng opisina ng Accountant General sa promotion arrears ng mga miyembro simula pa noong 2018. Binanggit din ng NEC ang hindi kasiya-siyang pagbabayad ng gobyerno sa naantalang walong buwang sweldo dahil sa welga noong 2022, at hiniling ang agarang pagpapalabas ng mga ito. Binigyang-diin sa pahayag ang patuloy na panliligalig sa mga miyembro ng ASUU sa ilang mga unibersidad, kabilang ang Federal University of Technology Owerri, Ambrose Alli University Ekpoma, Kogi State University Anyigba, Ebonyi State University Abakaliki, at Lagos State University Ojo. Muling iginiit ng ASUU ang pagtutol sa pagbuwag ng mga Governing Council ng unibersidad na walang tamang proseso, at binatikos ang mga nakaraang pamahalaan sa hindi pagtupad sa mga napagkasunduang kasunduan, lalo na ang 2009 FGN/ASUU agreement. Ang NEC meeting na ito ay tumapat din sa Heroes Day, isang araw ng pag-alala sa mga miyembrong nag-ambag ng malaki o nagbuwis ng buhay para sa unyon. Tampok dito ang lekturang inihatid ni Propesor Sheriffdeen Tella na may pamagat na “Economic Crises, Government Responses and Tertiary Education in Nigeria” at mga scholarship para sa mahuhusay ngunit kapos-palad na estudyante sa mga pampublikong unibersidad.

article_content:
Steve Jobs offered a heartfelt response to a man whose girlfriend passed away from cancer, revealing his poetic perspective on life and mortality. In April 2010, Jobs replied to James—a fellow Cupertino native—who thanked him for supporting organ donation at Lucile Packard Children's Hospital in Palo Alto, California. Jobs wrote, “You're most welcome, James. I'm sorry about your girlfriend. Life is fragile.”

Jobs, who underwent a liver transplant in 2009, died in October 2011 at age 56 after a seven-year battle with pancreatic cancer. James’ girlfriend died in April 2008 at age 24 from melanoma, which had spread to her liver. James expressed gratitude, saying, “My girlfriend and I are from Cupertino, and it's really nice to see the hometown hero take time out to do this.”

The exchange was first reported by Business Insider and is highlighted in Mark Milian’s book, “Letters to Steve: Inside the E-mail Inbox of Apple's Steve Jobs,” which explores Jobs’ perspectives through his personal correspondence.

Despite his fame, Jobs rarely disclosed his philosophical beliefs in public. Notably, during his 2005 Stanford University commencement address, he said, “Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose.” Jobs also once told the Computerworld Honors Program that he mainly worried about leaving behind friends, children, and work: “We're all going to be dead soon. You never know when you're going to go, but you are going to go pretty soon.”

Former colleague Bob Longo, from Jobs’ time at NeXT Computer, recalled receiving uncharacteristically enthusiastic email replies from Jobs, particularly one celebrating Longo’s successful cancer surgery.

Through his rare but revealing messages, Jobs occasionally shared his deep reflections on life and death.

Nagbigay si Steve Jobs ng taos-pusong sagot sa isang lalaki na namatayan ng kasintahan dahil sa cancer, at dito niya ipinakita ang makata niyang pagtingin sa buhay at kamatayan. Noong Abril 2010, tumugon si Jobs kay James—na taga-Cupertino rin—matapos siyang pasalamatan ni James sa kanyang suporta sa organ donation sa Lucile Packard Children's Hospital sa Palo Alto, California. Isinulat ni Jobs, “You’re most welcome, James. I’m sorry about your girlfriend. Life is fragile.”

Si Jobs, na sumailalim sa liver transplant noong 2009, ay pumanaw noong Oktubre 2011 sa edad na 56 matapos ang pitong taong laban sa pancreatic cancer. Pumanaw naman ang kasintahan ni James noong Abril 2008 sa edad na 24 mula melanoma na kumalat sa kanyang atay. Nagpahayag ng pasasalamat si James at sinabing, “Taga-Cupertino kami ng girlfriend ko, at nakakatuwang makita na naglalaan ng oras ang isang bayani ng bayan para dito.”

Una itong iniulat ng Business Insider at tampok ito sa libro ni Mark Milian na “Letters to Steve: Inside the E-mail Inbox of Apple's Steve Jobs,” na sumisilip sa mga pananaw ni Jobs sa pamamagitan ng personal niyang mga email.

Bagamat kilala siya, madalang ibahagi ni Jobs ang kanyang mga pilosopikal na paniniwala sa publiko. Sa kanyang kilalang talumpati sa Stanford University noong 2005, sinabi niya, “Ang pag-alala na ikaw ay mamamatay ay ang pinakamabisang paraan sa aking karanasan upang iwasan ang bitag na iniisip mong may mawawala ka pa.” Sinabi rin ni Jobs minsan sa Computerworld Honors Program na ang iniisip lang niya ay ang mga maiiwan niyang kaibigan, anak, at trabaho: “Mamamatay din tayong lahat. Hindi mo alam kung kailan, pero mangyayari ito nang mas maaga kaysa inaasahan.”

Naalala naman ng dating kasamahan ni Jobs na si Bob Longo mula sa NeXT Computer na minsan ay tumanggap siya ng email na punong-puno ng tuwa mula kay Jobs matapos gumaling si Longo mula sa cancer surgery.

Sa mga bihira pero makabuluhang mensahe, naibahagi ni Jobs ang kaniyang malalim na pagmumuni-muni sa buhay at kamatayan.

article_content: Over the past week, the sun has exhibited heightened activity, including an increase in sunspots and frequent coronal mass ejections (CMEs). According to Newsweek, this solar activity has significantly affected Earth, which has experienced solar storms and may encounter another one today, November 26. NASA scientists report that one CME could be heading toward Earth. If a CME collides with our planet, it can cause a major geomagnetic storm, potentially disturbing Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere due to the influx of solar plasma. Huw Morgan, head of the Solar Physics group at Aberystwyth University, explained that when a plasma storm from the sun carries a magnetic field opposite in direction to Earth's, it creates a 'perfect storm,' resulting in a larger geomagnetic event. Research from Spaceweather.com indicates that a minor G1-class geomagnetic storm may occur between late November 25 and November 26, as two CMEs are expected to brush Earth's magnetic field. These CMEs resulted from magnetic filaments erupting from the sun earlier in the week. Daniel Brown, an associate professor at Nottingham Trent University, told Newsweek that both solar flares and CMEs are caused when the sun’s magnetic field is twisted and stressed by solar motions. CMEs, or coronal mass ejections, are large bursts of plasma and magnetic fields from the sun’s outer atmosphere, called the corona. The corona is mostly hidden by the sun’s surface but can release billions of tons of material and embedded magnetic fields much stronger than the typical solar wind. CMEs can travel from less than 250 km/s to nearly 3,000 km/s. Disturbances from solar emissions can trigger geomagnetic storms on Earth, which are classified from G1 (minor) to G5 (severe). G1-level storms are relatively common and usually do not threaten life on Earth, but they can impact power grids, satellites, GPS, and mobile devices.

Sabi ng mga siyentipiko ng NASA, may isang CME na posibleng tumama sa Earth. Kapag tumama ito, maaaring magdulot ng malaking geomagnetic storm na gugulo sa magnetic field at atmospera ng Earth dahil sa pagpasok ng solar plasma. Sabi ng Spaceweather.com, posible ang isang bahagyang G1-class geomagnetic storm mula hatinggabi ng Nobyembre 25 hanggang Nobyembre 26, dahil dalawang CME ang inaaasahang sasalubong o dadaanan ang magnetic field ng Earth. article_content: Japan's Nikkei 225 index reached its highest level since March 1990 on Monday before reversing course to close 0.59% lower at 33,388.03. The broader Topix index also declined, ending the day down 0.77% at 2,372.60. According to Takehiko Masuzawa, trading head at Phillip Securities Japan, investors took profits and became cautious following the recent sharp gains in the Nikkei, which has climbed 8% so far this month and is on track for its strongest monthly performance since November 2020. Masuzawa noted that while there are more positive signals than negative for the Nikkei—including robust corporate forecasts, continued share buybacks, and indications that U.S. interest rates have peaked—investors are wary after the rapid rise. Chip-related stocks notably dragged the Nikkei down, with Tokyo Electron falling 0.87% and Advantest dropping 1.55%. Automakers were also under pressure as the yen strengthened against the dollar. Toyota Motor lost 3.89%, and Honda Motor declined 3.78%. The auto and auto parts sector was the weakest among the Tokyo Stock Exchange's 33 industry groups, slumping 3.43%. Conversely, Panasonic Holdings shares jumped 4.98% after the company announced the sale of a stake in its automotive systems business to funds managed by Apollo Global Management. Tokio Marine Holdings surged 5.63% following an increased annual profit forecast and a share buyback plan. The insurance sector was the day's best performer, rising 1.58%. Additional financial news included the Indian government contemplating a move to transfer unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account funds to the Consolidated Fund of India, with provisions for future claims. Apple aims to produce nearly ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India during the current fiscal year, and a family settlement is ongoing involving industrialist Gautam Singhania, whose estranged wife Nawaz Modi is seeking a large portion of his reported $1.4 billion net worth.

Ayon kay Takehiko Masuzawa, trading head ng Phillip Securities Japan, nag-take profit at naging maingat ang mga investor matapos ang matinding pag-akyat ng Nikkei nitong buwan—umabot ito ng 8% at malapit na sa pinakamalakas na monthly performance mula Nobyembre 2020. Binanggit ni Masuzawa na kahit mas marami ang positibong senyales para sa Nikkei—tulad ng matibay na corporate forecast, tuloy-tuloy na share buybacks, at senyales na nasa tuktok na ang U.S. interest rates—nagiging maingat pa rin ang mga investor matapos ang mabilis na pagtaas. Malaking naging dahilan ng pagbaba ng Nikkei ang mga chip-related stocks, kung saan bumagsak ng 0.87% ang Tokyo Electron at 1.55% ang Advantest. Nalugi rin ang mga automaker dahil sa paglakas ng yen laban sa dolyar—bumaba ng 3.89% ang Toyota Motor at 3.78% ang Honda Motor. Ang sektor ng sasakyan at auto parts ang pinakamahinang performance sa 33 grupo ng Tokyo Stock Exchange, bumagsak ng 3.43%. Sa kabilang banda, tumaas ng 4.98% ang shares ng Panasonic Holdings matapos ianunsyo ang pagbenta ng stake sa automotive systems business nila sa mga pondo ng Apollo Global Management. Lumundag ng 5.63% ang Tokio Marine Holdings dahil sa pagtaas ng annual profit forecast at plano para sa share buyback. Ang insurance sector ang nanguna at tumaas ng 1.58%. article_content: India is one of Krafton’s top three markets in terms of user base for games such as PUBG and Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI), even though less than 10% of Indian players pay for these games, according to Krafton India CEO Sean Hyunil Sohn. He notes that willingness to pay among Indian gamers is on the rise. "India is a long-term focus for us, with the gaming market expanding at 10–15% annually. We aim to maintain our leading position and grow alongside the market. India ranks among our top five overall markets and is within the top three by user base," Sohn said. Krafton currently operates BGMI in India, a game similar to PUBG, which was banned by the Indian government in September 2020. BGMI was also ordered blocked, but it was later re-launched in May. Sohn acknowledged that Krafton's paid user base and average revenue per user in India are lower than in more developed gaming markets. "We offer in-app purchases for cosmetics and extra skills, but do not allow real money gaming (RMG) with cash-outs," he said. When asked about entering the RMG segment, Sohn said Krafton is not specialized in this area due to strict regulations in Southeast Asia, including Korea, where the company is based. He compared India’s regulatory environment, which is more liberal like the US and UK, to Southeast Asian countries that prohibit cash-out gaming. Addressing concerns on the gaming industry's societal impact, Sohn explained that Krafton has voluntarily reduced playtime for minors to three hours per day and for adults to six hours, although age verification remains a challenge in India. Accounts registered as minors require parental permission. "No other games have such restrictions; we're more proactive with these measures, but age verification is still tricky in India," Sohn remarked. He also mentioned the possibility of future government guidelines on age verification and said Krafton is awaiting recommendations from the IT ministry. On further investment, Sohn stated Krafton has already invested around $150 million in Indian gaming companies and plans to invest another $150 million over the next 2–3 years. The company intends to launch new games, source titles from Korea and local developers, and nurture the domestic gaming ecosystem through incubator programs and investments in early-stage startups. Other business highlights: India approved its first 100% foreign direct investment in the defense sector, with Sweden’s Saab allowed to set up a rocket manufacturing facility. The State Bank of India reported an 8% rise in Q2 net profit due to steady loan demand and lower provisions. Byju’s, an edtech company, reported ₹3,569 crore in revenue with a reduced EBITDA loss for FY22.

Sabi niya, tumataas ang kagustuhan ng mga gamer sa India na gumastos. "Pangmatagalang pokus namin ang India, at lumalago ang gaming market dito ng 10–15% kada taon. Layunin naming mapanatili ang aming nangungunang posisyon at lumago kasabay ng merkado. Kabilang ang India sa top five markets namin at top three sa user base," ani Sohn. Kasalukuyang pinapatakbo ng Krafton ang BGMI sa India—isang laro na katulad ng PUBG na ipinagbawal ng gobyerno ng India noong Setyembre 2020. Ipinag-utos din ang pag-block ng BGMI, pero muling inilunsad ito noong Mayo. Aminado si Sohn na mas mababa ang bayad na user base at average revenue per user ng Krafton sa India kumpara sa mga mas mauunlad na gaming market. "May mga in-app purchases kami para sa cosmetics at karagdagang skills, pero hindi kami papasok sa real money gaming (RMG) na may cash-out," paliwanag niya. Ikinumpara niya ang regulasyon sa India—mas liberal tulad sa US at UK—sa mga bansang mahigpit na ipinagbabawal ang cash-out. Sa pagharap sa mga isyu tungkol sa epekto ng gaming sa lipunan, ipinaliwanag ni Sohn na boluntaryo nilang binawasan ang playtime ng minors sa tatlong oras bawat araw, at anim na oras para sa adults, pero mahirap pa rin ang age verification sa India. Kailangan ng pahintulot ng magulang sa mga account na nakarehistro bilang minor. "Wala pang ibang laro na may ganitong restrictions. Mas proactive kami sa mga ito, pero nananatiling hamon pa rin ang age verification sa India," diin ni Sohn. Binanggit din niya na posibleng maglabas ng guidelines ang gobyerno tungkol sa age verification, at hinihintay ng Krafton ang mga rekomendasyon mula sa IT ministry. Maglulunsad pa sila ng mga bagong laro mula Korea, iba't ibang bansa, at lokal na developers, at susuportahan pa ang gaming ecosystem sa pamamagitan ng incubator programs at investment sa early-stage startups. Iba pang business highlights: Pinayagan ng India ang una nitong 100% foreign direct investment sa defense sector, kung saan papayagan ang Swedish company na Saab na magtayo ng rocket manufacturing facility. Iniulat din ng State Bank of India ang 8% pag-akyat ng Q2 net profit dahil sa mataas na demand sa loans at mas mababang provisions. Sa ibang balita, iniulat ng edtech na Byju's ang revenue na ₹3,569 crore para sa FY22 na may mas mababang EBITDA loss.

article_content: Egg whites may help lower blood pressure in a way similar to some medications, according to new research. Scientists found that a component in egg whites, called RVPSL, has blood pressure-lowering properties comparable to Captopril, a medication often prescribed for high blood pressure. Dr. Zhipeng Yu and his team at Jilin University in China discovered that RVPSL, a peptide in egg whites, can block the action of ACE—a body enzyme that increases blood pressure. In laboratory tests with rats, the peptide effectively lowered blood pressure without toxic side effects. The research was presented at the National Meeting & Exposition of the American Chemical Society (ACS) in New Orleans. Dr. Yu stated that these results support earlier studies and are promising enough to motivate further research into the health effects of egg white peptides in humans. He suggested that egg white peptides, either consumed as part of eggs or supplements, could eventually serve as an addition to standard high blood pressure treatments. The study echoes 2009 findings from the University of Alberta in Canada, where researchers observed that egg proteins can mimic the action of ACE inhibitors, frequently used to treat high blood pressure. When eggs are digested, they release proteins that act similarly to these drugs, preventing a hormone called angiotensin from narrowing blood vessels. Additionally, researchers at the University of Missouri reported that eating a high-protein breakfast—including eggs—may curb appetite and reduce unhealthy nighttime snacking.

Nadiskubre ni Dr. Zhipeng Yu at ng kanyang team mula sa Jilin University sa China na ang RVPSL, isang peptide sa itlog na puti, ay kayang pigilan ang ACE—isang enzyme sa katawan na nagpapataas ng presyon. Sa laboratoryong eksperimento sa mga daga, napatunayang epektibo ang peptide sa pagpapababa ng presyon ng dugo nang walang masamang epekto. Inilahad ang pananaliksik na ito sa National Meeting & Exposition ng American Chemical Society (ACS) sa New Orleans. Ayon kay Dr. Yu, sinusuportahan ng resulta ang naunang mga pag-aaral at sapat itong dahilan upang ipagpatuloy pa ang mas malalim na pananaliksik sa benepisyo ng egg white peptides sa kalusugan ng tao. Iminungkahi rin niyang maaaring magamit ang egg white peptides, mula sa itlog o bilang supplements, bilang dagdag sa karaniwang gamot para sa mataas na presyon. Kapag natutunaw ang itlog, naglalabas ito ng mga protein na tulad ng epekto ng mga nasabing gamot at napipigilan ang hormone na angiotensin na magpasikip sa ating mga ugat. Bukod pa rito, iniulat ng mga researchers mula sa University of Missouri na ang pagkain ng almusal na mataas sa protina—kabilang ang itlog—ay nakakatulong rin na kontrolin ang gana at nakakapigil sa pagkain ng unhealthy snacks sa gabi.

Members of South Korean girl group Blackpink have been awarded honorary MBEs, marking another example of 'K-pop diplomacy.' The honor was bestowed during the UK state visit of South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol. During the visit, King Charles III praised the global influence of Korean pop culture and specifically acknowledged Blackpink for their advocacy of environmental causes. The MBEs recognize the group’s work as ambassadors for the COP climate summit and their promotion of the UN's sustainable development goals, which has helped raise environmental awareness among millions of young people. A special investiture ceremony took place in the 1844 Room of Buckingham Palace, a venue reserved for distinguished guests. The event underscores the high-level hospitality and strategic significance of the UK-South Korea partnership. 

Blackpink’s members—Roseanne Park, Jennie Kim, Jisoo Kim, and Lalisa Manoban—are now honorary members of the Order of the British Empire and attended a state banquet at Buckingham Palace, along with British royalty and dignitaries, on Tuesday evening. In his speech, the King noted the global appeal of South Korean pop culture and its remarkable ability to capture imaginations. 

Although the King humorously admitted a lack of 'Gangnam Style,' the British military band surprised onlookers outside Buckingham Palace during the changing of the guard by playing K-pop songs instead of traditional marching music. 

The state visit began with a ceremonial welcome for President Yoon, received by the King, Queen Camilla, and the Prince and Princess of Wales, followed by a carriage procession along The Mall. The official banquet featured 170 guests, including UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak and Foreign Secretary Lord Cameron, as well as members of both the British royal family and the South Korean delegation. 

The visit spotlights the shared interests of both nations, with a strong focus on expanding trade and military ties. On Wednesday, President Yoon and Mr. Sunak signed a 'Downing Street Accord,' outlining cooperation in trade, science, technology, and green energy. A defense agreement will strengthen joint efforts to enforce sanctions against North Korea and curb its illegal weapons activities, including joint naval patrols between the South Korean and UK navies.

Later, President Yoon was set to attend a banquet at London’s Guildhall, emphasizing growing economic links and £21 billion in investments from South Korean companies in the UK. Lord Mayor Michael Mainelli planned to highlight the increasing presence of Korean technology firms in the UK and the economic impact of Korean popular culture, saying: 'Like a K-pop single, Korea is climbing up the charts.'

(State visit news summarized from the BBC Royal Watch newsletter.)

article_content: Reuven Lerner, who teaches Python and Pandas, was permanently banned from advertising on Facebook. Puzzled by this action, he asked Facebook for clarification but received only a general automated reply saying that his account didn’t comply with ad standards, without explanations or a chance to appeal. Through LinkedIn, Lerner found that a friend had also experienced something similar, and suspected Facebook’s algorithm may have mistakenly flagged his programming courses as live animal sales—since the terms 'Python' and 'Pandas' are also animal names—an activity not allowed on the platform. Lerner sought help from friends currently and formerly at Meta, but they found the system’s decision irreparable due to a 180-day data retention policy. With all evidence deleted after a year, Lerner’s ad account could not be reinstated. Dissatisfied with the automated and unyielding process, Lerner decided he would advertise on other platforms like Google, where staff are involved in advertising oversight.

Sa LinkedIn, nalaman niya mula sa kaibigan na maaaring napagkamalan ng Facebook algorithm na nagbebenta siya ng totoong hayop na python at panda, dahil bawal ang pagbebenta ng hayop sa platform. Humingi ng tulong si Lerner sa mga kakilala sa Meta, pero hindi rin nagtagumpay dahil sa 180-day data retention policy—nabura na ang lahat ng ebidensya matapos ang isang taon kaya hindi na maibabalik ang kanyang ad account. Dahil dito, pinili ni Lerner na mag-advertise na lang sa ibang platform gaya ng Google, kung saan may mga totoong tao na sumasala ng ads.

article_content: A five-year-old boy in McKeesport, Pennsylvania, is suspected of deliberately starting a fire on Sunday night that resulted in the death of his two-year-old cousin, Ayanna Lisa Brooks. Authorities report the child has a history of setting fires and is believed to have used a lighter to ignite the blaze, which quickly spread through their rented home. Tragically, Ayanna died from smoke inhalation while trying to hide from the flames. At the time of the incident, she was living in a house shared with her mother, her cousin, and other children. Her mother was in Florida with another child when the fire broke out around 11:30 p.m. Three children managed to escape, but Ayanna was found trapped in an upstairs bedroom. Allegheny County District Attorney Stephen Zappala emphasized the evidence pointed to intentional arson. Under Pennsylvania law, children under 10 cannot be charged with murder, but court proceedings might result in the boy being removed from his family. The fire destroyed three homes and seriously damaged a fourth. Investigators noted the possible absence of smoke detectors, which if confirmed would violate safety regulations. The landlord, Steel City Realty Investments, has not commented as the investigation continues.

Dahil dito, namatay ang kanyang dalawang taong gulang na pinsan na si Ayanna Lisa Brooks. Ayon sa mga awtoridad, ang bata ay may kasaysayan ng pagsisimula ng apoy at pinaniniwalaang gumamit ng lighter upang simulan ang sunog na mabilis na kumalat sa kanilang inuupahang bahay. Nakakalungkot, si Ayanna ay namatay dahil sa paglanghap ng usok habang nagtangkang magtago mula sa apoy. Sa panahon ng insidente, nakatira siya sa bahay kasama ang kanyang ina, pinsan, at iba pang mga bata. Nasa Florida ang kanyang ina kasama ang isa pang anak nang sumiklab ang apoy bandang alas-11:30 ng gabi. Tatlong bata ang nakalabas, ngunit natagpuan si Ayanna na na-trap sa isang kwarto sa itaas. Binigyang-diin ni Allegheny County District Attorney Stephen Zappala na ang ebidensya ay nagpapakita ng sinadyang pagsunog (arson). Sa ilalim ng batas ng Pennsylvania, hindi maaaring kasuhan ng murder ang mga batang wala pang 10 taong gulang, ngunit maaaring ipaubaya sa korte kung tatanggalin ang bata sa kanyang pamilya. Tatlong bahay ang tuluyang nasunog at malubhang napinsala ang isa pa. Napag-alaman ng mga imbestigador na posibleng wala ring mga smoke detector, na kung mapapatunayan ay paglabag sa mga panuntunan sa kaligtasan. Hindi pa nagbibigay ng pahayag ang landlord na Steel City Realty Investments habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon.

Charles Poland, a dedicated school bus driver in rural Alabama, was killed while defending the children on his bus from an armed assailant. On Tuesday around 4 p.m., Poland refused to let a gunman take two students, which led to his death. His courageous stand is being celebrated in Dale County, with tributes from school officials, his family, and residents. Poland, who was born in Idaho and later moved to Alabama, shared 43 years of marriage with his wife Mary Janice. He was a devoted father and grandfather, and his affection for the students he drove was well known. He often spoke fondly about the children, treating them as if they were his own. Neighbors remember him as a kind, humble man always willing to help others, expecting nothing in return.

According to media reports, the attacker, Jimmy Lee Dykes, 65, confronted Poland's bus in Midland City. After Poland resisted, Dykes fatally shot him and abducted a 5-year-old boy, taking him to a bunker near Dykes’ home. As of late Thursday, law enforcement stated the boy was unharmed, but negotiations were still in progress. The community plans to honor Poland with both visitation and a funeral service at the Ozark Civic Center. Dale County Schools expressed gratitude for Poland’s heroic act in saving 21 students and described him as a selfless person whose sacrifice left a lasting legacy.

article_content: Lindsay Lohan's lawyer, Mark Heller, has accused prosecutors of leaking confidential details about her rehab plans to TMZ, which he claims resulted in an inaccurate report about where the actress will undergo treatment. Heller, who is currently under investigation for alleged witness tampering in Lohan's probation violation case, called for a probe into the actions of the Santa Monica and Los Angeles city attorneys. 'It's terrible, because Lindsay Lohan or any defendant should be able to trust that their privacy is being protected,' Heller told CNN. The TMZ report claimed Lohan would check into the Seafield Center in Westhampton Beach, New York, for her court-mandated 90 days of substance abuse rehabilitation next month. Heller said the information about the facility was in a 'personal and confidential' email sent only to the two prosecutors. 'Since I was the only one who communicated that information, it seems likely that one of the two prosecutors was the source,' he added. Heller also suggested the leaks could prompt a major investigation in California to determine the source of breaches of confidentiality. A spokesman for the Los Angeles city attorney declined to comment, and the Santa Monica prosecutor was unavailable to respond. Heller said, 'Think about the impact on the facility and the people seeking treatment—if 100 paparazzi show up, it could seriously affect their privacy.' Lohan, 26, was ordered to spend 90 days in rehab instead of jail time for her 'no contest' plea to charges of lying to police about a car crash, reckless driving, and violating probation from a prior shoplifting conviction. Heller expressed frustration that he often learns about developments in the case from the internet before hearing from prosecutors. He criticized the media’s influence, stating, 'These internet outlets are running amok, violating rights, and undermining the judicial system. Lindsay Lohan is the victim and deserves privacy.' Santa Monica police are investigating Heller after claims that he asked Lohan's personal assistant, who was in the car during last June's crash, to falsely testify that he, not Lohan, was driving. The Santa Monica city attorney requested the investigation, according to a source who was not authorized to speak to reporters. Heller dismissed the allegations as 'ridiculous.' Lohan recently appeared on David Letterman’s CBS show with Charlie Sheen to promote 'Scary Movie 5.' During the appearance, she joked about her legal issues but became emotional discussing her upcoming rehab stay, saying, 'I think this is an opportunity for me to focus on what I love in life. I don’t think it's a bad thing; I think it's a blessing.'

Si Heller, na kasalukuyan ding iniimbestigahan sa umano'y pakikialam sa saksi sa kaso ng probation violation ni Lohan, ay nanawagan ng imbestigasyon laban sa mga city attorney ng Santa Monica at Los Angeles. Ayon kay Heller, 'Isipin n'yo ang epekto nito sa pasilidad at sa mga nagpapagamot doon—kapag dumagsa ang paparazzi, malalabag ang kanilang privacy.' Inatasan si Lohan, 26, na magrehab ng 90 araw bilang alternatibo sa pagkakakulong matapos siyang umamin na 'no contest' sa mga kasong pagsisinungaling sa pulis kaugnay ng aksidente sa sasakyan, reckless driving, at paglabag sa probation mula sa naunang kasong shoplifting. Hindi ko ito nakikitang masama; isa itong blessing.'

article_content: Boston Red Sox star David 'Big Papi' Ortiz delivered an emotional message at Fenway Park on Saturday, a day after police captured marathon bombing suspect Dzhokar Tsarnaev. Ortiz used strong language in his speech, but he won't face any fines for it. In fact, his use of profanity was approved by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC). Before the game against the Kansas City Royals, Ortiz addressed a full stadium, thanking Mayor Menino, Governor Patrick, and the entire police department for their efforts over the past week. Standing on the infield as the crowd applauded the officers on the field, Ortiz said, 'This jersey that we wear today, it doesn't say Red Sox. It says Boston. This is our city. Nobody's going to dictate our freedom. Stay strong.' While the FCC has previously taken action for broadcast profanity—such as against FOX Television for live show expletives in 2002 and 2003—Chairman Julius Genachowski supported Ortiz, tweeting: 'David Ortiz spoke from the heart at today's Red Sox game. I stand with Big Papi and the people of Boston.' The Red Sox had canceled Friday's game due to the massive manhunt that shut down much of Boston. In an unrelated incident, veteran sportscaster Al Michaels was arrested and charged with DUI.
