Gumamit si Ortiz ng matinding pananalita, pero hindi siya pagmumultahin. Sa katunayan, aprubado ito ng Federal Communications Commission (FCC). Bago magsimula ang laro kontra Kansas City Royals, nagsalita si Ortiz sa harap ng napupunong stadium, at nagpasalamat kay Mayor Menino, Governor Patrick, at sa buong puwersa ng pulisya sa kanilang ginawa noong nakaraang linggo. Nakatayo sa infield habang pinalakpakan ng mga tao ang mga pulis, sinabi ni Ortiz, 'Ang jersey na suot natin ngayon, hindi lang Red Sox ang nakalagay. Ang nakasulat ay Boston. Ito ang lungsod natin. Walang magdidikta ng ating kalayaan. Laban lang.' Bagamat dati nang kumikilos ang FCC laban sa pagmumura sa broadcast—gaya ng kaso ng FOX Television noong 2002 at 2003—todo suporta si Chairman Julius Genachowski kay Ortiz, at nag-tweet ng: 'Mula sa puso ang sinabi ni David Ortiz sa laro ng Red Sox ngayon. Kasama ako kay Big Papi at sa mga taga-Boston.' Kinansela ng Red Sox ang laro nila noong Biyernes dahil sa malawakang manhunt na nagsara ng malaking bahagi ng Boston. In the affluent Dutch town of Voorburg, crates filled with canned fish, pasta sauce, and beans, along with meat, dairy, and bread stored in a large freezer and walk-in refrigerator, are prepared to support the 'new poor.' Despite the Netherlands’ wealth, more families—especially from the lower middle class—are turning to food banks for help. This surge underscores how poverty is spreading and has made tackling it a key focus in Wednesday’s parliamentary election.

“Should this worsen, it will truly be a social scandal,” said Rob Kuipers, a 70-year-old retired senior civil servant and chairman of the Leidschendam-Voorburg food bank, just a short ride from The Hague. The convergence of rising living costs, chronic shortages of social and affordable housing, and healthcare access constraints are collectively discussed as the crisis of 'security of existence.' Addressing these challenges is a common theme in all parties’ election campaigns.

Maurice Crul, sociology professor at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, noted, “For years, poverty affected a smaller, marginalized group, but now it’s spread into the lower middle class. That’s why the conversation has become prominent.” While poverty has traditionally been a focus for progressive or left-wing parties, Crul adds, “Now, populist right-wing parties and centrists are prioritizing this as well.”

A key centrist, Pieter Omtzigt, formerly of the Christian Democrats and founder of the New Social Contract, has quickly risen in the polls and is expected to play a significant role in coalition talks. Omtzigt, known for his advocacy for society’s marginalized and for uncovering government scandals, is focusing his campaign on combating poverty. “There’s a long list of actions needed to address the cost-of-living crisis,” he said at a campaign event. His party’s platform includes making essential goods affordable through tax and welfare reforms designed to raise disposable income.

The center-right People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD), led by outgoing Prime Minister Mark Rutte and known for supporting the free market, now also promises to help. The VVD pledges to raise the minimum wage so that full-time workers can make ends meet and to provide targeted support for families with children to reduce child poverty.

Echoing these plans, a center-left bloc led by former EU climate chief Frans Timmermans is also calling for an increase in the minimum wage to €16 ($17.40) per hour for those over 21, up from the current €12.79 for a 36-hour week. This increase is aimed at helping workers and those on welfare whose incomes are insufficient.

Nationwide, 176 Dutch food banks serve 38,000 households—totaling 100,000 people—each week. An estimated 1.2 million people in the Netherlands live below the poverty line, though this number has declined slightly since last year’s inflation spike. At the Leidschendam-Voorburg food bank, clients rose from 140 to 250 in a municipality of about 78,000, as the cost-of-living crisis hit. This group now represents up to 700 people, according to Kuipers, but the actual number eligible for food aid may be two or three times higher.

Kuipers now waits to see how the election’s outcomes will turn campaign promises into reality. “Party programs are full of beautiful words and relatively few concrete actions,” he notes, hoping these promises will result in meaningful policy after the vote.

Sa mayamang bayan ng Voorburg sa Netherlands, andam na ipamahagi ang mga kahon ng de-latang isda, pasta sauce, beans, at mga food items—karne, gatas, at tinapay—na nakaimbak sa malalaking freezer at walk-in refrigerator, para suportahan ang 'bagong mahihirap.' Sa kabila ng kasaganaan ng bansa, dumarami ang mga pamilyang lower middle class na lumalapit sa mga food bank. Ipinapakita nito kung paano kumakalat ang kahirapan—kaya ito ngayon ang pangunahing isyu sa nalalapit na parliamentary election sa Miyerkules.

"Kapag lumala pa ito, magiging tunay na iskandalo sa lipunan," sabi ni Rob Kuipers, 70-taong-gulang na retiradong senior civil servant at chairman ng Leidschendam-Voorburg food bank, malapit lang sa The Hague. Ang pagtaas ng gastusin sa pamumuhay, chronic na kakulangan ng abot-kayang pabahay, at limitadong access sa healthcare ay itinuturing na krisis ng 'seguridad sa pamumuhay.' Lahat ng partido ay nagtutuon dito sa kanilang election campaigns.

Ayon kay Maurice Crul, propesor ng sosyolohiya sa Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, “Dati, maliit lang at mga laylayan ang apektado ng kahirapan, pero ngayon pati lower middle class damay na, kaya malaking usapin na ito.” Kahit dating isinusulong lang ng mga progresibo o kaliwang partido ang isyung ito, ngayon pati kanang populista at centrists ay inuuna na rin ito.

Isa sa mga sentro ng isyu ay si Pieter Omtzigt, dating Christian Democrat at nagtatag ng New Social Contract. Lumalakas ang kanyang pangalan sa survey at inaasahang magkakaroon ng mahalagang papel sa coalition talks. Kilala siya sa pagtatanggol sa mga naaapi at pagbubunyag ng iskandalo sa gobyerno, at nakatutok ang campaign niya sa paglaban sa kahirapan. “Mahaba ang listahan ng kailangang gawin para tugunan ang cost-of-living crisis,” pahayag niya sa isang campaign event. Nasa plataporma ng kanyang partido ang gawing abot-kaya ang mga pangunahing pangangailangan, sa pamamagitan ng reporma sa buwis at welfare para tumaas ang disposable income ng tao.

Pati ang People’s Party for Freedom and Democracy (VVD), sentro-kanan at pinangungunahan ni outgoing Prime Minister Mark Rutte, na dati ay para sa mayayaman at pro-free market, nangangakong tutulong din. Layunin ng VVD na taasan ang minimum wage para makasapat ang kinikita ng full-time workers, at magbigay ng target na tulong sa mga pamilya na may anak laban sa kahirapan ng kabataan.

Kasabay nito, nais din ng center-left bloc sa pamumuno ni dating EU climate chief Frans Timmermans na itaas ang minimum wage sa €16 (€17.40) kada oras para sa higit 21 taong gulang, mula €12.79 sa 36-hour work week. Punong layunin nito na matulungan ang mga manggagawa at pagsuporta sa welfare beneficiaries na kulang ang kita.

Sa buong Netherlands, may 176 food banks na tumutulong sa 38,000 pamilya—katumbas ng 100,000 katao—linggo-linggo. Tinatayang 1.2 milyong tao ang nasa ibaba ng poverty line, bahagyang nabawasan kumpara noong mataas pa ang inflation. Sa Leidschendam-Voorburg food bank, umakyat ang kliyente mula 140 hanggang 250 sa isang lugar na may 78,000 na populasyon, dulot ng cost-of-living crisis. Sabi ni Kuipers, hanggang 700 katao ang natutulungan pero maaaring dalawa o tatlong beses pa roon ang talagang karapat-dapat makatanggap ng food aid.

Ngayon, naghihintay si Kuipers kung paano matutupad ang mga pangako ng mga partido matapos ang halalan. “Puno ng magagandang salita pero konti lang ang konkretong plano,” aniya, at umaasang magiging gawa, hindi lang salita, ang mga pangakong iyon pagkatapos ng botohan.
post_content: Poverty is rising in the Netherlands—even in rich towns like Voorburg! With food banks busier than ever, the cost-of-living crisis and housing woes are now election hot topics. Politicians are making big promises—will they deliver? #Netherlands #Election #CostOfLiving

Responding to complaints about the government's plan to assign senior bureaucrats to its proposed Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra starting November 20, the Election Commission (EC) instructed Cabinet Secretary Rajiv Gauba to ensure the program does not proceed in five states facing upcoming elections and a by-election constituency in Nagaland until after the polls conclude on December 5. The Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra, a two-month initiative, will be launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 15 in Khunti, Jharkhand—the birthplace of freedom fighter and tribal leader Birsa Munda. 

The Congress party has alleged that the BJP is attempting to politicize the bureaucracy by involving civil servants in government publicity efforts ahead of elections. This debate highlights the enduring popularity and political impact of 'yatras'—nationwide political marches—as campaign tools in India. 

Notably, actor-turned-politician N T Rama Rao's 'Chaitanya Ratham' rally in 1982, covering nearly 40,000 km across the state, led the TDP to a historic victory in 1983. In 1983-84, former Prime Minister Chandra Shekhar embarked on a 'padyatra' from Kanyakumari to Delhi, walking over 4,000 km and earning national attention that contributed to his ascension as Prime Minister in 1990. That same year, BJP leader L K Advani launched his 'Rath Yatra', traveling 10,000 km; his arrest in Bihar marked a turning point for the BJP at the national level. 

In December 1991, the BJP held an 'Ekta Yatra' from Kanyakumari to Kashmir, culminating with party leaders hoisting the national flag in Srinagar amid heavy security. Narendra Modi, then a rising party figure, played a key role. A similar 'Ekta Yatra' was organized in 2011, led by Anurag Thakur and attended by senior BJP leaders, to reinforce national unity and recall the legacy of Syama Prasad Mookerjee's opposition to Kashmir's special status.

In the run-up to the 2019 Andhra Pradesh Assembly elections, YSRCP chief Y S Jagan Mohan Reddy completed a massive 'Praja Sankalpa Yatra', walking 3,648 km over 241 days, meeting millions of voters, and ultimately securing a sweeping electoral win. He followed in the footsteps of his father, Y S Rajasekhar Reddy, whose 1,400-km padyatra in 2003 led to a landmark Congress victory in 2004.

Both leading national parties are planning yatras ahead of the 2024 polls. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's 'Bharat Jodo Yatra' recently covered 3,970 km across 12 states and two Union territories. Likewise, the BJP-led central government is proposing a 'Grameen Samvaad Yatra', a major outreach drive to showcase achievements and expand beneficiary coverage for government schemes.

Ang Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra, isang dalawang-buwang inisyatiba, ay ilulunsad ni Punong Ministro Narendra Modi sa Nobyembre 15 sa Khunti, Jharkhand—ang lugar ng kapanganakan ng bayani ng kalayaan at lider ng mga katutubo na si Birsa Munda.

Ayon sa partido ng Kongreso, sinusubukan ng BJP na politisahin ang burukrasya sa pamamagitan ng pagsali ng mga kawani ng gobyerno sa kampanya bago ang eleksiyon. Lumilitaw sa isyung ito ang patuloy na lakas ng 'yatra'—malalaking paglalakbay sa bansa—bilang mga mabisang kampanyang pampulitika sa India.

Kabilang sa mga kilalang halimbawa ang 'Chaitanya Ratham' rally ni N T Rama Rao noong 1982 na umabot ng halos 40,000 km sa buong estado at nagdala sa TDP sa makasaysayang panalo noong 1983. Noong 1983-84, nagsimula si dating Punong Ministro Chandra Shekhar ng 'padyatra' mula Kanyakumari hanggang Delhi, naglakad ng mahigit 4,000 km at nakapukaw ng pansin ng buong bansa—na tumulong sa kaniyang pagiging Punong Ministro noong 1990. Noong taon ding iyon, inilunsad ni BJP leader L K Advani ang kaniyang 'Rath Yatra,' na naglakbay ng 10,000 km; dulot ng kaniyang pagkakaaresto sa Bihar, nagkaroon ng malaking epekto sa pambansang politika ng BJP.

Noong Disyembre 1991, nagsagawa ang BJP ng 'Ekta Yatra' mula Kanyakumari hanggang Kashmir, at nagtapos ito sa pagwawagayway ng pambansang bandila sa Srinagar sa ilalim ng mahigpit na seguridad. Kabilang si Narendra Modi, noon ay tumataas pa lang na lider ng partido, bilang pangunahing kalahok. Isa pang 'Ekta Yatra' ay isinagawa noong 2011, pinamunuan ni Anurag Thakur at nilahukan ng mga senior leader ng BJP, upang itaguyod ang pagkakaisa ng bansa at gunitain ang pagtutol ni Syama Prasad Mookerjee sa espesyal na katayuan ng Kashmir.

Bilang paghahanda sa 2019 Andhra Pradesh Assembly elections, isinagawa ni Y S Jagan Mohan Reddy ng YSRCP ang malaking 'Praja Sankalpa Yatra', naglakad ng 3,648 km sa loob ng 241 araw, nakipagtagpo sa milyon-milyong botante, at nagtamo ng landslide victory. Sinundan niya ang yapak ng kaniyang amang si Y S Rajasekhar Reddy, na nagsagawa rin ng 1,400 km padyatra noong 2003 na nagbigay ng landslide win sa Kongreso noong 2004.

Ngayong papalapit ang 2024, parehong gumagamit ng mga yatra ang dalawang pangunahing partido. Nitong huli, pinangunahan ni Rahul Gandhi ng Kongreso ang 'Bharat Jodo Yatra,' na tumawid ng 3,970 km sa 12 estado at dalawang Union territories. Samantala, plano rin ng pamahalaang pinamumunuan ng BJP ang 'Grameen Samvaad Yatra,' isang malawakang outreach para ipakita ang mga nagawa ng pamahalaan at palawakin pa ang benepisyo ng mga national schemes.

article_content: A new study published by researchers from KAUST in Nature Communications reveals that corals, jellyfish, and other symbiotic cnidarians manage their symbiotic algae by limiting nitrogen availability. This discovery challenges traditional views of cooperative symbiosis in corals and has important implications for major coral reef restoration efforts, such as the KAUST Reefscape Restoration Initiative covering over 100 hectares of the Red Sea. By tracking nutrient exchange with carbon and nitrogen isotopes, the study demonstrates how three distinct cnidarian species, including corals, have independently evolved a common mechanism for managing symbiosis with marine algae (dinoflagellates). Researchers explored how sea anemones, jellyfish, and corals control their algal symbiont populations by tracing carbon and nitrogen isotopes in glucose and ammonium, respectively. They found that higher levels of ammonium result in larger algae populations due to increased nitrogen access, while higher glucose levels decrease algae populations, as glucose boosts the host's ability to assimilate its own nitrogen waste. According to KAUST Professor Manuel Aranda, who led the study, 'The hosts use the sugar provided by the symbionts via photosynthesis to assimilate their own nitrogen waste into amino acids. This limits the nitrogen available to the symbionts. Essentially, the host delivers just enough nitrogen for the symbiont to function and photosynthesize, but not enough to allow the produced sugar to be used for unchecked proliferation.' The symbiosis between algae and cnidarians is crucial for the survival of cnidarians in the nutrient-poor waters of the tropics, and the relationship is so intimate that algal symbionts live inside the hosts' cells. However, for healthy growth, the population of symbionts must be strictly regulated. Lead researcher Dr. Guoxin Cui commented, 'Climate change will significantly disrupt the carbon-nitrogen balance in cnidarian-algae symbiosis. This disturbance can trigger the breakdown of the relationship, commonly known as coral bleaching, leading to a global decline in coral reefs.' 'Understanding the molecular mechanisms behind these symbioses — particularly the carbon-nitrogen negative feedback loop — opens new opportunities for reef restoration strategies, such as selecting symbiotic partners that form more resilient colonies under environmental changes.' The study’s findings are expected to inspire further investigation into these regulatory processes and inform policies for developing effective restoration strategies. Professor Aranda concluded: 'By confirming that the same mechanism operates in distinct species, we demonstrated that a shared process allowed these symbioses to evolve multiple times. Nature’s solutions are often both clever and simple, providing us with a framework to better understand corals and their sensitivity to climate change.'
translated_content: Isang bagong pag-aaral na inilathala ng mga mananaliksik mula KAUST sa Nature Communications ang nagpapakita na ang mga korales, dikya, at iba pang cnidarian na may kasamang alga ay kinokontrol ang kanilang symbiotic na alga sa pamamagitan ng paglilimita ng nitrogen. Ang tuklas na ito ay sumasalungat sa tradisyonal na pananaw ng pagtutulungan sa pagitan ng mga korales at may mahalagang implikasyon sa malalaking proyekto ng pagpapanumbalik ng coral reef tulad ng KAUST Reefscape Restoration Initiative na sumasaklaw ng higit sa 100 ektarya ng Red Sea. Sa pamamagitan ng pagsubaybay sa paglipat ng sustansya gamit ang carbon at nitrogen isotopes, ipinakita ng pag-aaral kung paano tatlong magkaibang species ng cnidarian, kabilang ang mga korales, ang nakabuo ng magkaparehong mekanismo para sa pamamahala ng symbiosis sa mga marine algae (dinoflagellates). Sinuri ng mga mananaliksik kung paano kinokontrol ng sea anemone, dikya, at mga korales ang populasyon ng kanilang mga algal symbiont gamit ang pagsubaybay sa carbon at nitrogen isotopes sa glucose at ammonium, ayon sa pagkakabanggit. Natuklasan nila na mas mataas na ammonium ay nagdudulot ng mas malalaking populasyon ng algae dahil sa mas maraming nitrogen, habang mas mataas na glucose ay nagpapababa ng bilang ng algae dahil pinapalakas nito ang kakayahan ng host na magsipsip ng sarili nitong nitrogen waste. Ayon kay Prof. Manuel Aranda ng KAUST na nanguna sa pag-aaral, 'Ginagamit ng mga host ang asukal na ibinibigay ng symbiont sa pamamagitan ng photosynthesis upang maisama ang kanilang nitrogen waste sa amino acids. Nililimitahan nito ang nitrogen na napupunta sa symbiont. Sa esensya, tanging sapat lang na nitrogen ang ibinibigay ng host para gumana at mag-photosynthesize ang symbiont, ngunit hindi sapat upang magamit ang asukal para sa labis na pagdami.' Napakahalaga ng symbiosis sa pagitan ng algae at cnidarian para mabuhay ang mga cnidarian sa mahihirap na tubig ng tropiko. Sobrang lapit ng ugnayan na ang mga symbiont ay nasa loob mismo ng mga cell ng host. Gayunman, upang lumago nang malusog ang dalawang organismo, kailangang mahigpit ang regulasyon ng dami ng symbiont. Ayon kay Dr. Guoxin Cui, ang nanguna sa pananaliksik, 'Malaki ang magiging epekto ng climate change sa carbon-nitrogen balance ng cnidarian-algae symbiosis. Ang ganitong abala ay maaaring magdulot ng pagkasira ng ugnayan na kilala bilang coral bleaching na mauuwi sa pandaigdigang pagbaba ng coral reefs.' 'Ang pag-unawa sa molekular na mga mekanismo sa likod ng symbiosis na ito—lalo na ang carbon-nitrogen negative feedback loop—ay nagbubukas ng bagong mga oportunidad upang mapabuti ang estratehiya para sa reed restoration, lalo na sa pagpili ng mas matatag na mga kombinasyon ng symbiotic partners sa harap ng mga pagbabago sa kapaligiran.' Inaasahan na ang mga natuklasan sa pag-aaral ay magsusulong ng dagdag pang pananaliksik sa mga regulatoryong prosesong ito at makakatulong sa paggawa ng polisiya para sa mas epektibong estratehiya ng restoration. Dagdag pa ni Professor Aranda: 'Sa pagpapatunay na gumagana ang magkaparehong mekanismo sa iba't ibang species, naipakita namin na nag-evolve ng magkahiwalay ngunit magkatulad na paraan ang symbiosis na ito. Isa itong halimbawa kung paanong matalino pero simple ang kalikasan, at nagbibigay ito ng framework para mas maintindihan ang mga korales at ang pagiging sensitibo nila sa climate change.'

article_content: James Giles, an independent councillor from Kingston, emailed nearly 19,000 councillors, urging them to sign a letter advocating a ceasefire in Gaza. He indicated that those declining to sign could have their names made public, framing this as a matter of accountability. This tactic was widely criticized, with some councillors accusing him of blackmail and expressing worries over safety, particularly in light of past attacks on politicians. Robert Reiss, a Liberal Democrat from Sheffield, backed the ceasefire call but refused to sign, calling Giles' approach coercive. Labour councillor Matt Dent from Southend described the email as a potential threat to councillor safety, especially given the previous fatal attack on David Amess. Rachel Garrick of Labour in Monmouthshire said she would not sign any letter she perceived as using intimidation tactics. In response to the criticism, Giles clarified in a follow-up email that he did not plan to publish the names of councillors who objected to being publicly identified. He also issued a public apology to anyone who felt uncomfortable or threatened, maintaining that his motivation was transparency and public accountability. Giles told the BBC he believed he acted appropriately and never intended to name those simply not responding. The letter, co-written by Conservative councillor Jamal Chohan, was addressed to Prime Minister Rishi Sunak and Labour leader Keir Starmer. It called for efforts to support a lasting peace, denounced collective punishment by all parties, and emphasized that accusations of antisemitism should not be used to excuse violations of international law by Israel. The Local Government Association (LGA) condemned Giles' email, saying the message caused undue concern and did not reflect the organization’s values. Giles has temporarily stepped down from LGA duties but remains adamant that it is not a permanent resignation. The LGA also reported that both the police and the UK data privacy regulator had been notified, though Giles said he had not heard from them. Jamal Chohan, having been suspended by his local Conservative Association, subsequently left the party. He accused the party of suppressing those advocating for peace and said he was unwilling to apologize for a controversy he did not cause. Chohan expressed that he felt betrayed and disillusioned by the party’s response.
translated_content: Nagpadala si James Giles, isang independent counsellor mula Kingston, ng email sa halos 19,000 councillors na hinihikayat silang pumirma sa isang liham na nananawagan ng tigil-putukan sa Gaza. Sinabi niya na maaaring isapubliko ang mga pangalan ng tumangging pumirma, bilang bahagi daw ng accountability. Maraming tumutol sa pamamaraang ito—ilang councillor ang nag-akusa sa kanya ng blackmail at naghayag ng pangamba sa kaligtasan, lalo na pagkatapos ng ilang insidente ng pag-atake sa mga politiko. Si Robert Reiss, isang Liberal Democrat mula Sheffield, ay sumuporta sa panawagan ng tigil-putukan, ngunit tumangging pumirma at tinawag na mapilit ang paraan ni Giles. Itinuring ni Matt Dent, Labour councillor mula Southend, na banta sa kaligtasan ng mga councillor ang email lalo na’t may insidente ng pagpatay kay David Amess. Ayon kay Rachel Garrick ng Labour sa Monmouthshire, hindi siya pipirma sa kahit anong liham na gumagamit ng intimidasyon. Matapos ang mga batikos, nilinaw ni Giles sa sumunod na email na hindi niya planong ilabas ang pangalan ng councillors na tumutol isapubliko ang pangalan nila. Naghayag din siya ng paumanhin sa sinumang nakaramdam ng takot o discomfort, at iginiit na transparency at accountability sa publiko ang kanyang hangarin. Sinabi ni Giles sa BBC na naniniwala siyang tama ang ginawa niya at wala siyang balak pangalanan ang mga hindi lang tumugon. Ang liham, na isinulat din ni Conservative councillor Jamal Chohan, ay ipinadala kina Punong Ministro Rishi Sunak at Labour leader Keir Starmer. Nanawagan ito ng suporta para sa pangmatagalang kapayapaan, kinondena ang collective punishment mula sa dalawang panig, at iginiit na hindi dapat gamitin ang antisemitismo para lusutan ng Israel ang paglabag sa international law. Kinondena ng Local Government Association (LGA) ang email ni Giles, sinabing nagdulot ito ng labis na pag-aalala at hindi sumasalamin sa mga prinsipyo ng organisasyon. Pansamantalang nagbitiw si Giles sa mga opisyal na tungkulin niya sa LGA pero iginiit niyang hindi ito permanenteng pagre-resign. Sabi rin ng LGA, kabatiran ng pulis at UK data privacy regulator ang isyu, subalit ani Giles, hindi pa siya natatawagan ng mga ito. Matapos masuspinde ni Jamal Chohan ng kanyang lokal na Conservative Association, kusa siyang nagbitiw sa partido. Inakusahan niya ang partido na pinatatahimik ang mga tagapagtaguyod ng kapayapaan at tumangging mag-sorry para sa isyung hindi naman siya sangkot. Ibinahagi ni Chohan ang pagkabigo at pagkadismaya niya sa naging tugon ng partido.
post_content: Massive email row! Kingston councillor James Giles urged 19k councillors to back a Gaza ceasefire. He said he’d name those who refused, leading to blackmail claims and resignations. Now, LGA is investigating. #GazaCeasefire #LocalPolitics #Accountability

article_content: Fifteen-year-old Ben Pasternak from Sydney created one of the world's most popular apps, 'Impossible Rush', in just a couple of hours while bored during his Year 9 science class. He collaborated with Chicago-based teenager Austin Valleskey, whom he met through a Facebook group called 'High School Hackers.' Since its launch in August, 'Impossible Rush' has rapidly climbed the app charts in the US, Sweden, and Australia, achieving over 300,000 downloads within six weeks. In an interview, Ben expressed his excitement about the app reaching the number three spot in the Australian App Store, surpassing major platforms like Instagram, Pinterest, Spotify, and Shazam. Despite being a bright student at Reddam House School, Ben admits that his focus has shifted towards app development, which he currently prioritizes over his schoolwork. Ben and Austin developed their app quickly: Ben designed the graphics in Photoshop and sent them to Austin, who built the prototype using Xcode within an hour. They launched it shortly after. Marketing for the app improved when they sold it for $200 to Carlos Fajardo, a social media marketer from New York, who helped boost its visibility. Now, Ben is working on a new project called 'One,' aimed at combining Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram into a single streamlined app—a project that has taken months to develop. Ben is passionate about creating engaging technology and enjoys the challenge, although balancing it with school is sometimes stressful. His journey in tech began at age eight while playing the online game Club Penguin, where his curiosity led him to experiment and learn independently. Increased attention from his success has resulted in job offers and invitations to motivate students, but he remains focused on his own ventures. Ben's involvement in the High School Hackers group provided him support and inspiration, as he values the collaborative spirit and advice from peers. Ben still enjoys typical teenage activities and makes time for fun, but admits he sometimes places app development above school obligations, which occasionally leads to trouble with teachers. He first gained some public attention through a YouTube channel where he reviewed Apple products. Ben believes being a young developer gives him a unique understanding of what appeals to other young people. He credits his peers and online communities for encouragement, emphasizing the importance of appealing design and universal appeal for his projects. Ben is determined to see 'One' reach the top of the App Store rankings and is committed to both his education and entrepreneurial goals. The new app is expected to launch within the next one to two months.
translated_content: Nagawa ni Ben Pasternak, isang 15-anyos mula Sydney, ang isa sa pinakasikat na apps sa mundo na tinawag na ‘Impossible Rush’, sa loob lang ng ilang oras habang naiinip siya sa science class ng Year 9. Nakipag-collaborate siya kay Austin Valleskey, isang teenager mula Chicago na nakilala niya sa Facebook group na 'High School Hackers.' Mula nang ilunsad ito noong Agosto, mabilis na umangat ang 'Impossible Rush' sa app charts ng US, Sweden, at Australia—may mahigit 300,000 downloads sa loob ng anim na linggo. Sa isang panayam, ibinahagi ni Ben ang tuwa nang umabot sa number three ang app sa Aussie App Store, natalo pa ang malalaking platforms gaya ng Instagram, Pinterest, Spotify, at Shazam. Kahit matalino si Ben sa Reddam House School, inamin niyang mas binibigyang-prioridad niya ngayon ang paggawa ng apps kaysa sa pag-aaral. Mabilis nilang nagawa ni Austin ang app: Disenyo ni Ben gamit ang Photoshop, tapos ipinasa kay Austin na gumawa ng prototype gamit ang Xcode sa loob ng isang oras. Agad din nila itong nilunsad. Lalo pang sumikat ang app nang ibenta nila ito sa halagang $200 kay Carlos Fajardo, isang social media marketer mula New York, na tumulong mapansin ito. Ngayon, abala si Ben sa bagong proyekto niyang 'One,' na layong pagsamahin ang Facebook, Twitter, at Instagram sa isang sleek na app—ilang buwan na niyang tinatrabaho ito. Passionate si Ben sa paggawa ng teknolohiya at ine-enjoy niya ang hamon, kahit minsan ay nakaka-stress pagsabayin sa school. Nagsimula ang interes niya sa tech noong walo pa lang siya at naglalaro ng Club Penguin, kung saan natutunan niyang mag-explore at matuto nang mag-isa. Dahil sa tagumpay niya, marami na siyang natanggap na job offers at mga imbitasyon para magmotivate ng mga estudyante, pero tutok pa rin siya sa mga sariling proyekto. Malaking tulong kay Ben ang High School Hackers group dahil dito siya kumukuha ng suporta at inspirasyon, lalo na mula sa payo ng mga kapwa kabataan. Nagagawa pa rin ni Ben ang tipikal na buhay-teenager—nagsasaya at nagrerelax—pero inaamin niyang minsan inuuna niya ang app kaysa schoolwork na minsan dahilan ng issue sa teachers. Una siyang nakilala sa YouTube channel kung saan nagrereview siya ng Apple products. article_content: When Ozempic entered the market, I began to rethink how I practice medicine. As this new class of weight-loss drugs signaled a higher level of medical involvement in America’s obsession with thinness, I decided to stop urging my patients to lose weight. I sometimes refer to myself as a 'body-positive doctor,' although that doesn’t fully capture my perspective—my goal isn't to expect all patients to love their bodies at every moment. With my students, I call it 'weight-neutral medicine.' I’ve connected with a like-minded community of health care providers in the Health at Every Size movement, which advocates for health without an exclusive focus on weight loss. My change in approach began—as many of my realizations do—with reading. Memoirs from authors such as Roxane Gay, Lindy West, and Kiese Laymon described the harm they experienced at medical appointments because of their weight. I recognized aspects of myself in some of their stories, recalling times I’d told patients that weight loss might help their pain—as if they hadn’t considered or tried that already. These books also made me reckon with my own experiences regarding weight and medical care. As a teen, I remember feeling anxious during doctor visits, fearing the moment I had to step on the scale. One doctor even criticized my mother for buying 2% milk instead of skim. When I lost weight in my twenties, clinic visits shifted to my real concerns rather than calorie cutting. Yet as my body changed over time, weight again became the focus at appointments. I recall a midwife complimenting me for not gaining much weight during pregnancy—though the reality was I’d spent months suffering from anxiety and barely able to eat. That shouldn’t be a cause for congratulations. This led me to pledge not to make my patients endure similar experiences. Part of why I evolved my approach—beyond Ozempic’s arrival—was the realization that weight counseling from primary care doctors is typically ineffective. I also learned more about BMI’s questionable origins. BMI, weight divided by height squared, was devised by a 19th-century Belgian astronomer and mathematician aiming to define the 'average man'—white, European, and male—ignoring genetic and muscular differences. Still, medicine fixates on this measure. In my clinic, the electronic record flags red any BMI over 26, and medical education centers on such metrics. Most clinicians can provide examples where BMI is misleading: patients with high BMI but perfect blood pressure and glucose control, and thin patients with serious illnesses. Medical organizations are acknowledging that BMI isn’t always predictive of health. Ultimately, I stopped focusing on weight because advising patients to lose pounds rarely works, and often leaves them feeling worse. It can also distract from more important health issues. Research shows doctors are frequently responsible for weight stigma, and patients subjected to such judgment often delay care, avoid exercise, and are at higher risk for depression. I want no part in perpetuating that. Instead, I focus on other indicators of health: blood pressure, insulin resistance, joint pain. Of course, diet and exercise impact these, and eating less processed food or being more active is beneficial—potentially even leading to weight loss. But for me and my patients, health improvement—not weight loss—is the goal. I notice my patients seem relieved when they realize I won't focus on their weight. It leads to more open, trusting relationships. One patient's mother told me her son gained enough confidence to start playing sports because I approached their care differently. Ironically, patients often embrace healthy change when they’re not shamed about weight. However, the advent of Ozempic marked a cultural turning point. Unlike many fad diets or dubious supplements, this medication produces real weight loss for some. As my patients began requesting Ozempic, I considered how this fit with my weight-neutral approach. I ask patients why they want to lose weight—often, what they seek is more energy or health, which can be achieved by habit changes alone. Some are honest about cosmetic motives, which I respect; it’s not my role to withhold Ozempic solely because it doesn’t align with my philosophy. One patient, emotionally worn out by daily fatphobia, asked for Ozempic despite medically healthy markers. Ultimately, practicing weight-neutral medicine means respecting patients’ autonomy in decisions about their bodies. That said, not everyone tolerates Ozempic’s side effects; some prefer not to use it because of persistent nausea. Others experience significant weight loss—but then face new issues, such as being treated differently by society, or experiencing depression. Many patients and even fellow doctors believe weight loss is the answer to all problems, but this isn’t always true. Sometimes, weight loss is a distraction from real health concerns. We need more holistic approaches to health and to end the stigma against large bodies—which can prevent people from embracing healthy lives. I cannot eradicate our culture’s fatphobia, but I can strive to ensure each patient feels valued and safe, and understands that health isn’t determined solely by weight. Mara Gordon is a family physician in Camden, N.J., and an NPR contributor. She tweets at @MaraGordonMD. This story was edited by Carmel Wroth (NPR) with an illustration by Nicole Xu and art direction by Pierre Kattar.
translated_content: Nang lumabas ang Ozempic, nagsimula akong pag-isipan muli kung paano ko isinasagawa ang medisina. Habang dumarami ang gumagamit ng bagong uri ng gamot para sa pagbabawas ng timbang, napagtanto kong ayoko na pilitin ang mga pasyente kong magpapayat. Minsan tinatawag kong sarili ko na “body-positive doctor,” pero hindi iyon eksakto—hindi ko inaasahan na mamahalin agad ng bawat pasyente ang katawan nila. Tinatawag ko itong “weight-neutral medicine” kapag kasama ko ang mga estudyante. Natagpuan ko ang komunidad ng mga health care provider na naniniwala sa Health at Every Size movement, na nagtutulak ng kalusugan kahit walang pokus sa pagbabawas ng timbang. Nagsimula ang pagbabago ko—tulad ng maraming realizations ko—dahil sa pagbabasa. Ang mga memoir nina Roxane Gay, Lindy West, at Kiese Laymon ay nagkuwento ng hirap nila kapag nagkakaroon ng appointment sa doktor dahil sa timbang nila. Nakita ko ang sarili ko sa ilang istorya nila, naalala ko noong sinabi ko sa pasyente kong baka gumaan ang pakiramdam kapag pumayat sila—na para bang hindi pa nila naisip iyon. Pinag-isip din ako ng mga librong iyon tungkol sa sarili kong karanasan sa timbang at pagpunta sa doktor. Bilang teenager, naaalala kong kinakabahan ako tuwing may checkup at kailangang tumayo sa timbangan. May doktor pang pinagalitan ang nanay ko dahil bumili ng 2% na gatas at hindi skim. Noong pumayat ako nung twenties ko, naging mas nakatuon na ako sa totoong concerns ko tuwing checkup. Pero habang nagbabago ang katawan ko, naging pokus nanaman ang timbang ko sa mga appointment. Noong malapit na akong manganak, may midwife pang nagbigay ng papuri dahil hindi ako tumaba nang sobra—kahit halos wala akong makain dahil sa anxiety. Hindi iyon dapat ikatuwa. Dahil dito, nangako ako sa sarili ko na hindi ko ipaparanas sa pasyente ko ang ganoon. Isa sa mga nagbago ng paniniwala ko—bukod pa sa pagdating ng Ozempic—ay naisip kong madalas walang saysay ang payong magpapayat mula sa doktor gaya ko. Nalaman ko ring may problema ang origin ng BMI. Ang BMI, na base lang sa taas at timbang, ay galing sa isang Belgian astronomer noong 19th century na “average man” daw—puti, Europeo, at lalaki lang—na hindi isinasaalang-alang ang genetic at muscle differences. Pero sa medisina, laging binibigyan ng importansya ang BMI. Sa klinika ko, nilalagyan ng pula ang BMI na lampas 26. Kasama ito sa mga tinututukan sa medical school. Marami namang halimbawa na di tama ang BMI: may mataas na BMI pero ok ang blood pressure at sugar, at may payat na malala ang sakit. Kaya na-admit na din ng mga medical org na di lagi masusukat ng BMI ang kalusugan. Tumigil na akong mag-focus sa timbang kasi bihira itong gumana—mas madalas pang mapalungkot lang ang tao. Pwede ring nakaka-distract ito sa mas importanteng health issues. May mga pag-aaral na nagpapakitang madalas mismong mga doktor ang nagdadala ng weight stigma. Kapag nakadama ng hiya ang mga pasyente dahil sa katawan nila, minsan iiwas na silang magpagamot, umiwas mag-exercise, o tumaas ang risk ng depression. Ayoko maging bahagi nito. Kaya mas binibigyang pansin ko ngayon ang blood pressure, insulin resistance, at joint pain. Totoo namang konektado dito ang ehersisyo at tamang kain—at pwedeng magbawas ng timbang dahil dito. Pero sa akin at sa pasyente ko, kalusugan ang pinaka-goal, hindi ang timbang. Nakikita ko ang ginhawa sa mukha ng pasyente ko kapag hindi ko tinutuon sa timbang ang usapan. Mas nagkakaroon tuloy ng open at totoong kwento. May isang nanay pang nagsabi na dahil sa approach ko, nagkaroon ng confidence ang anak niyang pasyente ko maglaro ng sports. Ironic, pero mas malaki ang chance magbago ang isang tao kung di siya pinapahiya tungkol sa timbang. Pero pagdating ng Ozempic, parang nag-iba ang kalakaran. Hindi tulad ng maraming fad diets o pekeng supplements, totoo ngang bumababa ang timbang ng iba sa gamot na ito. Nung nagsimulang humiling ng Ozempic ang mga pasyente ko, inisip ko kung paano ba ito pasok sa weight-neutral approach ko. Tinatanong ko sila kung bakit gusto nilang pumayat—madalas, gusto lang talaga nilang maging active o mas maging healthy, na pwede namang makamit sa pag-aadjust ng habits. May ibang prangkang nagsasabi na gusto lang nilang maging attractive, na nirerespeto ko rin; hindi ko tungkuling hadlangan sila sa Ozempic dahil lang sa paniwala ko. May pasyente akong sobrang napagod na sa fatphobia kaya humiling ng Ozempic kahit ok naman ang blood pressure at sugar niya. Sa huli, bahagi ng weight-neutral medicine ang pagbibigay halaga sa sariling desisyon ng pasyente tungkol sa katawan nila. Pero hindi rin lahat ay natitiis ang side effects ng Ozempic; may umayaw na dahil sa tuloy-tuloy na pagsusuka. May mga pumayat ng malaki—pero nagkakaroon naman ng ibang problema, gaya ng pakikitungo na iba ng mga tao, o ang paglitaw ng depression. Maraming pasyente at doktor ang naniniwalang sagot sa lahat ang pagpapapayat, pero di naman totoo yun. Minsan distraction lang ito sa totoong problema. Kailangan natin ng mas holistic na health approach at dapat na matigil na rin ang stigma sa malalaking katawan—kasi nakakapigil ito sa mga taong maging healthy. Hindi ko kayang tanggalin mag-isa ang fatphobia ng lipunan, pero kaya kong siguraduhin na bawat pasyente ko ay tinatrato ng maayos at komportable, at nauunawaan na hindi sukatan ng kalusugan ang timbang lang. Si Mara Gordon ay isang family physician sa Camden, N.J., at contributor sa NPR. Nagtitweet siya bilang @MaraGordonMD. In-edit ni Carmel Wroth ng NPR ang kwento. article_content: Authorities worldwide are targeting fast fashion giants like Shein and Temu with new taxes over environmental and economic concerns. Previously, officials focused on products such as soda, plastics, and hazardous chemicals, but now fast fashion—a $100 billion industry—is in the spotlight. Some companies reportedly use tactics to pay less in import duties. For example, in South Africa and the US, Shein allegedly splits shipments into small, low-value packages to benefit from tariff exemptions, leading to investigations and debates about policy changes. These tax issues are linked to fast fashion's massive environmental impact. The industry now generates about 100 billion clothing items each year—almost twice as much as before 2000. While there used to be four main fashion cycles annually, fast fashion brands now produce fifty or more. In the US, 85% of discarded clothing ends up in landfills or is burned. The fashion sector is blamed for about 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions, and fabric dyeing is a major contributor to water pollution. Countries are proposing various tax strategies to push the industry towards sustainability. In the UK, some lawmakers suggest extending plastics taxes to textiles and introducing garment levies to fund recycling. They also support lowering taxes for clothing repairs. Australia has launched a voluntary levy—4 cents per clothing item—to support recycling and reduce waste, but the response from manufacturers has been limited. The European Union encourages its members to offer tax incentives for reuse and clothing repairs as part of a broader plan for sustainable textiles. Brazil, meanwhile, is preparing a digital tax on major e-commerce retailers, aiming to make companies—not consumers—pay tax, especially in cases of tax avoidance. The idea of taxing fast fashion is gaining momentum and being tested in different countries, but it remains to be seen how consumers and the industry will respond and whether these actions will have a real impact on sustainability.
translated_content: Tinututukan na ngayon ng mga awtoridad sa buong mundo ang mga higanteng fast fashion tulad ng Shein at Temu, dahil plano silang patawan ng bagong buwis kaugnay ng mga isyung pangkalikasan at ekonomiya. Dati, soda, plastik, at mapanganib na kemikal ang binubuwisan, pero ang fast fashion na may halagang $100 bilyon na ngayon ang sentro ng pansin. Iniulat na gumagamit ang ilang kumpanya ng mga paraan para makaiwas sa mataas na buwis sa pag-aangkat. Halimbawa, sa South Africa at US, hinihinalang hinahati ni Shein ang kanilang mga padala sa maliliit at murang packages para makalusot sa mga exemption, bagay na naging sanhi ng mga imbestigasyon at diskusyon ukol sa posibleng mga pagbabago sa patakaran. Kaugnay din ng mga isyu sa buwis ang matinding epekto ng fast fashion sa kalikasan. Tinatayang umaabot sa 100 bilyong piraso ang nalilikha kada taon—halos doble kumpara dati. Kung apat lang dati ang fashion cycles kada taon, ngayo’y mahigit 50 na dahil sa fast fashion brands. Sa US, 85% ng itinatapong mga damit ay nauuwi sa landfill o sinusunog. Tinatasa ang industriya bilang sanhi ng halos 10% ng global greenhouse gas emissions, at ang proseso ng pagdaday ay malaking bahagi ng polusyon sa tubig. Iba’t ibang bansa ang nagsusulong ng mga buwis para maitama ang direksyon ng industriya tungo sa sustainability. Sa UK, may panukalang palawigin ang plastics tax sa mga tela at magpatupad ng levy sa bawat damit bilang pondo sa recycling programs. Isinusulong din ang pagbawas ng buwis sa pag-aayos ng damit. Sa Australia, naglunsad ng boluntaryong levy—4 sentimo bawat damit—upang pondohan ang recycling at mapababa ang waste, ngunit kokonti pa lang ang nakikilahok mula sa mga manufacturer. Hinihikayat ng European Union ang mga kasaping bansa na magpatupad ng tax incentives para sa reuse at repair ng mga damit bilang bahagi ng plano para sa sustainable textiles. Sa Brazil naman, may balak ipatupad ang digital tax na papasanin ng mga malalaking e-commerce companies at hindi ng consumers, upang pigilan ang pag-iwas sa tamang buwis. Patuloy na lumalakas ang panukalang buwisan ang fast fashion sa iba’t ibang bahagi ng mundo, subalit hindi pa malinaw kung paano ito tatanggapin ng mga mamimili at ng industriya, at kung lulutas ba ito nang epektibo sa mga suliranin sa kalikasan.

article_content: Already relegated from the Super League, the Bradford Bulls notched up their third win in a row by defeating Hull FC 34-28 at Provident Stadium, Odsal. Remarkably, Joe Arundel and Jay Pitts—who are both on loan from Hull—scored tries against their parent team, helping Bradford overturn a 12-point deficit. Jamie Foster, a former Hull loanee, also shone for the Bulls. He crossed the try line and kicked five goals, pushing his career points beyond 1,000. Hull FC started the match on the front foot, with Jamie Shaul scoring his 15th try of the season from a Dean Hadley pass, and Gareth Ellis adding another try soon after. However, Bradford surged back in the second half, with significant contributions from Lee Gaskell, Adam Sidlow, and Danny Addy. Hull FC did manage some late tries via Setaimata Sa and Tom Lineham, but these weren't enough to catch up. Hull have now won just once in their last eight games and trail Widnes, who hold the final play-off spot, by five points with three matches left—making a play-off spot extremely unlikely.

Kapansin-pansin na sina Joe Arundel at Jay Pitts, parehong naka-loan mula Hull, ay naka-iskor ng try laban mismo sa kanilang parent team, dahilan para mabawi ng Bradford ang 12-point na lamang. Nagpakitang-gilas si Jamie Foster, dating loanee ng Hull, para sa Bulls. Nakagawa siya ng try at limang goal na nag-angat sa kanyang career points lampas 1,000. Malakas ang naging simula ng Hull FC, kung saan si Jamie Shaul ay naka-iskor ng kanyang ika-15 try ngayong season mula sa pasa ni Dean Hadley, at sinundan agad ni Gareth Ellis ng panibagong try. Ngunit bumulusok pabalik ang Bradford sa second half dahil sa mga mahahalagang galaw nina Lee Gaskell, Adam Sidlow, at Danny Addy. Bagama't nakadagdag pa ng late tries sina Setaimata Sa at Tom Lineham para sa Hull FC, hindi na ito naging sapat para makahabol. Isa na lang ang panalo ng Hull sa kanilang huling walong laro, at limang puntos na ang lamang ng Widnes, ang may hawak ng huling play-off spot, kaya't malabo nang makapasok ang Hull sa playoffs na may tatlo na lang natitirang laro.

article_content: SYDNEY, Australia – Eamon Sullivan reclaimed the 50-meter freestyle world record with a 21.41-second swim at the Australian Olympic trials. Sullivan had lost the 50m freestyle record to Frenchman Alain Bernard just four days earlier, when Bernard set a time of 21.50 seconds at the European championships. Previously, Sullivan held the record with 21.56 seconds, set in Sydney in February. After narrowly missing Bernard’s 100m world record on Wednesday, Sullivan expressed optimism about improving his 50m time in Friday’s final. “I was more relaxed tonight, having finished the 100m final and secured my spot on the team for Beijing. It’s satisfying to reclaim the record from Alain after missing the 100m world record last night and after he quickly broke my 50m record,” Sullivan said. “I know I have another swim left, so there’s always another chance. I hope to go faster in the final and maybe shave off a couple hundredths of a second. We’ll see.” In Olympic qualification, Sullivan swam the 100m in 47.52 seconds, missing Bernard’s world record by just two-hundredths of a second. Libby Trickett broke the women’s 100m freestyle world record with a time of 52.88 seconds. Competing for the first time under her married name, Trickett surpassed the previous 53.30 mark set by Germany’s Britta Steffen in Budapest on August 2, 2006. This is the second time Trickett has gone under 53 seconds, but her earlier time of 52.99 at last year’s Duel in the Pool in Sydney was not recognized by FINA since she competed against Michael Phelps. “I can’t describe how much I wanted this record since the unratified swim last year. To see it officially on the scoreboard is amazing,” Trickett said. “All my events are important to me, but the 100m freestyle is especially meaningful. Four years ago, I was 0.8 seconds off—this is awesome.” Trickett added, “The journey has been incredible, and I’m thrilled to be part of this team. We have fantastic swimmers coming through, and our relay team will be great.”

Masarap mabawi ang rekord mula kay Alain matapos hindi makuha ang 100m world record kagabi at pagkatapos niyang agawin agad ang 50m record ko,” sabi ni Sullivan. “May isa pa akong laban kaya may panibagong oportunidad. article_content: President Joe Biden, now 81 years old and the oldest president in U.S. history, is celebrating his birthday with the White House's annual Thanksgiving turkey pardon ceremony this Monday. This year, two turkeys named Liberty and Bell from Willmar, Minnesota, are being honored. Leading up to the event, they stayed at Washington, D.C.'s Willard Hotel, where they enjoyed VIP treatment including a red carpet, bubble bath, and treats from the mini bar. Markus Platzer, manager of the Willard Hotel, shared that Liberty and Bell listened to music by Taylor Swift and Prince, and Steve Lykken, chairman of the National Turkey Federation (NTF), commented that the turkeys are comfortable and ready for the ceremony. Liberty and Bell were carefully raised by the NTF's presidential flock program, with protection and constant care. After their pardon, the turkeys will retire at the University of Minnesota, possibly even attending a hockey game. This is President Biden's third time upholding the turkey pardon tradition, which dates back to 1947 when President Truman was first presented with a Thanksgiving turkey. The holiday celebrations continue as First Lady Jill Biden accepts an 18.5-foot Fraser fir Christmas tree from Fleetwood, North Carolina, marking the official start of the White House holiday season. The NTF notes that the turkey pardoning is not only fun but also acknowledges the hard work of turkey farmers and those in animal agriculture. The event marks a festive and cheerful opening to the holidays for everyone involved. Quick facts: President Joe Biden’s birthday is November 20, 1942. Before him, Ronald Reagan was the oldest president to serve, at 77.
translated_content: Ipinagdiriwang ni Pangulong Joe Biden, na ngayon ay 81 taong gulang at pinakamakatandang pangulo sa kasaysayan ng U.S., ang kanyang kaarawan sa pamamagitan ng taunang White House Thanksgiving turkey pardon ceremony ngayong Lunes. Ngayong taon, ang mga pabo na sina Liberty at Bell mula Willmar, Minnesota ang tampok. Bago ang okasyon, tinuring silang VIP sa Willard Hotel sa Washington, D.C.—may red carpet, bubble bath, at mga pagkain mula sa mini bar. Ibinahagi ni Markus Platzer, manager ng Willard Hotel, na pinakinggan nina Liberty at Bell ang mga kanta ni Taylor Swift at Prince. Ayon kay Steve Lykken, chairman ng National Turkey Federation (NTF), handa at komportable na ang mga pabo para sa seremonya. Maingat na inalagaan sina Liberty at Bell sa ilalim ng presidential flock program ng NTF, na may proteksyon at tuloy-tuloy na pag-aalaga. Pagkatapos ng pardon, magreretiro ang mga pabo sa University of Minnesota, at malamang ay makakapanood pa ng hockey game. Ikatlong beses na ito ni Pangulong Biden na sundin ang tradisyong ito ng turkey pardon, na sinimulan pa noong 1947 nang unang bigyan si Pangulong Truman ng Thanksgiving turkey. Magpapatuloy ang holiday celebrations habang tinatanggap ni First Lady Jill Biden ang 18.5-talampakang Fraser fir Christmas tree mula Fleetwood, North Carolina—hudyat ng opisyal na simula ng White House holiday season. article_content: A Fokker 50 aircraft operated by Skyward had to make an emergency belly landing at Nairobi's Jomo Kenyatta International Airport after striking birds led to a landing gear malfunction. The flight, traveling from Wajir to Nairobi with six people onboard, collided with two marabou storks during take-off. One bird became stuck in the left main landing gear door, preventing it from deploying when approaching Nairobi. Despite attempts to resolve the problem, including using the emergency gear extension, the left gear stayed locked. The crew circled to burn off fuel before making a safe belly landing. No injuries occurred. Airport operations were paused and incoming flights rerouted to Mombasa while the affected aircraft was removed. Skyward’s director, Emil Arao, commended the crew for their skilled response.
translated_content: Isang Fokker 50 ng Skyward ang nag-emergency belly landing sa Jomo Kenyatta International Airport sa Nairobi matapos masira ang landing gear dahil sa salpukan sa mga ibon. Ang flight mula Wajir patungong Nairobi na may anim na pasahero ay tumama sa dalawang marabou storks habang umaalis. Isa sa mga ibon ang naipit sa kaliwang landing gear door kaya hindi ito bumaba pagdating sa Nairobi. Sinikap ng crew na ayusin ang problema gamit ang emergency gear extension pero hindi pa rin umayos ang kaliwang gear. Nagpalipad muna sila sa paligid para maubos ang gasolina bago makapagligtas na belly landing. Wala namang nasaktan. Pansamantalang sinuspinde ang operasyon ng paliparan at inilipat sa Mombasa ang mga flight habang inaalis ang eroplano. Pinuri ni Emil Arao, director ng Skyward, ang mahusay na pagtugon ng crew.

article_content:
Movie studios are now required to obtain permission from actors before using their images in AI-generated material and must compensate performers whenever their digital likenesses appear on screen, according to a new labor agreement that ended a 118-day strike. These new safeguards for actors were part of a deal announced Wednesday, said SAG-AFTRA chief negotiator Duncan Crabtree-Ireland.

Under the new three-year contract, actors have the right to consent and to receive fair compensation whenever digital replicas or replacements of them are used, Crabtree-Ireland told Reuters. The agreement also sets minimum pay for AI uses, but actors can negotiate higher amounts.

Full details of the contract will be released after SAG-AFTRA’s national board votes on the proposal Friday. If approved, it will then go to the union’s 160,000 members for ratification.

Actors have long viewed AI as a threat, worried that digital doubles or AI-generated “metahumans” could replace them, especially background and voice actors who fear losing work to synthetic performers. Crabtree-Ireland said the contract includes safeguards for the use of generative AI to create synthetic actors, emphasizing protections around consent and compensation, though specifics have not been disclosed.

Studios have previously used AI to alter appearances or modify dialogue, raising ethical concerns. The use of AI was a major sticking point in the negotiations and one of the final issues to be resolved, Crabtree-Ireland noted.

“We now have protections that will keep pace as technology advances,” said Crabtree-Ireland.

The Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP), which represents Walt Disney, Warner Bros Discovery, Netflix, and other studios, said the contract offers extensive consent and compensation protections for AI use.

Hollywood studios are proceeding cautiously with AI as the industry awaits clear ground rules, according to Scott Mann, co-CEO and founder of Flawless, an AI dubbing and editing company. “There’s huge potential, but studios are being ultra cautious,” he said.

Earlier this year, film and television writers also won safeguards around AI use after a five-month-long Writers Guild of America strike. Studios must now disclose to writers if AI-generated material has been used.
translated_content:
Kailangan na ngayong humingi ng pahintulot ang mga movie studio mula sa mga aktor bago gamitin ang kanilang mga imahe sa AI-generated na materyal, at obligado silang bayaran ang mga performer kapag lumabas ang kanilang digital likeness sa screen, ayon sa bagong labor agreement na nagtapos sa 118-araw na welga. Kasama ang mga bagong pananggalang na ito para sa mga aktor sa kasunduang inanunsyo nitong Miyerkules, ayon kay Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, chief negotiator ng SAG-AFTRA.

Sa ilalim ng bagong tatlong-taong kontrata, may karapatan ang mga aktor na pumayag o tumanggi, at makatanggap ng makatarungang kompensasyon sa tuwing gagamitin ang kanilang digital na replica o papalitan sila ng teknolohiya, sinabi ni Crabtree-Ireland sa Reuters. Nakapaloob din sa kasunduan ang minimum na bayad para sa paggamit ng AI, ngunit maaaring makipag-negosasyon ang aktor para sa mas mataas pa.

Ipalalabas ang buong detalye ng kontrata matapos bumoto ang national board ng SAG-AFTRA sa Biyernes. Kapag naaprubahan, dadalhin ito sa 160,000 miyembro ng unyon para aprubahan.

Matagal nang pinangangambahan ng mga aktor ang AI, takot na palitan sila ng digital doubles o AI-generated na "metahumans," lalo na ang mga background at voice actors na nangangambang mawalan ng trabaho sa synthetic performers. Sinabi ni Crabtree-Ireland na may mga pananggalang sa kasunduan para sa paggamit ng generative AI sa paggawa ng synthetic actors, partikular na tungkol sa pahintulot at kabayaran, bagama't hindi pa inilahad ang detalye.

Dati nang gumamit ng AI ang mga studio para baguhin ang itsura o dialogue ng mga aktor, dahilan ng ilang alalahanin. Naging malaking isyu ang AI sa negosasyon at isa sa huling naresolba, ayon kay Crabtree-Ireland.

"Ngayon, may mga proteksyong tutugon kasama ng pag-unlad ng teknolohiya," sabi ni Crabtree-Ireland.

Sinabi naman ng Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP), na kumakatawan sa Walt Disney, Warner Bros Discovery, Netflix at iba pang studio, na nag-aalok ang kontrata ng malawak na proteksyon tungkol sa pahintulot at bayad sa paggamit ng AI.

Maingat ang mga Hollywood studio sa paggamit ng AI habang hinihintay ng industriya ang malinaw na mga panuntunan, ayon kay Scott Mann, co-CEO at founder ng Flawless, isang kumpanyang gumagamit ng AI para sa dubbing at editing. "Malaki ang potensyal, pero sobrang maingat ang mga studio," aniya.

Noong nakaraang taon, nakuha din ng mga manunulat ng pelikula at telebisyon ang mga panangalang kaugnay sa paggamit ng AI matapos ang limang buwang welga ng Writers Guild of America. Kailangan nang ilahad ng mga studio sa mga manunulat kung AI-generated ang anumang materyal na gamitin.

article_content: The search for a campaign manager for Hillary Clinton’s possible 2016 presidential campaign is intensifying. Clinton’s spokesman has confirmed that she is reaching out to a diverse group of individuals to gather input as she considers running. According to Politico, Clinton recently met in Washington with Guy Cecil, who is leaving his post as head of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, and has also discussed the role with her former aide, Robby Mook. These two are among the top contenders if Clinton decides to launch a presidential campaign. Clinton spokesperson Nick Merrill would not confirm specific meetings but did note Clinton is consulting with many people about a variety of topics, such as policy ideas and campaign strategies, to help inform her decision. Four main candidates have emerged for campaign manager: Guy Cecil, Robby Mook, Stephanie Schriock, and Ace Smith. Guy Cecil is recognized for his strong connections with both Hillary and Bill Clinton, having been her national political and field director in 2008. While he was at the helm of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee during the 2014 Senate losses, Cecil also played key roles in campaign victories across several states. He has not spoken publicly about any involvement with Clinton’s potential campaign. Robby Mook is viewed as a talented political strategist, known for managing Virginia Governor Terry McAuliffe’s winning 2013 campaign and helping Clinton to several state victories in 2008. Beginning his political career under then-Governor Howard Dean, Mook is widely respected in Democratic circles. Similar to Cecil, he has refrained from public comment about 2016. Emails leaked from his group of supporters—known as the “Mook Mafia”—have shown his energetic approach to campaigning. Stephanie Schriock leads EMILY’s List, which works to elect pro-choice Democratic women—a mission Clinton often highlights. Previously, she helped Howard Dean with online fundraising and managed winning Senate campaigns for Jon Tester and Al Franken. Schriock, too, has declined to discuss any possible involvement with a Clinton campaign. Ace Smith, a California-based consultant with longstanding ties to the Clintons, has managed Clinton’s previous wins in California, Texas, and North Carolina, and worked for notable Democrats like Richard Daley and Dianne Feinstein. Although considered an outside contender, Smith has expressed enthusiasm for any role in a Clinton campaign, saying he would gladly accept a request from her.

Kumpirmado ng kanyang tagapagsalita na kumakausap siya sa iba’t ibang tao para mangalap ng opinyon habang nagpapasya kung tatakbo. Ayon sa Politico, kamakailan lamang nagkita si Clinton kay Guy Cecil sa Washington, na papaalis bilang pinuno ng Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, at nakausap din niya ang dati niyang aide na si Robby Mook ukol sa posisyon. Sila ngayon ang nangunguna sa listahan kung sakaling tumakbo si Clinton. Bagamat hindi kinumpirma ni Nick Merrill, tagapagsalita ni Clinton, ang eksaktong mga pulong, sinabi niyang kumukunsulta si Clinton sa maraming tao ukol sa iba’t ibang paksa, mula polisiya hanggang campaign strategies, upang makabuo ng desisyon. Apat ang lumalabas na pangunahing posibleng campaign manager: sina Guy Cecil, Robby Mook, Stephanie Schriock, at Ace Smith. Tanyag si Guy Cecil sa kanyang matibay na koneksyon kina Hillary at Bill Clinton—naging national political at field director siya ni Hillary noong 2008. Bagamat namuno siya sa Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee nang matalo ang Demokratiko sa Senado noong 2014, naging bahagi rin siya ng ilan sa mga panalong kampanya sa iba’t ibang estado. Hindi pa siya nagbibigay ng pahayag ukol sa involvement niya sa posibleng kampanya ni Clinton. Hinahangaan bilang strategist si Robby Mook, na nagpatakbo ng matagumpay na kampanya ni Gov. Terry McAuliffe sa Virginia noong 2013 at naging bahagi ng mga tagumpay ni Clinton noong 2008. Nagsimula siya kay Gov. Howard Dean at mataas ang respeto sa kanya sa mga Democrat. Tulad ni Cecil, tumatanggi siyang magkomento tungkol sa 2016. Ayon sa ilang leaked emails mula sa 'Mook Mafia,' kitang-kita ang masigla niyang pag-atake sa kampanya. Pinamumunuan ni Stephanie Schriock ang EMILY’s List na sumusuporta sa pagkapanalo ng pro-choice na mga Democrat na babae—isang adbokasiya ring isinusulong ni Clinton. Dati siyang tumulong kay Howard Dean sa online fundraising at nagpatakbo ng matagumpay na Senate campaigns kina Jon Tester at Al Franken. Tumanggi rin si Schriock na talakayin ang tungkol sa Clinton campaign. Bagamat kinokonsiderang outsider, matindi ang deklarasyon niya ng suporta: ayon kay Smith, anumang ipagawa ni Clinton ay gagawin niya.

Sexist and objectifying casting notices persist in film, television, and theatre, as documented by 'Casting Call Woe,' a blog curated by the anonymous actress Miss L. The blog uncovers troubling ads that ask female performers to meet degrading requirements, such as appearing in lingerie or being partially undressed, and often specify certain body types. Miss L uses her platform to bring these issues to light and expose the industry's less visible problems.

High-profile actresses have also addressed these patterns of sexism. At the Empire Film Awards, Dame Helen Mirren criticized the scarcity of women in directorial roles and advocated for greater female representation. Thandie Newton, in a CNN interview, recalled inappropriate experiences at auditions and highlighted the ongoing need to address sexism and exploitation in entertainment.

Though these conversations and calls for change have increased, casting notices demanding 'sexy nuns' or semi-nudity for women—contrasted with clothed male parts—show that objectification is still commonplace. Miss L's blog underscores the urgent necessity for real progress in creating safer, fairer opportunities for women.
translated_content:
Patuloy pa rin ang pagkalat ng mga seksist at mapang-abusong casting notices sa pelikula, telebisyon, at teatro, ayon sa blog na 'Casting Call Woe.' Pinapatakbo ito ng anonymous na aktres na si Miss L, na inilalantad ang mga ad na humihingi ng mga babaeng artista na sumunod sa mapanirang mga rekisito—tulad ng pagsusuot ng lingerie o paglitaw nang halos nakahubad—at kadalasan ay may espesipikong tipo ng katawan. Ginagamit ni Miss L ang kanyang platform upang ibunyag ang mga problemang ito at ipakita ang itinatagong bahagi ng industriya.

Maging ang ilang kilalang aktres ay nagsalita na rin tungkol dito. Sa Empire Film Awards, binatikos ni Dame Helen Mirren ang kakulangan ng mga direktor na babae at nanawagan ng mas malawak na representasyon ng kababaihan. Sa isang panayam naman sa CNN, ibinahagi ni Thandie Newton ang kanyang karanasan ng hindi angkop na pagtrato sa mga audition at idiniin ang pangangailangang labanan pa rin ang sexism at exploitation sa entertainment.

Kahit lumalakas na ang panawagan at diskurso ukol dito, marami pa ring casting notices na naghahanap ng 'sexy nuns' o semi-nudity para sa mga babae—habang fully clothed ang mga lalake—na patunay na laganap pa rin ang objectification. Ipinapaalala ng blog ni Miss L ang agarang pangangailangan ng tunay na pagbabago para sa mas patas at ligtas na oportunidad ng kababaihan.
post_content: Still think Hollywood is all glitz and glamour? Think again. Sexist casting calls are still a thing, as exposed by Miss L’s 'Casting Call Woe'. Even stars like Dame Helen Mirren and Thandie Newton are speaking out. Time for a real change! #ActingTruth #WomenInFilm #EndSexism

article_content: Asia's road to the 2026 FIFA World Cup is underway, with ten teams already eliminated as the second round of qualifiers begins. This phase marks the region's most demanding World Cup qualification journey. Asian teams face six matches in round two, then ten in round three. Teams finishing third and fourth can advance to additional rounds and possibly an inter-continental playoff, meaning a team could play up to 25 matches from the first round to qualification. By comparison, European nations may qualify in as few as ten games, African sides in 10–14, and some Oceania teams in five. However, Asia now has at least eight berth spots, giving many teams renewed optimism. Palestine, currently ranked 16th in Asia and the second-highest in Group I, opens against Lebanon. Due to conflict near Lebanon's border, the match is set for the UAE. Palestine’s home fixture versus Australia on November 21 will be in Kuwait after the AFC declined Algeria as host. Both Lebanon and Palestine are targeting the second Group I spot, making their match crucial. Palestine may miss at least three players reportedly unable to leave Gaza. In Group A, Afghanistan could similarly lack squad members, with 18 players planning a boycott over alleged financial mismanagement by its soccer association. Afghanistan narrowly advanced past Mongolia in round one, surviving a potential forfeit after the head coach refused to sign the team sheet. This week, a reduced squad travels to Qatar and will host Kuwait in Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia is also hosting the home fixtures for Syria and Yemen. India, ranked 18th in Asia, benefits from the new qualification system. Captain Sunil Chhetri notes the team's increased preparation under coach Igor Stimac. India opens against Kuwait, who they defeated on penalties in July’s South Asian Football Federation Championship final. The additional World Cup spots make qualification less risky for regulars like Japan and South Korea. Roberto Mancini’s first competitive match as Saudi Arabia head coach is against Pakistan, Group G's lowest-ranked nation. Pakistan faces a major challenge to qualify, but for 'second tier' Asian teams such as Iraq, the UAE, and Uzbekistan, World Cup hopes are higher than ever. Iraq and UAE last appeared in the finals in 1986 and 1990 respectively, while Uzbekistan aims to qualify for the first time after near misses in recent campaigns.
translated_content: Nagsimula na ang laban ng Asia para sa 2026 FIFA World Cup, kung saan sampung koponan na ang nalaglag habang papasok na sa ikalawang round ng qualifiers. Ito na ang pinaka-hamon na qualification journey sa rehiyon. Maglalaro ang mga Asian teams ng anim na laban sa ikalawang round, at sampu pa sa ikatlong round. Ang mga koponang magtatapos ng ikatlo at ikaapat na pwesto ay maaaring umabante pa sa karagdagang rounds at posibleng maglaro sa inter-continental playoff, kaya’t puwedeng umabot sa 25 na laban mula simula hanggang World Cup qualification. Sa Europe, may mga bansa na puwedeng makapasok sa World Cup sa loob lang ng sampung laban, sa Africa ay 10–14 na laban, at sa Oceania ay limang laro lang. Pero dahil may walong slots na para sa Asia, mas marami ngayon ang may pag-asa. Ang Palestine, kasalukuyang ika-16 sa ranggo sa Asia at pangalawa sa Group I, ay magsisimula kontra Lebanon. Dahil sa kaguluhan sa hangganan ng Lebanon, sa UAE gaganapin ang laban. Ang home game ng Palestine laban Australia sa Nobyembre 21 ay gaganapin sa Kuwait matapos tanggihan ng AFC ang alok ng Algeria bilang host. Parehong inaasinta ng Lebanon at Palestine ang ikalawang pwesto sa Group I kaya mahalaga ang laban nila. Posible ring mawalan ng tatlong manlalaro ang Palestine na hindi makalabas ng Gaza. Sa Group A, posibleng mabawasan din ng players ang Afghanistan dahil sa banta ng 18 manlalaro na magbo-boycott dahil sa isyu ng umano’y maling paggastos ng pondo ng kanilang football association. Naipanalo ng Afghanistan ang laban kontra Mongolia sa first round, kahit muntik nang ma-forfeit dahil tumanggi ang kanilang coach pumirma sa team sheet. Ngayong linggo, sasabak sila sa Qatar at magho-host ng laban kontra Kuwait sa Saudi Arabia. Dito rin gagawin ang home games ng Syria at Yemen. Malaki ang pagkakataon ng India, ika-18 sa Asia, sa bagong qualification system. Sabi ni Kapitan Sunil Chhetri, mas handa na ang team sa ilalim ng coach na si Igor Stimac. Magsisimula sila kontra Kuwait, na tinalo nila sa penalty sa South Asian Football Federation Championship noong Hulyo. Dahil sa dagdag na World Cup slots, mas ligtas na makapasok ang mga regulars tulad ng Japan at South Korea. article_content: US President Joe Biden announced a new student loan relief strategy on August 24, 2022, unveiling the SAVE (Saving on a Valuable Education) income-driven repayment plan. This initiative aims to support federal student loan borrowers, particularly recent university graduates managing significant educational debt.  The SAVE plan seeks to reduce average monthly payments for undergraduate loans by half and expand eligibility for $0 monthly payments, based on borrowers' incomes and family sizes. Current data shows that over half of SAVE plan enrollees are making no monthly payments.  Additionally, borrowers who do not qualify for $0 payments can still save at least $1,000 per year compared to other income-driven repayment plans. One key feature is the government covering any unpaid interest, ensuring loan balances do not grow when payments are less than the accrued interest.  Loan forgiveness is another component: remaining balances are forgiven after 20 to 25 years in the program, or after just 10 years for those with less than $12,000 in eligible federal student loans.  Despite these benefits, critics point out possible moral hazards. Since payments depend on income, borrowers may feel less motivation to increase their earnings or repay loans faster, knowing their debt might eventually be forgiven. This system allows borrowers, especially those with larger balances, to minimize payments to maximize forgiveness and may reduce incentives for controlling college expenses. Colleges might raise tuition, recognizing that graduates' repayments are based on income, not total borrowed.  While federal loan limits reduce this risk for undergraduates, some graduate-level federal loans, like Direct PLUS loans, permit borrowing up to the full cost of attendance. Even then, payments under the SAVE plan are still determined by income and family size, intensifying concerns about unchecked tuition and borrowing.  A potential future issue is taxation. The American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 exempts forgiven student loan balances from federal income taxes through December 31, 2025. However, forgiven funding may become taxable after that, and some states may also tax forgiven debt, which could create a financial burden for borrowers when their loans are wiped out.  To sum up, the SAVE plan offers immediate relief to many current borrowers—especially those with low incomes and significant debts—but it may also result in long-term challenges, such as rising tuition and future tax implications. The Department of Education estimates that more people will qualify for $0 payments under SAVE compared to prior plans, with most others benefiting from annual savings of around $1,000. The plan also prevents unpaid interest from accruing when borrowers have low or $0 payments, which should help stop debt balances from increasing, even if forgiven amounts face taxation later.
translated_content: Inanunsyo ni US President Joe Biden ang bagong hakbang para sa student loan relief noong Agosto 24, 2022, na tinatawag na SAVE (Saving on a Valuable Education) income-driven repayment plan. Layunin nitong tulungan ang mga may federal student loan, lalo na ang mga bagong graduate na may mabigat na edukasyonal na utang.  Naglalayon ang SAVE plan na bawasan ng kalahati ang karaniwang buwanang bayad para sa undergraduate loans, at palawakin ang kwalipikasyon para sa $0 monthly payment base sa kita at laki ng pamilya ng borrower. Sa kasalukuyang datos, higit sa kalahati ng mga nakaenroll sa SAVE plan ay hindi nagbabayad buwan-buwan.  Para sa mga hindi pasok sa $0 monthly payment, puwede pa rin silang makatipid ng hindi bababa sa $1,000 kada taon kumpara sa ibang income-driven repayment plans. Isa pa sa mga tampok nito, sagot ng gobyerno ang anumang unpaid interest para hindi lumaki ang utang kung mas maliit ang bayad kaysa sa interest.  Isa pang benepisyo ang loan forgiveness: mabubura ang natitirang balanse ng utang pagkatapos ng 20 hanggang 25 taon sa programa, o sa loob ng 10 taon naman kung mas mababa sa $12,000 ang kwalipikadong pautang.  Gayunman, may mga nagsasabing maaaring maging dahilan ito ng mga moral hazard. Dahil batay sa kita ang bayad, maaaring mawalan ng motibasyon ang mga borrower na dagdagan ang kita o bilisan ang pagbayad, lalo na’t may posibilidad na mapatawad ang natitirang utang nila. Puwede ring samantalahin ng ilang borrower, lalo na ‘yung may malaking utang, ang sistema para mas maliit ang bayad at mas malaki ang mapatawad. Dahil dito, baka mas tumaas pa ang tuition fee sa kolehiyo dahil alam ng paaralan na hindi na directang mararamdaman ng graduates ang epekto ng laki ng utang.  Bagamat may limitasyon ang federal loan para sa undergraduate students, ang ilang graduate-level loan tulad ng Direct PLUS loans ay nagpapahintulot mangutang hanggang sa kabuuang halaga ng attendance. Pero, income at family size pa rin ang basehan ng buwanang bayad kaya nakakabahala ang posibleng pagtaas ng tuition at utang.  Isa pang isyu ang maaaring buwis sa hinaharap. Ayon sa American Rescue Plan Act of 2021, hindi papatawan ng federal income tax ang mapatawad na utang hanggang Disyembre 31, 2025. Pagkatapos nito, puwedeng maging taxable na ito at may ilang estado rin na nagpapataw ng buwis sa nawalang utang, kaya posibleng magdulot ito ng dagdag na pasanin sa borrowers kapag nabura ang utang.  Sa kabuuan, malaki ang tulong ng SAVE plan sa maraming borrowers ngayon—lalo na sa may mababang kita at malalaking utang—pero may mga posibleng isyu sa hinaharap gaya ng pagtaas ng tuition at buwis. Tantya ng Department of Education na mas maraming makikinabang sa $0 payments kumpara sa dating mga plano, at karamihan ay makakatipid din ng halos $1,000 kada taon. Pinipigilan din ng plan na lumaki pa ang utang mula sa unpaid interest kahit mababa o wala silang monthly payment, kahit pa maging taxable ang napatawad na halaga balang araw.
