article_content: Samantha Cameron, known for her impeccable style, attended London's Diwali celebrations in a striking russet-colored sari trimmed with gold. Joined by Prime Minister David Cameron, she visited the Swaminarayan Mandir in Neasden, the largest traditional Hindu temple outside India. Diwali, the festival of lights, is a major five-day celebration observed by millions of Hindus, Jains, and Sikhs worldwide. The festival commemorates the triumph of good over evil, marked by family gatherings, sweet exchanges, new clothes, and illuminated lamps. During their visit, both Samantha and David Cameron participated in temple traditions, received a chandlo (red mark on the forehead), and wore floral garlands. They were also given a 'nada chhadi,' a cotton thread wristband symbolizing friendship. Samantha walked barefoot during the ceremonies and blended seamlessly with other sari-clad volunteers. David Cameron, dressed in a navy suit, praised Hindu family and community values, and encouraged further Hindu involvement in British society. The Swaminarayan Mandir, inaugurated in 1995, draws almost three million visitors. Built with over 2,800 tons of Bulgarian limestone and 2,000 tons of Italian Carrara marble, the temple’s stonework was carved in India and assembled in London by more than 1,500 skilled artisans. Visiting Hindu temples during Diwali is a tradition for British and international leaders, including former Prime Ministers Tony Blair and Gordon Brown, as well as President Barack Obama. The temple’s construction was inspired by Yogiji Maharaj and realized by Pramukh Swami Maharaj, with craftsmen from Rajasthan and Gujarat using stones selected for their beauty and suitability to Britain's climate.
translated_content: Si Samantha Cameron, kilala sa kanyang mahusay na pananamit, ay dumalo sa Diwali celebrations sa London na suot ang napakagandang russet na sari na may gintong palamuti. Kasama niya si Prime Minister David Cameron nang bisitahin nila ang Swaminarayan Mandir sa Neasden, ang pinakamalaking tradisyonal na Hindu templo sa labas ng India. Ang Diwali, ang pista ng mga ilaw, ay isang mahalagang limang-araw na selebrasyon na ipinagdiriwang ng milyun-milyong Hindus, Jains, at Sikhs sa buong mundo. Ipinagdiriwang nito ang tagumpay ng kabutihan laban sa kasamaan, na tampok ang pagsasama ng pamilya, palitan ng matatamis, pagbili ng bagong damit, at pagsisindi ng mga ilaw. Sa kanilang pagbisita, parehong sina Samantha at David Cameron ay sumali sa mga tradisyon ng templo, tumanggap ng chandlo (pulang marka sa noo), at nagsuot ng bulaklak na garland. Nabigyan din sila ng 'nada chhadi,' isang pulseras na yari sa cotton thread na sumisimbolo ng pagkakaibigan. Naglakad ng nakapaa si Samantha habang isinasagawa ang mga seremonya at natural na nakihalubilo sa iba pang babaeng nakasari. Si David Cameron, naka-navy suit, ay pinuri ang mga pagpapahalagang pampamilya at pangkomunidad ng Hindu, at hinikayat ang mas malawak na partisipasyon ng mga Hindu sa lipunan ng Britanya. Ang Swaminarayan Mandir, na binuksan noong 1995, ay dinarayo ng halos tatlong milyong bisita. Gawa ito sa mahigit 2,800 toneladang Bulgarian limestone at 2,000 toneladang Italian Carrara marble. Ang mga bato ay inukit sa India at binuo sa London ng mahigit 1,500 mahuhusay na artisan. Ang pagbisita sa mga Hindu temple tuwing Diwali ay tradisyon para sa mga lider ng Britanya at iba pang bansa, kabilang sina dating Prime Ministers Tony Blair at Gordon Brown, pati na si President Barack Obama. Ang konstruksyon ng templo ay inspirasyon ni Yogiji Maharaj at naisakatuparan sa pangunguna ni Pramukh Swami Maharaj, sa tulong ng mga artisan mula Rajasthan at Gujarat gamit ang mga batong pinili para sa ganda at tibay para sa klima ng Britanya.

article_content: The Nigerian Meteorological Agency (NiMet) has issued a warning about an expected dust haze that will decrease visibility across Nigeria in the coming days. General Manager Muntari Yusuf Ibrahim signed the announcement in Abuja, advising airline operators to stay alert and use NiMet’s weather reports to plan their flights safely. Wind conditions are now favorable for dust from Niger and Chad to enter northern Nigeria. Weather stations in Niger have recorded visibility ranging from 800 to 6,000 meters. Forecasts predict even poorer visibility from dust coming from Chad within the next 24 hours. Northern cities such as Katsina, Kano, Nguru, Jigawa, Potiskum, and Maiduguri are expected to see especially bad visibility as the dust spreads. With high dust levels expected, NiMet is urging the public, particularly those with respiratory conditions, to take precautions, as the current air quality could worsen their health. The agency also recommends that airline operators closely monitor NiMet’s weather updates for effective planning. NiMet will continue to track the situation and provide more information as necessary.
translated_content: Naglabas ng babala ang Nigerian Meteorological Agency (NiMet) tungkol sa nalalapit na alikabok na magpapababa ng visibility sa buong Nigeria sa mga susunod na araw. Nilagdaan ni General Manager Muntari Yusuf Ibrahim ang anunsyo mula sa Abuja at pinayuhan ang mga airline operator na maging alerto at gamitin ang mga ulat ng panahon mula sa NiMet para sa ligtas na pagpaplano ng mga flight. Sa kasalukuyan, pabor ang lakas ng hangin sa pagpasok ng alikabok mula Niger at Chad patungong hilagang bahagi ng Nigeria. Naitala ng mga weather station sa Niger ang visibility mula 800 hanggang 6,000 metro. Inaasahan ding mas lalala pa ang visibility dahil sa alikabok na galing Chad sa loob ng susunod na 24 oras. Ang mga siyudad sa hilaga tulad ng Katsina, Kano, Nguru, Jigawa, Potiskum, at Maiduguri ang pinaka maaapektuhan ng napakababang visibility. Dahil sa mataas na antas ng alikabok, pinaalalahanan ng NiMet ang publiko, lalo na ang may karamdaman sa paghinga, na mag-ingat dahil maaaring magpalala ang kalidad ng hangin sa kasalukuyan ng kanilang kondisyon. Iminungkahing bigyang pansin ng mga airline operator ang mga ulat ng panahon mula sa NiMet para sa tamang pagplano. Patuloy na babantayan ng NiMet ang sitwasyon at magbibigay ng dagdag na abiso kapag kailangan.
post_content: Heads up, Nigeria! NiMet says serious dust haze is coming, especially up north. Bad air = poor visibility. Folks with breathing issues, take care. Airlines, check NiMet updates before takeoff! #DustAlert #StaySafe
translated_post: Alerto, Nigeria! May paparating na makapal na alikabok ayon sa NiMet—lalo na sa norte. Ingat sa mahirap na visibility at masamang hangin, lalo na sa may hika! Airlines, lagi mag-update sa NiMet. #AlikabokAlert #IwasDiskrasya

article_content:
French President Emmanuel Macron is visiting Central Asia, highlighting the region's growing importance to Europe's energy supply, particularly in nuclear and fossil fuels. His trip aims to strengthen business ties with Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, both key players in the global uranium market. Macron's visit is partly in response to the July military coup in Niger, which raised concerns about France's uranium supply stability. However, in 2022, Kazakhstan was France's main uranium supplier, not Niger.

On Wednesday, Macron met with officials in Kazakhstan, the world’s largest uranium producer, before traveling to Uzbekistan, another significant uranium producer. Both countries are led by authoritarian governments. During a press conference, Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev described France as a 'key and reliable partner,' while Macron thanked Tokayev for adhering to Western sanctions against Russia.

Since the start of the war in Ukraine, Russian oil exports to the EU have declined, making Kazakhstan the EU's third-largest petroleum supplier after Norway and the US. Nuclear energy accounts for over 60% of France’s electricity, the highest share globally, making access to uranium essential. Kazakhstan is also interested in learning from French expertise as it develops its own nuclear power industry.

France’s state-owned energy giant EDF is a candidate to construct Kazakhstan’s first nuclear power plant. The French government is encouraging its universities to open branches in Kazakhstan as well. While France has traditionally sourced much uranium from Niger, the coup there has cast doubt on continued supplies. French officials claimed their uranium reserves could last two years, but Macron's trip shows France remains vigilant about energy security.

The visit occurs as Central Asia reconsiders its relationship with Russia. Political analyst Dosym Satpayev notes that Russian influence in the region has diminished since the Ukraine conflict, despite leaders being discreet about the change. Last week, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov criticized efforts to draw Central Asian countries away from Moscow.

Nevertheless, the EU and US allege Russia circumvents sanctions by obtaining Western goods through Central Asian channels, as reported by the Organised Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP). These goods, including drones and microchips, reportedly support Russia’s military in Ukraine. Such concerns could complicate growing Central Asia-EU ties.

China’s economic influence is also increasing via its Belt and Road Initiative, funding numerous projects across Central Asia. Although the EU cannot match China’s investment scope, Macron’s visit seeks to use the current geopolitical context to deepen European links in the region.
translated_content:
Bumisita si Pangulong Emmanuel Macron ng Pransya sa Gitnang Asya upang bigyang-diin ang lumalaking kahalagahan ng rehiyon sa suplay ng enerhiya ng Europa, lalo na sa usaping nuklear at fossil fuels. Layunin ng kanyang biyahe na palakasin ang ugnayang pang-negosyo sa Kazakhstan at Uzbekistan, na parehong mahalagang manlalaro sa pandaigdigang pamilihan ng uranium. Bahagi rin ito ng tugon ni Macron kaugnay ng kudeta sa Niger noong Hulyo, na nagdulot ng pag-aalala ukol sa katatagan ng suplay ng uranium ng Pransya. Ngunit noong 2022, Kazakhstan, at hindi Niger, ang naging pangunahing tagapagsuplay ng uranium sa Pransya.

Noong Miyerkules, nakipagpulong si Macron sa mga opisyal ng Kazakhstan, ang pinakamalaking prodyuser ng uranium sa mundo, bago nagtungo sa Uzbekistan, isa pang mahalagang tagapagsuplay ng uranium. Pinamumunuan ng mga awtoritaryong pamahalaan ang parehong bansa. Sa isang press conference, tinawag ng Pangulong Kassym-Jomart Tokayev ng Kazakhstan ang Pransya na "pangunahing at maasahang ka-partner," habang nagpasalamat si Macron kay Tokayev dahil sumusunod ito sa mga parusang ipinataw ng Kanluran laban sa Russia.

Dahil bumaba ang inaangkat na langis ng EU mula Russia mula nang sumiklab ang digmaan sa Ukraine, naging ikatlong pinakamalaking tagasuplay ng petrolyo sa EU ang Kazakhstan, kasunod ng Norway at US. Higit 60% ng kuryente ng Pransya ay mula sa enerhiyang nuklear, pinakamalaki sa buong mundo, kaya kritikal ang suplay ng uranium. Nais din ng Kazakhstan na matutunan ang teknolohiya ng Pransya habang nagbuo ito ng sariling industriya ng nuclear power.

Isa ang EDF, pag-aari ng gobyerno ng Pransya, sa mga posibleng magtayo ng kauna-unahang planta ng nuclear power sa Kazakhstan. Pinopondohan ng gobyerno ng Pransya ang pagtatatag ng mga sangay ng kanilang mga unibersidad sa Kazakhstan. Habang tradisyonal na umaangkat ng maraming uranium mula Niger ang Pransya, ang kudeta roon ay nagdulot ng pangamba sa tuloy-tuloy na suplay. Sinabi ng mga opisyal ng Pransya na sapat ang kanilang reserba ng uranium para sa dalawang taon, ngunit ipinapakita ng biyahe ni Macron ang patuloy na pagiging mapagmatsyag ukol sa seguridad ng enerhiya.

Naganap ang pagbisita kasabay ng muling pagsasaalang-alang ng Gitnang Asya sa ugnayan nito sa Russia. Ayon sa political analyst na si Dosym Satpayev, humina ang impluwensya ng Russia simula nang sumiklab ang digmaan sa Ukraine, kahit tila tahimik ang mga pinuno ng rehiyon ukol dito. Nitong nakaraang linggo, binatikos ni Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov ang mga hakbang para ilayo ang mga bansa ng Gitnang Asya mula sa Moscow.

Gayunpaman, iginiit ng EU at US na nilalampasan ng Russia ang mga parusa sa pamamagitan ng pag-angkat ng mga produkto mula Kanluran sa pamamagitan ng Gitnang Asya, batay sa ulat ng Organised Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP). Kabilang dito ang drones at microchips, na ginagamit umano sa kampanya ng Russia sa Ukraine. Maaaring maging hadlang ito sa lumalalim na ugnayan ng Gitnang Asya at EU.

Lumalaki rin ang pang-ekonomiyang impluwensiya ng China sa rehiyon sa pamamagitan ng Belt and Road Initiative, na pinopondohan ang maraming proyekto sa Gitnang Asya. Bagama’t hindi kayang tapatan ng EU ang laki ng puhunan ng China, nais ni Macron na samantalahin ang kasalukuyang sitwasyon sa geopolitika upang mapalalim ang ugnayan ng Europa sa rehiyon.

For the first time in India’s election history, all polling booths in the Raipur (North) assembly constituency were staffed entirely by women, according to the Election Commission. During the second phase of Chhattisgarh’s assembly elections, 1,046 women managed all 201 polling stations in this region. The Commission explained that this initiative was meant to provide a safer and more welcoming experience for all voters, especially women and third-gender individuals, encouraging inclusive elections.

On the same day, voting took place in all 70 constituencies in Chhattisgarh and 230 in Madhya Pradesh. At the Sonewani polling station in Madhya Pradesh’s Balaghat assembly, all 42 voters (26 women and 16 men) participated, resulting in a 100% turnout.

Election officials highlighted their emphasis on accessibility, setting up polling booths in remote locations, even when there were fewer than 100 voters. In Sheradand, for instance, a polling booth was established for just five registered voters. Staff often navigated challenging terrain and dense vegetation to reach these areas.

To further support inclusivity, the Commission ensured 100% registration among particularly vulnerable tribal groups (PVTGs) in both states, covering major groups in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh, totaling over 752,000 voters.

Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar, with election commissioners Anup Chandra Pandey and Arun Goel, closely monitored the process to guarantee that elections were free, fair, and accessible to all of the 72.3 million eligible voters in both Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh.
translated_content:
Sa unang pagkakataon sa kasaysayan ng halalan sa India, pinamunuan ng mga kababaihan ang lahat ng polling booth sa Raipur (North) assembly constituency, ayon sa Election Commission. Sa ikalawang yugto ng halalan sa Chhattisgarh, 1,046 na kababaihan ang nag-assist sa lahat ng 201 polling station sa lugar. Layunin ng Commission na gawing mas ligtas at komportable para sa lahat ng botante—lalo na ang mga kababaihan at third-gender—ang eleksyon.

Noong araw na iyon, nagsagawa ng botohan sa 70 distrito ng Chhattisgarh at 230 distrito sa Madhya Pradesh. Sa Sonewani polling station ng Balaghat assembly sa Madhya Pradesh, bumoto ang lahat ng 42 rehistradong botante (26 babae, 16 lalaki), kaya 100% turnout ang naitala.

Binigyang-diin ng mga opisyal ng eleksyon ang kahalagahan ng accessibility, kaya nag-set up sila ng mga polling booth kahit sa malalayong lugar na kakaunti ang botante, kagaya ng Sheradand na may limang rehistradong botante lang. Dumaan pa sa matarik at masukal na lugar ang mga staff para lang makarating doon.

Bukod dito, tiniyak ng Commission na 100% rehistrado ang mga partikular na vulnerable tribal groups (PVTGs) sa parehong estado—lahat ng pangunahing grupo sa Chhattisgarh at Madhya Pradesh, na umabot sa mahigit 752,000 botante.

Sinubaybayan nina Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar, kasama sina Anup Chandra Pandey at Arun Goel, ang proseso para matiyak ang malaya, patas at accessible na halalan para sa 72.3 milyong rehistradong botante sa Chhattisgarh at Madhya Pradesh.
post_content: History made in India! For the first time, all-women teams ran every polling booth in Raipur North, inspiring safer, more inclusive elections. Plus, tribal and remote communities saw full participation. Voting for everyone! 🗳️💪 #IndiaVotes #InclusiveDemocracy

article_content: Marriott International has announced it will no longer block guests’ personal Wi-Fi devices at any of its managed hotels. This decision follows numerous customer complaints and a $600,000 fine issued by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) after the Marriott Gaylord Opryland hotel in Nashville, Tennessee was found to have blocked conventioneers from using their own Wi-Fi instead of purchasing the hotel’s service, which cost between $250 and $1,000 per stand. Previously, Marriott argued that personal Wi-Fi hotspots interfered with their onsite wireless networks and could pose security risks. The hotel used systems to monitor and de-authenticate guests’ hotspots, which the FCC determined to be a violation of federal communications law. Marriott clarified that it did not block devices in guest rooms or hotel lobbies. Marriott had petitioned the FCC for permission to continue blocking personal Wi-Fi devices to address security threats from unauthorized hotspots, with support from Hilton Worldwide and the American Hospitality and Lodging Association. However, technology companies like Google opposed the blocking, calling it inconsistent with promoting competition. Marriott stated it would continue to consult the FCC regarding acceptable security measures to protect guests’ data, while also seeking industry-wide solutions that do not involve blocking personal Wi-Fi devices.
translated_content: Inanunsyo ng Marriott International na hindi na nito haharangin ang personal na Wi-Fi devices ng mga bisita sa alinman sa kanilang pinamamahalaang mga hotel. Ang desisyong ito ay dumating matapos ang maraming reklamo ng customer at multa na $600,000 mula sa Federal Communications Commission (FCC) nang matuklasang hinarangan ng Marriott Gaylord Opryland hotel sa Nashville, Tennessee ang mga dumalo ng convention mula sa paggamit ng sarili nilang Wi-Fi sa halip na bumili ng serbisyo mula sa hotel na nagkakahalaga ng $250 hanggang $1,000 bawat stand. Dati, sinabi ng Marriott na ang mga personal na Wi-Fi hotspot ay maaaring makaapekto sa kanilang wireless networks at magdulot ng security risks. Gumamit ang hotel ng systema para imonitor at i-deactivate ang hotspots ng mga bisita, na itinuring ng FCC bilang paglabag sa batas ng federal communications. Nilinaw ng Marriott na hindi nila hinarang ang mga device sa mga guest room o lobby. Humiling ang Marriott sa FCC ng pahintulot na magpatuloy sa pagharang sa personal na Wi-Fi devices bilang depensa sa posibleng security threat mula sa unauthorized hotspots. Sinuportahan ito ng Hilton Worldwide at ng American Hospitality and Lodging Association. Tumutol naman ang mga tech company gaya ng Google at sinabing hindi ito pabor sa kumpetisyon. Sinabi ng Marriott na magpapatuloy silang kumonsulta sa FCC tungkol sa tamang security measures para protektahan ang data ng mga guest at hahanap ng mga solusyon na hindi kailangan ang pagharang ng personal Wi-Fi devices.
post_content: Marriott won't block personal Wi-Fi anymore! 📶 After tons of complaints & a $600k fine, guests can now use their own hotspots at all Marriott hotels. #WiFiFreedom #MarriottNews
translated_post: Hindi na haharangin ng Marriott ang personal Wi-Fi mo! 🙌 Matapos ang mga reklamo at malaking multa, pwede ka na ulit mag-connect gamit ang sariling hotspot sa kahit anong Marriott hotel. #WiFiParaSaLahat #BalitangMarriott

article_content: An Arizona couple has been charged with murder and child abuse following the death of their 18-month-old twin daughter, while her sibling remains hospitalized with severe injuries. Kristepher Benavidez, 25, and Monique Gaxiola, 30, were arrested after authorities responded to their Tucson home and discovered one of the twins was not breathing. Despite emergency efforts, the child died at a nearby hospital. Medical staff informed police that the injuries were not accidental. Further investigation revealed another twin with serious but non-fatal injuries at a neighbor's home. The seven-year-old sister did not appear to be harmed and is now under the care of state Child Protective Services. Benavidez and Gaxiola were initially charged with child abuse and detained at Pima County Jail. After the child's death, charges were increased to first-degree murder. According to Tucson police spokesman Sgt. Chris Widmer, detectives believe the father physically abused the twins while the mother did not report the abuse due to fear. Bail has been set at $20,000 for Benavidez and $5,000 for Gaxiola, though it is unclear if those amounts have changed since the charges were upgraded. Police continue to investigate the incident. Records show Benavidez was previously arrested on drug charges in 2011.
translated_content: Kinasuhan ng pagpatay at pang-aabuso sa bata ang isang mag-asawa sa Arizona matapos mamatay ang kanilang 18-buwang gulang na anak na babae, habang nasa ospital ang kakambal nito dahil sa malubhang pinsala. Inaresto sina Kristepher Benavidez, 25, at Monique Gaxiola, 30, matapos madiskubre ng mga awtoridad sa kanilang bahay sa Tucson na hindi na humihinga ang isa sa kambal. Sa kabila ng agarang lunas, namatay ang bata sa ospital. Ayon sa mga staff ng ospital, hindi aksidente ang natamong pinsala ng bata. Sa karagdagang imbestigasyon, nahanap ang kakambal na may seryoso pero hindi nakamamatay na pinsala sa bahay ng kapitbahay. Ang kanilang pitong taong gulang na kapatid ay walang natamong pinsala at ngayo’y nasa pangangalaga ng State Child Protective Services. Una munang kinasuhan ng child abuse sina Benavidez at Gaxiola at ikinulong sa Pima County Jail. Nang mamatay ang bata, itinaas sa first-degree murder ang kaso. Ayon kay Tucson police spokesman Sgt. article_content: Dmitri Shostakovich’s Symphony No. 7, famed for symbolizing resistance during World War II in Russia, is making headlines decades after the composer’s death. Its powerful fourth movement was recently sampled in Plan B’s hit song ‘Ill Manors’, which has now been shortlisted for Best Contemporary Song at the Ivor Novello Awards. ‘Ill Manors’, written by Ben Drew (aka Plan B) in reaction to the 2011 London riots, merges classical orchestration with modern urban sounds, paying tribute to Shostakovich by crediting him as co-songwriter. Originally performed in 1942 to honor Leningrad’s residents, Symphony No. 7 stands as one of Shostakovich’s most celebrated works. Emeli Sande, after a standout year of award wins and notable performances at the London 2012 Olympics, is recognized in two categories at the Novellos, while groups like Alt-J and The Maccabees are also in the running. The Ivor Novello Awards, esteemed for celebrating songwriting talent, will hold their 58th ceremony on May 16, judged as always by leading members of Britain’s music community.

Ang makapangyarihang ika-apat na bahagi ng simponiya ay ginamit sa kantang ‘Ill Manors’ ni Plan B, na nominado ngayon para sa Best Contemporary Song sa Ivor Novello Awards. Ang ‘Ill Manors’, na isinulat ni Ben Drew (aka Plan B) bilang tugon sa London riots noong 2011, ay pinagsama ang klasikong musika at makabagong tunog, kaya kinilala si Shostakovich bilang co-songwriter. Ang Symphony No. 7, unang itinugtog noong 1942 bilang pag-alay sa mga taga-Leningrad, ay isa sa pinakatanyag na likha ni Shostakovich. Si Emeli Sande, matapos ang isang matagumpay na taon ng mga parangal at pagganap sa London 2012 Olympics, ay nominado sa dalawang kategorya sa Novellos, habang ang Alt-J at The Maccabees ay kabilang din sa mga nominado. Ang Ivor Novello Awards, kilala sa pagbibigay-pugay sa mga magagaling na songwriter, ay gaganapin ang ika-58 edisyon nito sa Mayo 16, na huhusgahan ng mga kilalang tao sa industriya ng musika sa Britain.

article_content: At the Made by Google 2023 event, Google introduced the Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro, both featuring significant upgrades and new AI-powered features. A standout feature is the promise of seven years of guaranteed Android updates for both phones—more support than any other smartphone currently offers. Both devices come with a price increase: in the US, each is $100 more expensive, but in India, the price hike is especially steep. The Pixel 8, featuring 8GB RAM and 128GB storage, is set to retail for ₹75,999 ($912)—a ₹16,000 ($192) jump over the Pixel 7. Meanwhile, the Pixel 7’s price has dropped to ₹41,999 ($504), making it a strong value proposition. On the other hand, the Pixel 8 Pro is priced at ₹1,06,999 ($1,285) for the 12GB/128GB version, a notable ₹22,000 ($264) increase from last year’s Pixel 7 Pro. The disparity in pricing between the US and India, and between older and newer models, raises questions about Google’s strategy. Alongside the phones, Google also announced the Pixel Watch 2 for India, but so far only the Bluetooth version is available at ₹39,999 ($480), with no word yet on the LTE model. Google stated that all three products will be available for pre-order, with official sales beginning October 12, although the online store links are currently inactive. While higher import duties for devices sold in India may play a role in the higher prices, this was also the case in previous years and does not fully explain the significant price jump for the Pixel 8 series. If you’re considering purchasing a Pixel 8 series phone in India, be prepared to pay a significant premium. The upgrades are impressive, especially the new cameras and features, but the high price may warrant waiting for a better deal.

article_content: A recent study published in the journal Nature reveals that amphibians are undergoing a rapid global decline, making them the most threatened class of vertebrates. For instance, the endangered Blue-Sided Leaf Frog (Agalychnis annae) can be seen at Costa Rica's National Biodiversity Institute (INBio) in Heredia. In 2004, when JJ Apodaca began graduate studies in biology, the first comprehensive Global Amphibian Assessment was launched, evaluating over 5,700 species. The findings of that assessment became central to Apodaca’s career, who now leads the Amphibian and Reptile Conservancy. Nineteen years later, the second worldwide evaluation has been released. While not a contributor, Apodaca reviewed the study and remarked, “It’s a gut punch. Not only are things unimproved, but they’ve gotten worse.” Published in Nature, the assessment brings together 20 years of data from over 1,000 scientists, covering nearly the entire global amphibian population. “We assessed 94% of known species,” said lead author Jennifer Luedtke, noting that about 155 new amphibian species are identified annually. Despite continuous discoveries, amphibian declines are outpacing those of other vertebrates, with 41% now threatened with extinction—more than any other group. Major threats include habitat loss from agriculture, logging, and human encroachment, along with diseases such as the chytrid fungus. Increasingly, climate change has emerged as a significant factor: between 2004 and 2022, it contributed to 39% of at-risk species moving nearer to extinction, compared to just 1% in the prior twenty years, Luedtke reported. Amphibians are highly susceptible to changes in temperature and moisture since they require water for reproduction and have permeable skin. As Professor Patricia Burrowes from the University of Puerto Rico explains, “They don’t have feathers, hair, or scales. Their skin offers no protection.” Scientists have observed shifts in amphibian populations, with some species moving to higher elevations as temperatures warm. Burrowes’ study of the endangered forest coqui (Eleutherodactylus portoricensis) highlighted this, showing greater temperature sensitivity among migrating populations. “Patterns aren’t predictable anymore,” she said. The assessment also finds salamanders and newts at particular risk, with the highest diversity in the southeastern United States, especially the Southern Appalachia region where Apodaca works. “This isn’t just a problem for the Global South, Australia, or Central America,” he stressed. “This is happening in our own backyard, making it our responsibility to protect these species.”

Halimbawa, matatagpuan ang endangered na Blue-Sided Leaf Frog (Agalychnis annae) sa National Biodiversity Institute (INBio) ng Costa Rica sa Heredia. Noong 2004, noong nagsimula si JJ Apodaca sa graduate studies ng biology, inilunsad ang unang Global Amphibian Assessment na sumuri sa mahigit 5,700 species. Ang natuklasan doon ang naging gabay sa karera ni Apodaca, na ngayo'y pinuno na ng Amphibian and Reptile Conservancy. Pagkalipas ng labinsiyam na taon, inilabas na ang pangalawang pandaigdigang pagsusuri. Bagamat hindi siya bahagi mismo ng pananaliksik, nirepaso ni Apodaca ang pag-aaral at sinabi, "Masakit. Imbis na bumuti, mas lumala pa ang sitwasyon." Ang ulat na inilathala sa Nature ay pinag-isa ang 20 taon ng datos mula sa mahigit 1,000 siyentipiko at halos lahat ng kilalang species ng amphibian sa mundo. "Sinuri namin ang 94% ng mga kilalang species," pahayag ng lead author na si Jennifer Luedtke, at binaggit din niyang tinatayang may 155 bagong species ang natutuklasan kada taon. Kahit patuloy ang pagtuklas, mas mabilis pa rin ang pagbaba ng populasyon ng amphibian kumpara sa ibang vertebrates—41% ay nanganganib ng extinction, mas mataas pa kaysa sa ibang mga grupo. Pangunahing banta ang pagkawala ng tirahan dahil sa agrikultura, pagtotroso, at paglawak ng tao, kasabay ng mga sakit gaya ng chytrid fungus. Lalong matindi na rin ngayon ang dulot ng climate change: mula 2004 hanggang 2022, ito ang naging dahilan ng 39% ng moving-closer-to-extinction na species, kumpara sa 1% lamang ng nakaraang dalawang dekada, ani Luedtke. Likas na mahina sa pagbabago ng temperatura at moisture ang mga amphibian, dahil kailangan nila ang tubig para magparami at manipis lamang ang kanilang balat. Sabi ni Propesor Patricia Burrowes ng University of Puerto Rico, "Wala silang balahibo, buhok, o kaliskis. Walang proteksyon ang kanilang balat." Napansin ng mga eksperto ang pag-akyat ng ilang species sa mas malamig na bahagi dahil sa nagbabagong klima. Sa pag-aaral niya sa endangered na forest coqui (Eleutherodactylus portoricensis), nakita ni Burrowes na mas sensitibo sa pagbabago ng temperatura ang mga populasiyon na umaakyat. "Hindi na pare-pareho ang mga pattern," dagdag niya. Ayon din sa pagsusuri, sobrang nanganganib ang salamanders at newts, na may pinakamataas na biodiversity sa timog-silangan ng U.S., lalo na sa Southern Appalachia kung saan nagtatrabaho si Apodaca. "Hindi lang ito problema ng Global South, Australia o Central America," diin ni Apodaca. "Nangyayari ito mismo sa paligid natin kaya responsibilidad nating protektahan sila."

Google continues to strengthen its position in the personal assistant app market following its acquisition of Emu. Similar to Google Now, Emu leverages artificial intelligence to anticipate user needs and provide relevant, real-time suggestions. However, Emu goes a step further by scanning conversations as they happen, allowing it to automatically suggest actions like sharing a user’s location on a map or checking calendar availability when friends propose plans.

Emu uses a mix of contextual information from a user's phone—including calendar entries, GPS data, social network posts, and emails—to deliver timely recommendations. For example, if there's an upcoming meeting in the user’s calendar, Google Now can create reminders, provide directions, and estimate travel time based on current traffic. Emu enhances this experience by monitoring conversations to proactively send relevant information, and even allows live location sharing for a limited period.

Founded in 2012 by former Google and Apple employee Gummi Hafsteinsson, Emu’s machine learning technology could offer Google Now more context and improved speed across devices. The Emu team announced in a blog post that the app will be discontinued as of August 25, 2014, and will be removed from the App Store, with users unable to send or receive messages thereafter. While the terms of the deal have not been disclosed, Emu thanked its users and supporters for their involvement.

Google's acquisition of Emu adds to its ongoing investment in artificial intelligence. Earlier this year, the company purchased AI firm DeepMind and previously introduced the Hummingbird update to make its search engine more context-aware. Google also brought on futurist Ray Kurzweil as Engineering Director in 2012, who has made bold predictions about the future of AI—including human mind uploading and mechanical integration.

Ngunit, lumalamang ang Emu dahil kayang nitong i-scan ang mga pag-uusap habang nagaganap, kaya’t awtomatikong nakakapagbigay ito ng suhestiyon gaya ng pagpapadala ng lokasyon ng user sa mapa o pag-check ng availability sa kalendaryo kapag may nag-aaya ng lakad.

An old African proverb states: "If you want to walk fast, walk alone. But if you want to walk far, walk together." This spirit guided the recent International Roundtable on China-Africa Health Cooperation in Gaborone, the capital of Botswana. Marking its fourth consecutive year, and its first time on African soil, the event gathered health officials, academics, private sector members, and representatives from organizations such as the World Health Organization, Global Fund, Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, GAVI Alliance, and several United Nations agencies.

Over two days, participants addressed health challenges including malaria, AIDS, reproductive health, and schistosomiasis—issues that have largely been controlled in China, but which remain significant in Africa. China and African nations share common ground: both have histories of overcoming colonialism, recognize health as essential for economic development, and continue to evolve their economies. These shared values underpin a new model of South-to-South cooperation based on mutual respect and benefit.

China’s collaboration with Africa in health stretches back to the 1960s, starting with the dispatch of medical teams to the continent. In recent years, China has built hospitals, trained African medical professionals, and offered scholarships, along with providing high-quality, affordable medical products. China is now the world’s largest producer of active ingredients for malaria treatments and antiretroviral drugs for HIV/AIDS, as well as other medical devices like contraceptives and circumcision rings. These products, along with China’s logistical expertise in vaccine distribution, could greatly benefit Africa’s healthcare systems.

However, collaboration is reciprocal. Countries like Botswana and Zambia have achieved significant success in preventing mother-to-child HIV transmission, even in rural areas, providing valuable lessons for China as it extends health services to its own remote regions. While the China-Africa health partnership is long-standing and complex—occasionally facing tensions due to cultural differences—the conference highlighted the importance of open dialogue. International organizations also play a vital role by bridging gaps and sharing expertise.

Ultimately, partners aim to develop sustainable, Africa-led solutions to the continent’s greatest health challenges. While much work remains—ensuring treatment for all affected by AIDS, malaria, TB, widespread immunization, and women’s access to contraception—the path forward is encouraging. Closing with a Chinese proverb: "Numerous grains of earth make a mountain; numerous drops of water form an ocean." By advancing China-Africa cooperation, participants hope to achieve lasting health solutions for all.

Ika-apat na taon na'ng pagpupulong na ito, at una sa Africa, nagtipon ang mga opisyal ng kalusugan, akademista, pribadong sektor, at mga kinatawan mula sa World Health Organization, Global Fund, Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, GAVI Alliance, at ilang ahensya ng United Nations.

Dalawang araw nilang tinutukan ang mga hamon sa kalusugan tulad ng malaria, AIDS, reproductive health, at schistosomiasis—mga problemang halos nakokontrol na sa China ngunit malaking hamon pa rin sa Africa. Magkaaral ang China at Africa: parehong nilabanan ang kolonyalismo, itinuturing ang kalusugan bilang pundasyon ng kaunlarang pang-ekonomiya, at patuloy na umuunlad. Dahil sa pinagbabahaging halaga, lumalakas ang South-to-South cooperation na nakabase sa respeto at pagtutulungan.

Matagal na ang partnership ng China at Africa sa kalusugan—simula pa 1960s, nagpapadala na ang China ng medical teams sa Africa. Nitong huli, nagtayo sila ng mga ospital, nagsanay ng health professionals, at nagbigay ng scholarships. Ngayon, malaki ang papel ng China sa produksyon ng mga gamot para sa malaria at HIV/AIDS, at mga medical devices tulad ng contraceptives at circumcision rings. Mahalaga rin ang kontribusyon ng China sa logistics ng bakuna na makakatulong sa healthcare ng Africa.

Pero ang kooperasyon ay dalawang panig. Halimbawa, matagumpay ang Botswana at Zambia sa pagpigil ng mother-to-child HIV transmission kahit sa kanayunan—isang aral din para sa China sa pag-abot ng mga liblib na lugar. Bagama't matagal at masalimuot ang relasyon ng China at Africa, at may mga hamon dahil sa kultura, binigyang-diin ng pagpupulong ang halaga ng bukas na komunikasyon. Mahalaga rin ang ambag ng internasyonal na mga organisasyon sa pagbibigay ng kaalaman at tulong.

Layunin ng pagtutulungan na makamit ang pangmatagalang, Africa-led na mga solusyon sa mga pangunahing hamon sa kalusugan. Marami pang kailangang gawin—tulad ng paggamot sa AIDS, malaria, TB, pagbabakuna ng lahat ng bata, at ligtas na contraceptives para sa mga kababaihan—pero may pag-asa. Wika nga ng kasabihang Tsino: "Maraming butil ng lupa ang bumubuo ng bundok; maraming patak ng tubig ang bumubuo ng karagatan." Sa patuloy na kooperasyon ng China at Africa, magtatagumpay ang pangmatagalang solusyon sa kalusugan para sa lahat.

article_content: The much-anticipated cage fight between Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg may not happen soon, as Meta founder Mark Zuckerberg injured his ACL during MMA training and underwent surgery. He was preparing for his next competitive mixed martial arts (MMA) match. Zuckerberg stated, "I was training for a competitive MMA fight early next year, but now that's delayed a bit. Still looking forward to doing it after I recover. Thanks to everyone for the love and support." His followers have wished him a speedy recovery. Recovery from this type of injury can take up to a year for professional athletes. Last month, Zuckerberg posted a selfie on Instagram showing facial bruises he received during sparring. He commented, "Sparring got a little out of hand. May need to update my avatar," referring to the incident. Zuckerberg has been actively involved in combat sports, such as MMA and Jiu-Jitsu, especially after Elon Musk challenged him to a cage fight. Talks about the fight began in June when Musk replied to a tweet about Meta launching a competitor to Twitter (now called X). In August, Musk said the fight would be livestreamed from a location in Italy. Recently, Zuckerberg was awarded his blue belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu by his coach, Professor Dave Camarillo, after years of training.

A recent study has found that spending excessive time on screens—such as gaming, surfing the internet, and using social media or smartphones—can negatively impact several cognitive functions. The research, led by Macquarie University in Australia and featured in the Neuropsychology Review journal, reviewed data from over 30 studies focused on disordered screen use. This includes behaviors that result in significant problems in a person’s life, like mental health decline, poor performance in school or work, strained relationships, social withdrawal, and neglect of self-care.

Disordered screen habits were found to have similarities with behavioral addictions, such as gambling, and can even produce symptoms generally seen in substance dependence. The researchers analyzed 34 studies in total, with 20 centered on gaming, 12 on internet use, and one each addressing social media and smartphone use. Most studies examined the impact on young males, and tested a range of functions like attention span, impulse control, planning, organization, and problem-solving.

Lead author Mic Moshel highlighted that while the various studies used different types of tests—making direct comparisons tricky—they all showed clear evidence of diminished cognitive performance among those with problematic screen use. However, since only a handful of studies measured the severity of these symptoms, the actual extent of the effects remains uncertain.

Children and adolescents are especially at risk, as their developing brains are more vulnerable to cognitive decline. The research notes that if these issues aren’t addressed early, children may fall further behind their peers academically—a problem that gets worse over time, similar to what happens after a mild traumatic brain injury.

Note: The article also mentions some unrelated news on tax matters and family disputes, which are not connected with the findings about screen use.

article_content: Presidents Joe Biden and Xi Jinping held a significant meeting at California’s Filoli Estate on November 15, 2023, coinciding with the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation conference and in anticipation of the COP28 climate summit in Dubai. As leading global economies, the US and China’s willingness to collaborate is pivotal for advancing worldwide decarbonization efforts and moving toward net zero emissions. Both nations have grounds to question each other's climate actions—some in the US point to China's growing coal infrastructure, while China notes that the US powered its historical development through fossil fuels. Although these arguments are often oversimplified, there is validity on each side. China is responsible for 26% of global primary energy demand and generates about a third of energy-related CO2 emissions. Yet, it’s also a major provider of manufactured goods for the world, and almost half of global investment in low-carbon transition last year occurred in China. The country leads in battery production (over 60% global market share) and contributed 35% of global electric vehicle exports in 2022. Despite advancements in clean energy, coal remains dominant in China's energy mix. Over the past 20 years, China’s primary energy supply has nearly tripled—primarily from coal, which accounted for 58% of China’s energy use and 54% of global coal consumption in 2022. The approval of 87 GW of new coal-fired power plants last year marks a sharp increase compared to the previous year. This is concerning, as both coal and oil consumption are projected to rise in the near future. Nonetheless, a recent joint statement ahead of the Biden-Xi meeting included commitments to speed up the transition from fossil fuels to renewables. There is notable progress in China’s electrification, yet the country’s path to energy independence is expected to involve sustained coal use for several more years, with meaningful reductions forecasted by the end of this decade. In the US, the Inflation Reduction Act is accelerating clean energy initiatives and supporting technologies like hydrogen and direct air capture. Projections suggest that North America’s fossil fuel usage will decrease by 60% by mid-century, and coal consumption will drop by around 80%. Still, even as CO2 emissions from energy have peaked in the US and Canada, the region is unlikely to achieve net zero by 2050. While the US requires less energy per dollar of GDP compared to China, American consumers emit more CO2 per capita. The nation remains the world’s top oil consumer, and although electrifying transportation will reduce domestic oil use, global demand—some from China—will keep production high. Despite policy progress, the US is set to fall short of its net zero ambitions. These climate discussions take place against a backdrop of geopolitical complexity and growing focus on energy security. Continued dialogue between Washington and Beijing could help drive global progress in the energy transition.

Bilang dalawang pinakamalaking ekonomiya sa mundo, napakahalaga ng kooperasyon ng US at China para mapabilis ang pandaigdigang pagpapababa ng carbon at pag-abot ng net zero emissions. May batayan ang US at China para tanungin ang mga aksyon ng isa’t isa pagdating sa klima—binabatikos ng ilan sa US ang patuloy na pagtatayo ng planta ng karbon ng China, habang tinutukoy ng China na ang US ay matagal nang umasa sa fossil fuels para sa kaunlaran nito. Bagamat simplehan, may katotohanan sa mga pananaw na ito. Tumatanggap ang China ng 26% ng total primary energy demand at gumagawa ng halos isang-katlo ng mga energy-related CO2 emissions sa mundo. Mahalaga rin ang papel ng China sa mundo bilang pangunahing tagagawa ng produkto, at halos kalahati ng global low-carbon investment noong nakaraang taon ay nangyari doon. Nasa China din ang higit 60% ng global market share sa baterya at sila ang nag-export ng 35% ng electric vehicles sa mundo noong 2022. Kahit may pag-usad sa malinis na teknolohiya, nangingibabaw pa rin ang karbon sa enerhiya ng China. Sa nakalipas na dalawampung taon, halos tatlong ulit na lumaki ang energy supply nila na mula karamihan sa karbon—na noong 2022 ay 58% ng energy mix ng China at 54% ng global coal consumption. Noong nakaraang taon, 87 GW na bagong kapasidad ng coal power plants ang inaprubahan—malaking pagtaas. Ito ay nakababahala dahil inaasahang patuloy ang pagtaas ng coal at oil sa malapit na hinaharap. Gayunpaman, naglabas ng joint statement bago ang Biden-Xi meeting na nagpapahayag ng pangakong pabilisin ang paglipat mula fossil fuels patungong renewable energy. Malaki ang progreso ng electrification sa China pero nananatiling mataas ang paggamit ng karbon sa susunod pang ilang taon, bago tuluyang bumaba bago matapos ang dekada. Sa US, pinalalakas ng Inflation Reduction Act ang malinis na teknolohiya at pinopondohan ang hydrogen at direct air capture. Ayon sa projections, bababa ng 60% ang paggamit ng fossil fuels sa North America at 80% ang babang konsumo ng coal pagsapit ng 2050. Pero kahit bumaba na ang energy-related CO2 emissions sa US at Canada, malabong maging net zero ang rehiyon pagsapit ng 2050. Habang mas kaunti ang energy per GDP ang kailangan ng US kumpara sa China, mas mataas pa rin ang CO2 emissions per capita ng mga Amerikano. Buhay pa rin ang pagiging pinakamalaking konsyumer ng langis sa America at bagama’t makakatulong ang electrification ng transportasyon, pananatili pa rin ang taas ng produksiyon dahil sa global demand, kasama na ang China. Kahit may progresibong polisiya, malamang hindi pa rin maabot ng US ang net zero ambitions nito. Nagaganap ang climate talks sa gitna ng masalimuot na geopolitics at mataas na pagtuon sa energy security. Ang bukas na usapan sa pagitan ng US at China ay nagbibigay pa rin ng pag-asa para sa pagbilis ng global energy transition.

article_content: A remarkable insect fossil preserved in amber is offering new perspectives on ancient communication. Recent research on a long-extinct katydid, housed at the Natural History Museum, reveals that these cricket relatives have been using ultrasonic sound for millions of years as a strategy to evade predators. By analyzing a 44-million-year-old specimen called Eomortoniellus handlirschi, scientists have reconstructed its mating call. This demonstrates the earliest known use of communication at frequencies well beyond what humans can hear. While not as high-pitched as some modern katydids, its call would have been inaudible to most mammals—only a few, including the earliest bats, could detect it. This finding highlights a pivotal moment in the evolutionary arms race between echolocating bats and insects. Dr. Charlie Woodrow, the study’s lead author, explains that this katydid existed at a critical point when bats were developing echolocation abilities, potentially pushing katydids to call at higher frequencies. The research emphasizes the importance of well-preserved fossils and museum collections in such discoveries. Professor Fernando Montealegre-Zapata, a co-author, shares his excitement over the find, noting it is rare to discover katydids so well preserved in amber. He considers finding this specimen a stroke of luck. The research team’s findings were published in the journal Current Biology. The evolutionary struggle between bats and katydids dates back hundreds of millions of years. Katydids were among the first animals to use sound communication, generating noise by rubbing their wings. Males typically use these calls to attract mates, though they can also draw the attention of predators. Over time, to avoid detection, katydids evolved to call at increasingly higher frequencies. However, by about 125 million years ago, their mammalian predators had adapted to hear these calls. In response, some katydids developed ultrasonic calls, which remained undetected until bats—capable of hearing ultrasound—evolved around 52 million years ago. Since then, bats and katydids have been engaged in a co-evolutionary arms race, with bats becoming better at locating katydids by their calls and katydids continuously modifying their calls and behaviors for survival. Ultrasound allows katydids to communicate locally, reducing the risk of detection by distant predators because these high-frequency sounds do not travel far. The amber specimen of E. handlirschi was found in what was once East Prussia and is now divided among Poland, Russia, and Lithuania. After being described as a new species, it remained in the Natural History Museum’s collections for over 80 years before modern tech made it possible to study its internal structures. Unlike mammals, katydids have ears located inside their legs, a structure usually destroyed during fossilization. CT scans revealed that the ear canal of this specimen was filled with sap, which preserved the delicate auditory organs. The researchers modeled how sound would affect the ear and determined that E. handlirschi was most sensitive to sounds around 30 kHz. The reconstructed call also matched this frequency, suggesting that these insects communicated using these ultrasonic pitches. Additional hearing peaks at 60 and 90 kHz may have helped the katydids detect the echolocation calls of early bats and evade becoming prey. These abilities would have been enhanced by the katydid’s pinnae, a structure analogous—but only partly developed in this case—to the mammalian earlobe. Evolution since then has enabled related species to hear even higher frequencies. Dr. Woodrow emphasizes the need to identify more fossils to trace these evolutionary changes. He suggests that more specimens might exist in both private and public amber collections, waiting to be recognized and studied.
translated_content: Isang kamangha-manghang insektong fossil na napanatili sa amber ang nag-aalok ng bagong pananaw sa sinaunang komunikasyon. Kamakailang pananaliksik sa isang matagal nang nawala na uri ng katydid na nakaimbak sa Natural History Museum ay nagpapakita na ang mga kaanak na ito ng cricket ay gumagamit ng ultrasonic sound sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon bilang paraan upang makaiwas sa mga mandaragit. Sa pamamagitan ng pagsusuri sa isang specimen na tinatawag na Eomortoniellus handlirschi na tinatayang 44 milyong taon na ang tanda, narekonstrak ng mga siyentipiko ang mating call nito. Ipinapakita nito ang pinakamaagang kilalang paggamit ng komunikasyon na lampas sa naririnig ng tao. Kahit hindi kasing taas ng pitch ng ilang modernong katydid, ang tawag nito ay hindi maririnig ng karamihan sa mga mammal—maliban sa iilan, kagaya ng mga unang paniki na kayang makarinig nito. Ang tuklas na ito ay binibigyang-diin ang isang mahalagang yugto sa ebolusyonaryong pagtunggali sa pagitan ng mga paniking gumagamit ng echolocation at mga insekto. Ipinaliwanag ni Dr. Charlie Woodrow, pangunahing may-akda ng pag-aaral, na ang katydid na ito ay umiiral sa isang mahalagang panahon kung kailan ang mga paniki ay nagsisimulang magkaroon ng kakayahang gumamit ng echolocation, na posibleng nagtulak sa mga katydid na tumawag sa mas matataas na dalas. Binibigyang-diin ng pananaliksik na ito ang kahalagahan ng mga fossil na maayos ang pagkakapreserba at ang koleksyon ng mga museo. Ibinahagi ni Professor Fernando Montealegre-Zapata, isa sa mga may-akda, ang kanyang tuwa sa natuklasan, at sinabing bibihira ang makahanap ng katydid na ganito kaganda ang kondisyon sa amber. Itinuturing niyang isang malaking swerte ang pagkakatuklas ng specimen na ito. Ang mga natuklasan ng research team ay nailathala sa journal na Current Biology. Ang ebolusyonaryong labanan ng mga paniki at katydid ay nagsimula pa noong daan-daang milyong taon na ang nakalipas. Isa ang katydid sa mga unang hayop na gumamit ng tunog para magkomunika, gamit ang pagkikiskisan ng kanilang mga pakpak. Karaniwan, gumagamit ang mga lalaki ng tawag na ito para makaakit ng kapareha, pero maaari rin itong makaakit ng mga mandaragit. Sa paglipas ng panahon, upang makaiwas mahuli, nagbago ang mga katydid upang tumawag gamit ang mas mataas na dalas. Ngunit noong mga 125 milyong taon na ang nakararaan, nakadama na rin ng mga mammalian predator ang mga tawag nila. Bilang sagot, may mga katydid na gumamit ng ultrasonic na tawag na hindi naririnig hangga’t hindi pa nag-evolve ang mga paniki na kayang makarinig ng ultrasound, mga 52 milyong taon na ang nakalipas. Simula noon, ang mga paniki at katydid ay nasa patuloy na co-evolutionary arms race—mas nagiging mahusay ang mga paniki sa paghahanap sa katydid gamit ang tawag nito, habang tuluy-tuloy din ang pagbabago ng tawag at kilos ng mga katydid para mabuhay. Pinapayagan ng ultrasound ang katydid na makipag-komunika nang lokal, kaya mas mababa ang tyansang madiskubre sila ng mga malalayong mandaragit dahil hindi gaanong tumatagal ang high-frequency na tunog sa paligid. Ang amber specimen ng E. handlirschi ay natagpuan sa dating East Prussia na ngayon ay bahagi ng Poland, Russia, at Lithuania. Pagkatapos itong ilarawan bilang bagong species, nanatili ito sa koleksyon ng Natural History Museum nang mahigit 80 taon bago naging posible ng makabagong teknolohiya na pag-aralan ang mga internal na istruktura nito. Hindi tulad ng mga mammal, ang tenga ng katydid ay matatagpuan sa loob ng kanilang mga binti, isang estrukturang kadalasang nasisira kapag naging fossil. Sa tulong ng CT scan, natuklasan na napuno ng dagta ang ear canal ng specimen na ito kaya na-preserba ang maselang bahagi ng pandinig nito. Gumawa ang mga mananaliksik ng modelo kung paano naaapektuhan ng tunog ang tenga at natuklasan na ang E. handlirschi ay pinaka-sensitive sa tunog na mga 30 kHz. Ang narekonstrak na tawag nito ay tumutugma rin sa dalas na ito, na nagpapahiwatig na nag-uusap sila gamit ang ganitong ultrasonic na tunog. Mayroon ding natuklasang mga peak sa pandinig sa 60 at 90 kHz na posibleng tumulong para marinig ng katydid ang echolocation calls ng mga sinaunang paniki at makaiwas na maging pagkain. Lalong napahusay ang kakayahang ito dahil sa pinnae ng katydid, isang estrukturang kahalintulad—kahit hindi lubusang nabuo—ng earlobe ng mammal. Sa pagdaan ng panahon, nakarinig na rin ng mas matataas na dalas ang mga kaanak ng species na ito. Binibigyang-diin ni Dr. Woodrow ang pangangailangang makahanap pa ng mas maraming fossil para masubaybayan ang mga pagbabagong ito sa ebolusyon. Naniniwala siyang mas marami pang specimen ang posibleng nasa mga pribado at pampublikong koleksyon ng amber na naghihintay lamang na mapansin at mapag-aralan.

article_content: Ivan Ljubicic, a well-known Croatian tennis player and former world No. 3, will retire from the sport after the Monte Carlo Masters this April. Over his 14-year career, Ljubicic secured notable accomplishments, including helping Croatia win the Davis Cup in 2005, capturing 10 ATP Tour titles, earning a bronze medal at the 2004 Athens Olympics, and making it to the semifinals of the French Open in 2006. Roger Federer, a longtime friend and competitor, paid tribute to Ljubicic, commending his contributions both as a challenging opponent and an influential figure off the court. Federer noted their decade-long rivalry, having faced Ljubicic 16 times and winning on 13 occasions. Despite feeling that it's not an easy choice, Ljubicic is ready to retire and hopes to continue being involved in tennis in the future.

Nagbigay-pugay si Roger Federer, matagal na niyang kaibigan at karibal, at pinuri si Ljubicic bilang mahusay na kalaban at mahalagang tao sa tennis kahit labas ng court. article_content: Winter holidays in Europe don’t always have to involve skiing. For those looking for adventure off the slopes, there are plenty of exciting options. From dog sledding in Norway to hiking Spain’s famous Camino de Santiago, here are four action-packed winter breaks for non-skiers.  Hike the Camino de Santiago without the crowds: Although winter is the least busy time to walk the Camino de Santiago, it comes with unique benefits. The historic pilgrimage route, often crowded in warmer months, is much quieter in winter. Hikers can enjoy peaceful trails, snowy mountain scenery, and beautiful sunrises—all without the usual crowds or long waits for a hot shower.  Experience magic at Tivoli Gardens, Copenhagen: Tivoli Gardens, opened in 1843, is the second-oldest amusement park in the world and famously inspired Walt Disney. The park, known for its beautiful gardens and historic rides, transforms into a sparkling winter wonderland every Christmas. Over one million lights decorate the area, 40km of Christmas tree chains light the gardens, and 11,800 liters of mulled wine are served. For accommodation, consider the Moxy Copenhagen Sydhavnen, a leading sustainable hotel powered entirely by renewable energy.  Go sledding and search for the Northern Lights in Tromsø: Tromsø, located above the Arctic Circle in northern Norway, is a hotspot for winter adventure. From November to February, it’s peak season to see the spectacular Northern Lights. Visitors can go dog sledding, watch for reindeer, or even take a whale safari.  Explore winter hiking in Verbier, Swiss Alps: The Swiss region of Verbier offers winter hiking routes for all experience levels. You can hike to the ruins of Le Chateau de Verbier through forested areas with panoramic views of Valais and the Rhone Valley. Alternatively, take the Sentier des Chamois through the Haut Val de Bagnes nature reserve. Starting from Les Ruinettes, visitors can also wander through Verbier’s 3-D Sculpture Park showcasing unique mountain art.

The remains of Joao Goulart, the former president of Brazil, have been exhumed nearly four decades after his death to determine whether he was murdered. While Goulart, often called Jango, was long believed to have died of a heart attack in exile in Argentina in 1976, recent claims suggest otherwise. The body was removed from his grave in Sao Borja, Brazil, following allegations by a Uruguayan intelligence officer that Goulart was poisoned by spies working for Brazil’s then-military government.

Goulart, who led Brazil from 1961 until he was ousted in a military coup in 1964, first fled to Uruguay before settling in Argentina in 1973 at the invitation of President Juan Perón. He was known for his progressive, left-leaning politics. Goulart died in Mercedes, Argentina, in December 1976, just months after Perón’s widow, Isabel, was overthrown by the Argentine military. No autopsy was conducted in either Argentina or Brazil.

Officials had declared the cause of death as a heart attack, but controversy persisted. In recent years, Mario Neira, a former inmate convicted of drug smuggling, alleged that Goulart had been poisoned under the covert multinational Operation Condor, with Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, and Chile accused of collaboration. Neira claimed Goulart’s heart medication was switched with pills designed to induce cardiac arrest.

These claims are now under review by Brazil’s National Truth Commission. Goulart’s remains are set to be examined in Brasilia before an official ceremony. He is the only former Brazilian president buried without full honors. A statement from the commission, reported by the BBC, read: “Today we open a new chapter in the mystery surrounding the death of our former president. The exhumation aims to end the anguish of his family and many Brazilians who believe his death was not natural, as stated in the death certificate issued without a prior autopsy.”

Ang mga labi ni Joao Goulart, dating pangulo ng Brazil, ay inilibing muli halos apatnapung taon matapos siyang pumanaw upang matukoy kung siya ay pinaslang. Bagaman matagal nang pinaniniwalaang namatay si Goulart, na kilala bilang Jango, dahil sa atake sa puso habang nasa Argentina noong 1976, may mga bagong alegasyon hinggil dito. Inalis ang kanyang mga labi mula sa libingan sa Sao Borja, Brazil matapos ang paratang mula sa isang opisyal ng intelligence sa Uruguay na nilason siya ng mga espiya para sa militar ng Brazil noon.

Si Goulart, na naging pinuno ng Brazil mula 1961 hanggang mapatalsik siya sa isang kudeta ng militar noong 1964, ay tumakas muna sa Uruguay at nang lumaon ay lumipat sa Argentina noong 1973 sa paanyaya ni Pangulong Juan Perón. Kilala siya bilang isang progresibong lider na may paniniwalang makakaliwa. Namatay si Goulart sa Mercedes, Argentina noong Disyembre 1976, ilang buwan matapos patalsikin ng militar si Isabel Perón. Walang naisagawang autopsy o post-mortem sa Argentina o Brazil.

Idineklara ng mga opisyal na atake sa puso ang dahilan ng kanyang pagkamatay, ngunit nanatili ang kontrobersiya. Nitong mga nakaraang taon, inakusahan ni Mario Neira, isang dating bilanggo na nahatulan dahil sa droga, na nilason si Goulart sa ilalim ng lihim na Operation Condor—isang sabwatan ng Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, at Chile. Sinabi ni Neira na pinalitan umano ang kanyang gamot sa puso ng mga tableta na magdudulot ng hinto sa puso.

Kasalukuyang iniimbestigahan ng National Truth Commission ng Brazil ang mga alegasyong ito. Dadalhin ang mga labi ni Goulart sa Brasilia para sa pagsusuri bago ang opisyal na seremonya. Siya lamang ang dating pangulo ng Brazil na inilibing na walang buong parangal. Ayon sa pahayag ng komisyon na iniulat ng BBC: “Ngayong araw ay binubuksan natin ang bagong kabanata ng misteryong bumabalot sa pagkamatay ng ating dating pangulo. Layunin ng exhumation na tapusin na ang pangamba ng kanyang pamilya at maraming Brazilian na naniniwalang hindi likas ang kanyang pagkamatay, taliwas sa nakasaad sa kanyang death certificate na inisyu kahit walang ipinagawang autopsy.”

article_content: Most people agree that the cheese on pizza should be golden, flavorful, and perfectly elastic. Now, food scientists have identified the best cheese combination for optimal stringiness and taste: a mixture of mozzarella and cheddar. Researchers from the University of Auckland assessed seven cheese varieties—mozzarella, cheddar, colby, Edam, Emmental, Gruyere, and provolone—to see how well they melted and browned as pizza toppings. They found that key attributes like elasticity, oil content, moisture, water activity, and transition temperature all influence cheese appearance and texture. Their study, published in the Journal of Food Science, showed that cheddar, colby, and Edam rarely formed the characteristic dark blisters seen on pizzas due to their low elasticity. Meanwhile, Gruyere and provolone's high oil content prevented sufficient browning, and Emmental did not attain a golden color. The scientists suggest combining these cheeses with mozzarella, which blisters and browns more readily, to create gourmet pizzas with improved appearance and less burning. Notably, the study used computer vision to objectively evaluate cheese performance, avoiding subjective taste tests. Separately, Dr. Eugenia Cheng from the University of Sheffield developed a mathematical formula to optimize the ratio of topping to base on pizza. Her analysis revealed that smaller pizzas provide more topping per bite, while larger pizzas offer more evenly distributed flavors. Dr. Cheng's research, commissioned by Pizza Express, explained that factors like pizza size and base thickness determine the balance of flavors with each bite. For instance, an average bite from an 11-inch pizza has roughly 10% more topping than a bite from a 14-inch pizza, even with equal amounts of dough and topping overall.

Ngayon, natukoy na ng mga food scientist ang pinakamainam na kombinasyon ng keso para sa perpektong stringiness at lasa: pinaghalong mozzarella at cheddar. Sinuri ng mga mananaliksik mula sa University of Auckland ang pitong uri ng keso—mozzarella, cheddar, colby, Edam, Emmental, Gruyere, at provolone—kung paano ito natutunaw at nagba-brown bilang pizza toppings. Natuklasan nila na ang mga katangian tulad ng elasticity, oil content, moisture, water activity, at transition temperature ay malaking epekto sa itsura at tekstura ng keso. Ayon sa kanilang pag-aaral na inilathala sa Journal of Food Science, bihirang mabuo ang madidilim na blisters sa cheddar, colby, at Edam dahil sa mababang elasticity ng mga ito. Samantala, ang mataas na oil content ng Gruyere at provolone ay pumipigil na mag-brown ito, at hindi rin pumuputing-ginto ang Emmental. Iminumungkahi ng mga siyentipiko na pagsamahin ang mga kesong ito sa mozzarella, na mas madaling mag-blister at mag-brown, para makagawa ng gourmet na pizza na mas maganda ang itsura at hindi sunog. Kapansin-pansin, gumamit ng computer vision ang pag-aaral para masuri nang obhetibo ang performance ng keso, nang hindi umaasa sa subjective na taste test. Samantala, si Dr. Eugenia Cheng mula sa University of Sheffield ay gumawa ng mathematical formula para malaman ang pinakamainam na ratio ng toppings sa base ng pizza. Napatunayan niya na mas maraming toppings kada kagat ang mas maliit na pizza, habang mas pantay-pantay ang lasa sa malalaking pizza. Ipinaliwanag ni Dr. Cheng, na inatasan ng Pizza Express, na may malaking epekto sa balanse ng flavors kada kagat ang laki ng pizza at kapal ng base. Halimbawa, ang karaniwang kagat mula sa 11-inch na pizza ay may humigit-kumulang 10% na mas maraming toppings kaysa sa kagat mula sa 14-inch na pizza, kahit pareho ang dami ng dough at toppings.

article_content: Many people experience nostalgia—a predominantly positive emotion tied to recalling important events, often shared with close friends and family. Recent surveys indicate around two-thirds of Europeans feel this way. Nostalgia reaches beyond personal life, influencing politics through a longing for a more prosperous past or lost traditions. Political parties, especially those with right-wing or nationalist ideologies, have been observed employing nostalgic themes in their campaigns. A notable example is Italy's far-right party Fratelli d'Italia (Brothers of Italy), currently leading the nation's coalition government. Their 2022 manifesto included references such as the belief that the nation's 'natural resources and artistic heritage are an inheritance to be guarded and enhanced,' and that 'the elderly represent our history: a heritage of experiences, skills, talents that have helped to the birth and growth of our nation.' These statements draw on collective pride in Italy's past. Research demonstrates that nostalgia can shape political opinions. For example, studies from the Netherlands and Turkey found that nostalgic citizens are less satisfied with their governments and are more likely to support radical right parties. A recent study analyzed 1,650 election manifestos from parties across 24 European democracies spanning 1946-2018. While these manifestos mainly focus on promising future policies, about 10% of their content, on average, discusses the past. The study found that parties in Central, Eastern, and Southern Europe use nostalgic rhetoric more often than those in Western or Northern Europe. Central and Eastern European manifestos averaged 44 nostalgic sentences per 1,000 compared to less than half that in the West and North. Many of the most nostalgic parties are classified as nationalist, such as All for Latvia, the Estonian People's Union, Golden Dawn in Greece, Sweden Democrats, and the French National Rally (formerly the National Front). Nevertheless, nostalgic references can be found across the political spectrum: eight out of ten manifestos included some form of nostalgia. The analysis showed nostalgia is more connected with cultural conservatism than economic conservatism. It is more likely to address cultural topics than economic issues. Parties seem to use nostalgia strategically, choosing to emphasize the past, present, or future depending on the broader political context. Other studies reveal parties typically frame education, economic, and environmental policies with a future focus, while security, immigration, and defense are discussed with reference to the past. Nostalgia can unite people but is clearly employed strategically in political campaigns. Its widespread use suggests parties see it as a useful tool, but it should not distract voters from critically assessing future-oriented policy proposals. Sentiments like 'our historic market towns, cathedral cities, and unspoiled countryside are the envy of the world' are not equivalent to concrete electoral promises. Such messaging can sometimes mask an absence of tangible policy plans or offer political cover for introducing controversial measures. Research on issues like gun control, immigration, and social justice shows that nostalgic appeals can shift public opinion in unexpected directions. While conservative parties often leverage nostalgia, progressive parties might also use it for positive aims. Given nostalgia's strong presence in society, it is expected to remain a part of political communication.

Ayon sa mga survey, tinatayang dalawang-katlo ng mga Europeo ang nakakaramdam nito. Hindi lang limitado sa personal na buhay ang nostalgia; naaapektuhan din nito ang pulitika, lalo na kung may pananabik sa mas masaganang nakaraan o mga tradisyong nawala. Madalas gamitin ng mga partido pulitikal—lalo na ng mga right-wing at nasyonalista—ang temang nostalgia sa kanilang mga kampanya. Halimbawa, ang far-right na partido sa Italya na Fratelli d'Italia (Brothers of Italy), na kasalukuyang namumuno sa coalition government ng bansa. Sa 2022 na manifesto nila, may mga pahayag na tulad ng 'ang likas na yaman at pamana ng sining ng bansa ay minanang yaman na dapat pangalagaan at pagyamanin,' at 'ang mga matatanda ay sumasalamin sa ating kasaysayan: pamana ng karanasan, kakayahan, at talento na nag-ambag sa pag-usbong at paglago ng ating bansa.' Ang mga pahayag na ito ay nagsusulong ng kolektibong pagmamalaki sa nakaraan ng Italya. Ipinapakita ng pananaliksik na maaaring makaapekto ang nostalgia sa pananaw pampulitika. Sa mga pag-aaral sa Netherlands at Turkey, natuklasan na ang mga nostalhik na mamamayan ay hindi gaanong nasisiyahan sa pamahalaan at mas malapit bumoto sa mga radikal na right-wing na partido. Isang bagong pag-aaral ang nagsuri ng 1,650 na election manifesto mula sa mga partido ng 24 na European democracies simula 1946 hanggang 2018. Kahit kadalasan ay tungkol sa mga pangakong panghinaharap ang mga manifesto, mga 10% ng nilalaman nito ay tumatalakay sa nakaraan. Nakabuo ng konklusyon ang pag-aaral na mas madalas gumamit ng nostalgic rhetoric ang mga partido sa Central, Eastern, at Southern Europe kaysa sa Western at Northern Europe. Sa Central at Eastern Europe, may average na 44 nostalgic na pangungusap kada 1,000; kalahati lang nito ang karaniwan sa West at North. Kabilang sa mga pinaka-nostalgic na partido ayon sa Manifesto Project ang All for Latvia, Estonian People's Union, Golden Dawn ng Greece, Sweden Democrats, at French National Rally (dating National Front). Gayunpaman, makikita rin ang nostalgia sa iba’t ibang partido sa pulitika—walo sa bawat sampung manifesto ay may anyo ng nostalgia. Mas konektado ang nostalgia sa cultural conservatism kaysa economic conservatism—mas tinatalakay nito ang mga isyung kultural kaysa ekonomiko. Ginagamit ang nostalgia bilang estratehiya ng mga partido, na pinipiling ituon ang usapan sa nakaraan, kasalukuyan, o hinaharap depende sa kontekstong politikal. Ipinapakita ng ibang mga pag-aaral na mas naka-future focus ang usaping edukasyon, ekonomiya at kapaligiran, habang ang seguridad, migrasyon at defense ay karaniwang konektado sa nakaraan. Bagamat maaaring pagmulan ng pagkakaisa ang nostalgia, malinaw na ginagamit ito nang estratehiko sa pulitika. Pinapakita ng malawak nitong pag-gamit na kinikilala ito bilang mahalagang kasangkapan—ngunit hindi dapat ito maging hadlang sa masusing pagsusuri ng planong panghinaharap ng mga partido. Ang mga pahayag na tulad ng 'ang ating makasaysayang market towns, cathedral cities, at hindi nagagalaw na kanayunan ang hinahangaan sa buong mundo' ay hindi kapareho ng kongkretong plataporma. Minsan, natatabunan ng ganoong mensahe ang kakulangan ng tiyak na mga plano o nagagamit ito para matabunan ang mga kontrobersyal na patakaran. Lumalabas sa pananaliksik sa mga isyung tulad ng gun control, imigrasyon, at social justice na napapalipat-tanaw ng nostalgia ang pananaw ng mamamayan hindi sa inaasahan. Kung natutuklasan ng mga konserbatibong partido na malakas gamitin ang nostalgia, maaaring gamitin din ito ng mga progresibong grupo para sa positibong mensahe. Dahil malaki ang bahagi ng lipunan na nostalhik, malamang ay manatili ito bilang bahagi ng diskurso sa pulitika.

article_content: Two young men riding a motorbike went on a vandalism spree in Laggere, north Bengaluru, late Thursday night. According to police, the duo used wooden logs to smash the windows of 15 cars, break the windshields of a Canter truck and an autorickshaw, and damage two parked motorbikes. The attack happened around 12:30 in the morning, with all the vehicles parked in a row along the road. CCTV footage shows the suspects wearing full-face helmets while carrying out the attacks. Most vehicle owners, including Prasanna, were asleep at the time. Prasanna recalled waking up to loud noises and the sound of breaking glass, and seeing the men on a bike through his window. By the time residents gathered outside, numerous vehicles had already been damaged. Rajagopalnagar police suspect that the attackers might have been under the influence of alcohol or drugs, but this has not been established. Police commissioner B Dayananda stated that officers will take stricter action, including opening rowdy-sheets, against those responsible for such property destruction.

Ayon sa pulisya, nangyari ang insidente bandang 12:30 ng madaling araw, at magkakasunod na nakapila ang mga sasakyan sa kalsada. Kita sa CCTV na naka-full-face helmet ang mga lalaki habang naninira ng sasakyan. Karamihan sa mga may-ari, kasama si Prasanna, ay natutulog nang mangyari ito. Kwento ni Prasanna, napukaw siya ng malalakas na tunog at pagkalas ng salamin, at nasilayan ang mga binata sa motorsiklo. Ngunit marami nang sasakyan ang sira nang lumabas ang mga kapitbahay. Hinala ng Rajagopalnagar police, maaaring nasa impluwensya ng alak o droga ang mga salarin, pero hindi pa ito kumpirmado. Binanggit ni Police Commissioner B Dayananda na maghihigpit ang pulisya at magbubukas ng rowdy-sheets laban sa mga maninira ng ari-arian.

article_content: An Australian man has captured what may be one of the most exciting outback selfies ever. In a video posted on YouTube, he is seen driving near a huge red desert tornado, also referred to as a 'dust devil.' There is speculation about the video’s authenticity. In the one-minute clip, the man, with a strong Australian accent, says, 'It's really, really forming,' and laughs, 'That's one of the biggest ones I've seen in a few years.' He unbuckles his seatbelt and tells the camera, 'I'm running into this thing!' The footage shows him jumping out of his car in the Australian outback to take a selfie with the approaching tornado. As he gets closer, he shouts, 'Jesus Christ, that is huge!' The dust devil rapidly approaches, and he runs back to his car while filming. He appears to climb back into his car just as the tornado reaches it, with dust swirling around the windows and briefly plunging the car into darkness. As the tornado passes, the man readjusts the camera, breathless, and repeats, 'Oh my God.' The video was uploaded by Terry Tufferson, who previously posted a viral video featuring a man fighting off a great white shark in Sydney Harbour. Given Tufferson's history with viral content, some YouTube users have questioned the authenticity of the tornado video.

article_content: Moeen Ali’s first year in Test cricket has seen him face both sporting and personal challenges. Taking over as England’s principal spinner after Graeme Swann, Moeen has made his presence felt, thriving as a player and a positive influence, especially within the British Asian community. In addition to his performance on the field, Moeen has had to handle attention over his beliefs. His choice to wear pro-Palestinian wristbands during a Test match — an act he explained was done for humanitarian, not political, reasons — generated much public discussion. Moeen admitted he hadn’t realized the wristbands would draw so much notice but complied with the ICC’s instruction to remove them, and thanked the ECB for their backing. Clarifying another incident, Moeen explained that a photo of him believed to be from a political rally was actually just him shopping with his family. Though he values charity work, in this case, it was an ordinary family outing. His performances in the matches at Southampton and Old Trafford, where he took a total of ten wickets in two games, highlighted his growing skill as a spinner. Moeen credited improvements to advice from teammate Ian Bell and umpire Kumar Dharmasena, who helped him modify his bowling style for greater effectiveness. While he is best known as a batsman — as shown by his century against Sri Lanka — Moeen has worked to manage challenges from short-pitched Indian bowling. He is now refocusing on his fundamentals to continue improving. Moeen is mindful of his broader impact, aiming to change perceptions about Muslims and British Asians in sport. Proud of his English background, he encourages young people from minority groups to pursue their ambitions, believing hard work and inclusivity can break down barriers. His aspirations go beyond cricket, aiming to inspire others by challenging stereotypes within the English game.

Bukod sa kanyang ipinamalas sa cricket, napansin din ang kanyang mga paniniwala.
