article_content: MOGADISHU: Somalia is facing its worst flooding in decades, with at least 29 people dead and more than 300,000 forced to flee their homes, according to the National Disaster Management Agency. The heavy rains have inundated towns throughout East Africa, and authorities are working urgently to rescue thousands of people stranded by floodwaters. The disaster comes just after the region endured its most severe drought in 40 years. Hassan Isse, managing director of the Somali Disaster Management Agency (SOMDA), described the current situation as even worse than the devastating 1997 floods. He warned that the death toll and number of displaced people may rise, as many remain trapped by the rising water. Mohamed Farah, an elder in Baidoa city in southwest Somalia, shared: 'I do not remember such floods in my life. People keep evacuating, looking for high ground.' In Luuq town, the Jubba River has burst its banks, isolating at least 2,400 people, according to the United Nations. Ahmed Nur, a trader from Luuq, reported that 'Luuq is surrounded by the river and the floods are threatening us. People keep fleeing out of the town. Some are still trapped. Our shops have been washed away.' Neighboring Kenya has also experienced fatal flooding, with at least 15 deaths reported and a bridge in Uganda submerged, cutting off a key road from Kampala to oilfields in the northwest, authorities in both countries said. Climate expert Nazanine Moshiri of the International Crisis Group explained that the floods are the result of both El Niño and the Indian Ocean Dipole—weather patterns that raise ocean surface temperatures, leading to heavier rainfall. She added that the impact is worse due to soil degradation from previous drought, ongoing conflict, and the presence of al Shabaab militants, which complicate the construction of flood defenses. Scientists agree that climate change is fueling more intense and frequent extreme weather events. In response, African leaders have called for new global taxes and reforms to international financial institutions to help fund action against climate change.
translated_content: MOGADISHU: Nahaharap ngayon ang Somalia sa pinakamatinding pagbaha sa loob ng maraming dekada, kung saan hindi bababa sa 29 ang namatay at higit 300,000 katao ang napilitang lumikas mula sa kanilang mga tahanan, ayon sa National Disaster Management Agency. Inabot ng matinding pag-ulan ang mga bayan sa buong Silangang Africa, at nagtutulungan ang mga awtoridad para sagipin ang libu-libong taong na-trap sa tubig baha. Nangyari ito matapos ang pinakamatinding tagtuyot sa rehiyon sa loob ng 40 taon. Ayon kay Hassan Isse, managing director ng Somali Disaster Management Agency (SOMDA), mas malala pa raw ito sa malawakang pagbaha noong 1997. Nagbabala siya na maaaring tumaas pa ang bilang ng mga nasawi at lumikas, dahil marami pa ang na-trap sa taas ng tubig. Ibinahagi ni Mohamed Farah, isang nakatatanda sa lungsod ng Baidoa sa timog-kanlurang Somalia: 'Hindi ko pa naranasan ang ganitong pagbaha sa aking buong buhay. Tuloy-tuloy ang paglikas ng mga tao, naghahanap ng mas mataas na lugar.' Sa bayan ng Luuq, umapaw ang Jubba River at hindi bababa sa 2,400 katao ang na-isolate, ayon sa United Nations. Ayon kay Ahmed Nur, isang mangangalakal mula sa Luuq: 'Pinalilibutan ng ilog ang Luuq at nanganganib kami sa baha. Marami ang nagsilikas palabas ng bayan. May ilan pa ring na-trap. Nasira at inanod ang aming mga tindahan.' Apektado rin ang katabing bansa na Kenya na may hindi bababa sa 15 nasawi dahil sa baha, at nalubog din ang isang tulay sa Uganda, dahilan para maputol ang mahalagang daan mula Kampala papunta sa mga oilfield sa hilagang-kanluran, ayon sa mga awtoridad. Ipinaliwanag ni Nazanine Moshiri, isang climate analyst mula International Crisis Group, na dulot ng El Niño at Indian Ocean Dipole ang malawakang pagbaha—mga pattern ng panahon na nagpapainit ng temperatura ng dagat at nagdudulot ng mas malalakas na pag-ulan. Dagdag pa niya, naging mas malala ang epekto dahil sa sira-sirang lupa mula sa matinding tagtuyot, tuloy-tuloy na kaguluhan, at presensya ng mga armadong grupo tulad ng al Shabaab na nagpapahirap sa pagbuo ng mga flood defenses. Tinutukoy ng mga siyentipiko na ang climate change ay nagpapalala at nagpapadalas ng matitinding kalamidad na tulad nito. Bilang tugon, umapela ang mga lider ng Africa para sa mga bagong pandaigdigang buwis at reporma sa mga internasyonal na institusyong pinansyal para tumulong pondohan ang mga aksyon kontra climate change.

article_content: Boston-based designer and Project Runway: All Stars alum Sonjia Williams, age 27, took on a high-pressure challenge after seeing Rosamund Pike's eye-catching Givenchy gown at the Oscars. With only five hours overnight, Williams crafted her own version—even though she didn't have the exact lace fabric, she smartly improvised with red leather for the dress’s side detailing and belt and reproduced its scalloped neckline. The result was unveiled live on the Today show, modeled by host Natalie Morales. Speaking to anchor Savannah Guthrie, Williams described how she quickly bought materials before the awards and, lacking matching lace, opted for red crepe. Morales and Guthrie praised how skillfully Williams replicated the style, given her limited resources. Rosamund Pike’s Givenchy dress stood out on social media as a top Oscar red carpet look, while Williams’ speedy recreation earned accolades for creativity and effort. Despite working through the night, Williams said the experience was worth it, thanking the Today show with a celebratory Instagram post from the studio. At the Oscars, Pike was nominated for Best Actress for 'Gone Girl' but lost to Julianne Moore for 'Still Alice.' Social media buzzed over Pike’s style and Williams’ resourcefulness, which brought even more buzz to an already memorable red carpet event.

Wala siyang lace na tulad sa orihinal kaya red leather ang ginamit niya para sa mga detalye at sinturon, at tinapatan pa ang scalloped neckline. Ipinakita ang natapos na damit nang live sa Today show, suot ng host na si Natalie Morales. Ikinuwento ni Williams kay anchor Savannah Guthrie na mabilis siyang bumili ng materials bago nagsimula ang awards, at dahil wala siyang lace, red crepe ang napili niya. Sobrang impressed sina Morales at Guthrie sa pagkakagawa ni Williams kahit limited ang resources. Isa si Rosamund Pike sa mga pinaka-pinag-usapan sa social media dahil sa kanyang Givenchy dress, habang maraming bumilib sa bilis at pagiging malikhain ni Williams sa kanyang gawa. Kahit puyat, masaya si Williams at nagpasalamat siya sa Today show sa kanyang Instagram post mula mismo sa studio. Nominee pa si Pike sa Best Actress para sa 'Gone Girl,' pero si Julianne Moore ng 'Still Alice' ang nanalo. Usap-usapan sa social media ang gown ni Pike at ang resourcefulness ni Williams, na nagdagdag pa sa excitement ng red carpet.

Tina Martin, a 43-year-old woman from Seaton, Devon, defied the odds by giving birth to her daughter, Tassiah, despite a history marked by severe health problems. Diagnosed with Type 1 diabetes at age seven, Tina needed two kidney transplants from family members and a pancreas transplant from a deceased donor after years of illness and dialysis.

In January, she delivered Tassiah by caesarian section at 35 weeks, and although the baby weighed just four pounds, she was healthy. This outcome shocked Tina’s doctors, who had cautioned that her condition and anti-rejection medications gave her pregnancy very slim chances. Her consultant, Dr. Jonathan Kwan, highlighted the extraordinary rarity of Tina’s case, noting that very few, if any, individuals with end-stage diabetic kidney disease, a long dialysis history, and three organ transplants have delivered a healthy child.

Tina, who previously had two children by caesarian before her transplants, faced additional complications during her latest surgery due to the transplanted organs in her abdomen. Type 1 diabetes, an autoimmune illness most often beginning in childhood, causes the body to destroy the cells that make insulin. About one in ten diabetes cases in the UK are Type 1, which must be managed with insulin since there is no cure.

After her latest childbirth, Tina’s transplanted pancreas stopped working. She cannot receive another transplant until a year has passed, and because of her small body size, surgeons must remove the failed organ before another can be put in. Despite also becoming blind from her illness, Tina remains upbeat, expressing hope for the future and gratitude to her medical team for helping her through a seemingly impossible journey.

Si Tina Martin, 43-anyos mula Seaton, Devon, ay naging patunay na may mga himalang nangyayari. Sa kabila ng matinding problema sa kalusugan, nasilang niya ang anak na si Tassiah. Bata pa lang siya ay natukoy na may Type 1 diabetes at nagdaan siya sa dalawang kidney transplant mula sa kanyang ina at kapatid, at isang pancreas transplant mula sa yumao. Ilang taon din siyang sumailalim sa dialysis.

Noong Enero, isinilang ni Tina si Tassiah sa pamamagitan ng caesarian section sa ika-35 linggo ng kanyang pagbubuntis. Kahit apat na libra lang ang timbang ni Tassiah, malusog siya at nakakagulat ito para sa mga doktor. Ayon kay Dr. Jonathan Kwan, consultant ni Tina, napakarami ng komplikasyon kaya halos imposibleng magbuntis at manganak siya. Napakabihira ng kasong tulad niya—matagal na may end-stage diabetic kidney disease, matagal na dialysis, at tatlong organ transplant, pero nagawa pang magkaanak ng malusog.

Bago pa ang mga pag-transplant, nanganak na si Tina ng dalawa pang anak sa caesarian din. Lalo pang naging komplikado ang huling operasyon dahil sa mga transplanted organ sa tiyan niya. Ang Type 1 diabetes ay autoimmune at karaniwang nagsisimula sa pagkabata—sinisira ng katawan ang mga cell tagagawa ng insulin. Sampung porsyento lamang ng mga may diabetes sa UK ang may ganitong uri, at insulin lang talaga ang solusyon dito, walang lunas.

Matapos manganak, pumalya ang transplanted na pancreas ni Tina. Kailangan niyang maghintay ng isang taon bago pwedeng palitan ito. Dahil maliit ang build niya, kailangan munang alisin ang lumang pancreas bago malagyan ng bago. Nabulag na rin si Tina dahil sa kanyang sakit, pero nananatili siyang positibo at nagpapasalamat sa dedikasyon ng kanyang mga doktor at umaasa pa rin sa magandang hinaharap.

A Florida man has been arrested for fatally shooting his ex-girlfriend, who was an active participant in a medieval re-enactment group. Scott Stuut, 24, was taken into custody on Tuesday and charged with first-degree murder and armed burglary. The victim, Margaret Gee, 59, was found dead in her home north of DeLand on March 2. Gee, a grandmother and widow known as the Honorable Lady Nekhbet Alexandra Selene in the Shire of Vaca Del Mar group, had been babysitting a 19-month-old child at the time; the child was unharmed.

Gee had expressed concerns on social media about her ex-boyfriend after ending their relationship, noting that he had threatened her life. In a Facebook post, she indicated that unknown information about poisons had been found on her laptop. When questioned, Stuut acknowledged an interest in poisons, stating, 'I like to know things. Poisons are something to know.' Regarding the crime, he told detectives, 'Death happens. It's unfortunate that hers was this violent. But, it happens.'

Stuut had attended some Shire of Vaca Del Mar meetings—a local chapter of the Society for Creative Anachronism—but was not a full member. Group leader Stella Fullmer commented that she was not surprised by Stuut's arrest and hoped justice would be served. Upon his arrest, Stuut told detectives he entered Gee’s home armed and shot her after a verbal argument. Initially, he claimed to have blacked out and to be delivering cleaning supplies, a story later contradicted by the tenants.

Nahanap ang biktima, si Margaret Gee, 59, sa kanyang bahay sa hilaga ng DeLand noong Marso 2. Si Gee, isang lola at biyuda na kilala bilang Honorable Lady Nekhbet Alexandra Selene sa grupong Shire of Vaca Del Mar, ay nagbabantay ng isang 19-buwang gulang na bata noong nangyari ang insidente; hindi nasaktan ang bata.

Ipinahayag ni Gee sa social media ang takot niya matapos ang kanilang paghihiwalay at sinabing tinakot siya ng dating kasintahan. Sa isang Facebook post, tinukoy ni Gee na may natagpuang impormasyon tungkol sa mga lason sa kanyang laptop. Nang tanungin si Stuut, inamin niyang interesado siya tungkol sa mga lason at nagsabing, 'Gusto kong malaman ang mga bagay. Ang mga lason ay isang kaalaman.' Tungkol sa krimen, sinabi ni Stuut, 'Nangyayari ang kamatayan. Nakakalungkot lang at naging marahas ang sinapit niya. Pero, nangyayari talaga.'

Umatend si Stuut ng ilang pagpupulong ng Shire of Vaca Del Mar—isang lokal na chapter ng Society for Creative Anachronism—ngunit hindi siya ganap na miyembro. Una niyang sinabi na na-blackout siya at nagdala lamang daw ng mga panlinis, ngunit itinanggi ito ng mga nakatira sa bahay.

article_content: Alex Goode is set to make his first England appearance in a year and his first Test start since March 2013, after Mike Brown experienced a setback in his concussion recovery. Brown suffered a concussion after an accidental collision with Italy centre Andrea Masi at Twickenham 10 days ago and was expected to complete the return-to-play protocols to retain his No. 15 shirt against Ireland in Dublin on Sunday. However, the Harlequins full-back experienced a recurrence of concussion symptoms after cycling last Friday, so he was required to restart the entire protocol from scratch on Monday. Although head coach Stuart Lancaster has not entirely ruled Brown out of the crucial match between the two unbeaten RBS Six Nations teams, it now appears unlikely that Brown will be available for selection. Lancaster said, 'Mike was symptom-free, but after cycling on Friday, symptoms returned, so he had to step down again. He rested over the weekend and restarted the return-to-play process today.' 'Given the severity of the knock and the magnitude of the upcoming game, I need to be absolutely sure he's ready. Brown will not have trained from the Italy game until at least this Friday, which is 13 days, and the team must be prepared.' Brown was carried off on a stretcher after his collision with Masi and did not return to the match. Lancaster added, 'A lot depends on the next 24 hours, but a decision must be made in the next two days to ensure the team can prepare adequately.' Brown has played a key role in England's recent wins over Wales and Italy, and his absence would be noticeable. Goode last played for England on March 9 last year against Wales at Twickenham and has impressed for Saracens. Lancaster values his playmaking skills at full-back. The 26-year-old has not started for England since the 30-3 defeat in Cardiff nearly two years ago. His opportunities have been limited because Brown was outstanding in his position last year, earning Player of the Championship honors. 'He has been unlucky because Brown was the exceptional player in the Six Nations last year. Alex has waited for his chance and is confident he can take it if called upon.' Worcester full-back Chris Pennell, who debuted for England last June in New Zealand and recently performed well for the Saxons, is also included in the squad. Pennell is recognized for his abilities under the high ball, his positional play at full-back, and his ability to play fly-half, offering a different kicking and playmaking option. Courtney Lawes, Tom Wood, and Geoff Parling are expected to return to training on Tuesday after recovering from injuries and are contenders for the match-day 23 at Aviva Stadium. Lancaster is set to announce his team on Friday.

Na-concuss si Brown matapos ang isang aksidenteng banggaan kay Italy centre Andrea Masi sa Twickenham sampung araw na ang nakalipas. Inaasahan noon na magtutuloy-tuloy siya sa return-to-play protocols para mapanatili ang kanyang No. 15 spot laban sa Ireland sa Dublin ngayong Linggo. Ngunit muling nakaranas ng concussion symptoms si Brown matapos mag-bike noong Biyernes, kaya kinailangan niyang simulan ulit mula umpisa ang buong protocol nitong Lunes. Bagaman hindi pa tuluyang tinatanggal ni head coach Stuart Lancaster si Brown sa posibleng lineup para sa mahalagang laban ng dalawang hindi pa natatalong koponan sa RBS Six Nations, malamang na hindi na available si Brown para sa selection. Sabi ni Lancaster, 'Symptom-free na si Mike noon, pero pag-bike niya noong Biyernes, bumalik ang mga sintomas kaya kinailangan niyang mag-step down ulit. Nagpahinga siya nitong weekend at nag-restart ng return-to-play process ngayon.' 'Dahil sa bigat ng injury at laki ng laban, kailangan kong siguraduhin na 100% siyang handa. Hindi siya makakatrain mula sa laban sa Italy hanggang Biyernes, ibig sabihin 13 araw—kailangan na maghanda ang team.' Dinala si Brown palabas ng field sa stretcher pagkatapos ng banggaan kay Masi at hindi na siya nakabalik sa laro. Dagdag pa ni Lancaster, 'Malaki ang magiging basehan ng susunod na 24 oras, pero kailangang magdesisyon sa loob ng dalawang araw para makapaghanda ang team nang maayos.' Malaking bahagi si Brown sa mga panalo ng England kontra Wales at Italy, kaya ramdam ang magiging kawalan niya. Huling naglaro si Goode para sa England noong Marso 9 ng nakaraang taon kontra Wales sa Twickenham at maganda ang ipinapakita niyang laro para sa Saracens. Pinapahalagahan ni Lancaster ang kanyang playmaking skills bilang full-back. Hindi pa nagsimula si Goode sa England mula sa pagkatalo nilang 30-3 sa Cardiff halos dalawang taon na ang nakaraan. Hindi siya nabibigyan ng maraming oportunidad dahil naging standout si Brown noong nakaraang taon at nakuha ang Player of the Championship. 'Medyo hindi pinalad si Goode dahil standout si Brown sa Six Nations last year. Matyaga siyang naghintay at kumpiyansa siyang handa na siya kung magkaroon ng pagkakataon.' Kasama rin sa squad ang Worcester full-back na si Chris Pennell, na nag-debut para sa England Hunyo ng nakaraang taon sa New Zealand at maganda ang performance kamakailan para sa Saxons. Kilalang magaling si Pennell sa high ball, sa paglalaro bilang positional full-back, at kaya rin niyang maging fly-half kaya nagbibigay siya ng ibang opsyon sa kicking at playmaking. Inaasahan ring babalik sa training sa Martes sina Courtney Lawes, Tom Wood, at Geoff Parling matapos maka-recover sa kanilang injuries at kandidatong mapasama sa match-day 23 sa Aviva Stadium. Iaanunsyo ni Lancaster ang kanyang final lineup sa Biyernes.

article_content: The Russian Orthodox Church on Friday urged Alla Pugacheva, the country’s most famous pop singer, to apologize for her public criticism of Russia’s war in Ukraine. Pugacheva, who has enjoyed popularity across Russia and the former Soviet Union for decades, left for Israel with her husband, Maxim Galkin, several weeks after Russian troops entered Ukraine in February 2022. In September that year, Pugacheva drew widespread attention with remarks criticizing the conflict, claiming Russian soldiers were dying for 'illusory goals' and describing Russia as a 'pariah.' She also suggested authorities should label her a 'foreign agent,' a title already applied to Galkin, an actor and comedian. Despite the introduction of laws after the start of the war criminalizing criticism of the Russian armed forces, Pugacheva has not faced charges. She returned to Russia in May to attend the funeral of designer Valentin Yudashkin, where she was seen with Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. Pugacheva later left Russia but returned again this week, according to Russian news agencies. Church spokesman Vakhtang Kipshidze, quoted by state news agency RIA-Novosti, stated that Russians who left and insulted their country or made controversial statements should apologize, specifically mentioning Pugacheva. The Russian Orthodox Church has been a vocal supporter of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.
translated_content: Nanawagan ang Russian Orthodox Church nitong Biyernes na humingi ng paumanhin si Alla Pugacheva, ang pinakasikat na pop singer ng bansa, dahil sa kanyang pampublikong pagpuna sa digmaan ng Russia sa Ukraine. Si Pugacheva, na dekadang sumikat sa Russia at dating Soviet Union, ay lumipat sa Israel kasama ang kanyang asawang si Maxim Galkin, ilang linggo matapos pumasok ang mga sundalong Ruso sa Ukraine noong Pebrero 2022. Noong Setyembre ng parehong taon, umani ng malawakang pansin si Pugacheva matapos ang kanyang mga pahayag na bumabatikos sa digmaan — iginiit niyang namamatay ang mga sundalong Ruso dahil sa 'ilusyon na mga layunin' at tinawag ang Russia na isang 'pariah.' Sinabi rin niyang dapat siyang tawaging 'foreign agent,' katulad ng titulo na ibinigay na kay Galkin, na isa ring aktor at komedyante. Kahit may batas na ipinasa pagkatapos magsimula ang digmaan na nagpaparusa sa mga bumabatikos sa puwersang militar ng Russia, hindi pa kinasuhan si Pugacheva. Bumalik siya ng Russia noong Mayo para dumalo sa libing ng designer na si Valentin Yudashkin, kung saan nakita rin siya kasama si Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. Umalis muli si Pugacheva pero muling nagbalik ngayong linggo, ayon sa mga balita sa Russia. Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng simbahan na si Vakhtang Kipshidze, na sinipi ng state news agency na RIA-Novosti, ang mga Ruso na umalis at bumatikos o nagbigay ng kontrobersyal na pahayag ay dapat humingi ng paumanhin — partikular na binanggit si Pugacheva. Matibay na tagasuporta ang Russian Orthodox Church ng pagsalakay ng Russia sa Ukraine.

article_content: Rochdale's Falinge estate has been identified as the most deprived area in England, where four out of five children are growing up in poverty. Despite such hardship, residents of this former Lancashire mill town collectively wagered £72 million on Fixed Odds Betting Terminals (FOBTs) last year, chasing jackpots of up to £500. This sum is equivalent to £340 per resident, highlighting concerns that such high-stakes machines, often called the 'crack cocaine' of gambling, may fuel addiction among those least able to afford it.  Personal accounts illustrate the potential harm of FOBTs. Lorraine Bennett, a bookmaker in Glasgow, became addicted to slot machines she initially played for fun at work. Her addiction escalated into embezzlement, resulting in a conviction of three years’ probation, mandated counselling, and community service.  Another story involves Neil, a 51-year-old married father of three, who lost up to £100,000 on electronic roulette in betting shops. His gambling led to the loss of his business and nearly his family. Although he has since sought help through Gamblers Anonymous and regained some control, he still faces financial struggles.  Economic decline in Rochdale is evident, with even chain retailers like McDonald’s leaving the town center. The Falinge estate faces 72% unemployment and a high rate of unskilled residents. It has been ranked the most deprived area in England for five consecutive years, and over 200 children there live in poverty. Comparatively, life expectancy in Falinge is almost a decade shorter than in neighboring areas. The estate also experiences elevated teenage pregnancy rates.  Currently, there are 69 FOBTs in 19 betting shops in the town, allowing bets of up to £100 at a time on games like virtual roulette. Councillor Linda Robinson of the council’s health committee expressed concern over the normalization of gambling and the density of these machines in vulnerable areas, emphasizing that many residents cannot afford to gamble.  Bookmakers dispute allegations of targeting vulnerable communities and maintain that such claims are false. Nonetheless, statistics show that in the UK’s poorest areas, over £5.6 billion was staked on 4,454 FOBTs last year. In Liverpool Riverside, £197 million was bet on 189 machines in 52 betting shops. Local MP Louise Ellman called on the government to review gambling laws, noting the disproportionate impact on poorer residents.  Adrian Parkinson of the Campaign for Fairer Gambling highlighted the high stakes and rapid play associated with these machines, warning of their addictive nature. Reports show major betting firms like William Hill and Ladbrokes earn hundreds of millions from FOBTs annually. The Campaign advocates reducing the maximum stake to £2 to limit profitability and potential harm.  Others, like MP Tessa Munt, suggest revising planning laws to prevent clustering of betting shops in deprived areas. The current system allows betting shops to replace vacated financial service businesses unchallenged, contributing to their spread.  The gambling industry argues that betting shops are highly regulated, create jobs, and contribute significant tax revenue, with £1 billion paid annually. According to the Association of British Bookmakers, only 3.5% of gambling adults play FOBTs, with 8% of those players identified as problem gamblers—a figure they claim is declining.  The government, while expressing concern about problem gambling, has not taken immediate action on regulating FOBTs, citing insufficient evidence. Support is available for those affected, through organizations like Gamblers Anonymous.
translated_content: Ang Falinge estate sa Rochdale ay kinilala bilang pinaka-depribadong lugar sa England, kung saan apat sa bawat limang bata ang lumalaki sa kahirapan. Sa kabila ng ganitong hirap, ang mga residente ng dating mill town sa Lancashire ay tumaya ng kabuuang £72 milyon sa Fixed Odds Betting Terminals (FOBTs) noong nakaraang taon, umaasang manalo ng jackpot na aabot sa £500. Katumbas ito ng £340 bawat residente, at ito ay nagpapataas ng alalahanin na ang mga high-stakes na makinang ito, na tinatawag ring 'crack cocaine' ng pagsusugal, ay maaaring magpalala ng adiksyon lalo na sa mga hindi kayang magsugal.  May mga personal na kwento na nagpapatunay sa panganib ng FOBTs. Si Lorraine Bennett, isang bookmaker mula Glasgow, ay na-adik sa slot machines na una niyang nilaro bilang libangan sa kanyang trabaho. Lumala ang kanyang adiksyon na dahilan ng pagnanakaw, na nagresulta sa tatlong taong probation, counselling at community service.  Isa pang kwento ay tungkol kay Neil, 51-anyos na may asawa at tatlong anak, na natalo ng hanggang £100,000 sa electronic roulette sa mga betting shop. Bilang resulta, nawala ang kanyang negosyo at muntik na masira ang kanyang pamilya. Bagamat humingi na siya ng tulong sa Gamblers Anonymous at nakuha ang kaunting kontrol sa sarili, dumaranas pa rin siya ng problemang pinansyal.  Kitang-kita rin ang pagbagsak ng ekonomiya sa Rochdale, kung saan pati mga naglalakihang negosyo tulad ng McDonald’s ay umalis sa town center. Sa Falinge estate, 72% ang walang trabaho at marami rin ang walang sapat na kakayahan para magtrabaho. Sa limang sunod-sunod na taon, ito ang itinuring na pinaka-depribadong lugar sa buong England at mahigit sa 200 bata ang lumalaki sa kahirapan doon. Halos 10 taon na mas mababa ang inaasahang buhay dito kumpara sa kalapit na lugar. Mataas din ang antas ng teenage pregnancy sa estate.  Sa ngayon, may 69 FOBTs sa 19 betting shops sa bayan, na nagpapahintulot sa mga tao na tumaya ng hanggang £100 bawat laro tulad ng virtual roulette. Si Councillor Linda Robinson mula sa health committee ng konseho ay naglabas ng pagkabahala sa pagkalat ng pagsusugal bilang normal at dami ng makinang ito sa mahihinang komunidad, binigyang-diin na marami sa mga residente ang hindi naman talaga kayang magsugal.  Tinatanggi ng mga bookmaker na tinatarget nila ang mahihinang komunidad at iginiit nilang hindi ito totoo. Gayunpaman, ipinapakita ng datos na sa mga pinaka-mahihirap na lugar sa UK, mahigit £5.6 bilyon ang itinaya sa 4,454 FOBTs noong nakaraang taon. Sa Liverpool Riverside, umabot sa £197 milyon ang itinaya sa 189 makina sa 52 betting shops. Hinikayat ni MP Louise Ellman ang gobyerno na repasuhin ang mga batas sa pagsusugal dahil apektado raw nang labis ang mga mahihirap.  Binigyang-diin ni Adrian Parkinson ng Campaign for Fairer Gambling ang panganib ng malalaking taya at mabilis na laro ng mga makinang ito. Lumalabas sa mga ulat na kumikita ng daan-daang milyong pounds kada taon ang malalaking betting firm tulad ng William Hill at Ladbrokes mula sa FOBTs. Isinusulong ng Campaign na gawing £2 na lang ang maximum na pusta sa mga makinang ito para mabawasan ang kita at pinsala.  May iba ring kagaya ni MP Tessa Munt na nagmumungkahi ng pagbabago sa planning laws para hindi magsiksikan ang mga betting shop sa mga mahihirap na komunidad. Sa kasalukuyang sistema, puwedeng magbukas ng betting shop kung nagsara ang mga dating financial service na negosyo, kaya madaling kumalat ang mga ito.  Ipinagtanggol naman ng industriya ng pagsusugal na mahigpit silang nire-regulate, nagbibigay ng trabaho, at malaki ang ambag sa buwis—umaabot ng £1 bilyon kada taon. Sabi ng Association of British Bookmakers, 3.5% lang ng gambling adults ang naglalaro ng FOBTs, at 8% lang sa kanila ang may problema sa pagsusugal—at bumababa raw ang bilang na ito.  Bagamat may pag-aalala ang gobyerno ukol sa problemang dulot ng pagsusugal, wala pa silang ginagawang agarang aksyon sa regulasyon ng FOBTs dahil kulang pa raw sa ebidensya. Meron namang mga organisasyon tulad ng Gamblers Anonymous na puwedeng lapitan ng mga nangangailangan ng tulong.

article_content: Within Oregon's Willamette Valley, a notable western red cedar known as the 'Tree of Life' stands dead, its once-green leaves dried or gone and its trunk displaying narrow, stressed growth rings. Christine Buhl from the Oregon Department of Forestry confirms the cause: prolonged drought, which has claimed thousands of similar trees across Oregon and Washington. Historically, western red cedar has been vital for local communities, valued for its use in making tools, boats, and clothing. Today, scientists describe it as a 'climate canary'—a species exceptionally sensitive to environmental shifts, serving as a predictor for broader forest health issues. Buhl and her team have shown these trees are dying not from disease or insects, but from drought brought on by climate change. And red cedar isn't alone: at least 15 native tree species in the Pacific Northwest are struggling, with the majority linked to drought and warming temperatures. Experts point out that as the climate becomes hotter and drier, tree species will gradually shift their habitats uphill or further north. Trees left behind in less favorable conditions gradually die off, particularly in lower elevation areas. This movement has driven a large-scale event researchers call 'Firmageddon,' representing the widespread die-off—almost 1,900 square miles—of fir trees seen in Oregon, Washington, and northern California. Daniel DePinte of the U.S. Forest Service says most losses are occurring at lower elevations, supporting forecasts that warming and drying strike hardest there. Douglas fir, a major timber species in the region, faces similar struggles, particularly in the Klamath Mountains. Studies led by Oregon State’s David Shaw predict increased deaths—especially at higher elevations as climate warming continues. The red cedar die-off is blamed solely on drought, while fir and Douglas fir mortality results from weakened trees being hit by both drought and insects. Patrick Tobin of the University of Washington compares this to a person with a weak immune system catching a deadly illness: drought renders trees vulnerable to pests and diseases. Big leaf maples in western Washington suffer mysterious die-offs as well. Buhl concludes that although red cedars are unlikely to disappear entirely, their recovery in affected, drier areas is doubtful unless substantial climate action is taken.
translated_content: Sa loob ng Willamette Valley sa Oregon, isang kilalang western red cedar na tinaguriang 'Tree of Life' ay patay na—ang dating luntiang mga dahon nito ay natuyo o nangawala na, at ang katawan nito ay may makikitang manipis at stress na growth rings. Tinukoy ni Christine Buhl mula sa Oregon Department of Forestry na ang sanhi ay matagal na tagtuyot, na puminsala rin sa libu-libong kahalintulad na puno sa Oregon at Washington. Noong unang panahon, napakahalaga ng western red cedar sa mga lokal na komunidad, ginagamit ito sa paggawa ng kagamitan, bangka, at pananamit. Sa ngayon, tinatawag ito ng mga siyentipiko na 'climate canary'—isang uring sensitibo sa pagbabago ng kalikasan at nagsisilbing babala ng mas malalaking suliranin sa kagubatan. Ayon kay Buhl at sa kanyang team, hindi sakit o insekto ang pumapatay sa mga punong ito kundi ang tagtuyot na dulot ng pagbabago ng klima. Hindi lang red cedar ang apektado: hindi bababa sa 15 uri ng katutubong puno sa Pacific Northwest ang nakararanas ng paghina, at para sa karamihan, tagtuyot at tumataas na temperatura ang dahilan. Sabi ng mga eksperto, habang patuloy na umiinit at natutuyo ang klima, lilipat ang mga puno ng tirahan paakyat ng kabundukan o pa-hilaga. Ang mga naiwan sa hindi na akmang lugar ay unti-unting mamamatay, lalo na sa mababang lugar. Tinatawag ng mga researcher ang ganitong malawakang pangyayari na 'Firmageddon'—halos 1,900 square miles ng mga namamatay na fir tree sa Oregon, Washington, at hilagang California. Sabi ni Daniel DePinte ng U.S. Forest Service, karamihan ng mga ito ay nasa mababang lugar, sumasang-ayon sa prediksiyong una silang tatamaan ng init at tagtuyot. Nahaharap din sa parehong pagsubok ang Douglas fir, isang mahalagang timber sa rehiyon, lalo na sa Klamath Mountains. Batay sa pag-aaral na pinangunahan ni David Shaw ng Oregon State, posibleng tumaas pa ang pagkamatay ng mga ito, lalo sa mas matataas na lugar habang patuloy ang pag-init ng klima. Ang red cedar ay nalalagas dahil lang sa tagtuyot, samantalang ang fir at Douglas fir ay sinisira ng tagtuyot at peste. Inihalintulad ni Patrick Tobin ng University of Washington ito sa tao na mahina ang resistensya at madaling tamaan ng malubhang sakit: mas madali na tuluyang atakihin ng peste at sakit ang mga punong stressed sa tagtuyot. May mga big leaf maple din sa kanlurang Washington na nababawasan, bagamat hindi pa alam ang tiyak na sanhi. Ayon kay Buhl, hindi naman tuluyang mawawala ang red cedar pero malabong muling sumibol ito sa mga lugar na tuyo na, maliban na lang kung magkakaroon ng seryosong aksyon kontra climate change.

article_content: In a significant scientific milestone, researchers have spotted live pygmy tarsiers in Lore Lindu National Park, Indonesia—the first confirmed observation in over 80 years. Previously believed extinct since the early 1920s, these small, clawed primates have now been seen alive. The expedition, led by Texas A&M anthropologist Sharon Gursky-Doyen, successfully trapped and released three pygmy tarsiers (two males and one female) during a two-month study on Sulawesi island. A fourth tarsier was seen in the trees but couldn't be captured. Tarsius pumilus individuals are only about 50 grams in weight, with large eyes, dense fur, and unique claws instead of nails. They are approximately half the size of the Philippine tarsier and have drawn comparisons to the Furby toy and Gremlins film characters. The species went unobserved since 1921 until one was accidentally caught eight years ago. Motivated by the possibility of survival, Gursky-Doyen and her team set up mist nets on Mt. Rore Katimbo, and on their second night, successfully captured a pygmy tarsier, which was an emotional moment for the group. The animals were generally calm, not making alarm calls, but one did bite Gursky-Doyen as she attempted to affix a radio collar, demonstrating their agility and sharp teeth. Gursky-Doyen hopes further research will reveal more about the pygmy tarsier's population size and the effects of local environmental factors. However, the species remains at risk due to nearby human settlements inside Lore Lindu National Park.

article_content: How do you stop Lionel Messi? This has been a puzzle for most teams facing Barcelona over the past decade. In this tournament, Messi has consistently showcased his skills for Argentina. Swiss coach Ottmar Hitzfeld is known for his meticulous preparation and may consider man-marking Messi, possibly by using former West Ham player Valon Behrami, given Switzerland’s preferred 4-3-1-2 formation. However, former France World Cup winner Patrick Vieira, who faced Messi on his Juventus debut after leaving Arsenal, believes man-marking Messi would be a tactical error. Vieira stated, 'It would be a huge mistake to man-mark Messi. He can beat his marker or create space for others. The only effective strategy is to restrict his space, as Iran did by playing aggressively and closely. Even so, once they tired and gave him space, Messi was able to score.' Vieira recalled his first encounter with Messi, who was then just 18, saying, 'I tried to kick him, I tried to intimidate him, but whenever you fouled him, he simply took the free kick quickly and continued playing.' Vieira praised Messi’s bravery and commitment to his team. Left-footed players often possess remarkable skill, with legends like Puskas, Maradona, and Hagi. Messi joins their ranks, having scored all four of his World Cup goals with his left foot. Notably, 36 percent of goals in Brazil have been scored with the left foot. Belgium has lived up to expectations as a 'dark horse,' while the USA has impressed with their energy and attacking threat, presenting a challenge for coach Mark Wilmots’ Belgian side. Belgium’s goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois has never lost in his 20 appearances for Belgium. Atletico Madrid wants to extend his loan, but Chelsea is expected to make him their first-choice keeper after the tournament. American midfielder Michael Bradley, son of former USA coach Bob Bradley and currently at Toronto FC, has covered an impressive 23.6 miles in the first three group games, earning him the nickname 'Marathon Man.' Germany narrowly beat Algeria, and Brazil advanced after eliminating Costa Rica. The quarterfinals will see Colombia face Brazil and Germany take on France, setting up a possible Brazil vs Germany semi-final. These two football giants have met only once before in the tournament’s 84-year history—in the 2002 final, which Brazil won 2-0. Despite off-field controversies in the World Cup—such as allegations around FIFA, rumors involving Ghana, match-fixing claims about Cameroon, and the Luis Suarez incident—the on-field action remains gripping and dramatic, making this one of the best tournaments since 1970. The Bayern Munich striker, wanted by Liverpool, adds an offensive edge to Switzerland’s robust lineup. The France vs Germany quarter-final recalls their famous 1982 World Cup semi-final in Seville, which ended 3-3 before Germany won on penalties. That game is especially remembered for German keeper Harald Schumacher’s controversial foul on France’s Patrick Battiston, who was severely injured, yet Schumacher escaped punishment.

article_content: Two enterprising university students have developed a unique way to inspire their peers to try cooking: a 'naked cookbook.' Kinvara Hubbard, a Philosophy student at the University of Edinburgh, and Mimi Williams, studying French and Law at the University of Leeds, created the cookbook to make cooking more appealing to students who might otherwise avoid the kitchen. The friends, both 21 and from Cambridge, realized that traditional cookbooks were largely ignored in student housing, so they decided to create something eye-catching and engaging. Their book features fellow students posing nude in various scenarios, from skiing at Arthur’s Seat in Edinburgh to working out in a Leeds gym, adding playful visuals to straightforward recipes such as bean casserole and spaghetti Bolognese. Kinvara and Mimi report that finding willing volunteers was easy, and that their project quickly attracted attention and support from fellow students. The idea was sparked at a party where they realized most students had unused cookbooks, and some struggled with the basics of cooking. Both students had gained some kitchen skills from a summer catering job and wanted to emphasize the social and community aspects of cooking, hoping to make dinner parties trendy among students again. They aimed to ensure the cookbook was fun and foolproof, put together by students, for students. Neither Kinvara nor Mimi had publishing experience before creating 'The Naked Student Cookbook,' and they found balancing schoolwork with the project challenging but rewarding. The cookbook includes step-by-step guides for simple student meals like spaghetti Bolognese, curry, toad in the hole, and even how to boil an egg. Their universities were supportive, and many friends contributed, including participating in group photoshoots with lighthearted themes. One photoshoot featured the rugby team using cakes to cover themselves, followed by a memorable game of naked rugby, despite cold weather. Altogether, 60 friends participated in two weeks of photoshoots. For every book sold, £1 is donated to the homeless charity Crisis, recognizing their efforts in university cities. An initial print run of 1,000 copies was funded by an entrepreneurial scholarship, and the authors hope to partner with a major publisher to bring the book to wider audiences.

Magkaibigan sila mula pagkabata, parehong 21 taong gulang at taga-Cambridge, at napansin nilang hindi ginagamit ng mga estudyante ang mga tradisyonal na cookbook sa mga dorm, kaya naisipan nilang gumawa ng kakaiba at nakakaaliw na proyekto. Itinatampok ng libro ang mga kapwa estudyante na nagpapose ng hubad sa iba’t ibang eksena—mula sa skiing sa tuktok ng Arthur’s Seat sa Edinburgh hanggang sa pag-ehersisyo sa gym sa Leeds—na nagbibigay saya at kulay sa mga simpleng recipe tulad ng bean casserole at spaghetti Bolognese. article_content: After being held by the Taliban for five years, U.S. Army Sgt. Bowe Bergdahl was released in a widely-publicized prisoner swap. While many rejoiced at his return, the mood changed as questions emerged about whether he left his post on purpose. An official Army review suggested Bergdahl deliberately departed his Afghan outpost, though the full story could only come from him directly. Following his release in late May at age 28, Bergdahl spent time at a military hospital in San Antonio receiving both medical and mental health care. The Army has now cleared Bergdahl to resume duty, assigning him to a desk job at Fort Sam Houston. He'll work in a unit focused on homeland defense and partnerships with countries such as Canada, Mexico, and the Bahamas. According to Army spokesperson Don Manuszewski, Bergdahl will receive the same treatment as any other soldier and live in shared barracks, with a sponsor to help him adjust to military life again. Although his specific duties remain confidential, Bergdahl faces ongoing scrutiny, especially from some fellow soldiers who accuse him of desertion. Mental health professionals, like Dr. M. David Rudd, anticipate that he may endure significant stress and stigma moving forward. As Bergdahl returns to service, the Army is ending its family support services provided during his captivity, though help remains available if needed. No public family reunion has occurred, and the FBI continues investigating threats made against his parents. Reporters such as Mike Boettcher, who have also survived captivity, recognize how difficult reintegration can be for someone in Bergdahl’s position, given the intense public and peer attention.

article_content: Anti-riot police patrolled Dhaka and other parts of Bangladesh on Tuesday as protesters took to the streets, damaging vehicles and burning tires during a nationwide general strike, according to police and witnesses. Members of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, the country's largest Islamic party, clashed with police in Dhaka and several major cities, blocking various roads and highways. The strike, enforced across Bangladesh, disrupted daily life with road transport halted, and schools and businesses remaining closed. Demonstrators also damaged a U.S. embassy vehicle in the Khilkhet area of Dhaka, injuring its driver and a police officer. "No diplomatic staff was inside the vehicle, which was heading to the airport," Khilkhet police chief Shamim Hossain told journalists. Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, on its website, claimed responsibility for the incident but described it as "unexpected and unfortunate." The U.S. embassy in Dhaka condemned the attack in a statement, highlighting that peaceful protest is a fundamental democratic right and stating there is no justification for violence. The statement added, "We call upon the perpetrators to be held accountable for this unprovoked attack on a diplomatic vehicle and its innocent occupants." In many areas, demonstrators clashed with police, who used teargas to disperse crowds. Jamaat-e-Islami called the strike to protest the arrest and trial of its top leaders, who face war crimes charges related to Bangladesh's 1971 independence war. It is estimated that around 3 million people were killed during the nine-month war that resulted in the separation of Pakistan and the creation of Bangladesh. Jamaat-e-Islami opposed independence, sided with the Pakistani army, and was later accused of involvement in numerous killings.
translated_content: Nagpatrolya ang anti-riot police sa Dhaka at iba pang bahagi ng Bangladesh nitong Martes habang nagpoprotesta ang mga tao, nagdulot ng pinsala sa mga sasakyan at nagsunog ng gulong sa gitna ng nationwideng welga, ayon sa pulisya at mga saksi. Ang mga miyembro ng Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, ang pinakamalaking Islamic party sa bansa, ay nakipagsagupaan sa pulisya sa Dhaka at ilang pangunahing lungsod, hinaharangan ang iba't ibang kalsada at highway. Ang welga, na ipinatupad sa buong Bangladesh, ay nakaapekto sa araw-araw na pamumuhay dahil natigil ang transportasyon at nagsara ang mga paaralan at negosyo. Sinira rin ng mga nagpoprotesta ang isang sasakyan ng U.S. embassy sa Khilkhet, Dhaka, na nagdulot ng sugat sa drayber nito at isang pulis. "Walang diplomatic staff sa loob ng sasakyan, papunta ito sa airport," ayon kay Shamim Hossain, hepe ng Khilkhet police station, sa mga mamamahayag. Inako ng Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami sa kanilang website ang responsibilidad sa insidente pero tinawag itong "hindi inaasahan at nakakalungkot." Kinondena ng U.S. embassy sa Dhaka ang insidente sa isang pahayag, na binigyang-diin na ang mapayapang protesta ay isang mahalagang karapatang demokratiko at walang dahilan para sa karahasan. Dagdag ng pahayag, "Nanawagan kami na papanagutin ang mga sangkot sa hindi inisyatibo na pag-atake sa isang diplomatic vehicle at sa inosenteng sakay nito." Sa maraming lugar, nagkaroon ng sagupaan ang mga nagpoprotesta at pulisya, kung saan gumamit ang mga pulis ng tear gas para paalisin ang mga tao. Nagpatawag ang Jamaat-e-Islami ng welga bilang protesta sa pagkaka-aresto at paglilitis ng kanilang mga pangunahing lider na nahaharap sa kasong war crimes kaugnay ng digmaan para sa kasarinlan ng Bangladesh noong 1971. Tinatayang umabot sa 3 milyong tao ang namatay sa loob ng siyam na buwang digmaan na nagresulta sa pagsasarili ng Bangladesh mula sa Pakistan. Tutol noon ang Jamaat-e-Islami sa kasarinlan, kumampi sa hukbong Pakistani, at inakusahan ng pagkakasangkot sa maraming pagpatay.

article_content: Media commentators from both sides of the political spectrum have criticized New Jersey Governor Chris Christie this week, drawing parallels to past political scandals. Several members of Christie's staff have been implicated in an abuse of power, specifically the deliberate traffic disruption on the George Washington Bridge in 2013 that affected thousands of commuters. Although there is no evidence that Governor Christie himself knew of his staff’s actions, as the leader, he remains responsible for the culture and conduct of his administration. Leaders are expected to accept responsibility for both successes and failures during their tenure. Saying 'I didn’t know' is generally not accepted as an adequate excuse for wrongdoing within one’s administration. Individuals pursuing the presidency inevitably face both personal and professional challenges. While no candidate is without flaws, it is their capacity to confront and learn from these flaws that is most significant. Media commentators often advise politicians on managing public perception during scandals rather than addressing deeper issues of accountability and growth. Following the bridge scandal, Christie faces a crucial test of leadership—whether he can foster and uphold higher ethical standards in the future. His political future may depend on how convincingly he demonstrates that he has learned from this controversy. The article refers to Richard Nixon’s reflections on his own presidential failings, suggesting that Christie could benefit from this wisdom early in his career. The opinions expressed are those of the commentator, David Frum.
translated_content: Pinuna ng mga komentador mula sa magkabilang panig ng pulitika si Governor Chris Christie ng New Jersey ngayong linggo, na ikinumpara sa mga naunang iskandalo sa pulitika. Ilang miyembro ng staff ni Christie ang sangkot sa pang-aabuso ng kapangyarihan, partikular ang sinadyang trapik sa George Washington Bridge noong 2013 na nakaapekto sa libo-libong motorista. Bagaman walang ebidensyang alam mismo ni Governor Christie ang ginawa ng kanyang staff, bilang lider, siya pa rin ang may pananagutan sa kultura at asal ng kanyang administrasyon. Inaasahan mula sa mga pinuno na tanggapin ang responsibilidad sa parehong tagumpay at pagkabigo sa kanilang pamumuno. Kadalasan, ang pagsasabing 'Hindi ko alam' ay hindi kinikilalang sapat na dahilan sa mga pagkakamali ng kanilang pamunuan. Natural na ang mga nagnanais maging pangulo ay dumadaan sa personal at propesyonal na pagsubok. Walang kandidatong perpekto, kaya mahalaga ang kakayahan nilang harapin at matutunan ang mga leksyon mula sa sariling pagkukulang. Karaniwang nagbibigay ng payo ang media sa mga politiko kung paano haharapin ang publiko sa panahon ng iskandalo, sa halip na tutukan ang malalim na isyu ng pananagutan at pag-unlad. Matapos ang iskandalong ito, nasa matinding pagsubok ang pamumuno ni Christie—kaya ba niyang itaguyod at panindigan ang mas mataas na pamantayan ng etika? Maaapektuhan ang kanyang hinaharap sa pulitika batay sa kung gaano niya mapapatunayan na tunay siyang natuto sa problemang ito. Tinutukoy ng artikulo ang mga pagninilay ni Richard Nixon sa kanyang kabiguan bilang pangulo at sinasabing maaaring matuto si Christie mula rito ng mas maaga. Ang mga opinyon dito ay mula kay David Frum, ang may-akda.

article_content: Thanksgiving week officially marks the beginning of the holiday shopping season, highlighted by major retail days like Thanksgiving, Black Friday, and Cyber Monday. This short timeframe is critical for retailers, making up about 16.7% of seasonal retail sales and representing some of the busiest shopping days of the year. The National Retail Federation reports that nearly 19% of yearly retail sales occur between Black Friday and Christmas. This year, up to 74% of Americans are expected to shop—an all-time high since NRF started tracking in 2017—meaning 15.7 million more shoppers compared to last year. According to NRF President and CEO Matthew Shay, retailers spend months preparing for this period, ensuring products are stocked and customers are able to find deals throughout the season. Shoppers are expected out in force: 130.7 million on Black Friday, 71.1 million on Cyber Monday, and 32.5 million on Thanksgiving Day. Holiday spending for November and December is projected to increase by 3–4%, totaling between $957.3 billion and $966.6 billion, up from $929.5 billion last year. Deloitte notes consumers plan to spend an average of $567 between Black Friday and Cyber Monday, 13% more than last year. Millennial shoppers are predicted to drive 43% of the week’s sales, with many buying gifts for themselves. A Statista survey shows top shopping picks are clothing (48%), electronics (36%), shoes (32%), accessories (27%), and books, movies, music, or games (26%). Online stores are the top choice for 41% of shoppers, while 25% plan to visit brick-and-mortar locations, and 28% are undecided. The 2023 holiday season is seen as a turning point, with sales expected to finally recover to pre-pandemic levels—good news for stores and buyers.
translated_content: Opisyal na nagsisimula ang kapaskuhan sa pamimili tuwing Thanksgiving week, lalo na sa mga araw tulad ng Thanksgiving, Black Friday, at Cyber Monday. Mahalaga ang panahong ito para sa mga retailer dahil pumapalo sa 16.7% ng kabuuang pana-panahong benta at tinuturing na pinakaabalang mga araw sa taon. Ayon sa National Retail Federation, humigit-kumulang 19% ng taunang benta ay nagaganap mula Black Friday hanggang Pasko. Ngayong taon, inaasahang 74% ng mga Amerikano ang mamimili—pinakamataas simula nang simulan ng NRF ang pagsubaybay noong 2017—at may dagdag na 15.7 milyong shoppers kumpara dati. Sabi ng kanilang presidente at CEO na si Matthew Shay, matagal na naghanda ang mga retailer para dito, siguradong puno ang stock at handa silang magbigay ng magagandang alok para sa lahat ng mamimili. Tinatayang aabot sa 130.7 milyon ang mamimili sa Black Friday, 71.1 milyon sa Cyber Monday, at 32.5 milyon sa mismong Thanksgiving. Inaasahan na ang holiday spending ngayong Nobyembre at Disyembre ay tataas ng 3–4% na aabot sa $957.3B–$966.6B, mula $929.5B noong isang taon. Ayon sa Deloitte, planong gumastos ng mga mamimili ng $567 bawat isa mula Black Friday hanggang Cyber Monday—mas mataas ng 13% kaysa dati. Makikita din na dominante ang Millennials, na magpapalakas ng 43% ng bentahan at marami sa kanila ang bibili ng regalo para sa sarili. Sa survey ng Statista, nangungunang bibilhin ay mga damit (48%), electronics (36%), sapatos (32%), accessories (27%), at mga libro, pelikula, musika o laro (26%). Mas pinipili ng 41% na mag-online shopping, 25% ang pupunta sa mga tindahan mismo, at 28% ang hindi pa sigurado. Nakikita ang 2023 holiday season na babalik na sa siglang bentahan bago mag-pandemya—good news para sa mga tindahan at mamimili.

article_content: Rushabh Sheth, Co-founder and Co-CIO at Karma Capital, notes that Indian stock markets have performed well despite rising interest rates over the last eighteen months. He believes a small dip in interest rates is unlikely to shift market dynamics significantly, as investors remain focused on earnings growth and company valuations. Recent declines in the dollar index and easing bond yields suggest inflation may have peaked globally, with expectations growing for rate cuts in the US by the middle of next year. Sheth suggests India could follow if inflation and commodity prices remain in check. With corporate leverage in India at historic lows, Sheth argues that a marginal reduction in interest rates won’t drastically influence the equity markets but might enhance market sentiment. In the two-wheeler space, domestic demand continues to be stable, even if rural demand is somewhat weak. While export demand faced headwinds recently due to inflation and currency issues, Sheth expects the local market to remain solid. Premium real estate in western Indian cities is seeing rapid sales and shrinking inventory, especially for high-end properties, despite higher interest rates. This trend has continued since the pandemic, surpassing expectations considering the rate environment. For pharmaceuticals, Sheth sees robust growth in India and anticipates industry consolidation. Domestic markets are strong and capital allocation has improved, while the US market remains important due to product shortages and stable pricing. Sheth identifies the upcoming general elections and the global economic climate, especially in the US and China, as major factors to watch. He highlights India’s economic resilience and its favorable position to attract investments as global flows potentially shift from China. The Nifty and other Indian stock indices have recently reached fresh highs, as concerns about additional US rate hikes diminished and investors grew more optimistic.

Naniniwala siyang hindi agad magbabago ang takbo ng merkado kapag bahagyang bumaba ang rates, dahil focused pa rin ang mga investors sa earnings growth at valuations ng mga kumpanya. Ang pagbaba ng dollar index at pagluwag ng bond yields ay indikasyon na sumapit na ang rurok ng inflation globally, kaya't umaasa ang marami ng rate cuts sa US bandang kalagitnaan ng susunod na taon. Ayon kay Sheth, posible ring sumunod ang India kung patuloy na mababa ang inflation at kontrolado ang presyo ng commodities. Dahil mababa ang utang ng mga kumpanya sa India, paliwanag ni Sheth na hindi dramatiko ang epektong dala ng bahagyang pagbaba ng interest rates sa equity market—pero maaaring makatulong ito sa pagtaas ng kumpiyansa ng mga mamumuhunan. Sa larangan ng two-wheeler, nananatiling matibay ang demand sa lokal kahit may kahinaan pa rin sa rural demand. Bagamat nakaapekto ang inflation at mga isyu sa pera sa export demand ng ilan, tinitiyak ni Sheth na matatag pa rin ang merkado sa loob ng bansa. Sa premium real estate sa kanlurang bahagi ng India, malakas ang bentahan at mabilis na nauubos ang inventory ng mga high-end properties kahit mataas ang interest rates—trend na lalo pang tumindi matapos ang pandemya. Sa pharma sector, kumpiyansa si Sheth sa patuloy na paglakas ng domestic market at nagsisimula na ring konsolidasyon ng mga top company. Bumubuti rin ang kapital allocation, habang nananatiling mahalaga ang merkado sa US dahil sa kakulangan ng ilang produkto at stable na presyo. Pinagmamasdan ni Sheth ang nalalapit na eleksyon at ang mga galaw ng pandaigdigang ekonomiya, lalo na sa US at China. Binibigyang-diin niya na resilient ang India at maganda ang tsansa nitong makaakit ng investments habang unti-unting tumatamlay ang China. Umabot sa bagong mataas ang Nifty at iba pang Indian stock indices dahil nabawasan ang pangamba sa karagdagang rate hikes sa US at naging bullish ang mga investors.

article_content: The European Union (EU) has earmarked €24.4 million to combat the proliferation and illegal circulation of small arms and light weapons (SALW) in Nigeria and other West African countries. This initiative aims to reduce the availability of SALW, thereby helping to curb organized crime and strengthen security across the region. Speaking at a roundtable meeting held in Abuja on SALW control, the Head of the EU Delegation to ECOWAS, Enobong Moma, emphasized the growing threat posed by illicit arms. She noted that these weapons jeopardize electoral processes, weaken police authority, foster sexual violence, and threaten peace efforts, particularly at a time of rising criminal activity and violent extremism in Nigeria and neighboring countries. Moma highlighted that the EU, in response to these threats, is supporting ECOWAS and its member states, including Nigeria, in implementing the Convention on Small Arms and Light Weapons. The goal is to promote peace, security, and stability throughout the region. With a budget of €24.4 million, the EU-backed project forms part of a broader regional effort to fight organized crime and human trafficking by reducing the availability and illicit trafficking of SALW, especially at border communities. The project also seeks to enhance cross-border cooperation and build the capacity of national actors involved in SALW control. Nigerian National Security Adviser Nuhu Ribadu, represented by his Special Adviser on Special Duties, Mohammed Ahmed, stressed the urgent need for collaboration among stakeholders. He warned that the spread of SALW undermines Nigeria’s security, impedes national progress, and erodes society’s foundation, making a unified approach essential. Major General Abba Dikko (retd.), National Coordinator for the Control of SALW, appealed to President Bola Tinubu to approve the Centre’s Bill, which would provide the necessary legal framework for effective operations. He also announced ongoing efforts to implement an ICT-based national database to streamline and unify the management of SALW inventories across Nigeria.
translated_content: Naglaan ang European Union (EU) ng €24.4 milyon para labanan ang pagkalat at ilegal na pagpupuslit ng maliliit na armas at mga sandatang magaan (SALW) sa Nigeria at iba pang mga bansa sa West Africa. Layunin ng inisyatibong ito na bawasan ang pagkalat ng SALW upang makatulong pigilan ang organisadong krimen at mapalakas ang seguridad sa rehiyon. Sa isang roundtable meeting tungkol sa SALW control na ginanap sa Abuja, binigyang-diin ng Hepe ng EU Delegation sa ECOWAS na si Enobong Moma ang lumalaking banta ng ilegal na armas. Ani niya, pinapahina ng mga armas na ito ang proseso ng eleksyon, kapangyarihan ng pulisya, nagpapalaganap ng karahasang sekswal, at naglalagay sa panganib ang mga pagsusumikap para sa kapayapaan, lalo na ngayong tumataas ang kriminalidad at matinding karahasan sa Nigeria at karatig-bansa. Ipinahayag ni Moma na bilang tugon sa banta, sinusuportahan ng EU ang ECOWAS at ang mga miyembrong bansa nito, kabilang ang Nigeria, sa pagpapatupad ng Convention on Small Arms and Light Weapons. Layunin nito na palaganapin ang kapayapaan, seguridad, at katatagan sa buong rehiyon. Sa pamamagitan ng badyet na €24.4 milyon, ang proyektong suportado ng EU ay bahagi ng mas malawak na pagsusumikap sa rehiyon laban sa organisadong krimen at human trafficking sa pamamagitan ng pagbawas ng availability at ilegal na pagpuslit ng SALW, lalo na sa mga border communities. Layunin din ng proyekto na palakasin ang kooperasyon sa pagitan ng mga bansa at paunlarin ang kakayahan ng mga lokal na aktor sa SALW control. Binigyang-diin ni Nuhu Ribadu, National Security Adviser ng Nigeria (sa pamamagitan ni Special Adviser on Special Duties Mohammed Ahmed), ang agarang pangangailangan ng pagtutulungan ng lahat ng stakeholder. Aniya, pinahihina ng laganap na SALW ang seguridad ng Nigeria, nagpapabagal sa pag-unlad ng bansa, at sumisira sa pundasyon ng lipunan kaya’t mahalaga ang pagkakaisa. Nanawagan si Major General Abba Dikko (ret.), National Coordinator para sa Control of SALW, kay President Bola Tinubu na aprubahan ang panukalang batas ng sentro para magkaroon ng legal na batayan ang operasyon. Inanunsyo rin niya ang patuloy na pagsusumikap para sa ICT-based na pambansang database upang mapaayos at mapag-isa ang pamamahala ng SALW inventories sa Nigeria.

article_content: Bangladesh has announced a 56% increase in the monthly minimum wage for garment workers, raising it from $75 to $113 following weeks of intense protests—the worst seen in a decade in the country’s industrial sectors. The wage increase was revealed by State Minister for Labour and Employment, Monnujan Sufian, after a meeting with a wage board composed of representatives from both factory owners and workers. The new wage structure takes effect December 1. The protests, involving tens of thousands of workers, were sparked when the Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association initially proposed a more modest 25% wage hike to $90 per month. Workers had demanded a minimum of $208. Demonstrations turned violent, resulting in at least two worker deaths, four factories set ablaze, highway blockages, and clashes with police. On the day of the announcement, police used tear gas to disperse thousands of protesters in Gazipur, after a bus was set on fire. About 600 garment factories temporarily shuttered amid the unrest. Bangladesh’s wage board, formed under government pressure due to the strikes, includes factory owners, union leaders, and officials. Workers say the new wage does not keep pace with rising living costs and soaring inflation, currently around 9.5%. Munna Khan, a garment worker, expressed frustration: 'The increase is not enough when prices of all items and rent have gone up sharply. We work to survive but we can’t even cover our basic needs.' Kalpona Akter, president of the Bangladesh Garment and Industrial Workers Federation, also described the raise as 'extremely frustrating.' Siddiqur Rahman, representing factory owners on the wage board, supported the decision. He mentioned that government welfare and ration cards will be provided to help workers buy essentials at reduced rates. Bangladesh is the world’s second-largest garment exporter after China, with nearly 3,500 factories employing about four million people, most of them women. The industry contributes about $55 billion annually, making up almost 16% of Bangladesh’s GDP, supplying brands like Levi’s, Zara, and H&M, mainly in the US and Europe, and exploring new markets in Japan, China, and India. Factory owners argue that production costs are rising due to higher energy and transportation prices, while critics say they could do more for workers amid these ongoing disputes.
translated_content: Inanunsyo ng Bangladesh ang 56% pagtaas ng buwanang minimum wage para sa mga manggagawa sa garment industry, mula $75 naging $113, matapos ang mga linggo ng matinding protesta—ang pinakamatindi sa nakalipas na dekada. Ibinunyag ito ng State Minister for Labour and Employment na si Monnujan Sufian matapos ang pagpupulong ng wage board na binubuo ng mga kinatawan ng mga may-ari ng pabrika at mga manggagawa. Epektibo ang bagong sahod simula Disyembre 1. Nagsimula ang protesta, na nilahukan ng sampu-sampung libong manggagawa, nang alukin lamang ng Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association ng 25% pagtaas o $90 kada buwan. Humihiling ang mga manggagawa ng minimum na $208. Nauwi sa karahasan ang mga kilos-protesta—namatay ang di-bababa sa dalawang manggagawa, apat na pabrika ang nasunog, na-block ang mga highway, at nagkaroon ng sagupaan sa pulis. Sa araw ng anunsyo, gumamit ng tear gas ang pulisya para paalisin ang libo-libong nagpoprotesta sa Gazipur, matapos sunugin ang isang bus. Halos 600 pabrika ng garment ang pansamantalang nagsara dahil sa gulo. Ang wage board ng Bangladesh, na nabuo dahil sa presyon ng gobyerno dahil sa welga, ay binubuo ng mga may-ari ng pabrika, lider ng unyon, at mga opisyal. Sabi ng mga manggagawa, hindi sapat ang bagong sahod kung isasama ang mataas na gastusin sa pamumuhay at sumisirit na inflation, na ngayon ay nasa 9.5%. Ibinahagi ni Munna Khan, isang manggagawa: 'Hindi sapat ang dagdag sahod lalo na at tumaas ang presyo ng mga bilihin at renta. Nagtatrabaho kami para mabuhay pero hindi pa rin sapat.' Ayon naman kay Kalpona Akter, pangulo ng Bangladesh Garment and Industrial Workers Federation, 'sobrang nakakabigo' ang dagdag-sahod. Sinang-ayunan ni Siddiqur Rahman, kinatawan ng mga may-ari ng pabrika sa wage board, ang desisyon. Binanggit niyang ipapamahagi ang government welfare at ration cards upang makabili ng mga pangunahing pangangailangan sa mas mababang presyo. Ang Bangladesh ang pangalawang pinakamalaking garment exporter sa mundo kasunod ng China, na may halos 3,500 pabrika na may tinatayang apat na milyong manggagawa, karamihan ay kababaihan. Nag-aambag ang industriya ng humigit-kumulang $55 bilyon bawat taon at halos 16% ng GDP ng bansa, nagbibigay sa mga brand na gaya ng Levi’s, Zara, at H&M, pangunahing sa Estados Unidos at Europa, at pumapasok na rin sa mga merkado sa Japan, China, at India. Sabi ng mga may-ari ng pabrika, tumataas din ang production costs dahil sa energy at transportasyon, habang iginiit ng mga kritiko na kaya pang mas pagbutihin para sa kapakanan ng mga manggagawa.

article_content: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to significantly aid Nigeria’s fight against climate change, according to Julia Carvalho, General Manager for IBM Africa Growth Markets. Carvalho emphasized that access to reliable data is crucial for combating climate change. However, she lamented that challenges in data availability, storage, and reliability have hindered Nigeria’s ability to effectively prepare for climate-related events such as flooding. Carvalho noted, 'Data unavailability, storage, and reliability make research, analysis, forecasting, and economic predictions a daunting task.' She highlighted that advances in generative AI, specifically its machine learning algorithms and ability to process large volumes of data quickly, can help humanity gain better insights into climate problems and make more informed decisions. In 2022, Nigeria faced a surge in climate-related disasters, with flooding contributing to 662 deaths, 3,174 injuries, 2.5 million people displaced, and 200,000 homes destroyed. Carvalho explained that generative AI can help organizations analyze their operations, identify opportunities for reducing carbon emissions, and create strategies for reaching net zero emissions. She added that generative AI can help overcome obstacles such as unstructured or siloed data and complicated regulatory requirements. She stressed the importance of collaboration between businesses, government, and trusted technology partners in developing scalable and trustworthy generative AI systems.
translated_content: Malaki ang potensyal ng generative artificial intelligence (AI) na makatulong sa laban ng Nigeria kontra climate change, ayon kay Julia Carvalho, General Manager ng IBM Africa Growth Markets. Binanggit ni Carvalho na mahalaga ang access sa maaasahang datos para sa pagsugpo ng climate change. Subalit, sinabi niyang ang mga hamon sa pagkakaroon, pag-iimbak, at pagiging maaasahan ng datos ang nagpapahirap sa Nigeria na epektibong makapaghanda para sa mga sakuna kagaya ng pagbaha. Ayon kay Carvalho, 'Ang kakulangan, pag-iimbak, at pagiging hindi maaasahan ng datos ay nagpapahirap sa pagsusuri, forecasting, at paggawa ng economic predictions.' Itinampok din niya na ang pag-usbong ng generative AI, partikular ang paggamit ng machine learning algorithm at kakayahang magproseso ng malaking dami ng datos nang mabilis, ay makakatulong upang mas maintindihan ang mga problema sa klima at makagawa ng mas mahusay na desisyon. Noong 2022, nakaranas ang Nigeria ng serye ng mga sakunang may kaugnayan sa klima, kabilang ang pagbaha na nagdulot ng 662 na pagkasawi, 3,174 sugatan, 2.5 milyong nawalan ng tirahan, at 200,000 bahay na nawasak. Paliwanag ni Carvalho, makakatulong ang generative AI sa mga organisasyon na suriin ang kanilang operasyon, tukuyin ang paraan para mabawasan ang carbon emissions, at gumawa ng estratehiya papunta sa net zero emissions. Dagdag pa niya, kayang malampasan ang mga hadlang kagaya ng hindi organisadong datos at komplikadong regulasyon sa tulong ng AI. Binanggit din niya ang kahalagahan ng pagtutulungan ng mga negosyo, pamahalaan, at mga pinagkakatiwalaang technology partners upang makabuo ng scalable at mapagkakatiwalaang generative AI systems.

Youcef Nadarkhani, a 34-year-old Iranian Christian pastor, was acquitted of apostasy charges and released from prison on Saturday after spending three years incarcerated. Originally sentenced to death for refusing to renounce his Christian faith in Iran, Nadarkhani had his charges reduced to evangelizing to Muslims, which carried a three-year sentence. He was released with time served, according to the American Center for Law and Justice (ACLJ), a Washington-based human rights organization that advocated for his release.

'After almost three years in prison, he has finally been reunited with his family,' said Jordan Sekulow, executive director of the ACLJ, in a statement to FoxNews.com. 'Pastor Youcef’s case shows how international support can lead to justice and the preservation of freedom.'

Nadarkhani was arrested in his hometown of Rasht in 2009, reportedly for questioning the constitutionality of Iran’s requirement that children receive Islamic religious education, according to Christian Solidarity Worldwide. A convert to Christianity at 19, Nadarkhani wished to register a home-based church. In 2010, he was sentenced to death for apostasy. This verdict was upheld by Iran’s Supreme Court in 2011, even though Iran’s penal code did not explicitly prescribe the death penalty for apostasy. Instead, a legal loophole allowed judges to refer to Sharia law to justify such a sentence.

Earlier reports suggested Nadarkhani might face new, unspecified charges, but at his Saturday hearing he was released instead. Nadarkhani's attorney, who has also been imprisoned, said that the pastor faced the death penalty solely for refusing to renounce his faith. A breakthrough in the case came earlier this year when an Iranian diplomat told a United Nations panel that Nadarkhani would not be executed.

The ACLJ coordinated with the U.S. State Department and the U.S. House of Representatives, which passed a resolution condemning Nadarkhani’s imprisonment and calling for his immediate release. Nearly three million people expressed support for Nadarkhani online through the 'Tweet for Youcef' campaign. Prominent leaders, including President Barack Obama, EU foreign policy chief Catherine Ashton, and the governments of Germany, Britain, and France, also urged the Iranian government to release Nadarkhani, as reported by the Jerusalem Post.

While welcoming his release, the ACLJ emphasized that significant international attention pressured Iranian authorities to act. The organization also warned that Iran is likely to continue suppressing religious freedom. Since 1999, the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom has classified Iran as a 'country of concern.'

Una siyang hinatulan ng kamatayan dahil tumanggi siyang talikuran ang kanyang pananampalatayang Kristiyano sa Iran, ngunit ibinaba ang paratang at sinentensiyahan siya ng tatlong taon dahil sa pangangaral sa mga Muslim. Pinalaya siya dahil sa 'time served', ayon sa American Center for Law and Justice (ACLJ), isang human rights organization sa Washington na nangampanya para sa kanyang paglaya.

“Matapos ang halos tatlong taon sa bilangguan, muling nakapiling ni Nadarkhani ang kanyang pamilya,” sabi ni Jordan Sekulow, executive director ng ACLJ, sa isang pahayag sa FoxNews.com. “Ipinapakita ng kaso ni Pastor Youcef kung paano maaaring magtagumpay ang katarungan at kalayaan sa tulong ng internasyunal na suporta.”

Nababahala pa rin sila na maaaring magpatuloy ang pagsupil sa kalayaan sa relihiyon sa Iran.
