article_content: Ebola may persist even after the World Health Organization (WHO) declares an area free of the disease, according to one of the virus's discoverers. The WHO plans to announce soon that Nigeria and Senegal are Ebola-free after 42 days without new infections—the standard timeline for declaring an outbreak over, as it doubles the virus's maximum 21-day incubation period. The WHO is urging people in West Africa, including Liberia, to avoid unprotected sex because the Ebola virus can survive in semen for months after recovery. Rescue workers in Liberia are still fighting to contain the outbreak. Still, the WHO remains optimistic about declaring Nigeria and Senegal Ebola-free after 42 days without new infections. Studies show that the Ebola virus can remain in semen for at least 70 days after recovery, and potentially over 90 days. Survivors are advised to use condoms or avoid unprotected sex for a minimum of 90 days after recovery, according to Professor Peter Piot of the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, one of Ebola’s discoverers. For added caution, doubling this period would mean abstinence for 180 days, or six months, but 90 days is seen as a practical guideline. Ebola transmits through bodily fluids such as blood and saliva, and is also found in breast milk, urine, and semen, according to the WHO. The live virus has never been detected in sweat. The current Ebola outbreak has led to more than 3,400 deaths, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Meanwhile, the WHO has warned that Europe will likely see more Ebola cases, but the continent is well prepared to control the disease. Shortly after Europe’s first local Ebola infection was confirmed in a Spanish nurse, WHO European director Zsuzsanna Jakab stated that further cases are ‘unavoidable’ due to extensive travel between Europe and affected regions. In Spain, four people have been hospitalized following the nurse's infection—the first Ebola case contracted outside Africa. European countries including France, Britain, the Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, Norway, and Spain have all treated patients repatriated from West Africa, where Ebola has been spreading since March. More than 7,200 people in West Africa have been infected, and over 3,400 have died, making this the largest Ebola outbreak in history. Cases have also been reported in Nigeria, Senegal, and the United States. According to Jakab, health workers caring for repatriated Ebola patients—as well as their families and close contacts—face the highest risk of infection in Europe. However, she emphasized that Europe is still at low risk overall and is among the best prepared regions globally for handling viral hemorrhagic fevers such as Ebola. Experts warn that Europe may continue to see additional Ebola cases, such as Manuel Garcia Viejo, a Spanish priest who contracted the disease while working in Sierra Leone.
translated_content: Maaaring manatiling umiiral ang Ebola kahit matapos ideklara ng World Health Organization (WHO) na malaya na ang isang lugar mula sa sakit, ayon sa isa sa mga nakadiskubre ng virus. Plano ng WHO na ianunsyo sa lalong madaling panahon na malaya na ang Nigeria at Senegal sa Ebola matapos ang 42 araw na walang naitalang bagong kaso—ang pamantayang panahon para ideklara ang pagtatapos ng outbreak, katumbas ng doble ng pinakamahabang 21-araw na incubation period ng virus. Hinihikayat ng WHO ang mga tao sa West Africa, kabilang ang Liberia, na iwasan ang hindi protektadong pakikipagtalik dahil nananatili ang Ebola virus sa semilya ng ilang buwan matapos gumaling. Patuloy paring nakikipaglaban ang mga rescuer sa Liberia upang mapigilan ang pagkalat. Gayunpaman, positibo ang WHO na malapit nang ideklara ang Nigeria at Senegal na malaya na sa Ebola matapos ang 42 araw na walang bagong kaso. Ayon sa mga pag-aaral, maaaring manatili ang Ebola virus sa semilya ng hindi bababa sa 70 araw matapos gumaling, at posibleng mas mahaba pa sa 90 araw. Pinapayuhan ang mga survivor na gumamit ng condom o iwasan ang hindi protektadong pakikipagtalik ng hindi bababa sa 90 araw matapos gumaling, ayon kay Professor Peter Piot ng London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, isa sa mga nakadiskubre ng Ebola. Para sa mas mataas na pag-iingat, ang dobleng panahon ay 180 araw o anim na buwan, ngunit itinuturing na praktikal ang 90 araw bilang gabay. Naipapasa ang Ebola sa pamamagitan ng bodily fluids tulad ng dugo at laway, at na-dedetect din ito sa gatas ng ina, ihi, at semilya, ayon sa WHO. Hindi pa kailanman nahanap ang aktibong virus sa pawis. Umabot na sa higit 3,400 katao ang nasawi sa kasalukuyang Ebola outbreak, karamihan sa Guinea, Liberia, at Sierra Leone. Samantala, nagbabala ang WHO na malamang tumaas pa ang mga kaso ng Ebola sa Europe, ngunit handa ang kontinente na labanan ito. Matapos makumpirma ang unang lokal na kaso sa isang nurse sa Spain, sinabi ni WHO European director Zsuzsanna Jakab na ‘di maiiwasan’ ang dagdag kaso dahil sa malawak na paglalakbay sa pagitan ng Europe at mga apektadong bansa. Sa Spain, apat ang naiospital matapos magka-Ebola ang nurse—ang unang kaso ng Ebola na nakuha sa labas ng Africa. Ang iba pang bansang Europeo—France, Britain, Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, Norway, at Spain—ay tumanggap at gumamot ng mga pasyenteng nagmula sa West Africa, na apektado ng Ebola mula Marso. Higit 7,200 katao na ang nahawahan sa West Africa at mahigit 3,400 ang namatay—ginagawang pinakamalaking Ebola outbreak ito sa kasaysayan. May mga naiulat nang kaso sa Nigeria, Senegal, at Estados Unidos. Ayon kay Jakab, health workers na nag-aalaga ng mga repatriated Ebola patients, pati pamilya at malalapit na kontak nila, ang may pinakamataas na panganib mahawa sa Europe. Gayunpaman, giit niya, mababa ang panganib nang malawakan at kabilang ang Europe sa pinakamahusay na handa para sa mga viral hemorrhagic fevers gaya ng Ebola. Nagbabala pa rin ang mga eksperto na maaaring madagdagan ang kaso ng Ebola sa Europe, gaya ng naranasan ni Manuel Garcia Viejo, isang paring Espanyol na nahawa ng sakit habang nagtatrabaho sa Sierra Leone.

article_content: The Jurassic Park franchise faces uncertainty after the lukewarm response to Jurassic World Dominion, prompting questions about its future direction. Academy Award-winning filmmaker Emerald Fennell—known for Saltburn, Promising Young Woman, and a cameo in Barbie—recently shared her own imaginative take in an interview with Deadline. Fennell expressed gratitude for her successful career, noting that she has brought many of her dream projects to fruition. She revealed that Jurassic Park is her favorite film and shared an unconventional idea for the series: a story with an unexpectedly erotic angle, featuring a comedic take on the relationship between a human and a velociraptor, presented as a domestic drama. While her comments were delivered humorously, they reflect both her creative boldness and her affection for the franchise. During the interview, Fennell also mentioned It's a Wonderful Life as the movie that always moves her to tears, and cited Ursula from The Little Mermaid as her dream role, wishing for a prequel that portrays the sea witch as misunderstood and adventurous. Fennell’s remarks showcase her penchant for reimagining familiar stories in subversive and entertaining ways.

Kamakailan, ibinahagi ni Academy Award-winning filmmaker Emerald Fennell—na kilala sa Saltburn, Promising Young Woman, at nagkaroon ng cameo sa Barbie—ang kanyang malikhaing pananaw sa isang panayam sa Deadline. Nagpahayag si Fennell ng pasasalamat para sa kanyang matagumpay na karera at sinabi niyang natupad niya ang marami sa kanyang mga dream projects. Ibinunyag niya na paborito niyang pelikula ang Jurassic Park, at nagbahagi siya ng kakaibang ideya para sa serye: isang istorya na may hindi inaasahang erotic na tema, na may nakakatawang twist tungkol sa relasyon ng tao at velociraptor, na itinatampok bilang isang domestic drama. Bagamat pabiro ang kanyang mga komento, ipinapakita nito ang kanyang tapang sa creative storytelling at pagmamahal sa franchise. Sa panayam, nabanggit din ni Fennell na ang It's a Wonderful Life ang pelikulang laging nagpapaiyak sa kanya, at si Ursula mula sa The Little Mermaid ang kanyang dream role, na nais niyang bigyan ng prequel na nagpapakita kay Ursula bilang misunderstood at mapangahas. Ipinapakita ng mga pahayag ni Fennell ang hilig niyang bigyang-buhay ang mga paboritong kwento sa kakaiba at nakakaaliw na paraan.

article_content: Benito Mussolini, the founder of Italian fascism and ally of Adolf Hitler, remains a significant and controversial figure in Italy nearly 70 years after his death. Despite his dictatorial rule, implementation of anti-Semitic laws, and World War II alliance with Nazi Germany, Mussolini's image continues to appear on calendars that are reportedly becoming increasingly popular. Renato Circi, head of the Rome-based printer Gamma 3000, reports that sales of Mussolini-themed calendars are higher now, with greater interest among younger Italians compared to a decade ago. These calendars have long been available alongside those of sports personalities and animals, but the recent increase in sales suggests a renewed fascination with Mussolini, particularly among the youth. Beyond memorabilia, neo-fascist ideologies and symbols have experienced a resurgence. Youth groups such as Blocco Studentesco have organized regular protests in Rome, some of which have resulted in clashes with law enforcement. In late 2012, an attack on Tottenham Hotspur fans in Rome, believed to be linked to neo-fascist supporters, led to the stabbing of 25-year-old Ashley Mills. Earlier that year, a village south of Rome honored Field Marshal Rodolfo Graziani with a £100,000 statue, and there have been suggestions to rename Forli airport after Mussolini. Political analysts, including Professor James Walston, note that Italy’s relationship with its fascist past is complicated, with laws concerning fascist parties not fully enforced. Economic difficulties have contributed to growing interest in strong, authoritarian figures, as Italy faces persistent recession and high unemployment rates, prompting some young people to consider right-wing ideologies as solutions to the country’s challenges. Historically, Mussolini rose to power following World War I, forming the Fascist Party in 1919 and leading the March on Rome in 1922. He became dictator by 1925, adopting the title ‘Il Duce’ and pursuing the goal of restoring Italian power. Mussolini supported Franco in the Spanish Civil War, allied with Hitler’s Germany, and declared war on Britain and France in 1940. Following repeated military defeats, he was overthrown and imprisoned in 1943, later rescued by German forces, and eventually captured and executed by partisans in 1945 as Allied forces advanced through Italy. Simone di Stefano, vice-president of the neo-fascist group CasaPound, asserts that buyers of Mussolini calendars admire his policies and see value in prioritizing Italian interests. The debate over Mussolini’s legacy and the continued presence of fascist symbols remains a contentious issue in Italian society.
translated_content: Si Benito Mussolini, ang nagtatag ng Italian fascism at kaalyado ni Adolf Hitler, ay nananatiling mahalaga at kontrobersyal na tao sa Italya, halos 70 taon matapos ang kanyang kamatayan. Sa kabila ng kanyang diktadurya, pagpapatupad ng mga anti-Semitic na batas, at alyansa sa Nazi Germany noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig, patuloy na makikita ang imahe ni Mussolini sa mga kalendaryo na sinasabing mas pumatok sa kasalukuyan. Ayon kay Renato Circi, pinuno ng Rome-based printer na Gamma 3000, mas mataas na raw ang benta ng kalendaryong may larawan ni Mussolini ngayon, at karamihan sa bumibili ay mga kabataang Italyano. Matagal nang ibinebenta ang mga kalendaryong ito, katabi ng mga kalendaryong may litrato ng mga sports personalities at hayop, ngunit ang agarang pagtaas ng benta ay sumasagisag ng muling paglago ng interes kay Mussolini, partikular sa kabataan. Lagpas pa sa mga memorabilia, muling lumalakas ang presensya ng mga simbolo at ideolohiyang neo-fascist. Regular na nag-oorganisa ng mga protesta sa Rome ang youth group na Blocco Studentesco, na minsan ay nauuwi sa girian laban sa pulisya. Noong huling bahagi ng 2012, nagkaroon ng insidente ng karahasan sa mga tagahanga ng Tottenham Hotspur sa Rome na iniuugnay sa ilang neo-fascist supporters, at nagdulot ito ng pagkakasaksak kay Ashley Mills, isang 25 taong gulang na tagahanga. Mas maaga pa noong taong iyon, binigyang parangal ng isang bayan sa timog ng Rome si Field Marshal Rodolfo Graziani sa pamamagitan ng estatwang nagkakahalaga ng £100,000, at may minsang panukala na pangalanan muli ang Forli airport bilang Mussolini Airport. Ayon sa mga political analyst tulad ni Professor James Walston, kumplikado ang relasyon ng Italya sa nakaraan nitong fascist dahil hindi ganap na naipapatupad ang mga batas laban sa mga partidong fascist. Ang kahirapan at krisis sa ekonomiya ay nagpapalakas sa interes ng ilan sa malakas na lider, lalo na’t patuloy na nakararanas ng recession at mataas na unemployment ang bansa, kaya’t mayroong mga kabataan na tumitingin sa kanan o authoritarian na pamamaraan bilang lunas. Sa kasaysayan, umangat si Mussolini matapos ang Unang Digmaang Pandaigdig, itinatag ang Fascist Party noong 1919, at pinamunuan ang March on Rome noong 1922. Naging diktador siya noong 1925 gamit ang titulong ‘Il Duce’ at hinangad muling palakasin ang Italya. Pinili niyang suportahan si Franco sa Spanish Civil War, pumabor kay Hitler sa WWII, at nagdeklara ng digmaan laban sa Britain at France noong 1940. Matapos ang sunud-sunod na pagkatalo, napatalsik siya at nabilanggo noong 1943, tinulungan ng mga Aleman, ngunit nahuli at napatay ng mga partisan noong 1945 habang papalapit ang mga kaalyadong puwersa. Ayon kay Simone di Stefano, bise-presidente ng neo-fascist group na CasaPound, ang mga bumibili ng kalendaryo ni Mussolini ay humahanga sa kanyang patakaran at naniniwala sa pagbabalik ng interes ng bansa. Mainit pa rin ang usapin ukol sa pamana ni Mussolini at sa presensya ng mga simbolo ng fascism sa lipunang Italyano.

article_content: Subaru unveiled its Air Mobility Concept at the Japan Mobility Show in Tokyo on October 25, introducing an innovative take on future transportation. Suspended above Subaru’s electric Sport Mobility Concept car, the aircraft drew attention for its distinctive drone-hovercraft design and was dubbed the 'Air Mobility Concept.' Reflecting the event’s broader emphasis on mobility, Subaru showcased an example of airborne transport in addition to traditional vehicles. The Air Mobility Concept employs six rotors and accommodates two passengers in a compact cockpit, capitalizing on Subaru’s longstanding involvement in aviation. The company’s roots stretch back to 1915 as the Aircraft Research Laboratory, later becoming Nakajima Aircraft Company in 1932 and producing airplanes during World War II. Subaru shifted towards automobiles in 1953 under Fuji Heavy Industries, and, in 2017, formally adopted the Subaru name for its car division. Meanwhile, Subaru’s aerospace division continues to manufacture aircraft parts for Boeing and helicopters for Bell. The all-electric Air Mobility Concept is designed for vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL), well-suited for limited urban spaces. While Subaru has not disclosed specific technical details like range or battery life, the project parallels other Japanese ventures in flying cars, such as SkyDrive, which aims for limited service launch in 2026. Subaru has performed unmanned test flights of the prototype in Japan, as revealed during the show. The firm emphasizes that the Air Mobility Concept remains experimental, but highlights active collaboration between its automotive and aerospace teams. With relevant legislation in development for Japan and other countries, flying car operations could begin as early as 2026, potentially bringing Subaru’s vision to the skies.

article_content: Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers has called on Mario Balotelli to improve after a disappointing week capped by a loss to Basel. The £16 million striker, considered a significant signing in the summer, has struggled to deliver goals. A recent incident where he seemed to ignore supporters has raised further doubt about his suitability at Anfield. Balotelli had a difficult match in Switzerland, something Rodgers acknowledged. Despite Rodgers’ public statements, he and Balotelli appeared in good spirits during Thursday's training at Melwood, including time spent talking together and with team captain Steven Gerrard. Rodgers commended Balotelli's work ethic, saying: 'He is trying hard, but in terms of goals, he needs to improve—there’s no question about that. He hasn’t reached the numbers he wants.' Rodgers emphasized the need for teamwork: 'We must return to being a team. When confidence is low, players can focus on themselves, but we need to regroup.' He also pointed out that Liverpool’s quality was lacking during the loss to Basel, stating: 'We win and lose as a team, and last night we weren’t good enough.' Balotelli, who did not record a single touch in the opposition’s box, cut a dejected figure after Liverpool's loss, underscoring the team's attacking woes.

Kamakailan, may insidente rin siyang tila hindi pinansin ang mga tagasuporta, na lalong nagdudulot ng pagdududa kung akma ba siya sa Anfield. Inamin ni Rodgers na nahirapan si Balotelli noong laban sa Switzerland. Sa kabila ng mga komento ni Rodgers, maganda ang naging samahan nila ni Balotelli sa training noong Huwebes sa Melwood, kasama si team captain Steven Gerrard. Pinuri ni Rodgers ang sipag ni Balotelli, at sinabi: 'Talagang nagsusumikap siya, pero sa goals, kailangan pa niyang mag-improve—walang duda roon. Hindi pa niya naaabot ang target niya.' Binigyang-diin ni Rodgers ang kahalagahan ng pagiging team: 'Kailangan nating bumalik sa pagiging isang team. Kapag mababa ang kumpiyansa, nagiging makasarili ang mga manlalaro, pero kailangan nating magkaisa.' Binanggit din niyang kinulang ang kalidad ng Liverpool sa pagkatalo sa Basel: 'Sama-sama tayong nananalo at natatalo, at kagabi hindi talaga sapat ang ipinakita natin.' Bagamat walang naitalang kahit isang touch si Balotelli sa box ng kalaban, kita ang labis niyang pagkadismaya pagkatapos ng pagkatalo—ipinapakita nito ang problema ng koponan sa opensa.

article_content: One of the 78 wives of incarcerated polygamist sect leader Warren Jeffs has left the Arizona community of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (FLDS) this week and is now receiving medical care at a shelter, authorities report. Her name has not been released by the Washington County, Utah, Sheriff's Department, as she is considered an abuse victim. The woman was taken to the shelter after a tense situation with church members on Monday. She fled to the home of Willie Jessop, formerly a high-ranking church official who was expelled by Jeffs. Jessop said she sought him out for protection. The standoff began when FLDS men went to Jessop's office, trying to bring her back, according to Jessop. Detectives removed her and brought her to the shelter. Warren Jeffs, leader of the roughly 10,000-member FLDS, is serving a life plus 20-year sentence for sexual assault, following convictions in August for aggravated sexual assault against a 12-year-old and a 15-year-old girl, whom he called his 'spiritual wives.' The FLDS is a breakaway Mormon sect that openly practices polygamy in Hildale, Utah, Colorado City, Arizona, and at its Yearning For Zion ranch near Eldorado, Texas. The mainstream Mormon church officially renounced polygamy more than 100 years ago.

Hindi inilabas ng Washington County, Utah Sheriff's Department ang kanyang pangalan dahil siya ay itinuturing na biktima ng pang-aabuso. Dinala siya sa shelter matapos ang tensiyosong insidente kasama ang mga miyembro ng simbahan noong Lunes. Tumakas siya sa bahay ni Willie Jessop, dating mataas na opisyal ng simbahan na pinaalis ni Jeffs. Ayon kay Jessop, humingi siya ng proteksyon sa kanya. Nagsimula ang tensiyon nang pumunta ang ilang kalalakihan ng FLDS sa opisina ni Jessop para pabalikin siya sa komunidad, ayon kay Jessop. Inalis siya ng mga imbestigador at dinala sa shelter. Ang FLDS ay isang breakaway Mormon sect na lantaran ang pagsasagawa ng poligamya sa Hildale, Utah; Colorado City, Arizona; at sa Yearning For Zion ranch malapit sa Eldorado, Texas. Matagal nang tinanggihan ng mainstream Mormon church ang poligamya mahigit isandaang taon na ang nakalipas.

article_content: New Delhi, India's capital, is preparing to experiment with cloud seeding as a method to tackle its severe air pollution. The trial, possibly as early as next week, would involve releasing chemicals like silver iodide into the clouds to create rain in hopes of clearing the city's dangerous haze. Delhi has previously implemented traffic restrictions, constructed costly air filtration towers, and used fleets of water-spraying trucks, but none have solved the ongoing problem. Cloud seeding, if approved, remains a controversial measure. 'It’s not a real solution; it’s only temporary relief,' says Avikal Somvanshi, a researcher at the Center for Science and Environment in New Delhi. Environmentalists and scientists argue that officials are focusing too much on temporary mitigation instead of addressing pollution sources. 'There’s no real political will to solve this—one of the biggest problems,' adds Bhavreen Kandhari, activist and cofounder of the Warrior Moms group. The situation has forced schools in Delhi and nearby areas to close and led offices to allow remote work. The government has advised vulnerable populations, including children, the elderly, and people with chronic illnesses, to stay indoors. Most diesel trucks, unless carrying essential goods, are banned from entering the city. Rain last week brought brief improvement, but pollution worsened again after firecrackers were set off for the Diwali festival. Delhi officials are seeking approval from federal agencies to proceed with cloud seeding. The process involves using aircraft to spray clouds with substances such as silver iodide, potassium iodide, or dry ice to encourage rainfall. These chemicals interact with moisture in the clouds, forming larger droplets that fall as rain. China has used artificial rain to reduce air pollution in the past, but this method requires enough moisture and cloud cover, which Delhi often lacks in winter. If weather conditions are suitable, scientists from the Indian Institute of Technology in Kanpur plan to carry out cloud seeding around November 20. Until then, Delhi remains under toxic winter smog that results from a combination of factors early in the season.
translated_content: Naghahanda ang kabisera ng India na subukan ang cloud seeding bilang paraan laban sa matinding polusyon sa hangin. Maaaring maganap ang eksperimento sa susunod na linggo, kung saan magpapakawala ng mga kemikal gaya ng silver iodide sa ulap upang magdulot ng ulan at mapawi ang mapanganib na haze sa siyudad. Noon pa man, nagpatupad na ang Delhi ng pagbabawal sa trapiko, nagtayo ng mamahaling air filtration towers, at gumamit ng mga trak na nag-iispray ng tubig, ngunit hindi nito nasolusyunan ang matagal nang problema. Kung mapapayagan, nananatiling kontrobersyal ang cloud seeding. "Hindi ito totoong solusyon—pansamantalang ginhawa lang," sabi ni Avikal Somvanshi, researcher sa Center for Science and Environment sa New Delhi. Ayon sa mga environmentalist at siyentipiko, masyadong nakatutok ang mga opisyal sa pansamantalang solusyon sa halip na tugunan ang pinagmumulan ng polusyon. "Walang totoong political will para solusyunan ito—yan ang isa sa pinakamalalaking problema," dagdag ni Bhavreen Kandhari, aktibista at cofounder ng Warrior Moms. Dahil sa sitwasyon, napilitang magsara ang mga paaralan sa Delhi at kalapit-lugar at pinayagan ang mga opisina na mag-work from home. Pinayuhan ng gobyerno ang mga bata, matatanda, at may chronic illness na manatili sa loob ng bahay. Hindi pinapapasok ang karamihan sa mga diesel truck maliban na lang kung may dalang mahalagang suplay. Ang ulan noong nakaraang linggo ay panandaliang nagpa-improve sa hangin, pero bumalik agad ang polusyon matapos ang mga paputok sa Diwali. Humihingi ngayon ng pahintulot ang mga opisyal ng Delhi mula sa mga ahensya ng pambansang pamahalaan para isagawa ang cloud seeding. Ginagamitan ito ng eroplano na nag-iispray ng kemikal gaya ng silver iodide, potassium iodide, o dry ice sa ulap para magdulot ng ulan. Nakikipag-ugnayan ang kemikal sa moisture sa ulap para makabuo ng mas malalaking patak ng ulan. Ginamit na rin ng China ang artificial rain noon kontra polusyon, pero kailangan nito ng sapat na moisture at ulap, na kadalasang kulang sa Delhi tuwing taglamig. Kung magiging maganda ang panahon, plano ng mga siyentipiko mula sa Indian Institute of Technology sa Kanpur na gawin ang cloud seeding bandang Nobyembre 20. Hanggang doon, nananatiling nababalot ng toxic na smog ang Delhi tuwing taglamig, dulot ng iba’t ibang sanhi na sabay-sabay nagsisimula sa panahong ito.

article_content: A California mother's 20-minute video montage, showcasing moments from her 19-year-old daughter's life, was presented as 'victim impact evidence' during a murder trial. The video included celebrations like birthdays, picnics, and graduations, set to music with the mother's narration. The use of such evidence, along with a similar case, reached the U.S. Supreme Court after defendants claimed the videos unfairly influenced the jury. This Monday, the Supreme Court declined to review the appeals from both California cases, effectively letting the death sentences stand. The central legal question involved the presentation method of victim impact testimony, not its overall admissibility. Courts differ on whether and how such videos can be shown. In the case of Douglas Oliver Kelly, he was convicted for the 1993 murder of teenager Sarah Weir after befriending her. During the penalty phase, Sarah’s mother, Martha Farwell, played the video and spoke about her daughter's adoption from Canada and Blackfoot heritage, with Enya's music in the background. The judge found the video’s value outweighed any prejudicial effect. Kelly appealed, claiming the video may have improperly affected the jury. California’s highest court upheld Kelly’s conviction and sentence, though it advised trial judges to use caution with such evidence. Justice John Paul Stevens—joined by Justices David Souter and Stephen Breyer—advocated for reviewing the case, voicing concern that emotional videos could lead the jury away from reasoned judgment. Justice Breyer called the video 'poignant, tasteful, artistic and moving,' but warned that its emotional nature might excessively sway the jury. Only three justices supported a review, fewer than the four needed. In a related case, Samuel Zamudio was convicted of killing his elderly neighbors, Elmer and Gladys Benson. The victims' daughter, Linda Bouffard, narrated a montage depicting their lives, but the judge prohibited background music and inflammatory statements. Courts across the nation have varied in handling victim impact videos. Some allow family videos as evidence, while others have ruled them too prejudicial. Supreme Court precedents permit such evidence but with caution against potential misuse. A 1991 Supreme Court ruling noted that evidence could be excluded if so prejudicial it made a trial fundamentally unfair, and in 2006, the justices upheld a California conviction despite jurors seeing the victim’s family wearing buttons displaying his picture during trial.
translated_content: Isang 20-minutong video montage mula sa isang ina sa California, na nagpapakita ng mahahalagang sandali mula sa buhay ng kanyang 19-anyos na anak na babae, ang ginamit bilang 'victim impact evidence' sa isang paglilitis ng pagpatay. Tampok dito ang mga selebrasyon tulad ng kaarawan, picnic, at graduation, na may background music at salaysay ng ina. Ang paggamit ng ganitong ebidensya, kasama ang isang katulad na kaso, ay humantong sa Korte Suprema ng U.S., matapos iprotesta ng mga akusado na naapektuhan ang husgado dahil sa emosyonal na epekto ng mga video. Noong Lunes, tinanggihan ng Korte Suprema na pakinggan ang mga apela mula sa dalawang kaso sa California, kaya’t nanatili ang death sentence. Ang pangunahing isyu ay kung paano ipinapakita ang victim impact testimony, hindi ang kabuuang pagpayag sa ganitong ebidensya. Magkakaiba ang polisiya ng mga korte tungkol sa pagpapakita ng ganitong mga video. Sa kaso ni Douglas Oliver Kelly, napatunayang nagkasala siya sa pagpatay noong 1993 kay Sarah Weir matapos silang maging magkaibigan. Sa penalty phase, ipinakita ng ina ni Sarah na si Martha Farwell ang video at ikinuwento ang tungkol sa pag-aampon ng anak mula Canada at pagiging Blackfoot Indian, habang tumutugtog ang kanta ni Enya. Pinayagan ng hukom ang video dahil mas mataas ang kalidad nitong ebidensya kaysa sa panganib ng negatibong epekto. Umapela si Kelly, sinasabing maaaring naapektuhan ng video ang hatol ng hurado. Pinagtibay ng California Supreme Court ang hatol at sentensya kay Kelly, pero pinayuhan ang mga hukom na maging maingat sa ganitong mga ebidensya. Si Justice John Paul Stevens, kasama sina Justices David Souter at Stephen Breyer, ay gustong suriin ang kaso, dahil nababahala silang baka makaimpluwensya nang labis ang emosyonal na videos sa hurado. Tinawag ni Justice Breyer ang video na 'makabagbag-damdamin, disente, artistiko, at nakaaantig,' ngunit nagbabala rin na maaari nitong sobrahan ang epekto sa hurado. Tatlong justices lamang ang nagbigay suporta sa muling pag-review ng kaso—kulang sa kinakailangang apat. Sa kaugnay na kaso, napatunayang nagkasala si Samuel Zamudio sa pagpatay sa dalawang matandang kapitbahay na sina Elmer at Gladys Benson. Ang kanilang anak na si Linda Bouffard ang nag-narrate ng montage tungkol sa buhay ng magulang, ngunit ipinagbawal ng hukom ang background audio at emosyonal na komento. Iba’t iba ang naging desisyon ng mga korte sa bansa ukol sa victim impact videos. Pinapayagan ng ilan ang mga family video bilang ebidensya, habang tinatanggihan ng iba dahil maaaring masyadong makaapekto ito sa hurado. Pinahihintulutan ng mga dating desisyon ng Korte Suprema ang ganitong ebidensya ngunit may limitasyon sa maling paggamit dito. Noong 1991, sinabi ng Korte Suprema na maaaring hindi tanggapin ang ebidensya kung ito ay labis na nakakasama at nagpapahina sa fairness ng trial. Noong 2006, kinatigan pa rin ng mga hukom ang hatol sa isang kaso sa California kahit pinayagan ang pamilya ng biktima na magsuot ng button na may larawan ng namatay habang nasa korte.

article_content: Amazon Luna, Amazon’s cloud gaming platform, has launched a new feature that allows users to purchase individual Ubisoft games. With this integration, Luna users can now enjoy titles like Assassin’s Creed: Mirage and The Crew Motorfest without leaving the platform or needing additional downloads. The appeal of cloud-based gaming lies in its convenience. Players can stream games directly to multiple compatible devices, removing the need for large downloads or expensive hardware. Many cloud gaming platforms use a subscription model, offering a rotating library of games, but there’s often no guarantee of permanent access to specific titles. By contrast, services like GeForce Now let users stream games they’ve already purchased on PC through a subscription. Amazon Luna is trying to bridge the gap between these models, similar to what Google Stadia attempted before it closed. With Luna’s new feature, users can buy individual Ubisoft games through their linked Ubisoft Connect accounts. This means they own the game license and can stream it on any Luna-compatible device. Because the game is tied to Ubisoft Connect, players can also access it on their PC. Since its launch, Amazon Luna has aimed to gain a foothold in the cloud gaming market. Allowing users to directly purchase Ubisoft games is a major step forward in this effort. After buying a game on Luna, players can start playing immediately. This update aligns with Amazon’s goal of offering a consistent and high-quality gaming experience, in collaboration with top gaming studios. Although the current offering is limited to Ubisoft, Luna’s move to support individual game purchases could encourage other game publishers to join its marketplace in the future.
translated_content: Inilunsad ng Amazon Luna, ang cloud gaming platform ng Amazon, ang bagong tampok na nagpapahintulot sa mga user na bumili ng mga indibidwal na laro mula sa Ubisoft. Sa bagong integration na ito, puwede nang maglaro ang mga user ng Luna ng mga pamagat gaya ng Assassin’s Creed: Mirage at The Crew Motorfest nang hindi na umaalis sa platform o kailangan pang mag-download. Ang kagandahan ng cloud-based gaming ay nasa pagiging convenient nito. Puwedeng mag-stream ang mga manlalaro ng games diretso sa maraming compatible na devices, kaya wala nang malaking downloads o mamahaling hardware na kailangan. Maraming cloud gaming platforms ang gumagamit ng subscription model, na nagbibigay ng nagbabagong library ng mga laro, pero kadalasan walang garantiya na permanente mong maa-access ang isang partikular na laro. Sa kabilang banda, hinahayaan ng mga serbisyo tulad ng GeForce Now na mag-stream ang users ng mga larong binili na nila sa PC gamit ang subscription. Nilalayon ng Amazon Luna na maging tulay ng dalawang modelong ito, katulad ng sinubukan ng Google Stadia bago ito nagsara. Sa bagong tampok ng Luna, puwede nang bumili ang users ng indibidwal na Ubisoft games gamit ang kanilang naka-link na Ubisoft Connect accounts. Ibig sabihin, kanila na ang game license at puwede nila itong i-stream sa kahit anong device na compatible sa Luna. Dahil naka-link din sa Ubisoft Connect, puwede ring laruin ang laro sa PC. Mula noong inilunsad, layunin ng Amazon Luna na maging bahagi ng cloud gaming market. Ang desisyong payagan ang direct na pagbili ng Ubisoft games ay isang malaking hakbang sa pagsulong na ito. Pagkatapos bumili ng laro sa Luna, agad na puwedeng maglaro ang users. Ang update na ito ay sumasalamin sa layunin ng Amazon na maghandog ng tuloy-tuloy at high-quality na gaming experience, katuwang ang mga nangungunang gaming studios. Bagaman pansamantalang para lang sa Ubisoft ang feature na ito, ang hakbang ng Luna na mag-alok ng indibidwal na pagbili ng games ay maaaring maka-engganyo pa ng ibang game publishers na sumali sa kanilang marketplace sa hinaharap.

article_content: A new report by a leading think tank has found that political freedoms are under pressure in many parts of the world. According to the International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (IDEA), democracy declined globally for the sixth year in a row in 2022, with nearly half of all countries seeing setbacks in areas like freedom of expression and political participation. IDEA's annual report, released this week from its headquarters in Stockholm, stated that 85 out of 173 countries it surveyed experienced a decline in at least one key democratic indicator over the past five years. 'In short, democracy is still in trouble, stagnant at best, and declining in many places,' said IDEA Secretary-General Kevin Casas-Zamora in the Global State of Democracy 2023 report. This six-year drop in democracy marks the longest period of global democratic backsliding since records began in 1975. Casas-Zamora attributed the trend to the weakening of democratic institutions that safeguard human rights and the rule of law. He also noted hope in informal checks and balances—such as journalists, election officials, and anti-corruption authorities—who play a critical role in resisting authoritarian and populist movements. The report highlighted that 2022 was a difficult year, affected by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the COVID-19 pandemic, climate change, and a global rise in inflation leading to a cost of living crisis. While Europe ranked as the highest-performing region for democracy, it too witnessed backsliding—not only in younger democracies like Hungary but also in long-established ones, including the United Kingdom. Countries such as Azerbaijan, Belarus, Russia, and Turkey performed poorly in Eastern Europe and Asia. In the Americas, the United States, Guatemala, and El Salvador all moved backward in democracy rankings amid issues like decreased equality among social groups and political unrest. In Africa, a wave of coups demonstrated worsening democratic conditions. IDEA's indexes are based on over 100 measures of political representation, rights, rule of law, and participation.
translated_content: Isang bagong ulat mula sa isang kilalang think tank ang nagsabing napipilitang umatras ang mga pampolitikang kalayaan sa maraming bahagi ng mundo. Ayon sa International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (IDEA), bumaba ang demokrasya sa buong mundo sa ikaanim na sunod na taon noong 2022, kung saan halos kalahati ng mga bansa ay nakaranas ng pag-urong sa mga aspeto tulad ng kalayaan sa pamamahayag at pampulitikang partisipasyon. Ayon sa taunang ulat ng IDEA na inilabas ngayong linggo mula sa kanilang punong tanggapan sa Stockholm, 85 sa 173 bansang sinuri ang nakaranas ng pagbaba sa hindi bababa sa isang mahalagang demokratikong sukatan sa nakaraang limang taon. 'Sa madaling salita, ang demokrasya ay nananatiling nasa panganib, pinakamabuting stagnant, at bumabagsak sa maraming lugar,' pahayag ni IDEA Secretary-General Kevin Casas-Zamora sa Global State of Democracy 2023 report. Ang anim na taong sunod-sunod na pagbagsak ng demokrasya ay ang pinakamahabang yugto ng pagbaba mula noong nagsimula ang talaan noong 1975. Iniuugnay ni Casas-Zamora ang trend na ito sa panghihina ng mga demokratikong institusyon na nagbabantay sa karapatang pantao at batas. Nagbigay din siya ng pag-asa sa papel ng mga hindi pormal na mekanismo ng checks and balances—gaya ng mga mamamahayag, opisyal ng halalan, at mga anti-korapsyon na awtoridad—na mahalaga sa pagtutol sa mga awtoritaryan at populistang kilos. Ipinunto sa ulat na lalo pang naging hamon ang taong 2022 dahil sa pananakop ng Russia sa Ukraine, pandemya ng COVID-19, pagbabago ng klima, at pagtaas ng inflation na nagdulot ng krisis sa gastusin ng pamumuhay sa buong mundo. Bagaman pinakamataas ang ranggo ng Europa sa usaping demokrasya, nakaranas din ito ng pagbaba—hindi lang sa mga batang demokrasya tulad ng Hungary kundi pati sa matagal nang itinatag na bansa gaya ng United Kingdom. Sa Silangang Europa at Asya, mababa rin ang naging puntos ng Azerbaijan, Belarus, Russia, at Turkey. Sa Amerika, umatras ang Estados Unidos, Guatemala, at El Salvador sa ranggo ng demokrasya dahil sa mga isyu tulad ng pagbaba ng pagkakapantay-pantay ng mga grupong panlipunan at pampulitikang kaguluhan. Sa Africa, sunod-sunod na kudeta ang nagpapakita ng lumalalang kalagayan ng demokrasya. Batay ang mga sukatan ng IDEA sa mahigit 100 batayan ng pampulitikang representasyon, karapatan, batas, at partisipasyon.

article_content: A 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia’s Banda Sea on Wednesday, according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). There were no immediate reports of injuries or damage. No tsunami warning was issued for the quake, which was initially reported as magnitude 6.9. The earthquake occurred at 11:53 a.m. local time (0453 GMT). According to the Indonesian Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency, the tremor was felt moderately in the town of Saumlaki, in the Tanimbar Islands. Saumlaki resident Lambert Tatang told AFP, 'The earthquake was quite intense. But the people here were not panicking. We are used to having earthquakes. Especially after we learned there was no tsunami threat, so life is just normal now.' Tatang is 41 years old. Indonesia frequently experiences earthquakes as it lies on the Pacific 'Ring of Fire,' an arc of intense seismic activity stretching from Japan through Southeast Asia and across the Pacific basin. Past earthquakes in Indonesia include a 5.6-magnitude quake in West Java in November 2022 that killed 602 people, and a 9.1-magnitude earthquake off the coast of Sumatra in 2004, which triggered a tsunami that killed 220,000 people across the region, including about 170,000 in Indonesia.
translated_content: Isang lindol na may lakas na 7.1 ang yumanig sa Banda Sea ng Indonesia noong Miyerkules, ayon sa United States Geological Survey (USGS). Walang naitalang agad na pinsala o nasawi. Walang inilabas na babala ng tsunami para sa lindol, na una ay naiulat na magnitude 6.9. Nangyari ang lindol bandang 11:53 ng umaga lokal na oras (0453 GMT). Ayon sa Indonesian Meteorological, Climatological and Geophysical Agency, ramdam ng katamtaman ang pagyanig sa bayan ng Saumlaki sa Tanimbar Islands. Ayon kay Lambert Tatang, residente ng Saumlaki, sa AFP: 'Malakas ang lindol pero hindi nag-panic ang mga tao dito. Sanay na kami sa lindol. Lalo na nang malaman naming walang banta ng tsunami, kaya normal na uli ang buhay.' Si Tatang ay 41 taong gulang. Madalas makaranas ng lindol ang Indonesia dahil ito ay matatagpuan sa Pacific 'Ring of Fire,' isang arko ng malalakas na lindol na sumasaklaw mula Japan, Southeast Asia, at buong Pacific basin. Kabilang sa mga malalakas na lindol na tumama sa Indonesia ay ang 5.6-magnitude sa West Java noong Nobyembre 2022 na kumitil ng 602 katao, at ang 9.1-magnitude na lindol sa baybayin ng Sumatra noong 2004 na nagdulot ng tsunami na pumatay sa 220,000 katao sa buong rehiyon, kabilang ang tinatayang 170,000 sa Indonesia.

article_content: Wakanow.com Nigeria, a leading travel technology company, is empowering youth and women aiming to become entrepreneurs through its CSR program, Wakacares, which promotes gender equality in Nigeria. CEO Adenike Macaulay announced the second phase of the 'Skill Up' initiative on October 17, 2023, in Lagos, focusing on training members of Women In Management, Business & Public Service (WIMBIZ) in business opportunities within the travel industry and providing essential skills to start travel businesses. Launched in May, Wakacares aligns Wakanow Nigeria’s CSR activities with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and focuses on community engagement and empowerment. During the Skill Up with WIMBIZ training, Shola Ipinmoroti, Vice President (Commercial), emphasized that empowering women benefits families and society broadly. The hybrid event was attended by dozens in-person and virtually. Several trainees received tablet devices to support their new travel businesses using Wakanow.com's white label technology. Participants described the training as insightful and helpful. Participant Oluwatoyin Kayode found the event timely and informative for business startups in travel, while Nike Adetutu was enthusiastic about the prospects of additional income and praised the affiliate program and her tablet award. The first phase, 'Skill Up Imo', in partnership with the Imo State Ministry of Digital Economy and E-Government, trained 250 aspiring entrepreneurs in the travel sector, promoting self-employment. Gbenga Onitilo, VP B2B, shared that these projects encourage young people and women to develop entrepreneurial skills, thereby supporting economic growth and decent work. Wakacares is central to Wakanow.com Nigeria’s social responsibility, with program graduates joining as Affiliate Executives, selling flight tickets and travel deals independently. Through Wakacares, Wakanow.com Nigeria is advancing gender equality and economic development, positively impacting women and youth. About Wakanow.com Nigeria: The company is Nigeria’s leading online travel agency, offering comprehensive travel services such as flights, hotels, and vacation packages. With advanced technology and a commitment to customer satisfaction, Wakanow.com is redefining travel for millions in Nigeria. For more info, visit www.wakanow.com. Media contact: Tobi Kolawole, Corporate Communications & Public Relations Manager.

article_content: A rare, nearly flawless copy of Superman’s debut comic book, Action Comics No. 1, has sold for an astonishing $3.2 million. New York comic dealers Stephen Fishler and Vincent Zurzolo confirmed on Monday that they submitted the record-setting bid during an eBay auction that ended Sunday. The 1938 comic, which features Superman’s first appearance, broke its own previous record—the last similarly graded copy sold for $2.1 million in 2011. “It’s hard to believe that a kid’s 10-cent comic is now worth that much, but it is Superman. It’s iconic,” said Fishler. “It’s the first time anyone saw what a superhero could be.” eBay confirmed the sale price but has not released the buyer’s identity. The comic, rated an exceptionally high 9.0 out of 10 for condition, was originally kept for decades in a cedar chest in West Virginia by its first owner, who bought it off a newsstand. Collectibles dealer Darren Adams later acquired it, telling The Washington Post about its remarkable preservation. Action Comics No. 1 was created by Cleveland teenagers Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster. The issue introduced Superman’s Kryptonian origin, his alter ego as reporter Clark Kent, and his role as a champion for the oppressed—helping to lay the foundation for the modern superhero genre. It’s estimated that only 100 to 150 copies survive, with merely a handful in excellent condition. After the original owner passed away, a collector bought the comic from the estate and kept it in similar conditions, according to Adams. Fishler and Zurzolo, owners of ComicConnect.com, previously auctioned the 2011 record-breaking copy and another less well-preserved issue for over $1 million in 2010. Fishler noted that the rising interest and value are fueled by superhero movies and the growing appeal of comic books as alternative investments. This Sunday’s sale is also a high point for San Jose-based eBay, which Adams chose over specialty dealers and auction houses for this major transaction. Gene Cook, eBay’s general manager of emerging verticals, said the event demonstrates how eBay connects people with iconic items and impacts popular culture. A portion of the proceeds will go to the Christopher & Dana Reeve Foundation in honor of the late actor who played Superman. Fishler said he and Zurzolo do not have specific plans for their new acquisition, but that it was too good an opportunity to pass up.
translated_content: Isang bihira at halos perpektong kopya ng unang comic book ni Superman, ang Action Comics No. 1, ay naibenta sa nakakamanghang halagang $3.2 milyon. Kinumpirma ng mga comic dealer mula New York na sina Stephen Fishler at Vincent Zurzolo noong Lunes na sila ang nagbigay ng record-setting na bid sa eBay auction na natapos noong Linggo. Ang komiks na inilabas noong 1938, kung saan unang lumabas si Superman, ay muling na-break ang sarili nitong record—ang huling kaparehong kalidad na kopya ay naibenta sa halagang $2.1 milyon noong 2011. “Mahirap paniwalaan na ang 10 sentimong komiks ng bata noon, ay umaabot na sa ganitong presyo, pero Superman kasi ‘yan. Iconic talaga,” ayon kay Fishler. “Unang beses na nakita ng mga tao kung ano ang superhero.” Kinumpirma ng eBay ang presyo ng bentahan ngunit hindi pa inilalabas ang pangalan ng buyer. Ang komiks, na may napakataas na grado na 9.0 mula sa 10, ay itinago ng dekada sa isang cedar chest sa West Virginia ng orihinal nitong may-ari na bumili nito sa newsstand. Nakuha ito kalaunan ni collectibles dealer Darren Adams, na ibinahagi sa The Washington Post ang tungkol sa kakaibang pangangalaga dito. Ginawa ng mga kabataang taga-Cleveland na sina Jerry Siegel at Joe Shuster ang Action Comics No. 1. Dito unang pinakilala ang pinagmulan ni Superman bilang taga-Krypton, ang kanyang alter ego na si Clark Kent bilang reporter, at ang kanyang papel bilang tagapagtanggol ng api—nakakatulong ito sa pundasyon ng makabagong superhero genre. Tinatayang 100 hanggang 150 na kopya lang ang naiwan, at ilan lamang ang nasa napakagandang kondisyon. Matapos mamatay ang orihinal na may-ari, binili ng isang kolektor ang komiks mula sa estate at itinago ulit ito sa halos katulad na paraan, ayon kay Adams. Sina Fishler at Zurzolo, na may-ari ng ComicConnect.com, ay nauna nang nag-subasta ng record-breaking na kopya noong 2011 at isa pang hindi gaanong maganda ang kondisyon sa mahigit $1 milyon noon pang 2010. Ani Fishler, ang lumalaking interes at halaga ay pinapalakas ng mga superhero movie at ang pagtingin sa comics bilang alternatibong investment. Ang bentahan nitong Linggo ay isa ring malaking kaganapan para sa San Jose-based na eBay, na pinili ni Adams imbes na mga specialty dealer o auction house para sa malaking transaksyon na ito. Ayon kay Gene Cook, general manager ng emerging verticals ng eBay, pinapakita ng event na ito kung paano nag-uugnay ang eBay ng mga tao sa iconic na item at kung paano ito nakakaapekto sa pop culture. Ang bahagi ng kita ay mapupunta sa Christopher & Dana Reeve Foundation bilang paggunita sa yumaong aktor na gumanap bilang Superman. Wala pang partikular na plano sina Fishler at Zurzolo para sa bagong nakuha nila, pero anila, napakahirap palampasin ng pagkakataon.

article_content: On the final day of the European Championships, Chris O'Hare secured a bronze medal for Great Britain in the 1,500 metres. The event also saw France’s Mahiedine Mekhissi-Benabbad claim gold, redeeming himself after being disqualified earlier in the week during the 3,000m steeplechase. Mekhissi-Benabbad drew international attention when he removed his vest and celebrated during the steeplechase, leading to his disqualification for a kit violation after Spain lodged an appeal. Despite this setback, he returned strong in the 1,500m final—making his move with 400 metres to go and crossing the finish line in 3 minutes 45.60 seconds while keeping his vest on. O'Hare clinched bronze for Great Britain with a time of 3:46.18. His teammate, Charlie Grice, finished twelfth after a fall, while Ireland’s Paul Robinson came fourth and Ciaran O'Lionaird did not finish due to an injury. Reflecting on the race, O'Hare said, 'I think I could have challenged Mekhissi-Benabbad if I'd been closer in the final 200 metres. His disqualification in the steeplechase was silly, but he ran a great race today. This medal is a good outcome for me after a messy year.' Great Britain added another bronze medal in the women’s 4x400m relay. Eilidh Child, fresh from her 400m hurdles gold, led off, followed by Kelly Massey, Shana Cox, and Margaret Adeoye. Despite a strong finish, the team placed third behind France, who edged out Ukraine with a winning time of 3:24.27. World champion Christine Ohuruogu was not selected for this relay event.

Napansin si Mekhissi-Benabbad nang hubarin niya ang kanyang pang-itaas at magdiwang habang tumatakbo sa steeplechase, dahilan ng kanyang diskwalipikasyon dahil sa paglabag sa mga regulasyon tungkol sa kasuotan. Sa kabila ng nangyari, bumawi siya sa 1,500m final— nalunusutan niya ang mga kalaban sa huling 400 meters at nagtapos sa oras na 3 minuto at 45.60 segundo, suot pa rin ang kanyang vest. Nagawa ni O'Hare na makuha ang bronze para sa Great Britain sa oras na 3:46.18. Si Charlie Grice, na kasama niya sa team, ay nagtapos sa ika-12 matapos matumba, habang ika-apat si Paul Robinson ng Ireland at hindi nagtapos si Ciaran O'Lionaird dahil sa tinamong injury. Pagkatapos ng karera, sinabi ni O'Hare, 'Siguro kaya ko sana hamunin si Mekhissi-Benabbad kung mas malapit ako sa kanya sa huling 200 meters. Nakakatawa ang pagkakadiskwalipika niya sa steeplechase, pero mahusay siyang tumakbo ngayon. Malaking bagay para sa akin ang medal na ito matapos ang magulong taon.' Nagdagdag pa ng bronze medal ang Great Britain sa women’s 4x400m relay. Si Eilidh Child, na kakapanalo lang ng 400m hurdles gold, ang nagsimula ng laban, kasunod si Kelly Massey, Shana Cox, at Margaret Adeoye. Sa kabila ng matinding laban, nagtapos sila sa ikatlong puwesto sa likod ng France na nanaig sa Ukraine sa oras na 3:24.27. article_content: Treva Brandon Scharf took on the role of her family’s main nurturer from a young age, learning early to act as a helper and fixer. Now 60 and living in Beverly Hills, California, Scharf recalls how her parents’ struggles became her own, with little separation between their problems and hers. When her parents separated, she comforted her father as he cried, assuring him that things would be alright—even though, as a child, she wasn’t sure herself. It took years for Scharf to realize that her family dynamics were codependent—a term that describes relationship patterns involving excessive responsibility for others, difficulty understanding one’s own feelings, a strong need for approval, and frequent self-sacrifice. Codependency is not officially classified as a medical condition and does not appear in the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders. However, it can greatly impact well-being and relationships. Scharf believes codependency played a part in her marrying at age 51, noting that she was often drawn to men who needed help healing. She says there is often a pull to involve oneself in others’ chaos, even though it’s not anyone’s responsibility to fix another person. Many people with codependent tendencies, like Scharf, trace them to early childhood experiences. Ingrid Bacon, a psychologist in London who researches codependency, points out that such patterns often arise when children do not feel validated or encouraged to develop a sense of self. Bacon’s research has found that people dealing with depression, addiction, and other challenges often identify codependency as a core issue. One participant told her: 'I think codependency is the mothership of all addiction.' Fortunately, recovery is possible. Therapy, support groups, and self-help resources can all aid in the healing process. The first step is recognizing the signs of codependency: many codependent individuals become what others want them to be instead of staying true to themselves, struggling to separate their own identity from their family’s. Some lose touch with their personal values and needs as they adapt to serve those around them. Bacon refers to this as an 'insufficient individual identity.' Recovery often involves discovering personal interests, preferences, and making independent decisions, such as choosing what to eat or watch without deferring to others. Lacking a solid sense of self, those with codependency frequently seek validation from others and are drawn to relationships where they feel needed. Jessica Baum, a psychotherapist in Florida, explains that codependents are often people-pleasers who struggle to say 'no' and may repeatedly prioritize their family’s needs over their own. Research suggests that women may be more prone to codependent patterns, partly due to social expectations. Those affected may give up hobbies, follow others’ preferences, and ignore their own needs to maintain relationships. Sara ONeil of Nashville spent much of her life trying to help or change others, but after a friend’s death in 2016, she realized this approach was not sustainable. Exaggerated responsibility for loved ones is common, especially in families coping with addiction or depression, says Avigail Lev, a clinical psychologist in San Francisco. Some people prioritize helping others to the extent that they neglect their own well-being. Codependent individuals may also try to control family situations or become overly involved in loved ones’ lives, says Tara Lally, a supervising psychologist in New Jersey. Examples include making decisions on behalf of others or closely monitoring their activities. Such people may have difficulty making decisions for themselves, relying on reassurance from family or friends, according to Lev. A lack of emotional regulation often leads to interpersonal conflict and stress. Young people especially may struggle to recognize their feelings and focus instead on managing others’ emotions, says Kaytee Gillis, a psychotherapist in New Orleans. This ongoing stress can cause frustration, depression, or even anger. Although codependency can be a source of embarrassment for some, experts like Baum emphasize that it is not something to be ashamed of. Scharf highlights that codependency is tied to positive traits like compassion and empathy, but when these qualities are taken too far, they can become harmful.
translated_content: Si Treva Brandon Scharf ang naging pangunahing tagapag-aruga ng kanyang pamilya mula pagkabata, mabilis na natutunan kung paano maging tagatulong at tagaayos. Sa edad na 60 at nakatira sa Beverly Hills, California, inalala ni Scharf kung paano naging parang sarili niyang problema ang mga pagsubok ng kanyang mga magulang, dahil halos walang hangganan sa pagitan nila. Nang maghiwalay ang kanyang mga magulang, siya ang nagpalakas ng loob ng kanyang ama habang ito'y umiiyak, sinasabing magiging maayos din ang lahat—kahit siya mismo, bata pa noon, ay hindi sigurado. Matapos ang ilang taon, napagtanto ni Scharf na ang dinamika sa kanilang pamilya ay may pagka-kodependente—isang terminong naglalarawan ng mga relational pattern na kung saan sobra ang responsibilidad sa iba, hirap makilala ang sariling damdamin, labis na pangangailangan ng pagtanggap, at madalas na pagsasakripisyo ng sarili. Hindi itinuturing na opisyal na kondisyong medikal ang codependency at hindi ito nakalista sa Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders. Gayunpaman, malaki ang epekto nito sa kalusugan ng isip at pakikipagrelasyon. Naniniwala si Scharf na naging bahagi ito kung bakit siya nagpakasal sa edad na 51 at madalas siyang naaakit sa mga lalaking nangangailangan ng 'pagpapagaling.' Sabi niya, madalas may hatak na sumangkot sa gulo ng iba, kahit hindi naman responsibilidad ng sinuman na ayusin ang buhay ng iba. Maraming tao na may kaugaliang maging codependent, tulad ni Scharf, ang natutunan ito mula sa karanasan noong bata pa. Ayon kay Ingrid Bacon, isang psychologist sa London na nag-aaral tungkol sa codependency, kadalasan itong umuusbong kapag ang bata ay hindi nakakaramdam ng pagkakakilanlan o hindi napapatibay ang sariling pagkatao. Sa kanyang pananaliksik, nakita ni Bacon na maraming may dinadala, tulad ng depresyon at adiksyon, ang nagtatakda sa codependency bilang ugat ng kanilang problema. May isang sumagot pa: 'Pakiramdam ko ang codependency ang punong ugat ng lahat ng adiksyon.' Sa kabutihang-palad, posible ang paggaling. Makakatulong ang therapy, support groups, at mga self-help resources. Unang hakbang ang pagkilala na mayroon kang maling patterns: maraming codependent ang nagiging kung sino ang gusto ng iba imbes na manatiling totoo sa sarili, at nahihirapan silang ihiwalay ang sarili nilang pagkakakilanlan mula sa pamilya. Inuurong nila ang sariling pangangailangan para unahin ang ibang tao. Tinatawag ni Bacon itong 'insufficient individual identity.' Ang paggaling ay nangangahulugan ng muling pagtuklas sa mga interes at kagustuhan ng sarili at paggawa ng desisyon nang hindi laging nakadepende sa gusto ng iba. Dahil hindi matatag ang sariling pagkatao, madalas silang umaasa sa pagkilala ng iba at hinahanap ang mga relasyong nangangailangan sila. Ipinaliwanag ni Jessica Baum, isang psychotherapist sa Florida, na kadalasang hindi kayang tumanggi ng mga codependent at inuuna pa ang pangangailangan ng pamilya kaysa sa sarili. Iminumungkahi ng ilang pag-aaral na mas madalas ito sa mga babae, bunga ng mga inaasahan sa lipunan. Mapapansin sa kanila ang pagbitaw sa sariling interes at pagbigay-daan sa kagustuhan ng iba para mapanatili ang relasyon. Isang halimbawa si Sara ONeil ng Nashville, na ginugol ang malaking bahagi ng kanyang buhay para tumulong o baguhin ang iba, hanggang sa isang mahal niyang kaibigan ay namatay noong 2016. Doon niya napagtanto na hindi sapat ang ganoong paraan. Karaniwan ang lubos na responsibilidad sa pamilya, lalo kung may kalakip na adiksyon o depresyon, ayon kay Avigail Lev, isang clinical psychologist sa San Francisco. Napapabayaan ng ilan ang sarili dahil sa pagtulong sa iba. Ayon kay Tara Lally, isang supervising psychologist mula New Jersey, madalas ding subukang kontrolin ng mga codependent ang sitwasyon ng pamilya o sobrang makialam sa buhay ng mga mahal nila. Halimbawa, sila na ang nagpapasya para sa iba o mahigpit magbantay sa kanilang mga ginagawa. Nahihirapan din silang magdesisyon para sa sarili at palaging kailangan ng kumpirmasyon mula sa iba. Dahil dito, madali silang mawalan ng balanse sa emosyon at nagkakaroon ng gulo sa mga relasyon. Lalo na ang mga bata, na hirap tukuyin kung ano ang tunay nilang nararamdaman at pinipiling bigyan ng pansin ang emosyon ng pamilya, ayon kay Kaytee Gillis, isang psychotherapist mula New Orleans. Dahil dito, nauuwi ito sa stress, frustration, depresyon, at minsan ay galit. Bagaman nakakahiya minsan ang pagiging codependent, binibigyang-diin ng mga eksperto tulad ni Baum na hindi ito dapat ikahiya. Pinaaalalahanan ni Scharf na may magagandang ugali na kaugnay ng codependency tulad ng malasakit, kabaitan, at empatiya, ngunit maaaring maging masama ito kapag nasobrahan.

Healing is possible—know the signs, set boundaries, and put yourself first when needed! #MentalHealth #BoundariesMatter

article_content: The human brain’s intricate architecture and the way its billions of nerve cells communicate have puzzled scientists for centuries. Now, with the development of new technology, neuroscientists are mapping brain connections in higher detail than ever before. Creating a map of these connections—called a 'connectome'—is fueling hopes for better understanding and potentially treating brain disorders such as autism and schizophrenia. The Human Connectome Project (HCP), funded by the U.S. government, has started trials on healthy volunteers using a state-of-the-art diffusion-imaging scanner. Built by the German engineering company Siemens, the device tracks the movement of water molecules through nerve fibers, offering a clearer picture of the brain’s structure and neural pathways, experts say. Van Wedeen, director of Connectomics at the Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging at Massachusetts General Hospital, explains, 'The diffusion image maps water diffusion, which we use as markers for fiber pathways. We then reconstruct these using computer algorithms to interpret the patterns we observe.' Although the scanner looks similar to a traditional MRI machine, its advanced technology produces images over ten times clearer. 'It’s like the difference between looking at a car’s hood and viewing the gears and belts inside,' Wedeen notes. He adds that this process gives the brain a kind of coordinate system, much like using longitude and latitude when mapping the Earth. While data is still being refined, Wedeen and his colleague Bruce Rosen are optimistic about the scanner’s potential. Rosen, director of the Martinos Center for Biological Imaging at MGH, says, 'Over time, in addition to scanning healthy volunteers, we’re interested in scanning patients with disease.' He suggests that the mapping tools being developed could fundamentally change how diseases are understood and treated. Rosen adds that recognizing abnormalities in specific brain circuits could guide pharmaceutical treatments targeted to certain regions of the brain. He mentions that complex disorders like autism may result from abnormal brain connections—sometimes called 'connectopathies.' He hopes this research will help reveal whether that’s the case and how we might address it. Sebastian Seung, a neuroscientist at MIT, shares a similar perspective. He notes that while the neurons may be healthy, the way they’re connected could lead to brain disorders—a theory now more testable thanks to technological advances. Seung’s own research builds detailed 3D maps of individual neurons, mainly from the retina of mice, which is more detailed than what the HCP scanner can currently achieve. In his book 'Connectome: How the Brain’s Wiring Makes Us Who We Are,' Seung argues that our identities are shaped by the unique connections between our brain cells. He says that both genes and personal experiences influence these neural pathways, contributing to each person's individuality. Seung highlights the magnitude of the challenge by noting, 'The complete neural connectome of a human has a billion times more connections than the human genome has letters.' Up to now, only the connectome of the tiny worm C. elegans—which has just 300 neurons and 7,000 connections—has been fully mapped, a project that took British researchers over a decade. The human brain contains about 100 billion neurons. Seung concludes, 'The brain is so complex—do we have a chance of figuring it out? I believe technology has been our fundamental limitation. Once we can observe brain activity at the right resolution, real progress becomes possible.'
translated_content: Ang masalimuot na estruktura ng utak ng tao at kung paano nag-uusap ang bilyon-bilyong selula ng nerbiyos nito ay matagal nang palaisipan sa mga siyentipiko. Ngayon, gamit ang makabagong teknolohiya, mas detalyado nang nai-mamapa ng mga neuroscientist ang mga koneksyon sa utak. Ang paggawa ng mapa ng mga koneksyong ito, na tinatawag na 'connectome,' ay nagbubunsod ng pag-asa na mas mauunawaan at magagamot ang mga sakit sa utak gaya ng autism at schizophrenia. Ang Human Connectome Project (HCP), na pinopondohan ng gobyerno ng U.S., ay nagsimula ng mga pagsubok sa malulusog na boluntaryo gamit ang napapanahong diffusion-imaging scanner. Gawa ng German engineering company na Siemens, natutukoy ng device na ito ang galaw ng mga molekula ng tubig sa loob ng mga hibla ng nerbiyos, kaya't mas malinaw na nakikita ang estruktura ng utak at ang mga landas ng nerbiyo, ayon sa mga eksperto. Ipinaliwanag ni Van Wedeen, direktor ng Connectomics sa Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging sa Massachusetts General Hospital, 'Ang diffusion image ay nagma-mapa ng paggalaw ng tubig, na ginagamit naming palatandaan para sa mga landas ng hibla. Inire-reconstruct namin ito gamit ang algorithms ng computer para maintindihan ang mga pattern na aming nakikita.' Bagamat kahawig ito ng karaniwang MRI machine, ang advanced na teknolohiya ng scanner ay kayang gumawa ng mga larawan na higit sampung beses mas malinaw. 'Parang kaibahan ng pagtingin sa hood ng kotse at pagtingin sa gears at belts sa loob,' ani Wedeen. Idinagdag niyang nagbibigay ito ng coordinate system sa utak, tulad ng longitude at latitude sa pagma-mapa ng mundo. Habang pinapakinis pa ang datos, optimistiko sina Wedeen at ang kanyang kasamahan na si Bruce Rosen tungkol sa potensyal ng scanner. Ayon kay Rosen, direktor ng Martinos Center for Biological Imaging sa MGH, 'Sa paglipas ng panahon, bukod sa pag-scan ng malulusog na volunteers, interesado rin kaming mag-scan ng mga pasyenteng may sakit.' Naniniwala siyang maaaring baguhin ng mga bagong tools ang paraan ng pag-unawa at paggamot sa mga sakit. Dagdag pa ni Rosen, ang pagkilala ng abnormalidad sa ilang circuits ng utak ay makakatulong sa pag-disenyo ng gamot na target ang partikular na bahagi ng utak. Binanggit niyang ang komplikadong sakit gaya ng autism ay maaaring resulta ng abnormal na koneksyon—tinatawag ding 'connectopathies.' Umaasa siyang masisilip ng pag-aaral kung tunay ito at makikita kung paano ito aayusin. Ibinahagi rin ni Sebastian Seung, isang neuroscientist mula MIT, ang ganitong pananaw. Aniya, maaaring malusog ang mga neuron pero ang kanilang abnormal na pagkakakonekta ang sanhi ng pagkakaroon ng ilang sakit sa utak—isang teoryang masusubok na ngayon dahil sa bagong teknolohiya. Ang sariling pananaliksik ni Seung ay gumagawa ng detalyadong 3D mapa ng bawat neuron, lalo na mula sa retina ng daga, na mas detalyado kaysa sa kaya ng kasalukuyang HCP scanner. Sa kanyang libro na 'Connectome: How the Brain’s Wiring Makes Us Who We Are,' iginiit ni Seung na ang ating pagkakakilanlan ay hinuhubog ng natatanging koneksyon ng ating mga selula sa utak. Aniya, parehong nakakaapekto ang genes at personal na karanasan sa mga landas ng nerbiyo ng bawat isa. Ipinuntong mahirap ang hamon ni Seung: 'Ang kabuuang neural connectome ng tao ay may isang bilyong beses na mas maraming koneksyon kaysa sa bilang ng letra ng genome.' Hanggang ngayon, isang organismo pa lang ang kumpletong na-mapa—ang maliit na bulate na C. elegans na may 300 neuron at 7,000 koneksyon, na inabot ng mahigit sampung taon bago natapos. Ang utak ng tao ay may humigit-kumulang 100 bilyong neuron. Pahayag pa ni Seung, 'Napaka-komplikado ng utak—may pag-asa ba tayong maunawaan ito? Para sa akin, pangunahing balakid ang teknolohiya. Kapag nakuha nating makita sa tamang antas ng detalye ang ginagawa ng utak, magkakaroon tayo ng tunay na pag-unlad.'

article_content: Engineers have successfully recovered the remaining debris and presumed human remains from the Titan submersible, which catastrophically imploded during a dive to the Titanic wreck in June, the US Coast Guard confirmed. All five people aboard, including OceanGate CEO Stockton Rush, died in the accident. The disaster drew global attention and led to a massive search until debris was found days after the incident. On Tuesday, officials announced that more sub debris was found on the ocean floor and transported to a US port. Medical examiners are now working to identify the remains. OceanGate described Titan as 'experimental.' Despite its design, the sub had completed several dives to the Titanic, which sits about 3,800 meters deep in the North Atlantic. Passengers aboard the ill-fated dive were Shahzada Dawood, a British-Pakistani businessman; his son Suleman Dawood; British explorer Hamish Harding; and Paul-Henry Nargeolet, a former French navy diver. None survived. According to court documents, Stockton Rush reportedly overlooked previous warnings regarding the sub's safety. OceanGate has since suspended all its operations worldwide as investigations continue. The Titan was built with a carbon fibre hull and titanium end caps, a combination uncommon in manned deep-sea vehicles. An international investigation is still underway, with plans for a public hearing announced by US officials.

Lima ang namatay sa trahedya, kabilang ang CEO ng OceanGate na si Stockton Rush. Umani ito ng pandaigdigang atensyon at nagtulak ng malawakang search hanggang nakita ang mga debris ilang araw matapos ang insidente. Inanunsyo ng mga opisyal nitong Martes na may karagdagang bahagi ng sub na narekober mula sa ilalim ng dagat at dinala sa isang daungan sa US. Inoobserbahan ngayon ng mga medical examiner ang mga labi. Inilarawan ng OceanGate na 'experimental' ang Titan submersible. Bagamat kakaiba ang pagkakagawa nito, ilang beses na itong sumisid sa Titanic na nasa humigit-kumulang 3,800 metro ang lalim sa North Atlantic. Kasama sa trahedyang biyahe sina Shahzada Dawood, isang British-Pakistani na negosyante; ang kanyang anak na si Suleman Dawood; British explorer na si Hamish Harding; at dating French navy diver na si Paul-Henry Nargeolet. Wala ni isa ang nakaligtas. Ayon sa mga dokumento ng korte, umano’y hindi pinansin ni Stockton Rush ang mga naunang babala ukol sa kaligtasan ng sub. Pansamantala nang sinuspinde ng OceanGate ang lahat ng operasyon nito sa buong mundo habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon. Ang Titan ay gawa sa carbon fibre hull at titanium end caps—isang hindi karaniwang materyales para sa manned deep-sea vehicles. Tuloy pa din ang internasyonal na imbestigasyon at may nakaabang na public hearing ayon sa mga opisyal ng US.

article_content: More than 100 job applicants for positions at Owston Park Lodge in Doncaster, South Yorkshire, received an abusive rejection email. The message told recipients they were 'not good enough' and advised them to 'try harder next time.' Among those who received the email was 23-year-old Michaela Brookes. She expressed shock, saying, 'I have had rejections before, but I couldn't believe what I was reading. It seemed so cruel.' Another applicant, Danielle Jarvis, also described the email as extremely rude and unprofessional. She noted that several people had complained about receiving the same message. Paul and Tracy Snow, the owners of Owston Park Lodge, said they were horrified by the situation. They believe their computer system was hacked and that the emails were sent as part of a malicious prank. Mrs. Snow stated, 'We want to reassure people that we are deeply sorry for any offence caused by these emails. The police are investigating, and we believe our system was compromised.' The issue came to light when numerous upset applicants began calling the pub for answers. The owners have posted an apology on their website and are trying to contact anyone who may have received the email. South Yorkshire Police confirmed they have launched an investigation.

Ibinahagi niya, 'Marami na akong natanggap na tanggi, pero di ako makapaniwalang mababasa ko iyon. Napakasakit at cruel ng sabi.' Isa pang aplikante, si Danielle Jarvis, ay inilarawan din ang email na sobrang bastos at di-propesyonal. Binanggit niya na marami rin ang nagrereklamo na nakatanggap ng kaparehong mensahe. Ipinahayag nina Paul at Tracy Snow, mga may-ari ng Owston Park Lodge, ang kanilang pagkabigla sa pangyayari. Naniniwala silang na-hack ang kanilang computer system at bahagi ito ng isang malicious na panlilinlang. Iniimbestigahan ito ng pulisya at naniniwala kaming na-kompromiso ang aming sistema.' Nagsimulang mag-ingay ang isyu nang magsidating ang mga tawag mula sa mga galit at nalilitong aplikante. Naglabas ng public apology ang mga may-ari sa kanilang website at sinusubukan nilang abutin ang lahat ng maaaring nakatanggap ng email. Kumpirmado ng South Yorkshire Police na nagsimula na ang kanilang imbestigasyon.

article_content: A new report from Yale University has revealed troubling details about the situation of Ukrainian children deported by Russian and Belarusian authorities. Conducted by the Humanitarian Research Lab at Yale School of Public Health, the study describes how thousands of Ukrainian minors have been removed from their country, often transferred to Belarus via Russia. The findings, which rely on open-source information and satellite imagery, state that at least 2,442 Ukrainian children have been taken to Belarus since the start of the Russia-Ukraine war, with Russia and Belarus coordinating their transfer and placement. These children, between six and seventeen years old, were moved to Belarusian facilities, many of which implement reeducation programs that serve the political interests of the Belarusian regime. According to the report, eight out of thirteen facilities offer such programs, and several also provide military training. Researchers identified at least nine groups of children subjected to reeducation and at least six groups exposed to military instruction. Two known groups were reportedly taken to bases belonging to the Internal Troops of Belarus, a military law enforcement unit known for suppressing protests. Some children have undergone training that includes handling firearms, using body armor, and watching military parades and demonstrations. Others have received what the Belarusian government calls 'rehabilitation,' which includes medical treatments, exercise therapy, group psychological sessions, massage, and alternative therapies such as halotherapy and water or electrotherapy. In October, Belarus received a group of 37 Ukrainian children for unspecified medical evaluations, during which they also reportedly experienced reeducation activities. While the precise number of children forcibly transferred is unclear, Ukrainian officials estimate nearly 20,000 have been deported or displaced, while Russian officials claim over 700,000 children have come to Russia, mostly with their families. The International Criminal Court (ICC) has issued arrest warrants for Russian President Vladimir Putin and children’s commissioner Maria Lvova-Belova for allegedly illegally transferring children from Ukraine, contravening international humanitarian law, which forbids such forced deportations. Some Ukrainian children have ended up in Russian foster or adoptive families, while a number of children are being repatriated to Ukraine.
translated_content: Isang bagong ulat mula sa Yale University ang nagbunyag ng nakakabahalang detalye tungkol sa kalagayan ng mga batang Ukrainian na sapilitang dinala ng mga awtoridad ng Russia at Belarus. Ayon sa Humanitarian Research Lab ng Yale School of Public Health, libo-libong batang Ukrainian ang inalis sa kanilang bansa, at kadalasan ay dinala sa Belarus matapos munang dumaan sa Russia. Batay sa open-source na impormasyon at satellite imagery, ipinapakita ng ulat na hindi bababa sa 2,442 batang Ukrainian ang dinala sa Belarus simula nang magsimula ang digmaan ng Russia at Ukraine, na magkasanib na isinagawa ng Russia at Belarus ang paglipat at paglalagay ng mga bata. Ang mga batang ito, na may edad anim hanggang labing-pito, ay inilipat sa mga pasilidad sa Belarus, kung saan marami ang may reeducation programs na ipinatutupad para palakasin ang interes ng rehimen ng Belarus. Batay sa ulat, walo sa labintatlong pasilidad ang may ganitong mga programa, at ilan ay may kasamang military training. Natukoy ng mga mananaliksik na hindi bababa sa siyam na grupo ng mga bata ang sumailalim sa reeducation at hindi bababa sa anim na grupo ang nilahukan sa military instruction. Dalawang grupo ang iniulat na dinala sa mga base ng Internal Troops ng Belarus, isang militarisadong yunit na kilala sa pagsupil ng mga protesta. Ang ilang bata ay sumailalim sa pagsasanay tulad ng paghawak ng baril, pagsusuot ng body armor, at panonood ng military parade at demonstration. Ang iba naman ay dumaan sa tinatawag ng gobyerno ng Belarus na 'rehabilitation,' kabilang ang medikal na paggamot, exercise therapy, group psychological sessions, masahe, at alternatibong therapy gaya ng halotherapy at water o electrotherapy. Noong Oktubre, 37 batang Ukrainian ang dumating sa Belarus para sa di detalyadong medical evaluation, at sila rin ay nakaranas ng mga reeducation activity dito. Bagamat hindi tiyak ang kabuuang bilang ng mga batang sapilitang inilipat, tinatantya ng mga opisyal ng Ukraine na halos 20,000 bata ang na-deport o na-displace, samantalang mga opisyal ng Russia ay nagsasabing higit 700,000 bata, karamihan ay kasama ang kanilang pamilya, ang dinala sa Russia. Naglabas ng arrest warrants ang International Criminal Court (ICC) laban kay Russian President Vladimir Putin at kay children’s commissioner Maria Lvova-Belova kaugnay ng diumano'y iligal na paglipat ng mga bata mula Ukraine, na labag sa international humanitarian law na nagbabawal ng sapilitang pagde-deport. May ilang batang Ukrainian na napunta sa foster o adoptive families sa Russia, at mayroon ding mga batang unti-unting naibabalik na sa Ukraine.
