article_content: Dozens of US states have recently passed new voting laws that are likely to impact the 2024 general election, according to experts. These laws differ from state to state, with some expanding or restricting voting access in crucial battleground areas, as both Democrats and Republicans seek electoral advantages. The Brennan Center reports that more than 40 states have introduced fresh voting laws for the upcoming election, and in at least 14 states, voting has become harder. This rise in restrictive laws is notable, except when compared to the spike following the 2020 election. On the other hand, nearly half of all states have implemented measures making voting easier, with about three expansive laws for every restrictive one. Sara Carter of the Brennan Center emphasizes that these opposing trends don't simply balance out, since the changes occur in different states, resulting in major differences in voting access nationwide. Voting policies started to shift after temporary changes during the pandemic-affected 2020 election. However, many states have since rolled back those adjustments, influenced in part by efforts from former President Donald Trump to challenge the prior results. Liz Avore from the Voting Rights Lab points out that these legal shifts could influence the presidential race, particularly in states where outcomes are tight. According to the Brennan Center, lawmakers have proposed over 560 election-related bills since 2020, focusing on competitive states like Wisconsin, Nevada, Arizona, Michigan, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Georgia, and New Hampshire. While Nevada and Michigan have broadened access, Georgia, New Hampshire, North Carolina, and Wisconsin have imposed new limitations. Restrictive laws often cover voter registration changes, tighter mail-in voting rules, and stricter voter ID requirements, which voting rights advocates say especially affect voters of color. One Texas law, for example, consolidates polling places and could increase wait times. These new measures may lead to disputes over certifying election results, potentially increasing the influence of partisan lawmakers and courts. Major races are at stake in states with tighter voting rules, with Republicans focusing on Texas, Florida, and North Carolina, and Democrats setting sights on Michigan and New York. Many restrictions target groups that assist voters—such as Florida's ban on non-citizens collecting registration forms and new rules for third-party organizations—leading to more penalties for organizations that help people vote. Voting rights groups say the push for restrictive laws is driven by baseless claims of widespread fraud in 2020, with the legislative activity concentrated in states where Trump tried to overturn results. Mail-in voting has become a common focus of these efforts. However, expansive voting laws are also trending. Almost half the states are boosting early voting days, making mail-in ballots easier to access, increasing the number of ballot drop boxes, and simplifying registration—including in jails and schools. States like Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, and New Mexico are among those expanding access. Advocates highlight that these pro-voting changes came after the defeat of candidates who denied 2020 results in the 2022 midterms. Continued updates to restrictive laws could have major consequences in states where the last presidential race was extremely close. ACLU's Sophia Lin Lakin warns that frequent changes can confuse voters, comparing the situation to modern-day literacy tests. As the 2024 election approaches, the effect of these new voting laws on turnout and results is the subject of ongoing concern and discussion.
translated_content: Maraming estado sa US ang nagpatupad kamakailan ng mga bagong batas para sa pagboto na malaki ang magiging epekto sa eleksyon sa 2024, ayon sa mga eksperto. Magkakaiba ang mga patakaran—may mga nagpapadali at may mga nagpapahirap sa pagboto—lalo na sa mga tinaguriang battleground state, kung saan nagpapaligsahan ang mga Demokratiko at Republikano. Ayon sa Brennan Center, may higit 40 estado na nagpatupad ng mga bagong batas sa pagboto para sa darating na eleksyon, at sa hindi bababa sa 14 na estado, lalong naging mahirap ang pagboto. Mataas ang bilang ng mga restriktibong batas na ito, maliban na lang noong sumirit ito pagkatapos ng 2020 eleksyon. Sa kabilang banda, halos kalahati ng mga estado ay may mga batas na nagpapadali sa pagboto—mga tatlong malawakang batas para sa bawat isang restriktibo. Binibigyang-diin ni Sara Carter mula sa Brennan Center na hindi lang basta nababalanse ng magkasalungat na pagbabago ang epekto nito, dahil iba't ibang estado ang pinupuntirya, kaya nagkakaroon ng malaking diperensya sa access sa pagboto sa buong Amerika. Nagsimula ang mga pagbabagong ito matapos ang pansamantalang mga polisiyang in-adopt noong kasagsagan ng pandemya noong 2020. Pero marami rin ang bumalik sa dating sistema, bunga ng mga pagtatangkang pagtalunan ang resulta ng halalan ni dating Pangulong Donald Trump. Sabi ni Liz Avore ng Voting Rights Lab, ang mga pagbagong ito ay maaaring maging mahalaga sa resulta ng halalan, lalo na sa mga estado kung saan siksikan ang laban. Nakasaad sa ulat ng Brennan Center na mula 2020, may mahigit 560 panukalang batas na may kinalaman sa eleksyon ang isinulong, partikular sa mga malalapit ang laban tulad ng Wisconsin, Nevada, Arizona, Michigan, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Georgia, at New Hampshire. Samantalang pinadali ng Nevada at Michigan ang pagboto, nagpatupad naman ng dagdag na limitasyon ang Georgia, New Hampshire, North Carolina, at Wisconsin. Mga karaniwang restriksyon ay tungkol sa pagrehistro, mas mahigpit na alituntunin sa mail-in voting, at mas istriktong voter ID—na ayon sa mga tagapagtaguyod ng karapatang bumoto ay may malakas na epekto sa mga minorya. Halimbawa, ang bagong batas sa Texas ay nagbabago ng sistema ng polling places kaya posibleng humaba ang pila. Maaaring sumiklab ang mga pagtatalo sa pag-certify ng resulta ng eleksyon, kaya posibleng lumakas ang impluwensya ng mga partidista sa mga mambabatas o korte. Maraming mahahalagang laban ang apektado sa mga estadong may restriktibong batas. Ang mga Republikano ay nakatuon sa Texas, Florida, at North Carolina, samantalang mga Demokratiko naman ang target ang Michigan at New York. Marami sa mga bagong restriksyon ay nakatutok sa mga grupong tumutulong sa mga botante—gaya ng pagbabawal ng Florida sa non-citizens na kumuha ng mga registration form at bagong regulasyon para sa third-party organizations—kaya dumarami rin ang parusa sa mga grupong tumutulong sa pagboto. Sabi ng mga grupo ng karapatang bumoto, ang pagsusulong ng mga restriktibong batas ay galing sa mga walang basehang alegasyon ng pandaraya noong 2020, at sa mga estado kung saan sinubukan ni Trump na baligtarin ang resulta ng eleksyon ay aktibo ang mga bagong batas. Ang mail-in voting ay madalas target ng mga panukalang ito. Sa kabila nito, lumalaganap din ang mga batas na nagpapadali ng voting access. Halos kalahati ng mga estado ay nagdadagdag ng mga araw para sa early voting, dinadali ang proseso ng mail-in ballot, nadaragdagan ang drop box, at pinapasimple ang registration, maging sa kulungan at paaralan. Ang Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, at New Mexico ay kabilang sa mga estado na nagpapalawak ng access. Binanggit ng mga tagapagtaguyod ng karapatang bumoto na dumami ang mga pro-voting na polisiya matapos matalo ang mga kandidatong nag-deny ng 2020 result sa 2022 midterms. Ang patuloy na pagbabago sa mga restriktibong batas ay pwedeng magdala ng malaking epekto, lalong-lalo na sa mga estadong dikit ang labanan noong huli. Babala ni Sophia Lin Lakin ng ACLU, ang kalituhang dulot ng pabalik-balik na pagbabago ay parang makabagong literacy test. Habang palapit na ang 2024 eleksyon, patuloy ang mga diskusyon at pangamba tungkol sa magiging epekto ng mga bagong batas na ito sa partisipasyon at resulta ng halalan.

article_content: A new yoga class in San Francisco is encouraging students to use marijuana before practicing. Yoga instructor Dee Dussault, 34, started teaching weekly Ganja Yoga sessions at the Merchants of Reality studio in October. The 75-minute classes cost $15 each. 'Many students already consume cannabis before yoga, so the community aspect is a big benefit,' Dussault told ABC News. 'After using cannabis, people often want to relax and stretch, depending on the strain and dose.' Students are asked to use cannabis prior to arrival, but those with a medical marijuana card may participate in a 15-minute pre-class session where they socialize and consume together while seated in a circle. Dussault, who has practiced yoga for 20 years and began teaching Ganja Yoga in Toronto in 2009, connects the practice to ancient traditions, referencing early uses of cannabis-infused beverages and incense in yoga communities. Classes, usually held on Wednesday evenings with about 16 attendees, have become popular enough that Dussault is considering additional sessions. Participation includes seasoned yoga practitioners new to cannabis, cannabis users new to yoga, as well as people with experience in both. Though the classes attract both men and women, Dussault notes that more men attend Ganja Yoga compared to her other sessions. Experts caution that physical activity after consuming marijuana may present risks, with the National Institute on Drug Abuse stating that marijuana can raise heart rate by 20–100% for up to three hours. Dussault emphasizes that the movements in her classes are slow and gentle for safety. Dussault also offers private lessons such as Clothing-Free Yoga and Sexual Awakening Yoga. She believes that, when used properly, cannabis and yoga together enhance relaxation. 'Cannabis, with the right strain and dose, promotes relaxation. Combined with yoga, they can help people unwind and enjoy life,' she noted. Dussault is not alone in offering such classes. In Los Angeles, Liz McDonald has led 4:20 Yoga at Atwater Yoga since 2010.
translated_content: Isang bagong klase ng yoga sa San Francisco ang hinihikayat ang mga estudyante na gumamit ng marijuana bago mag-practice. Si Dee Dussault, 34, isang yoga instructor, ang nagsimula ng lingguhang Ganja Yoga sessions sa Merchants of Reality studio noong Oktubre. Ang bawat 75-minutong klase ay nagkakahalaga ng $15. 'Marami sa mga estudyante ang gumagamit na ng cannabis bago ang yoga, kaya malaking benepisyo ang komunidad,' ani Dussault sa ABC News. 'Pagkatapos gumamit ng cannabis, gusto ng mga tao na mag-relax at mag-inat, depende sa strain at dose.' Hinihiling sa mga estudyante na gumamit ng cannabis bago pa dumating, ngunit ang mga may medical marijuana card ay maaaring sumali sa 15-minutong pre-class session kung saan sila ay nagsasama-sama at nagkikwentuhan habang gumagamit. Si Dussault, na may 20 taon na karanasan sa yoga at nagsimulang magturo ng Ganja Yoga sa Toronto noong 2009, ay binigyang-diin ang kaugnayan ng yoga at cannabis sa sinaunang tradisyon, partikular ang paggamit noon ng mga inumin at insenso na may cannabis sa mga yoga community. Ang klase, na kadalasang ginaganap tuwing Miyerkules ng gabi at ina-attendan ng mga 16, ay naging popular kaya pinag-iisipan ni Dussault na magdagdag pa ng sesyon. Dumadalo rito ang mga yoga practitioner na baguhan sa cannabis, cannabis users na baguhan sa yoga, pati na rin ang may karanasan na sa pareho. Bagamat may parehong dumadalo na lalaki at babae, napansin ni Dussault na mas maraming lalaki ang nag-eenroll sa Ganja Yoga kaysa sa iba niya pang klase. Nagbabala ang mga eksperto na ang pisikal na aktibidad pagkatapos gumamit ng marijuana ay maaaring magdulot ng panganib. Ayon sa National Institute on Drug Abuse, maaaring tumaas ang heart rate ng 20–100% hanggang tatlong oras matapos gumamit ng marijuana. Iginiit ni Dussault na ligtas ang klase dahil mabagal at banayad lamang ang mga galaw. Nag-aalok din si Dussault ng private na klase gaya ng Clothing-Free Yoga at Sexual Awakening Yoga. Naniniwala siya na kapag tama ang strain at dose ng cannabis, napapalakas nito ang relaxation na binibigay ng yoga. 'Ang cannabis, kung tama ang gamit, ay nagpaparelax. Kapag pinagsama mo pa sa yoga, mas lalong nakakatulong ito para makapagpahinga at ma-enjoy ang buhay,' ani niya. Hindi lang si Dussault ang nagtuturo ng ganitong klase. Sa Los Angeles, si Liz McDonald naman ang namumuno ng 4:20 Yoga sa Atwater Yoga simula pa noong 2010.

article_content: Human Rights Watch (HRW) has alleged in a new report that China is closing, destroying, and repurposing mosques. According to HRW, this crackdown is part of a systematic effort to limit the practice of Islam in China. The country has about 20 million Muslims. Although China is officially atheist, it claims to allow religious freedom. Observers have pointed out that there has been a growing government crackdown on organized religion in recent years, with Beijing aiming for greater control. The BBC contacted China's foreign ministry and ethnic affairs commission for comment prior to the publication of the HRW report. "The Chinese government’s closure, destruction, and repurposing of mosques is part of a systematic effort to curb the practice of Islam in China," said Maya Wang, acting China director at Human Rights Watch. This report follows increasing evidence of systematic human rights violations against Uyghur Muslims in the northwestern Xinjiang region. Beijing denies the accusations of abuse. Most of China’s Muslims live in the northwest, including Xinjiang, Qinghai, Gansu, and Ningxia. In the majority-Muslim village of Liaoqiao in Ningxia, three out of six mosques have reportedly had their domes and minarets removed, according to HRW, and the rest have had their main prayer halls destroyed. Satellite images obtained by HRW show that a mosque’s dome in Liaoqiao village was replaced by a Chinese-style pagoda between October 2018 and January 2020. Approximate numbers suggest around 1,300 mosques in Ningxia have been closed or converted since 2020, according to Hannah Theaker, an academic focusing on Chinese Muslims. This represents about a third of total mosques in the region. Under President Xi Jinping, the Communist Party has aimed to align religion with its political ideology and broader Chinese culture. In 2018, a central committee document from the Chinese Communist Party addressed 'control and consolidation' of mosques, urging local governments to destroy more mosques and strictly monitor their construction, layout, and funding. Such repressive policies have been most severe in Tibet and Xinjiang, but are seen in other areas as well. China has two main Muslim ethnic groups: the Huis, descended from Muslims who arrived in the 8th century during the Tang Dynasty, and the Uyghurs, mostly living in Xinjiang. Reports say about two-thirds of mosques in Xinjiang have been damaged or destroyed since 2017, according to the Australian Strategic Policy Institute. Dr. Theaker noted that Ningxia has been a test site for the 'Sinicisation' policy, with mosque renovations and mergers beginning there earlier than elsewhere. Sinicisation refers to President Xi’s efforts to transform religious beliefs to reflect Chinese culture. The Chinese government argues that mosque consolidation, often linked to village relocations, reduces economic burdens on Muslims. However, some Hui Muslims see it as an attempt to direct loyalty toward the Communist Party. Some residents have publicly opposed Sinicisation policies, but their efforts have not succeeded. Many have been detained or jailed after opposing mosque closures or demolitions. Following the removal of mosque exteriors, authorities have also removed facilities essential for religious practices, like ablution halls and preacher’s podiums, according to US-based Hui activist Ma Ju. He claims that officials close down mosques when attendance drops due to these actions. A video verified by HRW shows an ablution hall at the Liujiaguo mosque in southern Ningxia being demolished after its minarets and dome were removed. In Gansu province, officials have periodically announced the closing, consolidation, and alteration of mosques. In 2018, authorities banned minors under 16 from religious activities in Linxia, a city previously known as 'Little Mecca.' A 2019 report by a local TV station said several mosques were converted into workspaces or cultural centers after extensive ideological work by authorities. Before Sinicisation campaigns, Hui Muslims had received more support from the state, Dr. Theaker said. Now, these campaigns have limited the space for religious practice and promoted a specific view of patriotism and observance. Dr. Theaker noted that the policies require Muslims to prove patriotism above all else and treat foreign influence with suspicion. Elaine Pearson, Asia director at HRW, said Muslim and Arab leaders worldwide should raise concerns about these policies. Other ethnic and religious minorities have also been affected. Recently, the Chinese government replaced the name ‘Tibet’ with ‘Xizang’ in diplomatic documents, removed crosses from churches, arrested pastors, and pulled Bibles from online stores.
translated_content: Ayon sa Human Rights Watch (HRW), isinara, sinira, at binago ng China ang mga mosque base sa bagong ulat. Sabi ng HRW, bahagi ito ng sistematikong hakbang para pigilan ang pagpraktis ng Islam sa China. Tinatayang may 20 milyong Muslim sa bansa. Bagaman opisyal na ateista ang China, sinasabi nilang pinapayagan nila ang kalayaan sa relihiyon. Ayon sa mga tagamasid, lumalakas ang pagpigil ng gobyerno sa mga organisadong relihiyon nitong mga nakaraang taon, kung saan layon ng Beijing na magkaroon ng higit na kontrol. Kinontak ng BBC ang foreign ministry at ethnic affairs commission ng China para magbigay ng komento bago ilathala ang ulat ng HRW. "Ang pagsasara, pagsira, at pagbabago ng mga mosque ng gobyernong Tsino ay bahagi ng sistematikong hakbang para pigilan ang Islam sa China," ayon kay Maya Wang, pansamantalang direktor ng Human Rights Watch sa China. Sumusunod ang ulat na ito sa dumaraming ebidensya ng sistematikong paglabag sa karapatang-pantao ng mga Uyghur Muslim sa hilagang-kanlurang Xinjiang. Itinatanggi ng pamahalaan ng Beijing ang mga alegasyong ito. Karamihan sa mga Muslim ng China ay naninirahan sa hilagang-kanluran tulad ng Xinjiang, Qinghai, Gansu, at Ningxia. Sa nayon ng Liaoqiao sa Ningxia na karamihan ay Muslim, iniulat ng HRW na tatlo sa anim na mosque ay tinanggalan ng dome at minarete, at ang mga natitira ay sinira ang pangunahing dasalan. Ayon sa satellite images ng HRW, nakitang pinalitan ng Chinese-style pagoda ang dome ng isang mosque sa Liaoqiao village mula Oktubre 2018 hanggang Enero 2020. Tinatayang nasa 1,300 mosque sa Ningxia ang isinara o binago mula 2020, ayon kay Hannah Theaker, isang iskolar na nag-aaral ng mga Muslim sa China. Katumbas ito ng halos isang-ikatlong bahagi ng lahat ng mosque sa rehiyon. Sa ilalim ng pamumuno ni Pangulong Xi Jinping, nilalayon ng Communist Party na ihanay ang relihiyon sa kanilang political ideology at kultura. Noong 2018, naglabas ng dokumento ang central committee ng Chinese Communist Party tungkol sa 'kontrol at konsolidasyon' ng mga mosque na hinihikayat ang lokal na pamahalaan na magdemolish ng mas marami at mahigpit na bantayan ang konstruksyon at pondo. Pinakamalupit ang mga ganitong polisiya sa Tibet at Xinjiang, ngunit nararanasan na rin sa ibang lugar. May dalawang pangunahing grupong etniko ng Muslim sa China: ang Hui, na nagmula sa mga Muslim na dumating noong ika-8 siglo, at ang Uyghur na karamihan ay nasa Xinjiang. Ayon sa Australian Strategic Policy Institute, dalawang-katlo ng mga mosque sa Xinjiang ang nasira o na-demolish mula 2017. Ayon kay Dr. Theaker, naging 'test site' ang Ningxia para sa polisiya ng 'Sinicisation', kaya dito naunang nagsimulang ayusin at pag-ibayuhin ang mga mosque. Ang Sinicisation ay tumutukoy sa pagsasalin ng relihiyon upang maging angkop sa kulturang Tsino. Sabi ng gobyernong Tsino, ang pagsasanib ng mga mosque ay nakakatulong sa ekonomiya, lalo na kung may relokasyon sa mga baryo. Ngunit para sa ilang Hui Muslim, ito ay paraan para baguhin ang katapatan nila sa Partido Komunista. May mga residente na tahasang tumutol sa polisiya ng Sinicisation ngunit hindi nagtagumpay. Marami sa kanila ang naaresto o nakulong matapos tutulan ang pagsasara o demolisyon ng kanilang mga mosque. Matapos tanggalin ang labas ng mosque, inaalis din ng mga awtoridad ang mahahalagang pasilidad gaya ng ablution hall at preacher's podium, ayon kay Ma Ju, isang US-based Hui activist. Ayon sa kanya, isinasara ng lokal na opisyal ang mosque kapag konti na ang pumupunta. May video na napatotohanan ng HRW na makikitang winasak ang ablution hall ng Liujiaguo mosque sa southern Ningxia matapos tanggalin ang mga minarete at dome. Sa lalawigan ng Gansu, ilang beses nang inanunsyo ng mga opisyal ang pagsasara, pagsasanib, at pagbabago ng mga mosque. Noong 2018, ipinagbawal ng mga awtoridad ang mga menor de edad na wala pang 16 na taon mula sa mga aktibidad panrelihiyon sa Linxia, kilala noon bilang 'Little Mecca'. Isang ulat mula 2019 ng lokal na TV station ang nagsabing ginawang workspace o cultural center ang maraming mosque matapos ang mahigpit na pagbabantay at oryentasyon ng awtoridad. Bago ang mga kampanya ng Sinicisation, mas maraming suporta ang natatanggap ng mga Hui Muslim mula sa estado, sabi ni Dr. Theaker. Sa ngayon, mas kaunti na ang kalayaan upang mamuhay bilang Muslim at itinataguyod ang isang uri ng patriotism at obserbansya. Sabi ni Dr. Theaker, ang mga polisiya ay ginagawang pangunahing batayan ang pagiging makabayan at tinitingnang banta ang mga banyagang impluwensiya. Ayon kay Elaine Pearson, Asia director ng HRW, nararapat lang na magtanong at magpahayag ng pagkabahala ang mga lider Muslim at Arabo sa buong mundo tungkol sa mga polisiya. Apektado rin ang iba pang minoryang etniko at panrelihiyon. Kamakailan, pinalitan ng gobyerno ng Tsina ang pangalan ng 'Tibet' ng 'Xizang' sa mga opisyal na dokumento, tinanggal ang mga krus sa simbahan, inaresto ang mga pastor, at tinanggal ang Bibliya sa mga online store.

article_content: Ukrainian troops have repurposed old Soviet KS-19 antiaircraft guns into mobile ground weapons capable of inflicting heavy losses on Russian forces, The Daily Beast reports. Members of Ukraine’s 241st Brigade invested several months in dismantling and modifying these guns to mount them on truck platforms, allowing rapid movement in and out of combat zones. This adaptation makes it possible to hit targets as far as 100 meters (328 feet) apart, causing significant casualties with each shot. A sergeant in the unit, Evegeny Iitvin, claimed that in just three days, a single modified gun was responsible for 1,000 Russian casualties. While Ukraine receives weaponry from Western partners, much of its firepower consists of inherited Soviet-era equipment—a situation mirrored by Russian forces. The brigade received four KS-19s in March and equipped them with $8,000 electronic tablets coordinated with drones for improved targeting. The project’s funding came largely from soldiers themselves, along with donations from friends and supporters. Iitvin noted that the Ukrainian government cannot always supply the funds needed for such upgrades, leaving units to seek outside help. With Western military assistance sometimes delayed or insufficient, Ukraine is accelerating its production of weapons and ammunition at home. Crowdfunding has become vital for essentials like drones, night vision, and medical gear. Ukrainian officials remain concerned about potential donor fatigue from allied countries and the impact of the approaching US presidential election.
translated_content: Ginawang mga mobile ground weapon ng mga tropang Ukrainian ang mga lumang Soviet KS-19 antiaircraft gun, na nagdudulot ng malaking pinsala sa mga puwersang Ruso, ayon sa ulat ng The Daily Beast. Ilang buwan ring binuno ng 241st Brigade ng Ukraine ang pagbaklas at pagbabago ng mga baril upang maikabit sa mga truck, kaya mabilis silang maililipat sa gitna ng labanan. Dahil dito, kayang tamaan ng mga baril ang mga target na nasa layong hanggang 100 metro (328 talampakan) mula sa isa’t isa, na maaaring magresulta sa matinding pinsala sa bawat putok. Ayon kay Sarhento Evegeny Iitvin mula sa yunit, sa loob ng tatlong araw ay may isang nabagong baril na nakapatumba ng 1,000 sundalong Ruso. Bagama’t tumatanggap ng armas mula sa Kanluran ang Ukraine, nananatiling lumang kagamitan ng Soviet ang ginagamit ng karamihan—ganito rin sa hanay ng Russia. Apat na KS-19 ang nakuha ng brigade noong Marso at nilagyan ng electronic tablets na tig-$8,000, na ginagamit kasabay ng drone para sa mas eksaktong pagtukoy sa target. Nagmula ang pondo sa sariling bulsa ng mga sundalo at sa mga donasyong galing sa kaibigan at tagasuporta para sa mga upgrade ng truck at kagamitan. Ayon kay Iitvin, kulang ang suporta ng pamahalaan para sa kanilang mga proyekto kaya umaasa silang makakuha ng tulong mula sa labas. Dahil sa pagkaantala at kakulangan ng tulong militar mula sa Kanluran, pinapabilis ng Ukraine ang sariling produksyon ng armas at bala. Napakahalaga rin ng crowdfunding para sa pagbili ng drone, night vision, at medical supplies. Patuloy na nag-aalala ang mga opisyal ng Ukraine sa posibilidad ng donor fatigue mula sa mga kaalyado at sa epekto ng nalalapit na halalan sa Amerika.

article_content: Malaria is a debilitating and potentially life-threatening disease caused by parasites spread to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes. For those who have experienced severe malaria, symptoms can include high fever, intense body aches, chills, profuse sweating, and exhaustion. Now, two students—Moctar Dembele from Burkina Faso and Gerard Niyondiko from Burundi—have developed an innovative soap called 'Faso Soap,' which they say can help prevent malaria. Using locally sourced herbs and natural ingredients, Faso Soap is designed to repel mosquitoes and reduce malaria risk. The product recently won the $25,000 Grand Prize at the Global Social Venture Competition (GSVC), a program started by MBA students at UC Berkeley to support entrepreneurial ideas that create positive social impact. Faso Soap contains shea butter, essential lemongrass oil, and other natural ingredients that the inventors have not disclosed. Gerard Niyondiko, who studies with Dembele at the International Institute for Water and Environmental Engineering in Ouagadougou, says the soap leaves a scent on the skin that repels mosquitoes. Additionally, the soap's wastewater contains compounds thought to inhibit the development of mosquito larvae—addressing sanitation issues that contribute to malaria. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about half of the world’s population is at risk for malaria, with most cases occurring in the world’s poorest regions. In 2010, there were an estimated 660,000 malaria deaths worldwide, 90% of which were in sub-Saharan Africa, predominantly among children under five. Malaria not only claims lives but also has a heavy economic impact. Many families face high costs for treatment, medicines, medical visits, and transportation, and the disease perpetuates poverty through loss of income and productivity. Niyondiko says Faso Soap aims to be affordable and accessible. He notes that most people in their country cannot regularly buy medicines, repellents, or mosquito nets. Since soap is a daily necessity, Faso Soap provides both hygiene and malaria protection without additional costs. The team is currently optimizing the soap and conducting clinical trials, with plans to launch in Burkina Faso by 2015 and eventually expand distribution across sub-Saharan Africa and other malaria-affected regions. They hope to partner with NGOs and companies to broaden distribution. James Logan, a medical entomologist at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, calls the concept promising, as people often do not use topical repellents, but emphasizes the need for scientific evidence to confirm the soap's effectiveness against malaria transmission. Niyondiko, 35, and Dembele, 22, outperformed 650 competitors from nearly 40 countries—the first African team to win the GSVC. Niyondiko expressed pride in their achievement, stating it shows that Africans can solve challenges facing their continent.
translated_content: Ang malaria ay isang nakakapahina at maaaring nakamamatay na sakit na dulot ng mga parasite na naipapasa sa tao sa pamamagitan ng kagat ng mga infected na lamok. Para sa mga nakaranas ng malalang malaria, maaari kang makaranas ng mataas na lagnat, matinding pananakit ng katawan, panginginig, labis na pagpapawis, at sobrang pagod. Ngayon, dalawang estudyante—sina Moctar Dembele mula Burkina Faso at Gerard Niyondiko mula Burundi—ang nakabuo ng makabagong sabon na tinatawag na 'Faso Soap,' na ayon sa kanila ay makakatulong para maiwasan ang malaria. Gumagamit ang Faso Soap ng mga likas na damo at natural na sangkap para itaboy ang mga lamok at mabawasan ang panganib ng malaria. Kamakailan, nagwagi ang produkto ng $25,000 Grand Prize sa Global Social Venture Competition (GSVC), isang programa na sinimulan ng mga MBA student sa UC Berkeley para suportahan ang mga ideya ng entreprenyur na may positibong epekto sa lipunan. Ang Faso Soap ay gawa sa shea butter, essential lemongrass oil, at iba pang natural na sangkap na hindi pa nila isinasapubliko. Ayon kay Gerard Niyondiko, na nag-aaral kasama si Dembele sa International Institute for Water and Environmental Engineering sa Ouagadougou, iniiwan ng sabon ang isang amoy sa balat na nagtataboy ng lamok. Bukod dito, ang wastewater mula sa sabon ay naglalaman ng mga compound na pinaniniwalaang nakakatulong makapigil sa pagdami ng larvae ng lamok—sagot ito sa problema ng sanitasyon na nagdudulot ng pagdami ng malaria. Ayon sa World Health Organization (WHO), halos kalahati ng populasyon sa mundo ang nanganganib sa malaria, at karamihan ng mga kaso ay nasa pinakamahihirap na rehiyon. Noong 2010, tinatayang 660,000 ang namatay dahil sa malaria sa buong mundo, 90% nito ay sa sub-Saharan Africa, karamihan ay mga batang limang taon pababa. Hindi lang buhay ang nawawala dahil sa malaria; mabigat din ang epekto nito sa ekonomiya. Maraming pamilya ang gumagastos nang malaki para sa gamutan, mga gamot, konsultasyon sa doktor, at transportasyon, at mas pinalalala pa ng sakit ang kahirapan dahil sa pagkawala ng kita at produktibidad. Sabi ni Niyondiko, layunin ng Faso Soap na maging abot-kaya at madaling ma-access. Marami daw kasi sa kanilang kababayan ang hindi kayang bumili ng regular na gamot, mosquito repellent, o kulambu. Dahil sabon ay pang-araw-araw na gamit, nagbibigay ang Faso Soap ng kalinisan at proteksyon kontra malaria nang walang dagdag gastos. Sa ngayon, ine-enhance pa nila ang sabon at kasalukuyang nagsasagawa ng clinical trials, may balak na ilunsad ito sa Burkina Faso pagsapit ng 2015 at palawakin ang distribusyon sa sub-Saharan Africa at iba pang rehiyon na apektado ng malaria. Umaasa silang makipag-partner sa mga NGO at kumpanya para mapalawak ang distribusyon. Ayon kay James Logan, isang medical entomologist sa London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, promising ang konsepto dahil hindi madalas gamitin ng mga tao ang mga topical repellent, pero dapat pa ring magkaroon ng sapat na ebidensya na epektibong napipigilan ng sabon ang malaria batay sa scientific research. Sina Niyondiko, 35, at Dembele, 22, ay nagwagi laban sa 650 na kalahok mula sa halos 40 bansa—sila ang kauna-unahang African team na nanalo sa GSVC. Ipinahayag ni Niyondiko ang kanilang kasiyahan at pagmamalaki sa tagumpay, na patunay raw na kayang solusyunan ng mga taga-Africa ang kanilang sariling mga hamon.

article_content: This story originally appeared on Yale Environment 360 and is part of the Climate Desk collaboration. In 2015, a lightning strike sparked what became known as the Rough Fire, which eventually burned more than 150,000 acres of forest east of Fresno and just west of Kings Canyon National Park. The blaze reached seven different sequoia groves in Sequoia National Forest, as well as the General Grant Complex in Kings Canyon National Park. After the flames subsided and the smoke cleared, experts were alarmed to find that an unusually large number of mature sequoias had been lost—27 on park land and 74 in national forest areas. The death toll was unprecedented and deeply distressed those who study and care for redwoods, some of whom were moved to tears by the loss of trees that had stood for over a thousand years. Ben Blom, director of stewardship and restoration for the Save the Redwoods League, said that after the Rough Fire the notion of 'immortal' sequoias no longer seemed true. While the impacts of that fire were concerning, events in 2020 and 2021 represented a major escalation, according to Blom. 'We’re talking tens of thousands of big trees dying in those two fire seasons,' he said. After those fires, Blom added, it became clear that the giant trees faced an existential crisis. This crisis is driven by climate change—which has led to record heat and drought, more insect infestations, and increasingly severe fires in California—compounded by a century of suppressing frequent, low-intensity burns. In response to this emergency, experts declared a code red and are working swiftly to save the remaining giant sequoias. Teams of biologists, Native American tribes, and government agencies are urgently thinning overgrown woodlands around the trees and conducting prescribed burns. Research indicates these efforts help prevent extremely hot fires from reaching the sequoia canopy. However, 'active management' approaches—which include logging with heavy equipment and chainsaws even in protected and unique ecosystems—have sparked debate. A bipartisan Congressional bill to increase funding for thinning is facing opposition from a coalition of conservation organizations, who argue the legislation lacks sufficient environmental review.
translated_content: Ang kuwentong ito ay orihinal na lumabas sa Yale Environment 360 at bahagi ng Climate Desk collaboration. Noong 2015, nagsimula ang tinatawag na Rough Fire dahil sa kidlat, na tumupok ng mahigit 150,000 ektarya ng kagubatan sa silangan ng Fresno at kanluran ng Kings Canyon National Park. Umabot ang sunog sa pitong sequoia groves sa Sequoia National Forest, pati na rin sa General Grant Complex sa Kings Canyon National Park. Nang humupa ang apoy at naglaho ang usok, nabigla ang mga eksperto nang makita ang hindi pangkaraniwang dami ng mga sequoiang namatay—27 sa lupang parke at 74 sa national forest. Hindi inaasahan ang dami ng namatay at labis na ikinalungkot ng mga nag-aaral at nag-aaruga sa mga punong redwood, ang ilan ay naluha nang matanaw ang pagkawala ng mga punong tumayo ng mahigit isang libong taon. Ayon kay Ben Blom, direktor ng stewardship at restoration para sa Save the Redwoods League, buhat ng Rough Fire ay nawawala na ang paniniwalang walang kamatayan ang mga sequoia. Bagamat nakakabahala ang pinsalang dulot ng sunog na iyon, mas malala ang nangyari noong 2020 at 2021. 'Pinag-uusapan natin ang sampu-sampung libong malalaking puno na namatay sa dalawang fire season na iyon,' ani Blom. Matapos ang mga sunog na iyon, napagtanto nila na talagang delikado na ang sitwasyon ng mga higanteng puno. Ang krisis na ito ay dulot ng pagbabago ng klima—nagdulot ito ng matitinding init, tagtuyot, mas maraming peste, at papatindi pang mga sunog sa California—samahan pa ng isang siglong pagpigil sa madalas na mahihinang sunog. Bilang tugon, nagdeklara ng code red ang mga eksperto at mabilis ang kilos para iligtas ang natitirang mga sequoia. Ang mga team ng mga biyolohista, katutubong tribo, at mga ahensya ng gobyerno ay nagmamadaling nagbabawas ng makakapal na kakahuyan sa paligid at nagsasagawa ng prescribed burns. Napag-alamang epektibo ito para maiwasan ang matitinding sunog na kayang umabot sa itaas ng sequoia. Gayunpaman, ang tinatawag na 'active management'—kabilang ang pagputol gamit ang mabibigat na makinarya at chainsaw, kahit sa mga protektado at natatanging ecosystem—ay nagdulot ng debate. Isang bipartisan na panukala sa Kongreso para pondohan ang thinning ang kinakalaban ng ilang environmental groups, na sinasabing kulang ang pagsusuring pangkalikasan ng batas.

article_content: With graduation approaching, many college students are thinking about which companies they want to work for, how much student debt they’ll have, and what their future earnings might look like. New information from the Census Bureau’s 2022 American Community Survey reveals typical median earnings by field for graduates between 25 and 64 years old. The survey shows that those who studied electrical engineering or computer science had median incomes above $100,000—the highest among all reported majors. Out of the 34 bachelor’s degree fields included (some grouped under categories like 'other business degrees'), not just electrical and computer engineering but additional engineering disciplines also reported strong salary numbers. Business fields such as finance and economics followed with high median pay. Nursing is notable as a non-engineering field that also provided relatively high median earnings. Conversely, social work, family and consumer sciences, and elementary education ranked at the bottom, all with median earnings under $50,000. Among people with a bachelor’s degree or higher, median earnings for electrical engineering graduates reached $121,600—far exceeding the overall median salary of $74,150 for those with at least a bachelor’s.

Batay sa bagong datos ng Census Bureau mula sa 2022 American Community Survey, inilathala ang karaniwang kita ng mga nagtapos (edad 25 hanggang 64) depende sa kursong tinapos. Makikita sa datos na ang mga kumuha ng electrical engineering o computer science ay may median income na higit sa $100,000—pinakamataas sa lahat ng kurso na nakalista. Sa kabuuang 34 na field ng bachelor’s degree na isinama (kabilang ang ilang pinagsama-samang kategorya gaya ng 'other business degrees'), hindi lang electrical at computer engineering ang may mataas na kita—pati na rin ang ibang engineering fields. Mataas din ang median na sahod ng graduates ng finance at economics. Nangingibabaw din ang nursing bilang non-engineering course na nagbibigay ng mataas na median salary. Sa kabilang banda, ang social work, family and consumer sciences, at elementary education ay nasa pinakamababang hanay—lahat may median earnings na mas mababa sa $50,000. Para sa mga may bachelor’s degree o mas mataas pa, pumalo sa $121,600 ang median earnings ng electrical engineering graduates—malaking taas kumpara sa overall median salary na $74,150 para sa lahat ng degree holders.

article_content: Rangers Football Club's chief executive, Graham Wallace, is set to receive a bonus of up to £160,000, even as the club faces financial challenges. Of this sum, £100,000 will be paid in cash, while an additional £60,000 in shares is pending shareholder approval. Wallace's compensation comes amid a power struggle at the club, with Dave King and Mike Ashley competing for influence. Mike Ashley, who owns 8.9% of Rangers and is also the owner of Newcastle United, has called for the removal of Wallace and financial director Phillip Nash from the board in an upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting. Ashley's growing involvement has been criticized by the Union of Fans supporters group, which accuses the Scottish Football Association of not properly enforcing rules against dual ownership in football. At the same time, a consortium led by former directors Dave King and Paul Murray and shareholder George Letham has offered to invest £16 million in return for a 51% controlling stake through a new share issue. This investment could be jeopardized if Ashley succeeds in his move to oust current directors. The Union of Fans believe that Ashley aims to gain greater control of Rangers, potentially taking charge of valuable assets like club trademarks and merchandise rights through loans with favorable terms for himself. The group has formally appealed to the SFA to closely enforce its ownership rules, arguing that Ashley's actions breach existing regulations. In other developments, Rangers striker Kris Boyd was cleared of a violent conduct charge after an incident in a loss to Hibernian, allowing him to play in the next match against Raith Rovers. Meanwhile, defender Bilel Mohsni will serve a two-game suspension after accepting responsibility for a separate violation in the same game. Rangers are currently second in the Scottish Championship, trailing Hearts by six points and leading Raith Rovers by two points.

Si Mike Ashley, na nagmamay-ari ng 8.9% ng shares ng Rangers at ng Newcastle United, ay humihiling na tanggalin si Wallace at ang financial director na si Phillip Nash mula sa board sa nalalapit na Extraordinary General Meeting. article_content: U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton is scheduled to meet on Friday with Myanmar President Thein Sein, who has overseen a series of political reforms in the Southeast Asian country over the past year, according to a senior State Department official. Clinton is currently in Cambodia for a regional conference after visits to several Asian countries in recent days. She will meet Thein Sein in Siem Reap, a rapidly growing tourism hub adjacent to the famous Angkor temples. The meeting was announced after U.S. President Barack Obama stated on Wednesday that the United States would ease sanctions on Myanmar, allowing American companies to conduct business there—a decision that has raised concerns among human rights advocates. According to the State Department, Clinton's meeting is seen as a reward for Myanmar's progress in implementing reforms. Over the past year, Myanmar (also known as Burma) has released hundreds of political prisoners, allowed pro-democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi's party to participate in by-elections, and engaged in peace talks with ethnic rebel groups. Myanmar was ruled for decades by a repressive military junta, but in recent years, military leaders have relaxed their grip on power, allowing Thein Sein’s government to enact changes. In response, Western governments have begun easing sanctions. Obama commended Thein Sein, Suu Kyi, and the nation for 'significant progress along the path to democracy.' He noted that easing sanctions 'signals our support for reform, and will provide immediate incentives for reformers and significant benefits to the people of Burma.' However, Obama also highlighted concerns about a lack of transparency in Burma's investment environment and the military's economic influence. As a result, new licenses for U.S. companies will exclude entities owned by the Myanmar armed forces and the Ministry of Defense. The U.S. Treasury retains authority to impose sanctions on individuals or entities that undermine reforms, commit human rights abuses, contribute to ethnic conflict, or engage in military trade with North Korea, Obama said. Despite these safeguards, the Obama administration will allow U.S. companies to do business with Myanmar's strategic oil and gas sector, which remains a key source of revenue for the regime, according to Phil Robertson, deputy director of Human Rights Watch’s Asia division. 'We're disappointed that the U.S. government included the oil and gas sector in the easing of sanctions,' said Robertson, who is based in Bangkok. He specifically referenced Myanmar Oil & Gas Enterprise, highlighted by Suu Kyi for its lack of transparency. The NLD, headed by Suu Kyi, expressed hope that U.S. companies would invest responsibly. 'There is no true transparency in the country,' said Nyan Win, NLD spokesperson. 'How can we be sure that investment will benefit our people?' Signs of both reform and resistance remain visible in Myanmar. Suu Kyi, a Nobel laureate who spent years under house arrest, attended her first legislative session in parliament since being sworn in two months ago. Meanwhile, military leaders nominated Myint Swe, a former general loyal to ex-dictator Than Shwe, for vice president. His likely promotion from Yangon’s chief minister to the country’s second highest post has disappointed reform advocates. These mixed developments will form the backdrop to Clinton’s meeting with Thein Sein. Robertson hoped Clinton would address the 'long list' of unresolved human rights issues in Myanmar, citing ongoing political imprisonment and ethnic conflicts. 'The government says they will resolve these issues, but they haven’t done it,' Robertson said. Reporting by CNN’s Kocha Olarn and Hilary Whiteman.
translated_content: Nakatakdang makipagkita si U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton kay Myanmar President Thein Sein ngayong Biyernes, na nanguna sa serye ng mga reporma sa pulitika sa bansa nitong nagdaang taon, ayon sa isang senior State Department official. Nasa Cambodia ngayon si Clinton para sa isang regional conference matapos bumisita sa ilang bansa sa Asya kamakailan. Magkikita sila ni Thein Sein sa Siem Reap, isang mabilis lumagong sentro ng turismo na malapit sa kilalang Angkor temples. Inanunsyo ang pagpupulong matapos ipahayag ni U.S. President Barack Obama nitong Miyerkules na luluwagan ng Estados Unidos ang mga sanction sa Myanmar, kaya’t papayagan ang mga kumpanyang Amerikano na magnegosyo doon—isang hakbang na ikinabahala ng mga tagapagtanggol ng karapatang pantao. Ayon sa State Department, ang pagpupulong ni Clinton ay itinuturing na gantimpala para sa progreso ng Myanmar sa pagpapatupad ng reporma. Nitóng nakaraang taon, pinalaya ng Myanmar (na kilala rin bilang Burma) ang daan-daang political prisoners, pinayagan ang partido ni Aung San Suu Kyi na sumali sa by-elections, at nakipag-dayalogo sa mga grupong etnikong rebelde. Dekada ring namayani ang mahigpit na military junta sa Myanmar, ngunit nitong mga nakaraang taon, lumuwag ang kanilang kontrol at pinayagan si Thein Sein na magpatupad ng mga pagbabago. Bilang tugon, nagsimulang luwagan ng mga kanluraning bansa ang mga sanction. Pinuri ni Obama sina Thein Sein, Suu Kyi at ang bansa sa 'makabuluhang progreso sa daan patungong demokrasya.' Ayon sa kanya, ang pagluluwag ng sanctions ay 'malakas na pahiwatig ng ating suporta sa reporma at agad na magbibigay ng insentibo sa mga repormista at benepisyo sa mamamayan ng Burma.' Gayunpaman, binigyang-diin din ni Obama ang mga pangamba sa kakulangan ng transparency sa investment environment ng Burma, at ang lakas ng impluwensya ng militar sa ekonomiya. Dahil dito, hindi saklaw ng bagong mga lisensya para sa U.S. companies ang mga entity na pagmamay-ari ng military o ng Ministry of Defense ng Myanmar. May kapangyarihan pa rin ang U.S. Treasury na magpataw ng sanctions laban sa mga sumusuway sa reporma, lumalabag sa karapatang pantao, nagpapalala ng hidwaan ng mga etniko, o sumasali sa military trade sa North Korea, ayon kay Obama. Sa kabila ng mga safeguard, papayagan pa rin ng administrasyon ni Obama ang mga kumpanyang Amerikano na makipagnegosyo sa oil and gas sector ng Myanmar, na isang pangunahing pinagkukunan ng kita ng gobyerno, ayon kay Phil Robertson, deputy director ng Human Rights Watch sa Asya. 'Nadismaya kami na isinama ng gobyerno ng U.S. ang oil and gas sector ng Burma sa pagluwag ng sanctions,' ani Robertson, na nakabase sa Bangkok. Tinukoy rin niya ang Myanmar Oil & Gas Enterprise na nabanggit ni Suu Kyi na walang sapat na transparency. Nagpahayag naman ang NLD, pinamumunuan ni Suu Kyi, ng pag-asa na maging responsable ang investments ng mga Amerikanong kumpanya. 'Wala talagang transparency sa bansa,' ani Nyan Win, tagapagsalita ng NLD. 'Paano namin masisiguro na magiging kapaki-pakinabang sa aming mga tao ang investment?' Makikitang may magkahalong reporma at pagtutol sa Myanmar. Si Suu Kyi, Nobel laureate na ilang taon ang ginugol sa house arrest, ay unang beses dumalo sa legislative session ng parliament dalawang buwan matapos siyang manumpa. Samantala, itinalaga ng mga lider militar si Myint Swe, dating heneral at tapat kay dating diktador Than Shwe, bilang vice president. Ang promosyon niya mula sa pagiging chief minister ng Yangon patungo sa ikalawang pinakamataas na posisyon sa bansa ay ikinadismaya ng mga reporma advocates. Ang mga magkahalong pangyayaring ito ang magsisilbing background sa pagpupulong nina Clinton at Thein Sein. Umaasa si Robertson na tatalakayin ni Clinton ang 'mahaba pang listahan' ng di nalulutas na human rights issues sa Myanmar, kabilang ang political prisoners at nagaganap pang pagka-kontra ng mga etnikong grupo. 'Sinasabi ng pamahalaan na aayusin nila ang mga ito pero hindi pa nila natutupad,' ani Robertson. Ulat nina Kocha Olarn at Hilary Whiteman ng CNN.

article_content: Janay Rice, wife of suspended NFL player Ray Rice, criticized the media on Tuesday but continued to support her husband. A day after the Baltimore Ravens released Ray and the NFL suspended him for assaulting her, Janay described the experience as a nightmare. "To make us relive a moment in our lives that we regret every day is a horrible thing," she wrote on Instagram. "To take something away from the man I love, who has worked so hard for it all his life, just to gain ratings is horrific." The Baltimore Ravens released Ray Rice on Monday after a video appeared showing him punching his then-fiancée and dragging her out of an Atlantic City casino elevator. Initially, Rice was suspended for two games for the February incident, a punishment many considered too lenient. He was weeks away from returning to play when the new video prompted swift action from the team and the NFL, ending his football career. On Tuesday, Janay Rice said she felt as if she was mourning the loss of her closest friend. "No one knows the pain that the media and opinions from the public have caused my family," she wrote. Despite this, she stated her family will "continue to grow and show the world what real love is." "THIS IS OUR LIFE!" she added. Later, Janay Rice defended her husband to ESPN: "I love my husband. I support him. I want people to respect our privacy in this family matter." In response to messages on Tuesday, Ray Rice texted CNN sports journalist Rachel Nichols: "I'm just holding strong for my wife and kid—that's all I can do right now." The TMZ video shows the couple inside a casino elevator. Ray Rice punches Janay, she approaches him, and he hits her again, causing her to fall. In March, a grand jury indicted Ray Rice for third-degree aggravated assault; a simple assault charge against Janay was dropped. The couple married the next day. Ray Rice pleaded not guilty to aggravated assault and entered a program for first-time offenders that could clear his record within a year. The Ravens had stood by him through the aftermath. NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell faced strong criticism over his handling of the case. Both the NFL and the Ravens responded forcefully only after the release of the second video. The NFL claimed it had not seen the elevator video until TMZ published it. Ravens owner Steve Bisciotti apologized to fans, saying the team had tried to get the video from the casino, police, and prosecutors, but was denied access. "Seeing that video changed everything. We should have seen it earlier. We should have pursued our own investigation more vigorously," Bisciotti wrote on the team's website. "We didn't, and we were wrong." In his first televised comments since suspending Rice, Goodell told CBS News that he learned of the new video on Monday. He said the league assumed a video existed and requested it, but was not allowed to see it. According to the Associated Press, a longer, higher-quality video with audio, provided anonymously, showed the couple yelling obscenities at each other in the elevator. Janay spat at Ray, who then punched her. After she collapsed, Ray pulled her from the elevator and hotel staff were heard speculating if she was drunk and calling for no police involvement. In May, Ray and Janay Rice addressed the media about the case. "I deeply regret the role I played in the incident that night," Janay said. "I love Ray, and I know he will work to regain your respect." Ray Rice apologized to the team's owner, general manager, and head coach, as well as to fans and others affected by the situation. He did not apologize to Janay at that time, but at a July press conference, he called his actions "inexcusable" and said they were in counseling.
translated_content: Pinuna ni Janay Rice, asawa ng sinuspindeng NFL player na si Ray Rice, ang media nitong Martes ngunit patuloy na sumusuporta sa kanyang asawa. Isang araw matapos tanggalin ng Baltimore Ravens si Ray at suspendihin siya ng NFL dahil sa pananakit sa kanya, tinawag ni Janay ang karanasan bilang isang bangungot. "Pinapabalik sa amin ang isang sandali sa aming buhay na pinagsisisihan namin araw-araw—isang napakasakit na bagay," isinulat niya sa Instagram. "Ang kunin ang pinaghirapan ng mahal kong asawa sa buong buhay niya para lang tumaas ang ratings ay nakakatakot." Inalis ng Baltimore Ravens si Ray Rice nitong Lunes matapos lumabas ang isang video na nagpapakitang sinuntok niya ang kanyang dating fiancé at hinila palabas ng elevator sa isang casino sa Atlantic City. Sa simula, sinuspinde lang si Rice ng dalawang laro kaugnay ng insidente noong Pebrero—isang parusang itinuring ng marami na masyadong magaang. Ilang linggo bago siya magbalik sa paglalaro nang ang bagong video ay nagdulot ng mabilis na aksyon mula sa team at NFL, na tumapos sa kanyang career. Noong Martes, sinabi ni Janay Rice na pakiramdam niya ay nagluluksa siya para sa pagkawala ng pinakamalapit niyang kaibigan. "Walang nakakaalam ng sakit na dulot ng media at mga opinyon ng publiko sa aming pamilya," ani niya. Sa kabila nito, sinabi niyang patuloy silang lalago at ipapakita sa mundo kung ano ang tunay na pagmamahal. "ITO ANG BUHAY NAMIN!" dagdag pa niya. Kalaunan, ipinagtanggol ni Janay ang kanyang asawa sa ESPN: "Mahal ko ang aking asawa. Sinusuportahan ko siya. Nais kong igalang ng mga tao ang aming privacy tungkol sa isyung ito ng pamilya." Sa isang mensahe nitong Martes, nag-text si Ray Rice kay Rachel Nichols ng CNN: "Pinapatibay ko lang ang loob ko para sa aking asawa at anak—iyan lang ang kaya kong gawin ngayon." Ipinakita ng TMZ video ang mag-asawa sa loob ng casino elevator. Sinuntok ni Ray Rice si Janay, nilapitan siya nito, at muli siyang sinuntok na naging dahilan ng pagkakabagsak nito. Noong Marso, inakusahan si Ray Rice ng grand jury ng third-degree aggravated assault; ibinaba ang simple assault charge laban kay Janay. Nagpakasal sila kinabukasan. Hindi umamin si Ray Rice at sumali sa first-time offender program na maaaring mag-linis ng record niya sa loob ng isang taon. Patuloy na sumuporta ang Ravens sa kanya matapos ang insidente. Naharap sa matinding kritisismo si NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell sa paggabay niya sa kaso. Parehong naglabas ng matibay na aksyon ang NFL at Ravens matapos ang paglabas ng ikalawang video. Ayon sa NFL, hindi raw nila nakita ang elevator video hanggang ilathala ito ng TMZ. Humingi ng paumanhin si Ravens owner Steve Bisciotti sa mga fans, sinabing sinubukan ng team na kunin ang video mula sa casino, pulisya, at prosecutor ngunit hindi pinayagang makita ito. "Binago ng video na iyon ang lahat. Dapat sana'y nakita namin ito kaagad. Dapat ay mas pinursige namin ang imbestigasyon namin," ayon kay Bisciotti sa website ng team. "Hindi namin ginawa, at mali iyon." Sa una niyang panayam mula nang suspindihin si Rice, sinabi ni Goodell sa CBS News na nalaman niya ang bagong video nitong Lunes. Ani niya, inakala ng liga na may video at hiniling nila iyon, pero hindi ito ibinigay sa kanila. Ayon sa Associated Press, may napanood silang mas mahabang video, mas malinaw at may tunog, mula sa anonymous na source, na nagpapakitang nagsisigawan ng masasakit na salita ang mag-asawa sa elevator. Dumura si Janay kay Ray bago siya sinuntok. Nang bumagsak si Janay, hinila siya palabas ng elevator ni Ray at narinig ang staff ng hotel na nagtatanong kung siya ay lasing at humihiling na walang pulis. Noong Mayo, hinarap nila Ray at Janay Rice ang media tungkol sa kaso. "Lubos kong pinagsisihan ang papel na ginampanan ko sa insidente noong gabing iyon," sabi ni Janay. "Mahal ko si Ray, at alam kong gagawin niya ang lahat para maibalik ang respeto ninyo." Humingi ng paumanhin si Ray Rice sa owner, general manager, at head coach ng team, pati sa fans at lahat ng naapektuhan ng sitwasyon. Hindi siya humingi ng tawad kay Janay noon, ngunit sa press conference noong Hulyo, tinawag niyang 'inexcusable' ang kanyang ginawa at sinabi nilang nagpapayo sila.

article_content: In a rare podcast appearance, Apple CEO Tim Cook spoke with singer Dua Lipa, covering a wide range of topics—including the far-reaching influence of artificial intelligence (AI) in Apple's products. Known for his low public profile outside of official Apple events, Cook shared insights on how AI is integrated across Apple devices. Cook highlighted that AI is a fundamental part of all Apple products, even if consumers may not notice it directly. He provided examples, such as the Apple Watch's abilities to detect falls, car crashes, irregular heartbeats, and to perform ECGs. He also mentioned features like predictive typing, all powered by AI. Addressing the recent surge in AI interest—driven by tools like ChatGPT—Cook acknowledged both the transformative potential and the possible downsides of generative AI. He noted that AI could be used in groundbreaking ways, such as helping people with health diagnoses, but also warned that it has the capacity for harm and misuse. Cook called for 'rules of the road' and proper regulation for AI, emphasizing that many governments worldwide, including the US, UK, EU, and several Asian countries, are now focusing on establishing guidelines. He explained that Apple is among the first companies to advocate for such regulation, aiming to ensure AI is used responsibly. Cook expressed confidence that AI regulations would materialize within the next 12 to 18 months. On the topic of smartphone overuse, especially among young people, Cook agreed on the need for moderation. He pointed out Apple's 'Screen Time' feature, designed to help users monitor and limit their device usage. The conversation, part of 'Dua Lipa: At Your Service,' offered listeners Cook’s perspective on technology's future, responsible innovation, and digital well-being.
translated_content: Sa isang bihirang podcast appearance, nakapanayam ng Apple CEO na si Tim Cook si singer Dua Lipa at tinalakay nila ang iba't ibang paksa—lalo na ang malawakang epekto ng artificial intelligence (AI) sa mga produkto ng Apple. Kilala si Cook na bihirang lumabas sa publiko maliban sa mga opisyal na event ng Apple, kaya't nagbahagi siya ng pananaw kung paano nakabaon ang AI sa mga Apple device. Binigyang-diin ni Cook na mahalagang bahagi ang AI ng lahat ng produkto ng Apple, kahit hindi ito napapansin ng mga gumagamit. Binanggit niya ang mga halimbawa tulad ng kakayahan ng Apple Watch na mag-detect ng pagbagsak, mga aksidente sa kotse, hindi regular na tibok ng puso, at magsagawa ng ECG. Kasama rin ang predictive typing na gamit ang AI. Tinalakay ni Cook ang biglang pagsikat ng interes sa AI—dahil sa mga tool gaya ng ChatGPT. Inamin niyang malaki ang potensyal ng AI ngunit may mga panganib din ito. Maaaring magdulot ito ng pagbabago, tulad ng pagtulong sa mga health diagnosis, pero nagbabala rin siya na maaari rin itong gamitin sa maling paraan. Hinimok ni Cook na dapat magkaroon ng malinaw na 'mga patakaran sa paggamit' o regulasyon para sa AI. Binanggit niyang maraming gobyerno sa buong mundo—kabilang ang US, UK, EU, at ilang bansa sa Asya—ang nagsusumikap ngayon na gumawa ng mga panuntunan. Ipinaliwanag niya na ang Apple ay isa sa mga unang kumpanyang nananawagan ng regulasyon para matiyak na responsableng magagamit ang AI. Buo ang loob niyang magkakaroon ng AI regulations sa susunod na 12 hanggang 18 buwan. Tungkol naman sa labis na paggamit ng smartphone lalo na ng mga kabataan, sumang-ayon si Cook na kailangang i-moderate ito. Ipinagmalaki niya ang 'Screen Time' feature ng Apple na tumutulong sa mga user na subaybayan at limitahan ang kanilang paggamit ng device. article_content: A bearded dragon lizard received oxygen from paramedics after being rescued from a house fire in Bolton, Greater Manchester. Emergency crews were called to a terraced house shortly before 11 a.m., where a fire had started behind the fridge-freezer. Upon arrival, firefighters found a woman outside with her two husky dogs, who informed them that her pet lizard was still inside as smoke poured from the kitchen. Firefighters located the bearded dragon in its tank and brought it out to the fire engine, where medics administered oxygen therapy. Watch Manager Tony McKenna from Bolton Central said, 'Crews wearing breathing apparatus used a hose reel to extinguish the fire in the kitchen, which we believe started due to an electrical fault behind the fridge-freezer.' The fire caused significant damage to the kitchen, prompting reminders about regular maintenance of electrical items and plugs. Councillor David Acton, Chair of the Greater Manchester Fire and Rescue Authority, said, 'We would like to remind people to take extra care with electrical items, avoid leaving them plugged in for too long, and ensure wires, plugs, and chargers are in good condition.' The pet's owner managed to escape the house with her dogs, while the bearded dragon was successfully rescued and treated.
translated_content: Isang bearded dragon na butiki ang binigyan ng oxygen ng mga paramedic matapos itong mailigtas mula sa sunog sa bahay sa Bolton, Greater Manchester. Tumawag ang emergency crews sa isang terraced house bago mag-11 a.m., kung saan nagsimula ang sunog sa likod ng fridge-freezer. Pagdating ng mga bumbero, nakita nila ang isang babae sa labas kasama ang dalawa niyang husky na aso, na nagsabi sa kanila na ang kanyang alagang butiki ay naiwan pa sa loob habang lumalabas ang usok mula sa kusina. Natagpuan ng mga bumbero ang bearded dragon sa loob ng tangke nito at inilipat ito sa fire engine, kung saan binigyan ito ng oxygen therapy ng mga medics. Ayon kay Watch Manager Tony McKenna mula sa Bolton Central, 'Ang mga crew na may suot na breathing apparatus ay gumamit ng hose reel para patayin ang apoy sa kusina, na pinaniniwalaan naming nagsimula dahil sa electrical fault sa likod ng fridge-freezer.' Malaking pinsala ang idinulot ng sunog sa kusina kaya pinaalalahanan ang lahat tungkol sa regular na pag-check at pag-maintain ng mga electrical items at plug. Ayon kay Konsehal David Acton, Chair ng Greater Manchester Fire and Rescue Authority, 'Nais naming ipaalala sa mga tao na mag-ingat sa paggamit ng mga electrical items, huwag iwanang matagalang naka-plug, at siguraduhing maayos ang mga wire, plug, at charger.' Nakawala ang may-ari ng alaga kasama ang kanyang mga aso, habang ang bearded dragon ay naligtas at naalagaan.
post_content: A bearded dragon got oxygen therapy after a dramatic rescue from a house fire in Bolton! Firefighters saved the lizard and reminded everyone to check their electricals for safety. 🦎🔥 #FeelGoodNews #FireSafety

article_content: Daniel O'Reilly officially ended his character Dapper Laughs last month following widespread criticism and accusations of sexism. Despite this, Dapper Laughs has been included on the longlist for Best Breakthrough Act at the upcoming Brit Awards, after his song 'Proper Moist' reached the Top 20 of the singles chart earlier this year. The comedian from Clapham, south London, joins over 90 other acts on the longlist. Dapper Laughs was axed after thousands signed a petition to ban his show from ITVBe. His nomination comes as a result of the eligibility rule, which requires that an artist has had a single or album in the Top 40 in the past year. Artists are only ineligible if they have previously been nominated for a Brit Award or had a Top 30 single or album before the current period. Neither the retirement of a character nor public controversy disqualifies someone from the category. A Brit Awards spokesperson told the Independent, 'Bands are eligible for British Breakthrough Act if they have had an Official Charts Company Top 40 single and/or artist album during the eligibility period. They are not eligible if they have previously been nominated in any Brit Award category (excluding Critics' Choice) or had an Official Charts Company Top 30 single or album before this period.' Tracey Emin has designed the trophy for the 2015 Brit Awards. A panel of music industry experts will select five finalists from the longlist, and the public will vote online for the winner ahead of the event. 'Proper Moist' features lyrics that have attracted controversy, making it uncertain if Dapper Laughs will be shortlisted or attend the awards ceremony. O'Reilly announced the end of Dapper Laughs on BBC's Newsnight in November, following a significant backlash over his comedy. During the same week, ITV announced it would not continue his show 'On The Pull' after a storm of criticism over his jokes. O'Reilly admitted, 'I didn't think that so many people would end up seeing it. In the end it became very popular and I got a bit carried away. It's wrong, but I saw it as a character pushing boundaries because it was popular. I thought viewers found it ridiculous and were laughing at that.' In 2014, the Best Breakthrough Act Brit Award went to Bastille.
translated_content: Opisyal na tinapos ni Daniel O'Reilly ang kanyang karakter na si Dapper Laughs noong nakaraang buwan matapos siyang makatanggap ng matinding batikos at paratang ng seksismo. Sa kabila nito, kabilang pa rin si Dapper Laughs sa longlist para sa Best Breakthrough Act sa nalalapit na Brit Awards, dahil umabot sa Top 20 ng singles chart ngayong taon ang kanyang kantang 'Proper Moist.' Ang komedyante mula Clapham, south London, ay nasa listahan kasama ng mahigit 90 na iba pang mga acts. Tinanggal si Dapper Laughs matapos magkaroon ng libu-libong lumagda sa petisyon na ipatanggal ang kanyang palabas sa ITVBe. Nominado siya dahil sa patakaran kung saan kailangang may single o album na mapasama sa Top 40 sa nakalipas na taon. Hindi kwalipikado ang mga artist na dati nang nominado sa Brit Awards o may single o album na pumasok sa Top 30 bago ang panahong kasalukuyan. Hindi hadlang ang pagreretiro ng karakter o kontrobersiya para matanggal sa kategoryang ito. Sabi ng tagapagsalita ng Brit Awards sa Independent, 'Kwalipikado ang mga banda sa British Breakthrough Act kung mayroon silang Official Charts Company Top 40 single at/o artist album sa panahon ng eligibility. Hindi sila kwalipikado kung dati na silang nominado sa Brit Award (maliban sa Critics’ Choice) o may Official Charts Company Top 30 single o album bago ang panahong ito.' Si Tracey Emin ang nagdisenyo ng tropeyo para sa Brit Awards 2015. Pipili ang panel ng mga music industry expert ng limang finalist mula sa longlist, at ang publiko ang magbobotohan online para malaman ang mananalo bago ang event. Dahil sa mga kontrobersyal na linya ng 'Proper Moist,' hindi sigurado kung mapapasama si Dapper Laughs sa shortlist o kung dadalo siya sa awards night. Inanunsyo ni O'Reilly ang pagtatapos ng Dapper Laughs sa BBC Newsnight noong Nobyembre, kasunod ng matinding backlash tungkol sa kanyang komedya. Noong parehong linggo, sinabi ng ITV na hindi na nila ipagpapatuloy ang kanyang programa na 'On The Pull' dahil sa mga reklamo sa kanyang mga biro. Aminado si O'Reilly, 'Hindi ko inakalang ganoon karaming tao ang makakapanood. Naging patok ito at medyo nadala ako. Mali, pero tinitingnan ko lang ito bilang karakter na nilikha ko at sinusubukang itulak ang hangganan dahil sumikat siya. Akala ko tawa lang ito para sa manonood.' Noong 2014, napunta sa Bastille ang Best Breakthrough Act Brit Award.

On Monday, the Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB) criticized Nigeria’s Directorate of State Services (DSS) for denying Nnamdi Kanu access to visitors. IPOB also dismissed the DSS’s claim that the denial resulted from insufficient personnel due to elections in Imo, Bayelsa, and Kogi States, calling the explanation “laughable and suspicious.”

In a statement by IPOB spokesman Emma Powerful, the group alleged that the DSS’s refusal to grant Kanu access to his visitors was a deliberate attempt to mistreat him. According to IPOB, Kanu was denied visitation rights on Thursday, November 9, 2023, with the DSS citing logistical challenges related to the ongoing state elections.

IPOB argued that despite previous, larger elections such as the presidential and gubernatorial polls, Kanu had previously been allowed visitors at the DSS detention facility. They questioned why this policy had now changed, suggesting it was part of a larger pattern of harassment.

The group further accused the DSS and other security agencies of selectively enforcing court orders and enabling political interference in the case. IPOB demanded that court rulings permitting Kanu weekly, unrestricted visitor access be respected and insisted on his unconditional release in line with existing Appeal Court orders.

IPOB also criticized security agency officials—including DSS director Yusuf Bichi and spokesperson Mazi Peter Afunanya—alleging ethnic bias and a disregard for legal procedures. The group argued that a responsible government would not allow political actors or alleged corruption to influence court-mandated actions, especially regarding Kanu’s case.

Finally, IPOB reiterated calls for the Nigerian government to prioritize Kanu’s health and welfare, allowing him consistent, unhindered access to visitors per court orders.
translated_content:
Noong Lunes, binatikos ng Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB) ang Directorate of State Services (DSS) ng Nigeria dahil sa hindi pagpapahintulot kay Nnamdi Kanu na makapagtanggap ng mga bisita. Tinanggihan din ng IPOB ang paliwanag ng DSS na kulang umano sila sa tauhan dahil sa mga eleksyon sa mga estado ng Imo, Bayelsa, at Kogi, at tinawag nila itong “nakakatawa at kahina-hinala.”

Ayon kay Emma Powerful, tagapagsalita ng IPOB, layunin daw ng DSS na pahirapan si Kanu sa pamamagitan ng hindi pagpapahintulot sa kanya na magkaroon ng mga bisita. Noong Nobyembre 9, 2023, Huwebes, hindi pinayagan ng DSS na madalaw si Kanu, dahil umano sa mga problemang dulot ng kasalukuyang mga eleksyon.

Binigyang-diin ng IPOB na kahit noong nakaraang mas malalaking halalan, tulad ng presidential at gubernatorial elections, nakadalaw naman ang mga bisita kay Kanu sa pasilidad ng DSS. Kaya’t kinuwestiyon nila ang pagbabagong ito, at tiningnan bilang bahagi ng patuloy na panggigipit kay Kanu.

Dagdag pa rito, inakusahan nila ang DSS at iba pang ahensya ng seguridad ng ‘selective’ na pagpapatupad ng utos ng korte at pinapayagan daw ang panghihimasok ng politika sa kaso. Nanawagan ang IPOB na sundin ang utos ng korte na bigyan ng lingguhang at walang limitasyong dalaw si Kanu, at iginiit ang kanyang agarang paglaya batay sa kautusan ng Appeal Court.

Binatikos din ng IPOB ang ilang opisyal ng security agencies, kabilang si DSS director Yusuf Bichi at si Mazi Peter Afunanya, tagapagsalita ng DSS, sa umano’y pagkakaroon ng kinikilingan at hindi pagsunod sa tamang proseso. Giit ng grupo, responsibilidad ng pamahalaan na hindi hayaan ang pulitika o korapsyon na makaapekto sa mga desisyon ng korte, lalo na para sa kaso ni Kanu.

Sa huli, nanawagan ulit ang IPOB na unahin ng Nigeria ang kalusugan at kapakanan ni Kanu, at tiyaking makatatanggap siya ng bisita ayon sa utos ng korte.

Birgit Fischer made her Olympic debut in Moscow at just 18 years old. After planning to retire following the Sydney 2000 Games, Fischer returned from retirement in 2004 to compete in the Athens Olympics, aiming to add to her impressive tally of 10 Olympic medals—a record in canoeing. In Athens, she secured both a gold and a silver medal.

In Sydney, Fischer entered the record books by winning the 500-meter pairs and 500-meter fours. After that victory, she declared, “No more competition,” having become the first woman in Olympic history to win gold medals 20 years apart and only the fifth competitor to earn golds in five separate Games. "Sometimes you just have to finish, and it's great to finish on a high," she reflected.

As an 18-year-old in Moscow in 1980, Fischer earned gold in the individual event. However, she missed the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics due to East Germany’s boycott, despite being a world champion in singles, pairs, and fours at the time. In Seoul 1988, after finishing second in singles, she bounced back to win gold in pairs and fours.

After briefly retiring following the Seoul Games, Fischer returned in time for the 1992 Barcelona Olympics on the unified German team. There, she regained the individual title she first won in 1980 and took silver in the fours. In Atlanta 1996, she added two more medals: gold in the fours and silver in the pairs, setting the stage for her record-breaking performances in Sydney.

Beyond the Olympics, Fischer won 27 world championship titles between 1979 and 1999. Despite the sport’s low profile, she remains humble, saying after Sydney, “The number of medals is simply not that important to me. Most of the medals I have won have been in team events, so the medals belong as much to the team as to me.”
translated_content:
Ginawa ni Birgit Fischer ang kanyang Olympic debut sa Moscow noong siya ay 18 taong gulang pa lamang. Matapos planuhin ang pagreretiro pagkatapos ng Sydney 2000 Games, bumalik mula sa pagreretiro si Fischer noong 2004 para lumaban sa Athens Olympics, na layuning madagdagan pa ang kanyang 10 Olympic medals—isang rekord sa canoeing. Sa Athens, nakakuha siya ng isang ginto at isang pilak na medalya.

Sa Sydney, pumasok si Fischer sa kasaysayan sa pamamagitan ng pagwawagi sa 500-meter pairs at 500-meter fours. Pagkatapos ng tagumpay na iyon, idineklara niya, “Wala nang kompetisyon,” na naging kauna-unahang babae sa kasaysayan ng Olympics na nagwagi ng ginto na may 20 taong agwat, at ikalimang atleta na nagkamit ng ginto sa limang magkaibang Games. "Minsan kailangan mo lang tapusin, at napakagandang magtapos nang matagumpay," ani Fischer.

Bilang 18-anyos sa Moscow noong 1980, nagwagi si Fischer ng ginto sa individual event. Ngunit na-miss niya ang 1984 Los Angeles Olympics dahil sa boycott ng East Germany, kahit na siya ay world champion noon sa singles, pairs, at fours. Sa Seoul 1988, nang matapos siyang pangalawa sa singles, bumawi siya ng ginto sa pairs at fours.

Matapos ang maikling pagreretiro pagkatapos ng Seoul Games, bumalik si Fischer sa 1992 Barcelona Olympics bilang bahagi ng nagkakaisang German team. Doon, nabawi niya ang individual title na una niyang napanalunan noong 1980 at nagtamo ng pilak sa fours. Sa Atlanta 1996, nadagdagan pa ang kanyang mga medalya: ginto sa fours at pilak sa pairs, na naglatag ng daan para sa kanyang record-breaking na mga tagumpay sa Sydney.

Bukod sa Olympics, nanalo si Fischer ng 27 world championship titles mula 1979 hanggang 1999. Sa kabila ng pagiging low profile ng isport, nananatili siyang mapagkumbaba, “Hindi ganoon kahalaga sa akin ang bilang ng mga medalya. Karamihan ng mga medalya ay napanalunan ko sa team events, kaya para rin ito sa buong koponan.”
post_content: Birgit Fischer proved age is just a number! She came back from retirement in 2004, adding more Olympic medals to her legendary record. 🏅🛶 #OlympicLegend #Inspiration
translated_post: Walang kupas si Birgit Fischer! Bumalik siya mula sa pagreretiro at nadagdagan pa ang mga Olympic medalya niya. Totong inspirasyon! 🥇🚣‍♀️ #PambansangBida #BirgitFischer

article_content: The Federal Government of Nigeria has decided to withdraw civil claims totaling $1.1 billion against Eni SpA, concluding a lengthy legal dispute in Italian courts over corruption allegations related to the OPL 245 oil field. According to a letter reviewed by Bloomberg, the Ministry of Justice will unconditionally and immediately waive these claims before Italy’s highest court, no later than November 17. The government has also agreed to irrevocably waive any future legal action in Italy against Eni, its affiliates, and current or former officers concerning OPL 245. Eni confirmed it had received the letter and stated it is ready to work with Nigeria on converting the license to facilitate the oil block’s development. Legal operations on OPL 245 have been halted for over a decade due to numerous trials and competing legal claims. Eni estimates that the area holds around 560 million barrels of recoverable oil reserves, making it one of Nigeria’s richest concessions. Although a Milan court definitively acquitted Eni, Shell, and several of their executives of corruption charges last year, Nigeria continued to pursue $3.5 billion in civil compensation, reflecting what it considered the fair value of the license acquired by Eni and Shell in 2011. Moving forward, OPL 245’s development depends on the resolution of other ongoing legal processes, including arbitration at the World Bank’s International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes and litigation within Nigeria. The Ministry of Justice did not immediately comment, according to Bloomberg.
translated_content: Nagpasya ang Pamahalaang Pederal ng Nigeria na bawiin ang mga sibil na paghahabol na nagkakahalaga ng $1.1 bilyon laban sa Eni SpA, na nagwawakas sa matagal na usaping legal sa mga korte ng Italya kaugnay ng mga alegasyon ng korapsyon sa OPL 245 oil field. Ayon sa liham na nakita ng Bloomberg, ang Ministry of Justice ay walang kondisyon at agarang tatalikdan ang mga kasong ito sa pinakamataas na korte ng Italya, hindi lalampas sa Nobyembre 17. Sumasang-ayon din ang pamahalaan na hindi na muling magsasampa ng kaso sa Italya laban sa Eni, mga katuwang nito, at sa mga kasalukuyan o dating opisyal kaugnay ng OPL 245. Kinumpirma ng Eni na natanggap nila ang liham at naghayag ng kahandaang makipagtulungan sa Nigeria para sa conversion ng lisensya upang maisulong ang pagpapaunlad ng oil block. Nahinto ang mga operasyon sa OPL 245 sa loob ng higit isang dekada dahil sa mga pagsubok at nagbabanggaang mga usaping legal. Ayon sa Eni, tinatayang mayroong humigit-kumulang 560 milyong bariles ng maaaring makuhang langis sa lugar, na itinuturing na isa sa pinakamayamang concesyon sa Nigeria. Bagamat napawalang-sala ng korte sa Milan ang Eni, Shell, at ilan sa kanilang mga executive sa mga kasong korapsyon noong nakaraang taon, ipinagpatuloy ng Nigeria ang paghingi ng $3.5 bilyon bilang sibil na danyos na anila’y sumasalamin sa totoong halaga ng lisensyang nakuha ng Eni at Shell noong 2011. Ang pagpapatuloy ng pagpapaunlad sa OPL 245 ay nakasalalay pa rin sa resulta ng iba pang kasalukuyang proseso ng legal, kabilang na ang arbitrasyon sa International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes ng World Bank at mga kaso sa loob mismo ng Nigeria. Ayon sa Bloomberg, hindi pa agad nagbigay ng pahayag ang Ministry of Justice.
post_content: Nigeria drops $1.1B lawsuit against Eni, paving the way to develop the valuable OPL 245 oil block after a decade of legal disputes. #NigeriaNews #Eni #OPL245 #OilIndustry
