article_content: On September 6, 2013, Montana’s Supreme Court ruled that District Judge Todd Baugh did not have the authority to amend the 30-day jail sentence given to former teacher Stacey Rambold, convicted of raping 14-year-old Cherice Moralez. Judge Baugh had initially sentenced Rambold, an ex-Billings high school teacher, to just 30 days in jail after the 2007 rape of Moralez, who later died by suicide. Baugh’s remarks that the victim seemed older than her age and was 'probably as much in control' as her teacher caused public outrage. The Montana Supreme Court voted 4-2 to stop Judge Baugh from conducting a hearing to possibly change Rambold’s sentence. The lenient sentence and the judge's statements led to widespread criticism from women’s groups and victim advocates. Amid the controversy and the prosecution’s intention to appeal, Judge Baugh apologized and set a hearing to review the sentence, but the state attorney general argued that he was not legally allowed to do so. The Supreme Court agreed, ruling that Baugh’s attempt to amend the sentence was unlawful, though it did not address the fairness of the sentence itself. The ruling came just before Judge Baugh’s planned hearing. Both the prosecution and defense opposed the hearing, saying it lacked legal authority. Prosecutors believed Rambold should have received at least two years in prison, instead of a 15-year sentence with all but one month suspended. Judge Baugh further angered the public by claiming that the light sentence 'increased' Rambold’s 'debt to society.' Cherice Moralez died by suicide on February 6, 2010, weeks before turning 17. Her mother, Auliea Hanlon, said the abuse and impending trial were major factors in her daughter's death and that Cherice was bullied at school after the abuse became known. Rambold, arrested in 2008, originally received a deferred prosecution agreement requiring him to plead guilty to one count and attend sex offender treatment. In 2012, the agreement was revoked after he violated treatment terms, including unauthorized contact with minors and failing to inform his counselor of a sexual relationship (not with a minor). Judge Baugh saw these violations as minor and cited expert opinions that Rambold was a low risk to the community. His decision was influenced by confidential reports and interviews. Criticism intensified after Judge Baugh said the victim was 'older than her chronological years' and 'in control' during the incidents—a statement for which he later apologized. He also argued the crime was not violent, though he acknowledged in writing that all forms of rape are traumatic crimes. Even though Judge Baugh later called a prison sentence 'appropriate,' he kept the 15-year sentence nearly fully suspended, with just 31 days in jail including credit for time served. Rambold is on 15 years' probation, must complete sex-offender treatment, and must register as a sex offender. Yellowstone County prosecutor Scott Twito continues to review possible legal grounds for appeal. Public protest has grown, with large demonstrations and an online petition urging Judge Baugh's removal. Cherice’s mother spoke out against the outcome, saying Rambold 'took away everything beautiful in my life and he just gets to walk away.'
translated_content: Noong Setyembre 6, 2013, nagpasya ang Korte Suprema ng Montana na walang kapangyarihan si District Judge Todd Baugh na baguhin ang 30-araw na sentensya ng pagkakakulong na ipinataw kay dating guro na si Stacey Rambold, na nahatulan ng panggagahasa kay Cherice Moralez, 14 taong gulang. Unang hinatulan ni Judge Baugh si Rambold, dating guro sa Billings high school, ng 30 araw lamang sa kulungan matapos ang insidente noong 2007 kay Moralez, na kalauna'y nagpakamatay. Nagdulot ng matinding galit sa publiko ang mga pahayag ni Baugh na mukhang mas matanda ang biktima at 'tila kontrolado' rin ang sitwasyon. Bumoto ang Korte Suprema ng Montana ng 4-2 para harangin si Judge Baugh sa pagdinig na maaaring magbago ng sentensya ni Rambold. Tinuligsa ng mga grupong pangkababaihan at tagapagtanggol ng biktima ang magaan na hatol at naging pahayag ng hukom. Sa gitna ng kontrobersiya at balak ng prosekusyon na umapela, humingi ng paumanhin si Judge Baugh at nagtakda ng hearing para muling rebyuhin ang sentensya. Ngunit iginiit ng state attorney general na labag ito sa batas. Sumang-ayon ang Korte Suprema at sinabing labag sa batas ang tangkang pagbabago, ngunit hindi nito tinalakay kung makatarungan ang mismong sentensya. Agad inilabas ng korte ang desisyon bago pa man magsimula ang hearing. Sinang-ayunan ng parehong prosekusyon at depensa na hindi dapat matuloy ang hearing dahil walang legal na basehan. Para sa mga taga-usig, mas mabigat sana ang parusa kay Rambold—hindi bababa sa dalawang taon—imbes na 15 taon na nasuspindi maliban sa isang buwan lang. Lalo pang uminit ang protesta matapos sabihin ni Judge Baugh na 'lumaki' raw ang pananagutan ni Rambold dahil sa magaan na sentensya. Nagpakamatay si Cherice Moralez noong Pebrero 6, 2010, ilang linggo bago ang ika-17 niyang kaarawan. Kuwento ng kanyang ina, si Auliea Hanlon, malaki ang naging epekto ng abuso at nakaambang paglilitis sa kanyang anak at naranasan pa nito ang pambu-bully. Naaresto si Rambold noong 2008, at una sanang binigyan ng deferred prosecution agreement na kailangan niyang umamin sa isang kaso at pumasok sa sex offender treatment. Nabawi ito noong 2012 dahil nilabag ni Rambold ang mga alituntunin ng programa, gaya ng ilegal na pakikitungo sa mga menor de edad at hindi pagsasabi ukol sa isang relasyon (hindi menor de edad) sa kanyang counselor. Tinuring ni Judge Baugh na hindi malala ang mga paglabag na ito at batay sa opinyon ng eksperto, mababa ang banta ni Rambold sa komunidad. Nakaapekto rin sa desisyon niya ang ilang confidential na ulat at panayam. Nag-igting ang batikos matapos sabihin ni Judge Baugh na 'mas matanda sa kanyang edad' at 'may kontrol' ang biktima—pagpag-amin, inako niyang mali na ang mga iyon. Inilarawan pa niyang hindi raw marahas ang krimen, ngunit kinilala niyang lahat ng uri ng rape ay malupit na krimen. Bagaman sinabi niyang 'nararapat' ang parusang kulong, nanatili pa rin ang 15 taon na halos lahat ay nasuspindi at 31 araw lamang ang aktwal na kulong (kalakip ang isang araw na credit). Nakaprobasyon si Rambold ng 15 taon, kailangan niyang tapusin ang sex-offender treatment, at rehistrado bilang sex offender. Tuloy ang pagsusuri ni Yellowstone County prosecutor Scott Twito sa posibleng apela. Uminit ang protesta ng taumbayan, may malaking rally at online petition para patalsikin si Judge Baugh. Naglabas ng sama ng loob si Auliea Hanlon, ina ni Cherice, at sinabing 'kinuha ni Rambold ang lahat na maganda sa buhay ko at siya'y basta na lang nakalaya.'
post_content: Public outrage grows in Montana after Judge Baugh's 30-day sentence for ex-teacher who raped 14-year-old Cherice Moralez. Supreme Court blocks any change to the light sentence, fueling protests and calls for the judge's removal. #JusticeForCherice #MontanaCourt

article_content: Organizers in Shepton Mallet, Somerset, planned to lower the Union Flag to half-mast for a vigil commemorating 100 years since the start of the First World War, as a sign of respect for those who died. Initially, the Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS), via senior policy advisor Fiona Wood, denied permission, explaining that only the Queen or Prime Minister could grant such approval. The rule stated that half-masting the flag is reserved for marking the deaths of national figures or for immediate tragedies, and not for anniversaries. This decision caused disappointment and frustration among locals, who felt the government was failing to honor those lost in the war. Councillor Jeannette Marsh, who organized the event, and many in the community voiced their dissatisfaction, emphasizing the importance of commemorating the fallen. After public backlash, the DCMS reversed its decision and clarified that decisions on flag flying at local buildings are the responsibility of local authorities, not the department. Official national instructions for half-masting the Union Flag are issued by Buckingham Palace, typically following the death of prominent figures. The centenary commemoration in Shepton Mallet will proceed and include a vigil by cadets, a church service, and music in memory of the war's casualties. Community leaders continue to stress the significance of local autonomy in marking such occasions and criticized the government's original response as unnecessarily bureaucratic.
translated_content: Nagplano ang mga tagapag-ayos sa Shepton Mallet, Somerset na itaas ang Union Flag sa half-mast bilang paggunita sa ika-100 taon ng pagsisimula ng Unang Digmaang Pandaigdig, bilang paggalang sa mga nasawi. Sa umpisa, tinanggihan ito ng Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS) sa pamamagitan ni Fiona Wood, senior policy advisor, at iginiit na tanging Reyna o Punong Ministro lamang ang maaaring magbigay ng pahintulot. Ayon sa patakaran, ang half-masting ng watawat ay ginagawa lamang bilang paggunita sa pagkamatay ng mga pambansang personalidad o tuwing may agarang trahedya, hindi para sa mga anibersaryo. Dahil dito, nadismaya at nainis ang mga taga-komunidad, at pakiramdam nila ay hindi binigyang halaga ng gobyerno ang mga nagbuwis ng buhay sa digmaan. Si Konsehal Jeannette Marsh, na nag-organisa ng seremonya, at marami pang lokal, ay nagpahayag ng pagkadismaya, at iginiit na mahalagang gunitain ang mga nasawi. Pagkatapos ng mga reklamo mula sa publiko, binawi ng DCMS ang desisyon at nilinaw na ang pagpapasya kung mag-half-mast ng watawat sa lokal na gusali ay nakasalalay sa local authorities, hindi sa naturang ahensya. Ang mga opisyal na utos mula sa Buckingham Palace para sa half-masting ng Union Flag ay karaniwang ibinibigay lamang sa pagkamatay ng mahahalagang personalidad. Tuloy pa rin ang paggunita sa Shepton Mallet na kinabibilangan ng vigil ng mga cadet, serbisyong simbahan, at musikang iniaalay para sa mga nagbuwis ng buhay sa digmaan. Patuloy na binibigyang-diin ng mga lider-komunidad ang halaga ng lokal na pagpapasya sa mga ganitong okasyon at binatikos ang orihinal na tugon ng gobyerno bilang labis na burukratiko.
post_content: Drama in Shepton Mallet! Locals wanted to fly the Union Flag at half-mast for WWI’s 100th anniversary, but officials said no at first. After pushback, the gov admitted it’s up to local councils. Community power wins! 🇬🇧💪 #Centenary #CommunityVoice #FlagRow
translated_post: May issue sa Shepton Mallet! Gustong mag-half-mast ng Union Flag para sa ika-100 taon ng WWI, pero una'y pinagbawalan ng gobyerno. Dahil sa reklamo, pumayag din at napunta sa lokal na awtoridad ang desisyon. Panalo ang bayan! 🇬🇧💪 #BayanAngBida #Centenary #Watawat

article_content: Neon Roberts, age seven, has finished radiotherapy and will soon begin chemotherapy to treat his brain tumour. His father, Ben Roberts, 34, has spoken out following claims from Neon's mother, Sally, 37, that treatment has harmed their son. After surgery to remove a large brain tumour last year, Neon completed 30 sessions of radiotherapy. Ben reports that Neon is recovering well and that doctors are cautiously optimistic. Sally Roberts, his estranged mother, lost a court case to halt radiotherapy, still asserting the treatment has caused severe harm. In December, Sally left with Neon to avoid the treatment, worried about potential side effects such as stunted growth and infertility, and sought alternative therapies. Doctors advised that without radiotherapy, Neon may have died within three months. The High Court ruled for medical treatment, saying Sally's judgment was flawed. Neon is currently taking a break before chemotherapy starts in early April. Ben acknowledges Neon feels tired, which is a common short-term side effect. Sally says Neon seems 'grey and fragile' and is no longer himself, expressing deep concerns over his mood and behavior changes. The disagreement between Sally Roberts and Dr Hilary Jones, who appeared on Daybreak, highlights the ongoing dispute over Neon's care. Neon and his mother shared happier times before his diagnosis. Doctors estimate that the combination of radiotherapy and chemotherapy offers children up to an 86% survival rate. However, treatment delays have lowered Neon's chances to 67%. The court ordered Neon to live with his father during treatment and barred Sally from removing him from Ben’s care. Common short-term effects of radiotherapy include fatigue, nausea (which can be managed), weight loss, skin changes, and hair loss. Patients should avoid direct sunlight for a year post-treatment. Rare long-term risks include persistent hair or skin changes, infertility (if reproductive organs were in the treated area), swelling (lymphoedema), red marks on skin, and very rarely, secondary cancers. Doctors insist that while radiotherapy has risks, they are usually small and outweighed by the benefits. This information comes from Macmillan Cancer Support.
translated_content: Natapos na ni Neon Roberts, pitong taong gulang, ang radiotherapy at magsisimula na ng chemotherapy para sa kanyang brain tumour. Nagsalita ang kanyang amang si Ben Roberts, 34, matapos ipahayag ng inang si Sally, 37, na napinsala raw ang kanilang anak dahil sa paggamot. Matapos maoperahan at matanggal ang malaking brain tumour noong nakaraang taon, sumailalim si Neon sa 30 sessions ng radiotherapy. Ayon kay Ben, maganda ang paggaling ni Neon at may pag-asa raw ayon sa mga doktor. Natalo si Sally Roberts, hiwalay na ina, sa kaso sa korte para mapatigil ang radiotherapy at iginiit pa rin niyang malubhang naapektuhan si Neon. Noong Disyembre, umalis si Sally kasama si Neon upang iwasan ang paggamot, dahil natatakot siya sa mga side effect gaya ng pagkabansot at pagkabaog, at naghanap ng alternatibong therapy. Sinabi ng mga doktor na kung walang radiotherapy, maaaring namatay si Neon sa loob ng tatlong buwan. Pumabor ang High Court sa gamutan at sinabing nagkamali ng pasya si Sally. Nagpapahinga muna si Neon ngayon bago simulan ang chemotherapy sa unang bahagi ng Abril. Aminado si Ben na pagod si Neon, na normal na short-term side effect. Sabi ni Sally, parang 'maputla at mahina' si Neon at hindi na katulad ng dati, kaya nag-aalala siya sa mga pagbabago sa ugali at damdamin ng anak. Ang pagtatalo nina Sally Roberts at Dr. Hilary Jones sa Daybreak ay nagpapakita ng patuloy na hindi pagkakasundo sa paggamot kay Neon. Mas masasaya ang alaala nina Neon at ng kanyang ina bago siya ma-diagnose. Sabi ng mga doktor, 86% ang tsansa ng mga batang gumaling sa kombinasyon ng radiotherapy at chemotherapy, pero bumaba ito sa 67% dahil sa pagkaantala. Iniutos ng korte na manirahan si Neon sa kanyang ama habang ginagamot at ipinagbawal kay Sally na ilayo si Neon mula sa pangangalaga ni Ben. Karaniwang short-term effects ng radiotherapy ay pagkapagod, pagkahilo (na pwedeng gamutin), pagbabawas ng timbang, pagbabago sa balat, at pagkakalbo. Iwasan ang matinding sikat ng araw sa loob ng isang taon matapos ang paggamot. Bihirang long-term risks ay permanenteng pagbabago ng buhok o balat, pagkabaog (kung kasama sa tinarget ng paggamot ang reproductive organs), pamamaga (lymphoedema), pulang marka sa balat, at napakabihirang kaso ng pangalawang cancer. Paliwanag ng mga doktor na madalas mas maliit ang panganib ng radiotherapy kaysa sa benepisyo. Galing ang impormasyon na ito sa Macmillan Cancer Support.
post_content: Neon, age 7, bravely faces brain cancer treatment as his parents clash over what's best: his dad supports medical advice, his mom is worried about side effects. Court sided with doctors saying treatment could save his life. #FamilyStruggle #CancerAwareness #NeonRoberts
translated_post: Matapang na nilalabanan ni Neon, 7, ang brain cancer habang nag-aaway ang mga magulang niya sa tamang gamutan—pabor si papa sa doktor, takot si mama sa side effects. Pumabor ang korte sa mga doktor para mailigtas si Neon. #Pamilya #LabanNiNeon #CancerAwareness

article_content:
As a young Army officer in Vietnam, Jack Jacobs endured an ambush where many of his troops were killed in seconds. Despite suffering serious head wounds, Jacobs made multiple trips through intense enemy fire to rescue wounded comrades, saving 14 lives. He was awarded the Medal of Honor for his remarkable bravery.

Retired Colonel Jacobs and other Medal of Honor recipients are now dedicated to education. They lead the Medal of Honor Character Development Program, which teaches students about character, courage, and selfless service. Jacobs is spearheading fundraising efforts to secure the program’s future, providing teachers with training, educational videos, and lesson plans. Medal of Honor recipients also connect with students directly, in person or via teleconference.

The program is being piloted in 38 states, receiving highly positive feedback from both teachers and students. Many report that they have learned about sacrifice, honor, and courage. As one student observed, referring to the recipients, “The people are 'normal' people, so it could be us that become heroes.”

To sustain the program, the Congressional Medal of Honor Foundation aims to build a $20 million endowment. With only 79 living Medal of Honor recipients remaining—and just four from recent wars—Jacobs stresses the need for urgent action: “Tomorrow is the only thing we can fix.”

Jacobs often highlights the service of others, like Tibor Rubin, a Medal of Honor recipient recognized for courage and selflessness as a prisoner during the Korean War. Jacobs’ humility and dedication capture the values that the program seeks to inspire. This commentary was written by John Bare.
translated_content:
Bilang isang batang opisyal ng Army sa Vietnam, hinarap ni Jack Jacobs ang isang madugong ambush kung saan maraming tropa niya ang namatay sa ilang segundo. Kahit malubha ang sugat sa ulo, paulit-ulit siyang bumalik sa gitna ng matinding putukan upang sagipin ang mga nasugatan niyang kasamahan at nakapagsalba ng 14 na buhay. Ginawaran siya ng Medal of Honor para sa kanyang kakaibang tapang.

Ngayon, naka-focus si retired Colonel Jacobs at iba pang Medal of Honor recipients sa edukasyon. Pinamumunuan nila ang Medal of Honor Character Development Program na nagtuturo sa mga estudyante ng halaga ng karakter, tapang, at walang pag-iimbot na serbisyo. Nangunguna si Jacobs sa fundraising para masigurong magpapatuloy ang programa, na nagpo-provide ng training, educational videos, at lesson plans para sa mga guro. Nakikipag-ugnayan din mismo ang Medal of Honor recipients sa mga estudyante, harapan o sa teleconference.

Ipinapatupad na ang programa sa 38 estado at labis ang positibong tugon ng mga guro at estudyante. Marami sa kanila ang nagsabing natutunan nila ang sakripisyo, dangal, at tapang. Sabi pa nga ng isang estudyante ukol sa mga recipient, “Karaniwang tao lang sila, kaya puwede rin tayong maging bayani.”

Para masiguro ang kinabukasan ng programa, layon ng Congressional Medal of Honor Foundation na makalikom ng $20 milyong endowment. Sa ngayon, 79 na lang ang buhay na Medal of Honor recipients—at apat lang mula sa mga pinakahuling digmaan—kaya't binaon ni Jacobs ang pangangailangan ng mabilisang aksyon: “Bukas lang ang pwede nating ayusin.”

Madalas ding binibigyang-diin ni Jacobs ang kwento ng ibang recipients tulad ni Tibor Rubin, na kinilala sa tapang at sakripisyo bilang bihag sa Korean War. Ang kababaang-loob at dedikasyon ni Jacobs ang mismong mga halaga na nais ituro ng programa. Ang komentaryong ito ay isinulat ni John Bare.

article_content: A panel from the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm announced the winner of the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics on Tuesday. The prize was awarded to three scientists: Pierre Agostini from The Ohio State University in the U.S., Ferenc Krausz from the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich in Germany, and Anne L'Huillier from Lund University in Sweden. Their research has provided new tools for exploring electrons within atoms and molecules by creating extremely short pulses of light, allowing scientists to measure the rapid movements and energy changes of electrons, according to the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. The Nobel Prizes include a monetary award of 11 million Swedish kronor (about $1 million), which comes from the bequest of Swedish inventor Alfred Nobel, who died in 1896. In 2022, three scientists won the Physics Nobel for proving that tiny particles can remain connected even when separated, a phenomenon now being explored for applications like secure information encryption. The 2023 Nobel announcements began with the Medicine Prize awarded to Hungarian-American Katalin Karikó and American Drew Weissman for their work enabling the creation of mRNA vaccines against COVID-19. Further Nobel announcements are scheduled: Chemistry on Wednesday, Literature on Thursday, the Peace Prize on Friday, and the Economics Prize on October 9. Laureates are invited to ceremonies on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel's death. As per Nobel's wishes, the Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo, while the other awards are presented in Stockholm.

Ang kanilang pananaliksik ay nagbigay ng bagong mga kagamitan para pag-aralan ang mga electron sa loob ng mga atomo at molekula gamit ang napakaikling liwanag, na nagbibigay-daan sa mga siyentipiko na masukat ang mabilis na galaw at pagbabago ng enerhiya ng mga electron, ayon sa Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. Noong 2022, tatlong siyentipiko ang nanalo ng Nobel sa Physics dahil pinatunayan nila na ang maliliit na partikula ay maaaring manatiling konektado kahit na magkalayo, isang fenomenong pinag-aaralan na ngayon para sa mga aplikasyon tulad ng ligtas na encryption ng impormasyon. Sinimulan ang mga anunsyo ng 2023 Nobel sa paggawad ng Medicine Prize kina Katalin Karikó na Hungarian-American at Drew Weissman na Amerikano dahil sa kanilang ambag sa pagbuo ng mRNA vaccines laban sa COVID-19. Ang iba pang Nobel announcements ay itinakda: Chemistry sa Miyerkules, Literature sa Huwebes, Peace Prize sa Biyernes, at Economics sa Oktubre 9. Inaanyayahan ang mga laureate sa seremonya tuwing Disyembre 10, anibersaryo ng pagkamatay ni Alfred Nobel. Alinsunod sa kagustuhan ni Nobel, ipinagkakaloob ang Peace Prize sa Oslo, habang ang iba pang parangal ay idinaraos sa Stockholm.

article_content: Richard Williams, father of tennis champions Venus and Serena Williams, is known as a controversial figure who challenged the establishment of the sport. His unconventional coaching methods were crucial in helping his daughters become two of the biggest names in women's tennis, but these came at personal cost. Williams separated from their mother, Oracene Price, and married Lakeisha Graham in 2009. As Venus and Serena's careers advanced, Richard stepped back and became less involved in their coaching. Williams has authored a book titled 'Black and White: The Way I See It,' co-written with Bart Davis. In the autobiography, Williams recounts his early life growing up in severe poverty in Shreveport, Louisiana, as the only son among six children raised by his single mother, Julia Mae, after his father R.D. left the family. He writes candidly about feeling unloved and struggling with his father's abandonment. To help his mother and sisters, Williams resorted to hunting and occasionally stealing food. He became fascinated with stealing at a young age, describing it as a byproduct of his environment and circumstances. At age 12, Williams started a produce garden, selling fruits and vegetables at a farm stand. Some produce he grew himself, while some he admits to stealing from white-owned properties. As the business grew, he was able to provide his family a better home. Williams describes Shreveport as being under the control of the local Ku Klux Klan. He recalls violent incidents involving the Klan, including the murder of a friend, Lil Man, and his own experience of being beaten by three white men while onlookers, including his father, did nothing to intervene. These experiences fueled feelings of anger and a sense of injustice within Williams. Before moving to Chicago, he writes that he sought revenge by attacking a white farmer and his son after obtaining a Klan robe. Williams later married Lakeisha Graham, and they have a young son named Dylan. In addition to his interest in photography, he shares his life story and challenges in his book, published by Atria Books.

Naghiwalay sila ng kanilang ina na si Oracene Price at nagpakasal si Richard kay Lakeisha Graham noong 2009. Habang umuusad ang karera nina Venus at Serena, unti-unting umatras si Richard mula sa aktibong pagko-coach. Nagsulat si Williams ng aklat na may pamagat na 'Black and White: The Way I See It,' kasama si Bart Davis. Sa talambuhay na ito, ikinuwento ni Williams ang kanyang paglaki sa matinding kahirapan sa Shreveport, Louisiana bilang nag-iisang anak na lalaki sa anim na magkakapatid na pinalaki ng kanilang inang si Julia Mae matapos silang iwan ng amang si R.D. Ibinahagi niya ang damdamin ng pagiging unloved at ang hirap ng iniwang relasyon sa kanyang ama. Upang matulungan ang kanyang ina at mga kapatid, napilitan si Williams na manghuli at paminsan-minsan magnakaw ng pagkain. Bata pa lang siya ay nahilig na siya sa pagnanakaw, na inilarawan niyang bunga ng kanyang kapaligiran. Sa edad na 12, nagsimula siyang magtanim sa sariling gulayan at nagbenta ng prutas at gulay. Ang iba ay siya mismo ang nagtanim, ngunit aminado siyang ang iba ay ninakaw niya mula sa mga lupain ng mga puti. Nang lumago ang negosyo, naiangat niya ang kalagayan ng kanilang pamilya. Ikinuwento ni Williams na ang Shreveport ay kontrolado ng Ku Klux Klan. Naranasan at nasaksihan niya ang karahasan ng grupo, kabilang ang pagpatay sa kaibigan niyang si Lil Man, at ang kanyang sariling insidente nang bugbugin siya ng tatlong puting lalaki habang nanonood lang ang kanyang ama at iba pa. Dahil sa mga karanasang ito, napuno siya ng galit at pakiramdam ng kawalang-katarungan. Bago lumipat sa Chicago, sinabi niyang naghanap siya ng paghihiganti at inatake ang isang puting magsasaka at anak nito matapos makakuha ng kasuotang Klan. Kalaunan ay nagpakasal si Williams kay Lakeisha Graham, at nagkaroon sila ng anak na lalaki na si Dylan. Bukod sa pagkahilig sa photography, ibinahagi niya ang kanyang kwento at mga pagsubok sa kanyang aklat na inilathala ng Atria Books.

article_content: Zolgensma, a one-time gene therapy injection for children under two suffering from spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), is once again making headlines in India. Priced at around Rs 17 crore for a single dose, it is one of the most expensive drugs in the world. While Zolgensma is not currently approved in India, it can be imported with a doctor's recommendation and government approval. Recently, Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah appealed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for assistance in securing Zolgensma for a 15-month-old boy battling SMA. The drug was developed by Swiss pharmaceutical company Novartis and is designed to treat SMA, a rare genetic disorder. According to the Cleveland Clinic, SMA affects the nerves and muscles, leading to increased weakness. Though it primarily impacts infants and children, adults can also develop the condition. Estimates suggest that 10,000 to 25,000 people in the United States live with SMA. Dr. N Varsha Monica Reddy, a pediatric neurologist at Yashoda Hospitals in Hyderabad, explained to the Press Trust of India: 'Zolgensma delivers a functional copy of the SMN gene to motor neuron cells, improving muscle movement and function in children with SMA. The gene encodes the SMN protein, which is essential for motor neuron health. Without enough SMN protein, motor neurons die, causing severe and often fatal muscle weakness.' Medical experts note the drug's high cost is due to limited demand and the significant investment required for its research and development. Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan, in a LinkedIn post, emphasized that gene therapies like Zolgensma represent significant medical breakthroughs. However, he questioned how one should value and pay for a one-time therapy that provides lifelong benefits. Dr. Vibhu Kawatra, a pediatrician at Rainbow Children's Hospital in Delhi, told Press Trust of India that Zolgensma's high price is due to R&D expenses and the limited market size. Nevertheless, some experts believe that the long-term benefits of gene therapy may offset overall healthcare costs associated with treating SMA. According to Novartis, Zolgensma is approved in 45 countries, with over 2,500 patients treated through clinical trials, managed access programs, and in commercial settings. The company reports having provided free therapy to nearly 300 children in 36 countries.

Bagamat hindi pa ito aprubado sa India, maaari itong mai-import basta may rekomendasyon ng doktor at pahintulot ng gobyerno. Kamakailan, nanawagan si Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah kay Prime Minister Narendra Modi ng tulong para makakuha ng Zolgensma para sa isang 15-buwang gulang na batang may SMA. Ang gamot ay gawa ng Swiss pharmaceutical company na Novartis at idinisenyo para sa paggamot ng SMA, isang bihirang sakit na genetic. Ayon sa Cleveland Clinic, naaapektuhan ng SMA ang nerves at muscles, dahilan ng unti-unting panghihina ng katawan. Kadalasang bata ang tinatamaan ngunit maaari ring magkaroon ang mga matatanda. Ang gene na ito ay gumagawa ng SMN protein na mahalaga para sa kalusugan ng motor neurons. Kapag kulang ang SMN protein, namamatay ang mga motor neuron, nagdudulot ng malubha at madalas nakamamatay na panghihina ng katawan.' Ayon sa mga eksperto, mataas ang presyo ng gamot dahil kakaunti ang demand at malaki ang ginastos sa research at development. Binanggit ni Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan sa LinkedIn na malaking medikal na tagumpay ang mga gene therapy gaya ng Zolgensma, pero malaking tanong kung paano babayaran at bibigyan ng halaga ang isang therapy na isang beses lang gawin subalit habangbuhay ang benepisyo. Ayon sa Novartis, aprubado na ang Zolgensma sa 45 bansa, may higit 2,500 pasyente na ang nabigyan ng therapy sa clinical trials, managed access programs, at commercial settings. Iniulat din ng kumpanya na halos 300 bata sa 36 na bansa ang nabigyan ng libreng therapy.

article_content: At the Valdai Club conference on Thursday, Russian President Vladimir Putin openly speculated about the consequences if Western support for Ukraine diminishes. 'Imagine, if the supply is cut off tomorrow, you'll have a week to live, when the ammunition runs out,' Putin told the audience. He has long pursued a strategy aimed at weakening Western resolve in supporting Ukraine amid the ongoing Russian invasion. Recently, there have been signs that Putin’s patience might be rewarded. In the United States, Congress remains divided on sending additional aid to Ukraine, particularly as House Republicans—many of whom oppose such support—recently ousted Speaker Kevin McCarthy. Meanwhile, in Slovakia, a far-right party opposed to Ukraine aid won the general election, and in Germany, support for the far-right AfD is rising amid similar rhetoric. With the possibility of high fuel prices and inflation this winter, public support for substantial aid packages could decline further. President Joe Biden has vowed to back Ukraine 'as long as it takes,' but some analysts question whether this promise can be sustained. George Beebe, former head of the CIA’s Russia analysis unit, noted: 'Putin is fighting a war of attrition, betting that Ukraine lacks sufficient population, weapons, and ammunition to sustain the war, and that the West lacks both the capacity and political will for long-term support.' Putin initially hoped to capture Kyiv quickly but, confronted by fierce Ukrainian resistance, shifted to a slower, grinding strategy. Analysts suggest a war of attrition benefits Russia, given its larger population and ability to produce more weapons and ammunition than Ukraine, whose economy is heavily reliant on Western support. 'There are increasing signs Putin may be correct,' Beebe told Insider. 'Ukraine is falling short of conscription targets, its economy is under strain, and enthusiasm for high levels of aid is waning in both the US and Europe.' Should Western aid dry up and Ukrainian resistance falter, Russia could potentially turn Ukraine into a failed state in perpetual crisis. Yet, Putin's approach has risks. Although Ukraine's counteroffensive has not yielded a decisive breakthrough, advances in the south have challenged Russian resolve. Significant Ukrainian successes could trigger renewed Western support and erode Putin’s standing at home, where he already faces economic stagnation and a military struggling with morale and outdated equipment. According to Lawrence Freedman, an emeritus professor at King's College London, 'Military success can have ripple effects. Putin’s other problems—economic troubles, public opinion, and the state of the armed forces—could become more acute with additional military setbacks.' Beebe adds that Putin’s strategy depends on the Russian public and elites maintaining patience with a 'go slow' approach. These tensions were evident in June, when the Wagner mercenary group staged a rebellion against Russian military leaders over what they viewed as excessive caution and inefficiency in Ukraine. Although Putin suppressed the uprising and its leader Yevgeny Prigozhin died in a mysterious plane crash in August, the underlying divisions remain. Recently, Ukraine has intensified attacks inside Russia using long-range drones, striking targets such as estates near Moscow and the strategic Crimean bridge. Some attacks appear intended to provoke Putin into significant retaliation, potentially shifting international public opinion. 'Putin is aware of these dangers,' Beebe said. 'He has repeatedly claimed that Ukraine and its Western allies are trying to draw him into a trap and deviate from his attrition strategy. Whether he can stay the course remains to be seen.'

Matagal niya nang sinusubukan pahinain ang determinasyon ng Kanluran sa pagsuporta sa Ukraine sa gitna ng patuloy na pananakop ng Russia. Kamakailan, may mga palatandaang maaaring magtagumpay ang taktika niya. Sa Estados Unidos, hati pa rin ang Kongreso tungkol sa pagbibigay ng dagdag na tulong sa Ukraine, lalo na matapos patalsikin ng ilang House Republicans—na tutol sa suporta—si Speaker Kevin McCarthy. Sa Slovakia, nanalo ang isang far-right na partido na tutol din sa tulong para sa Ukraine. Sa Germany naman, lumalakas ang suporta sa far-right AfD dahil sa kaparehong mga argumento. Dahil posibleng tumaas ang presyo ng langis at inflasyon ngayong taglamig, maaaring humina pa lalo ang pampublikong suporta sa malalaking ayuda. Ipinangako ni US President Joe Biden na susuportahan ang Ukraine 'hanggang kailanman,' pero may mga analistang nagdududa kung kakayanin nga ito. Ani George Beebe, dating hepe ng CIA Russia analysis unit: 'Si Putin ay lumalaban gamit ang war of attrition, umaasang kulang sa tao, armas, at bala ang Ukraine, at kulang naman ang Kanluran sa kakayahan at political will na magpatuloy sa suporta.' Una sanang plano ni Putin na mabilis sakupin ang Kyiv, ngunit dahil sa matinding paglaban ng Ukraine, napilitan siyang baguhin ang estratehiya at magpakabagal. Sabi ng mga eksperto, mas pabor ang war of attrition sa Russia dahil mas marami itong populasyon at kayang gumawa ng sandata kumpara sa Ukraine na malaki ang inaasahan sa tulong mula sa Kanluran. 'Dumarami ang senyales na tama si Putin,' ani Beebe sa Insider. 'Hindi naaabot ng Ukraine ang mga target ng conscription, bagsak ang ekonomiya, at humihina ang sigla ng US at Europe sa malakihang ayuda.' Kapag tuluyang nawala ang suporta at humina ang pagtutol ng Ukraine, puwedeng gawing 'failed state' na laging may krisis ang Ukraine ng Russia. Ngunit may panganib din para kay Putin. Wala mang malaking tagumpay ang kontra opensiba ng Ukraine, may mga pagsulong sa timog na hinahamon ang determinasyon ng Russia. Ang mga makabuluhang tagumpay ng Ukraine ay puwedeng magdulot ng panibagong suporta mula Kanluran at tanggalan ng kredibilidad si Putin sa kanyang bansa, lalo na’t humaharap siya sa mabagal na ekonomiya at militar na mababa ang moral at luma ang gamit. Ayon kay Lawrence Freedman, emeritus professor sa King's College London, 'Malaki ang epekto ng tagumpay sa labanan. Lalo pang lalala ang ibang problema ni Putin—ekonomiya, opinyon ng publiko, at katayuan ng militar—kung dadami ang kabiguan sa labanan.' Sabi rin ni Beebe, nakaasa ang estratehiya ni Putin sa pagtitiis at pasensya ng mga Ruso at mga elite sa 'go slow' na lapit. Lumabas ang mga tensyon nitong Hunyo nang mag-aklas ang Wagner mercenary group laban sa mga lider militar ng Russia dahil umano sa sobrang pag-iingat at hindi epektibong estratehiya sa Ukraine. Napigil ni Putin ang rebelyon at namatay si Yevgeny Prigozhin, lider ng grupo, sa misteryosong pagbagsak ng eroplano noong Agosto—pero buhay pa rin ang mga hidwaan. Kamakailan, pinaigting ng Ukraine ang mga pag-atake sa loob ng Russia gamit ang long-range drones, na tumarget sa mga lugar gaya ng mansion sa labas ng Moscow at mahalagang Crimean bridge. Mukhang layon ng ilan sa mga ito na galitin si Putin at himukin siyang gumanti, na maaaring magbago ng opinyon ng international publiko. 'Alam ni Putin ang mga panganib na ito,' ani Beebe. 'Paulit-ulit niyang sinasabing sinusubukan ng Ukraine at ng mga Western allies na ilagay siya sa bitag at ilihis mula sa attrition strategy niya. Kung kakayanin niyang panindigan ang taktika ay malalaman pa lamang.'

article_content: Former President George W. Bush stated on Thursday that his brother, Jeb Bush, the former Governor of Florida, is interested in becoming president but has not yet decided whether he will run in the 2016 election. In an interview on Fox News Channel, George W. Bush shared that he encouraged Jeb to enter the presidential race. 'I, of course, was pushing him to run for president. He, of course, was saying, "I haven't made up my mind."' The former president added that he genuinely believes Jeb has not made a final decision and may be uncomfortable with pressure from his older brother. Jeb Bush, a prominent figure in a potentially crowded Republican field for 2016, has not indicated if he intends to campaign for the presidency. His absence from public events has contributed to average polling numbers. Many moderate Republicans are urging him to run, seeing him as an alternative to another campaign by former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney. However, the party's more conservative 'tea party' wing criticizes Jeb Bush, labeling him as a 'RINO' (Republican in Name Only). George W. Bush expressed his belief that Jeb wants to be president and would make an excellent leader, highlighting Jeb's familiarity with the presidency through their family’s experience. Describing his brother as thoughtful and considerate, George said Jeb is carefully weighing his options. When asked about President Barack Obama's decisions regarding military engagement in the Middle East, George W. Bush declined to criticize, saying it is not his role to second-guess a sitting president. He noted that he agreed with General Martin Dempsey's recommendation to keep a residual American force in Iraq, rather than a complete withdrawal. Bush emphasized that the sitting president and his team must make the most informed decisions possible. George W. Bush also expressed confidence in Joe Clancy, the interim Secret Service director following Julia Pierson's departure, saying he trusts Clancy's judgment and expects him to perform well. Reflecting on his post-presidency, Bush shared that he does not miss Washington, apart from some perks of the office. He spends his time working on his memoirs and painting, staying largely out of the public eye. Bush also mentioned that he misses saluting the men and women serving in the military, making a lighthearted remark regarding President Obama's 'latte salute.'

article_content: Peachtree City Police Chief William McCollom is under investigation after he allegedly shot his wife, Margaret, early New Year’s Day at their home in Georgia. The incident occurred just after 4 a.m., when Chief McCollom called 911 to report accidentally shooting his wife with his service weapon, a Glock 17 9mm, in their bedroom. Margaret McCollom, 58, was airlifted to Atlanta Medical Center, where she remains in critical condition. Authorities initially believed she had been shot twice, but later confirmed she sustained a single gunshot wound. The Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) has taken over the case and will present its findings to the District Attorney, who will determine whether charges will be filed. GBI Director Sherry Lang said that Chief McCollom is cooperating fully with investigators. As a result of the ongoing investigation, Chief McCollom has been placed on paid administrative leave by the city manager. No charges have been filed, and Chief McCollom has not been arrested. He has served as police chief since October, previously holding the role of assistant chief and joining the department in 2012. Margaret McCollom is a licensed practical nurse and former emergency room worker, according to her Facebook profile. Neighbors describe the couple as loving and supportive, stating they have never observed any issues at the home. Peachtree City police officers have expressed concern for both the chief and his wife during this difficult time.

article_content: The highly anticipated 19th Africa Movie Academy Awards took place on October 29, 2023, at the Balmoral Convention Centre in Lagos, drawing filmmakers and creatives from Africa and around the globe. This annual gathering celebrates excellence and fresh perspectives in African cinema. Nancy Isime, Rahama Sadau, and Richard Ato Turkson hosted the night, as the crowd honored landmark achievements and artistic brilliance. C.J. ‘Fiery’ Obasi’s ‘Mami Wata’ led the nominations with 12 nods and secured key awards, including Best Nigerian Film and Best Cinematography. Apolline Traore was awarded Best Director for ‘Sira,’ while ‘Xalé’ from Senegal took the Best Film honor. Other noteworthy winners included ‘Lions’ (Ethiopia) for Best Short Film, ‘Jabari’ (Ghana) for Best Animation, and ‘Le Spectre de Boko Haram’ (Cameroon) for Best Documentary. Diaspora creators like ‘Raw Materials’ (Jamaica) and ‘Sound of the Police’ (USA) were also celebrated, marking the global impact of African narratives. The event underscored themes of unity, diversity, and the importance of cross-border collaborations, reflecting the influential reach of African cinema today.

article_content: Hop (Humulus lupulus L. var. Lupulus) is a diploid, wind-pollinated perennial plant, notable for its vital role in brewing and flavoring. Its female inflorescences contain lupulin glands—glandular trichomes that synthesize and store resins, bitter acids, essential oils, and flavonoids. Among hop varieties, Cascade is widely grown in America and is renowned for its floral and citrus aroma. Optimal hop cultivation occurs between 35° and 55° latitude in both the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Both Humulus (hop) and Cannabis belong to the Cannabaceae family, though the precise timing of their evolutionary divergence remains debated. The emergence of new genomic data now makes it possible to reassess and more accurately estimate these divergence events. The hop genome is notably large and highly heterozygous. Despite previous attempts using long-read sequencing, genome assemblies remained fragmented, leaving the order of genome contigs unresolved. High-quality, contiguous genome sequences are crucial for studying gene organization and synteny. A study published in Horticulture Research titled "An improved assembly of the 'Cascade' hop (Humulus lupulus) genome uncovers signatures of molecular evolution and refines time of divergence estimates for the Cannabaceae family" presents an improved assembly of the Cascade hop genome. Researchers analyzed the genome's content, organization, and evolutionary history. The initial PacBio primary assembly, used to anchor scaffolds, was around 3.71 Gb in size and was enhanced using the Dovetail Hi-C method. The assembly’s N50—a measure of sequence contiguity—rose from 673 kb with PacBio to 345.208 Mb with Dovetail Hi-C, dramatically increasing genome continuity. About 93.6% of the assembled genome was captured in the largest 10 scaffolds, which likely represent the 10 hop chromosomes. The polished Dovetail assembly had a GC content of 39.13% and just 0.022% ambiguous (N) bases. Researchers found an enrichment of CHH trinucleotides linked to DNA methylation, which regulates key plant gene functions. Assembly completeness, assessed using BUSCO, improved after polishing and better matched earlier hop genome studies. The genome size was estimated at roughly 3.058 Gb, with heterozygosity around 4.59%–5.47%, and repetitive sequences comprising 64.25% of the genome. The genetic map revealed 10 linkage groups, with average genetic distances of 0.35 cM and about 409 markers per group. Gene model prediction combined Transdecoder and MAKER tools, with Transdecoder identifying 94.9% of its models on the top 10 scaffolds. Gene model completeness was verified with BUSCO. Repeat-associated models were filtered out based on similarity to Pfam domains and UniProt genes. In total, 23,583 genes matched UniProt Embryophyta, and after further filtering, 30,404 gene models remained for additional analyses. Using OrthoFinder, comparisons to seven other plant species revealed 22,739 orthologous gene groups. Visualization of gene and long terminal repeat (LTR) densities on the 10 major scaffolds—using circos plots—showed higher gene densities at the chromosome ends. Notably, the third largest scaffold held significant sex-associated markers, suggesting it is the X chromosome. Most syntenic blocks appeared within individual scaffolds. Comparisons between hop and hemp genomes highlighted substantial sequence similarities and revealed unique sequences exclusive to hop chromosomes. Analysis of defense and terpene genes in syntenic blocks indicated that chromosome 8 could be a valuable focus for future defense gene research. Molecular evolution analysis, based on synonymous substitution rates (Ks), estimated the divergence between hop and hemp at 16.013 million years ago, and between Humulus and Cannabis at approximately 22.64 million years ago, as determined using a fossil-calibrated timetree. An orthologous gene analysis detected expansions and contractions in hop gene families, leading to insights into their functional enrichment. Overall, this groundbreaking work advances understanding of hop evolution, defense, and metabolism. The new Cascade chromosome-level assembly is expected to inform future research in hop gene organization, cultivar variation, and broader Cannabaceae family genomics.

Pinagsama ang Transdecoder at MAKER para tukuyin ang mga gene model, kung saan 94.9% ng Transdecoder models ay nasa 10 pinakamalaking scaffold. Sinuri ang completeness gamit ang BUSCO. Ang repeat-associated models ay inalis batay sa pagkakapareho sa Pfam domains at UniProt genes. Naitala ang 23,583 genes na hawig sa UniProt Embryophyta, at pagkaraan ng karagdagang pag-filter, 30,404 gene models ang napiling isama sa mga pag-aaral. Sa circos plots ng gene at long terminal repeat (LTR) density sa 10 pangunahing scaffold, mas makapal ang gene density sa mga dulo. Ang ikatlong pinakamalaking scaffold ay may mahahalagang sex-associated markers, kaya tinuturing na posibleng X chromosome. Karamihan ng syntenic blocks ay nasa loob ng mga scaffold. Sa paghahambing ng hop at hemp genome, kitang-kita ang pagkakahawig ng sequence at natukoy din ang natatanging bahagi ng hop chromosomes. Ang pag-aaral ng defense at terpene genes sa syntenic blocks ay nagmungkahing dapat pagtuunan ng pansin ang chromosome 8 para sa defense genes. Sa molekular na pagsusuri gamit ang Ks, tinatayang naghiwalay ang hop at hemp 16.013 milyong taon na ang nakalipas, at ang pagitan ng Humulus at Cannabis ay mga 22.64 milyong taon na ang nakararaan batay sa fossil-calibrated timetree. Ang orthologous gene analysis ay nagpakita ng expansion at contraction sa hop gene families, na nagbibigay-liwanag sa kanilang function. Sa kabuuan, ang makabagong pag-aaral na ito ay nagbibigay-daan sa mas malalim na pag-unawa sa evolution, defense, at metabolism ng hop. Inaasahang magagamit ang bagong Cascade chromosome-level assembly para sa mga susunod na pananaliksik ng organization, structural variation ng hop cultivars, at mas malawak na genomes ng Cannabaceae.

article_content: If the woman in your life seemed a bit irritable after waking up today, there’s a scientific explanation—studies show that women require more sleep than men, though many aren’t getting enough. Research conducted in the United States found that when women don’t get sufficient rest, they face greater mental and physical health risks than men, including a higher likelihood of heart disease, depression, increased blood clotting that could result in strokes, and more pain due to higher inflammation. Sleep specialist Dr. Michael Breus notes that these factors can make mornings especially tough for women. The study from Duke University further found men’s health seems less affected by sleep deprivation. Dr. Breus observed that women who don’t sleep enough tend to be more prone to anger and irritability, particularly early in the day. He recommends targeted naps—either 25 or 90 minutes in length—to help mitigate sleep loss, as naps of other durations might make people feel worse. The theory that women need more sleep isn’t new; Professor Jim Horne from Loughborough University discovered that women may need around 20 extra minutes of sleep nightly, pointing to women’s multitasking and greater brain usage during the day. Horne explains that the more a person’s brain is used, the more recovery and sleep they require. Men with cognitively demanding jobs may also need more rest, but typically not as much as women.
translated_content: Kung sa tingin mo ay naging masungit ang babae sa buhay mo pag-gising niya ngayong umaga, may dahilan ito ayon sa agham—ipinapakita ng mga pag-aaral na mas kailangan ng tulog ng mga babae kaysa sa mga lalaki, pero madalas ay kulang sila sa pahinga. Lumalabas sa pananaliksik mula sa Amerika na kapag kulang sa tulog ang mga babae, mas malaki ang posibilidad na magkaroon sila ng mga problemang mental at pisikal, tulad ng sakit sa puso, depresyon, pamumuo ng dugo na maaaring magdulot ng stroke, at mas mataas na antas ng pananakit dahil sa inflammation. Ayon kay Dr. Michael Breus, isang eksperto sa pagtulog, mas mahirap talaga ang umaga para sa mga babae dahil dito. Napag-alaman din sa Duke University na ang kalusugan ng mga lalaki ay hindi gaanong naaapektuhan ng kakulangan sa tulog. Sinabi pa ni Dr. Breus na ang mga babaeng kulang sa tulog ay mas madaling magalit o mainis tuwing umaga. Irerekomenda niya ang maikling tulog o power nap na 25 o 90 minuto para makatulong, dahil kung hindi ganito ang haba, mas manghihina pa ang pakiramdam. Hindi rin bago ang ideyang ito; ayon kay Propesor Jim Horne ng Loughborough University, kailangan ng mga babae ng dagdag na 20 minuto ng tulog gabi-gabi, dahil madalas silang multi-tasker at maraming bahagi ng utak ang ginagamit nila araw-araw. Paliwanag ni Horne, habang mas ginagamit ang utak, mas mahaba ang oras ng pag-recover at mas maraming tulog ang kailangan. Kahit ang mga lalaking may mahihirap na trabaho ay maaaring mangailangan din ng dagdag na tulog, pero madalas ay hindi kasing dami ng mga babae.

article_content: Ben Shelton clinched his first ATP Tour title on Sunday by defeating Russia's Aslan Karatsev 7-5, 6-1 at the Japan Open in Tokyo. The 21-year-old American completed the victory in just 84 minutes at the ATP 500 event. As a result, Shelton will achieve a career-high ranking of No. 15 when the new rankings are published on Monday. He is the sixth player this season to capture his maiden ATP title. During the match, the left-handed Shelton hit 18 winners, won 80 percent of his first-serve points, and converted four of six break opportunities. He now leads Karatsev 2-0 in head-to-head meetings. Over his last 16 matches, Shelton has compiled a 14-2 record and recently reached the quarterfinals in Shanghai. At the European Open in Antwerp, Belgium, third seed Alexander Bublik secured his third career ATP title with a 6-4, 6-4 victory over fourth seed Arthur Fils of France in the final. Bublik tallied 28 winners and saved all three break points to overcome the 19-year-old Fils, who made history as the youngest finalist in the tournament's history. The 26-year-old Kazakh player fired 11 aces and won 36 of 37 points on his first serve, wrapping up the match in 75 minutes. In Stockholm at the BNP Paribas Nordic Open, France’s Gael Monfils earned his 12th ATP title after rallying to defeat Russian qualifier Pavel Kotov 4-6, 7-6(6), 6-3 in the final. The 37-year-old Monfils delivered seven aces and, by winning in two hours and 37 minutes, became the oldest champion in the tournament’s history. Monfils had previously won this event in 2021. Kotov managed to convert 68 percent of his first serves but committed seven double faults.

article_content: This year’s Portrait of Britain celebrates diversity, empathy, and authenticity, according to event organizers. The exhibition’s 200 shortlisted portraits, drawn from all over the UK—including many from the West Midlands—offer snapshots into a variety of lives and communities. Among the featured subjects are Herefordshire cobbler Nick Turner, who has run his solo business for 36 years despite being advised otherwise, participants in a neighbourhood project in Stoke-on-Trent, and a father photographed in his Coventry garden. Out of these 200 shortlisted photos, 100 winning images will appear on digital advertising screens in shopping centres, high streets, and transport hubs nationwide. Mick Moore, the CEO of the British Journal of Photography, which leads the competition, describes the exhibition as a celebration of ‘the quirky, the mundane, and the extraordinary everyday.’ The entire shortlist is also included in the Portrait of Britain Vol 6 book, published in partnership with Bluecoat Press and sponsored by JCDecaux. For updates, visit BBC West Midlands on Facebook, X, or Instagram, or send your own story ideas to their newsroom.

Ilan sa mga tampok ay si Nick Turner, isang cobbler mula Herefordshire na pinayuhang huwag magtrabaho mag-isa ngunit matagumpay na pinatakbo ang kanyang negosyo ng 36 na taon, mga kasali sa proyekto sa komunidad sa Stoke-on-Trent, at isang ama na kinunan ng retrato sa kanyang bakuran sa Coventry. Mula sa 200 larawang ito, pipiliin ang 100 na itatanghal sa mga digital advertising screens sa mga shopping centre, high streets, at transport hubs sa buong bansa. Para sa updates, bisitahin ang BBC West Midlands sa Facebook, X, o Instagram, o magpadala ng mga kwento sa kanilang newsroom.

World-renowned reptile expert and TV wildlife presenter Mark O'Shea, 56, was airlifted to hospital after being bitten by a 10-foot king cobra at West Midlands Safari Park. The incident occurred during a routine feeding session when the highly venomous snake bit O'Shea on the leg. King cobra venom is potent enough to kill an elephant. Thanks to the swift action of first aid staff equipped with anti-venom, O'Shea suffered no serious effects. Paramedics quickly arrived, and O'Shea was airlifted to Worcester Royal Hospital as a precaution, where he was reported stable and expected to be discharged soon.

O'Shea, best known for presenting wildlife series on the Discovery Channel and Channel 4, minimized the seriousness of the bite, calling it "just a nick." He noted that accidents sometimes happen in his line of work and praised the emergency response. Bob Lawrence, head keeper at the safari park, explained that the incident was rare and happened while the animal was fed behind closed doors. He added that strict safety measures are in place for working with dangerous animals.

King cobras, the longest venomous snakes, can grow up to 18.5 feet and inhabit the forests and plains of India, southern China, and Southeast Asia. Their venom, while not the most potent, is strong enough to kill an elephant or 20 people. They feed mainly on other snakes. Though generally shy, king cobras are aggressive when threatened.

The West Midlands Safari Park keeps anti-venom and regularly practices emergency scenarios with local hospitals. The ambulance service responded promptly, treating O'Shea onsite before transporting him to hospital. O'Shea, who has participated in over 60 expeditions to nearly 40 countries, has previously survived several venomous bites. He remains fascinated by reptiles, a passion he has pursued for nearly fifty years.

article_content: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, has stated that the company will "never rule out" the possibility of creating its own AI chips, as it faces a worldwide shortage of crucial processors. Speaking at The Wall Street Journal's Tech Live event, Altman clarified that although OpenAI is not currently developing custom chips, realizing its goal of achieving general artificial intelligence may require this step in the future. Altman explained, "We are trying to determine what it will take to scale and to deliver what we believe the world will want, at the scale our research supports. This might not require custom hardware, and we currently have excellent partnerships with organizations doing incredible work — so our default path is to continue as we are. Still, I’d never rule out building our own chips." Earlier this month, Reuters reported that OpenAI was exploring the development of proprietary chips to power its language models, such as ChatGPT. The company currently relies on its partnership with Microsoft for vast computing resources. In 2020, Microsoft built OpenAI a massive supercomputer utilizing 10,000 advanced Nvidia GPUs. Should OpenAI pursue its own chip development, it would potentially alter the dynamic of its close relationship with Microsoft, who agreed to invest $10 billion in OpenAI earlier this year. Advanced processors, like Nvidia’s H100 “Hopper” GPU, are essential for training and running large language models such as GPT-4. The surge in AI development has led to a global shortage of these microchips as companies and governments compete for supply. Nvidia currently commands over 80% of the global AI chip market. Altman indicated that increased demand could eventually result in more competitors entering the market, potentially alleviating shortages and driving down prices. "Nvidia certainly has something amazing," Altman said. "But the magic of capitalism is at work—many others are trying, and we’ll see how it all unfolds." OpenAI did not immediately respond to Insider’s request for comment, which was made outside of regular business hours.

Sa isang talumpati sa Tech Live event ng The Wall Street Journal, nilinaw ni Altman na bagamat hindi sila kasalukuyang gumagawa ng custom chips, maaring kailanganin ito para matupad ang pangarap nilang magkaroon ng general artificial intelligence sa hinaharap. "Sinusubukan naming alamin kung ano ang kakailanganin para makapag-scale at makapaghatid ng gusto naming maibigay sa mundo, batay sa kayang suportahan ng aming pananaliksik. Maaring hindi nito kailangan ng custom hardware, at ngayon ay mahusay ang aming mga partnership sa mga organisasyong gumagawa ng magagandang bagay—kaya ang normal naming direksyon ay ipagpatuloy ito. Pero hindi ko isinasara ang posibilidad ng paggawa ng sarili naming chips," ani Altman. Iniulat ng Reuters nitong buwan na sinusuri ng OpenAI ang paggawa ng sarili nitong chips para tumakbo ang mga language models nila gaya ng ChatGPT. Sa ngayon, umaasa ang kumpanya sa partnership nila sa Microsoft para sa malaking computing power. Noong 2020, gumawa ang Microsoft ng napakalaking supercomputer para sa OpenAI gamit ang 10,000 advanced na Nvidia GPUs. Kapag itinuloy ng OpenAI ang paggawa ng sarili nitong chips, maaaring baguhin nito ang dynamics ng malapit nitong relasyon sa Microsoft, na pumayag mag-invest ng $10 bilyon sa OpenAI ngayong taon. Ang mga advanced na processor tulad ng Nvidia H100 'Hopper' GPU ay mahalaga para sa pag-train at pagpapatakbo ng malalaking language models gaya ng GPT-4. Dahil sa pagsigla ng AI, dumami ang kakulangan ng mga microchip global dahil sa patinding kumpetisyon ng mga kumpanya at bansa para sa supply. Sa ngayon, kontrolado ng Nvidia ang mahigit 80% ng global AI chip market. Ayon kay Altman, ang tumataas na demand ay maaaring magdulot ng mas maraming kakompetensiya sa merkado, na posibleng makatulong sa pagresolba ng kakulangan at pagbawas ng presyo. "Kahanga-hanga talaga ang nagawa ng Nvidia," sabi niya. "Pero umaandar ang magic ng kapitalismo—marami pa ang sumusubok, at titignan natin kung paano ito mauuwi." Hindi agad tumugon ang OpenAI sa request ng Insider para sa komento, na ginawa sa labas ng regular na oras ng trabaho.

article_content: Supreme Court nominee Sonia Sotomayor is set to make history not only as a Hispanic candidate but also by strengthening a major demographic trend on the U.S. Supreme Court: a prominent Catholic presence. If she is confirmed, Sotomayor would be the sixth Catholic among nine justices, a notable development considering Catholics comprise only about a quarter of the U.S. population. Barbara Perry, a government professor at Sweetbriar College and Supreme Court historian, observes that the Court has shifted from having a single 'Catholic seat' to what could now be termed a 'Catholic court.' Of the 110 individuals who have served as Supreme Court justices, only 11 have been Catholic, yet five—Samuel Alito, Anthony Kennedy, Antonin Scalia, Clarence Thomas, and Chief Justice John Roberts—currently serve. Perry credits recent Republican presidents for the rise in Catholic justices, noting that their socially conservative views align with the party's criteria for nominations. Bill Donohue, President of the Catholic League, believes that Catholics have an easier confirmation process than evangelical candidates, as the label 'religious right' is not typically associated with Catholics. Donohue also highlights the disciplined education in Catholic schools as contributing to the legal expertise of many justices. Several current justices, including Roberts, Scalia, Thomas, and Sotomayor, attended Catholic schools during their upbringing. In contrast, back in the mid-1980s, only one Catholic, William J. Brennan, Jr., sat on the Court, underlining how quickly this demographic has grown. The present Supreme Court also includes two Jewish justices, Stephen Breyer and Ruth Bader Ginsburg. Should Sotomayor join, John Paul Stevens would remain the only Protestant justice on a bench formerly dominated by white Protestant men. Analysts are considering the potential impact of a Catholic majority on Supreme Court decisions, referencing the 2007 case Gonzales v. Carhart, where five Catholic justices voted to uphold a ban on late-term abortion. Sotomayor’s judicial record indicates limited involvement with abortion cases, and her stances on other key issues are not yet clear. Although Donohue expects Sotomayor to be more liberal compared to the other Catholic justices, he supports her nomination, saying he feels a sense of solidarity despite their differing ideologies.

Kapag siya ay nakumpirma, magiging ika-anim siyang Katoliko sa siyam na mahistrado, na kapansin-pansin dahil isa lang sa apat na Amerikano ang Katoliko. Ayon kay Barbara Perry, propesor ng gobyerno sa Sweetbriar College at historyador ng Supreme Court, nagbago na ang Korte mula sa tinatawag na ‘Katolikong upuan’ tungo sa tinutukoy ngayong ‘Katolikong Korte.’ Sa 110 mahistradong nagsilbi sa Supreme Court, labing-isa lamang ang Katoliko, pero lima sa kanila—sina Samuel Alito, Anthony Kennedy, Antonin Scalia, Clarence Thomas, at Chief Justice John Roberts—ang kasalukuyang nagsisilbi. Ipinaliwanag ni Perry na tumaas ang bilang ng mga Katolikong mahistrado dahil karamihan sa kanila ay hinirang ng mga Republican president, na mas nagtutulak ng konservatibong pananaw. Ayon kay Bill Donohue, presidente ng Catholic League, mas madaling kumpirmahin ang mga Katolikong nominado kaysa mga evangelical dahil hindi sila madalas nauugnay sa ‘religious right.’ Dagdag pa niya, ang edukasyon sa Katolikong paaralan ay nagsanay ng mga hukom na may matibay na batayan sa batas. Kabilang sa mga mahistradong nag-aral sa Katolikong paaralan sina Roberts, Scalia, Thomas, at Sotomayor. Noong 1980s, iisa lamang ang Katolikong hukom—si William J. Brennan, Jr.—kaya kitang-kita ang mabilis na pagbabago sa komposisyon ng Korte. Kasama rin ngayon sa Supreme Court ang dalawang Hudyong mahistrado, sina Stephen Breyer at Ruth Bader Ginsburg. Kung makukumpirma si Sotomayor, si John Paul Stevens na lang ang Protestanteng mahistrado—isang malaking pagbabago mula sa panahong pinamumunuan ng mga white Protestant. Pinag-uusapan ng mga tagamasid kung paano maaapektuhan ng mayoryang Katoliko ang mga desisyon ng Korte Suprema. Halimbawa, sa kasong Gonzales v. Carhart noong 2007, bumoto ang limang Katolikong hukom na ipatupad ang pagbabawal sa late-term abortion. Hindi pa gaanong malinaw kung saan papanig si Sotomayor sa mga isyung tulad ng aborsyon at iba pang panlipunang isyu. Bagamat mas liberal umano si Sotomayor kaysa sa iba pang Katolikong mahistrado, nananatili ang suporta ni Donohue sa kanyang nominasyon, at aniya ay may pagkakapareho pa rin silang nararamdaman kahit magkaiba sila ng posisyon.

article_content: Usually, defenders are the ones who set the tone early by challenging strikers. With Diego Costa, the dynamic is reversed. He seems to relish confrontation and almost invites defenders to rile him up, as it often brings out his best. To handle Costa effectively, one must outmatch him in strength, speed, and anticipation. Currently, Costa could be facing a three-match suspension following an FA charge for stamping on Liverpool's Emre Can. He also clashed with Martin Skrtel during the same game after another stamping incident. Defenders have to act swiftly and stay ahead of him—which can be risky, since if Costa breaks free, he's incredibly difficult to catch. Matching his physical approach is necessary, even if it risks penalties or ejections. However, Costa isn't just aggressive—he demonstrates sharp link-up play and considerable skill, drawing comparisons to Didier Drogba. Still, his actions—like the stamp on Skrtel for which he wasn't dismissed—have fueled debate over officiating decisions.

Sa ngayon, maaaring masuspinde siya ng tatlong laro matapos siyang kasuhan ng FA dahil sa pag-stamp kay Emre Can ng Liverpool. Nakipagsagupan din siya kay Martin Skrtel sa parehong laro matapos ang isa pang insidente ng stamping. Kailangang maagap ang mga defender at maunahan siya—delikado ito dahil kapag nakatakas si Costa, mahirap na siyang habulin. Kailangan tapatan ang pisikal niyang laro kahit malagay sa panganib ng foul o pagpapatalsik. Pero hindi lang siya puro agresibo—magaling din siyang mag-connect sa teammates at may husay, kaya naikumpara siya kay Didier Drogba. Pero dahil sa mga nagawa niya—tulad ng stamp kay Skrtel na hindi siya napalayas—nagkaroon ng usapan tungkol sa mga tawag ng referees.

article_content: Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology is 'too important not to get right,' a top Google executive told the BBC. Matt Brittin, president of Google for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, said AI offers the potential for significant breakthroughs across various industries. The global debate over the risks and rewards of AI continues. Brittin spoke as Google announced a partnership with the University of Cambridge for joint research. As part of this collaboration, Google will provide funding to establish the new Centre for Human-Inspired AI, where researchers from both Cambridge and Google will work together. This long-term agreement will address topics including robotics, healthcare, and climate change. The partnership comes ahead of the UK AI safety summit at Bletchley Park, where the government aims to gather leading industry figures. The agreement follows increased debate about AI’s potential benefits and efforts by regulators around the world to create frameworks for this rapidly developing field. Brittin said: 'If we get it right, there could be major breakthroughs in health, unlimited clean energy, and a society where everyone benefits from education and intelligent technologies. This is a major opportunity.' Zoubin Ghahramani, vice president of research at Google DeepMind and a professor at Cambridge, told the BBC that research at the new centre could help address climate challenges. For example, AI tools have been used to optimise flight routes to reduce contrails—vapour trails left by airplanes. Professor Ghahramani noted that while this use might not be obvious, it is valuable for addressing the effects of air travel. Brittin explained that sustainability and climate solutions have long been a focus for Google and DeepMind, including efforts to lower energy use in their data centres. 'I joined the company in 2007, which was the year we reached carbon neutrality and became one of the world’s largest buyers of renewable energy,' Brittin said. He added that Google's recent UK power purchase agreements mean that, by 2025, the company’s services in the UK will operate almost entirely on carbon-free energy. Brittin also highlighted projects such as optimising traffic light sequences to lower pollution and helping users find fuel-efficient routes or optimal solar panel locations via Google Maps. However, some academics warn the AI revolution could also cause environmental harm. One described it as 'an enormous extractive industry for the 21st Century.' A recent study found that the sector's rapid expansion could lead AI to consume as much energy as a country the size of the Netherlands, prompting the author to suggest that AI should be used only when absolutely necessary.

Ayon kay Matt Brittin, presidente ng Google para sa Europa, Gitnang Silangan, at Africa, may malaking potensyal ang AI para sa mga makabuluhang tagumpay sa iba’t ibang industriya. Patuloy ang pandaigdigang talakayan tungkol sa mga panganib at benepisyo ng AI. Nagsalita si Brittin habang inanunsyo ng Google ang pakikipagtulungan nito sa University of Cambridge para sa isang pananaliksik. Bilang bahagi nito, magbibigay ang Google ng pondo para sa bagong Centre for Human-Inspired AI kung saan magsasama ang mga mananaliksik mula Cambridge at Google. Ang pangmatagalang kasunduan na ito ay tutok sa mga paksa tulad ng robotics, healthcare, at climate change. Nauuna ito sa gagawing UK AI safety summit sa Bletchley Park, kung saan target ng gobyerno na tipunin ang mga pangunahing tao sa industriya. Ang kasunduan ay kasunod ng mas tumitinding usapan tungkol sa mga posibleng benepisyo ng AI at mga hakbang ng mga regulator sa iba’t ibang bansa na gumawa ng mga patakaran para sa mabilis na umuunlad na larangang ito. Ayon kay Brittin: 'Kung tama ang ating paggawa, pwedeng magkaroon ng malaking pag-unlad sa kalusugan, walang limitasyong malinis na enerhiya, at lipunang may pantay na oportunidad dahil sa edukasyon at matatalinong teknolohiya. Malaking oportunidad ito.' Sinabi ni Zoubin Ghahramani, vice president ng research sa Google DeepMind at propesor sa Cambridge, sa BBC na ang pananaliksik sa bagong sentro ay makakatulong sa pagtugon sa mga isyu sa klima. Halimbawa, ginagamit ang AI para ma-optimize ang ruta ng mga eroplano upang mabawasan ang contrails—mga usok na iniiwan ng mga sasakyang panghimpapawid. Dagdag niya, dahil sa mga bagong kasunduan sa UK, halos lahat ng serbisyo ng Google sa bansa ay tatakbo gamit ang carbon-free energy pagsapit ng 2025. Itinampok pa ni Brittin ang mga proyekto tulad ng pag-aayos ng takbo ng mga traffic light para mabawasan ang polusyon, at pag-gabay sa mga gumagamit ng Google Maps para hanapin ang pinaka-matipid na ruta at pinakamahusay na lugar para sa solar panels. Gayunpaman, nagbabala ang ilang eksperto na maaaring magdulot din ng pinsala sa kalikasan ang AI revolution. Isa ang tumawag dito bilang 'isang malaking extractive industry para sa ika-21 siglo.' Napag-alaman sa isang bagong pag-aaral na maaaring gumamit ang AI ng kasing dami ng enerhiya ng isang bansang kasing-laki ng Netherlands, dahilan para iminungkahi ng may-akda na gamitin lamang ang AI kung kinakailangan.

article_content: The Karnataka Cabinet has decided to withdraw its previous consent for the CBI to investigate Deputy Chief Minister and state Congress president D.K. Shivakumar in a significant corruption case. The original approval, granted by the BJP-led administration in September 2019, is now being challenged due to the absence of necessary permission from the state Assembly Speaker—an essential procedural step for inquiries involving serving legislators. The Karnataka High Court had earlier noted that the CBI's investigation was authorized through a general executive order rather than a formal sanction under the Prevention of Corruption Act. Despite this, the state government is moving forward to revoke its consent, which could temporarily shield Shivakumar, who has appealed the earlier decision in court. Meanwhile, the CBI is nearing the completion of its investigation, with the High Court hearing scheduled soon. Shivakumar first attracted significant scrutiny in 2017 after tax authorities raided properties associated with him, coinciding with his hosting of Gujarat Congress MLAs during a high-stakes Rajya Sabha election. The aftermath brought allegations of tax evasion and discovery of unaccounted cash, which led to an Enforcement Directorate (ED) money laundering case and his brief arrest in 2019. Subsequent findings from tax and ED investigations prompted the BJP government to permit a CBI investigation, resulting in an FIR in 2020. The CBI alleges that, between 2013 and 2018—when Shivakumar was energy minister—he accumulated assets worth nearly Rs 75 crore beyond his known sources of income. Efforts by Shivakumar to dismiss the case have been rejected by the courts, and despite some acquittals in tax cases, the ED maintains allegations of money laundering with the involvement of Shivakumar’s associates. The BJP has condemned the Congress government's move to halt the CBI inquiry, calling it unconstitutional and organizing protests. In contrast, Congress leaders, including Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and Minister Priyank Kharge, argue that the prior investigation was politically motivated and intended to intimidate opposition politicians. Shivakumar, seen as a contender for chief minister in the future, is striving to uphold his influence in the party while Congress relies on his leadership for upcoming electoral battles in Karnataka.

article_content: The United States, in partnership with the United Kingdom, has introduced new sanctions to target the funding networks of Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad (PIJ). These sanctions aim to hinder how these groups receive financial support, with particular focus on funds originating from Iran. A statement from the US Treasury Department describes this as the third round of sanctions against Hamas, now concentrating on its leaders and entities that facilitate Iranian-backed financing. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen emphasized that these joint efforts are intended to sever Hamas from foreign funding and block new emerging financial channels. The UK has imposed sanctions on four prominent Hamas leaders and two individuals accused of helping with fundraising, including the political leader in Gaza and the organization’s military commander, according to the Foreign Office. These moves come after an October attack by Hamas in southern Israel, which Israeli officials say killed around 1,200 people, mostly civilians. Israel subsequently launched major airstrikes and began a ground assault in Gaza. Health authorities in Gaza report that over 11,200 people have been killed in the Israeli offensive, including thousands of children, and most residents have been displaced with vital resources cut off. The coordinated sanctions are aimed not just at leaders but also at intermediaries allegedly facilitating financial flows from Iran to Hamas and PIJ. US Secretary of State Antony Blinken has stated that the US will keep working with other nations to disrupt these funding networks. Individuals targeted by US sanctions include Mahmoud Khaled Zahhar, a senior Hamas figure and co-founder, as well as Nasser Abu Sharif, PIJ’s representative to Iran, and Akram al-Ajouri, PIJ’s deputy leader. The Lebanon-based money exchange firm Nabil Chouman & Co, along with its owner and his son for allegedly transferring money between Iran and Gaza, were also sanctioned. The sanctions freeze any assets in the US belonging to those listed and generally prohibit American citizens or entities from doing business with them. Officials hope these measures will undermine the financial strength of Hamas, PIJ, and those who support them.
translated_content: Inilunsad ng Estados Unidos, kasama ang United Kingdom, ang mga bagong parusa laban sa mga network ng pondo ng Hamas at Palestinian Islamic Jihad (PIJ). Layunin ng mga hakbang na ito na hadlangan kung paano natatanggap ng mga grupong ito ng pondo, partikular mula sa Iran. Ayon sa US Treasury Department, ito na ang ikatlong beses na nagpatupad sila ng parusa laban sa Hamas, na ngayon ay nakatuon sa mga lider at mga entidad na tumatanggap ng pondo mula Iran. Ayon kay Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, layon ng pinagsanib na hakbang ng UK at US na putulin ang koneksyon ng Hamas sa panlabas na pondong natatanggap at pigilin ang mga bagong paraan ng pagpopondo. Nagpatupad din ang UK ng parusa sa apat na kilalang lider ng Hamas at dalawang indibidwal na umano'y tumutulong sa pangangalap ng pondo, kabilang ang political leader ng grupo sa Gaza at ang military commander nito, ayon sa Foreign Office. Dumating ang mga hakbang na ito matapos ang pag-atake ng Hamas noong Oktubre sa timog Israel na ayon sa mga opisyal ng Israel ay nagdulot ng higit 1,200 na nasawi, karamihan ay sibilyan. Bilang tugon, naglunsad ang Israel ng airstrikes at ground assault sa Gaza. Sa tala ng health authorities sa Gaza, higit 11,200 katao ang nasawi sa Israeli offensive, kabilang ang maraming bata, at karamihan sa mga residente ay napilitang lumikas o nawalan ng pangunahing pangangailangan. Hindi lang mga lider kundi pati umano'y mga tagapamagitan na tumutulong maglipat ng pondo mula Iran patungong Hamas at PIJ ang puntirya ng mga parusa. Ayon kay US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, magpapatuloy ang US sa pakikipagtulungan sa ibang bansa upang pigilan ang mga network ng pinansyal ng mga grupong ito. Kabilang sa mga indibidwal na pinatawan ng US ng parusa ay sina Mahmoud Khaled Zahhar, isang mataas na pinuno at co-founder ng Hamas; Nasser Abu Sharif, kinatawan ng PIJ sa Iran; at Akram al-Ajouri, deputy leader ng PIJ. Kabilang din ang Lebanon-based money exchange na Nabil Chouman & Co, pati may-ari at anak nito dahil umano sa pagpapadala ng pera mula Iran papuntang Gaza. Ang mga parusa ay naglalaman ng pag-freeze ng mga asset sa US at pagbabawal sa mga Amerikano na makipagnegosyo sa mga nabanggit. Umaasa ang mga opisyal na mapapahina nito ang kakayahan ng Hamas, PIJ, at mga tagasuporta nilang makalikom ng pondo.
