article_content: E. Lynn Harris, a groundbreaking African-American novelist, introduced millions of readers to the often-unseen lives of black gay men. Friends and colleagues remember him for his generosity and courage. Harris, 54, passed away Thursday night during a business trip to Los Angeles, California, according to his publicist, Laura Gilmore. Harris authored several novels that brought to light characters rarely represented in literature: affluent, masculine, and complex black gay men. Keith Boykin, an author and friend, noted Harris's role in encouraging open conversations about homosexuality within the black community, breaking the prevalent 'don't ask, don't tell' mindset. Works such as 'Invisible Life,' 'A Love of My Own,' and the best-selling memoir 'What Becomes of the Brokenhearted' effectively created a new literary genre. Harris's stories of black gay men living double lives resonated with readers, making his books popular staples in black beauty salons, bookstores, and book clubs—especially among black women. Harris's literary journey began in 1991 when, as a former IBM executive, he started selling his books from the trunk of his car. Over time, he became one of the nation's most popular writers, with an estimated four million copies of his books in print. Author Tina McElroy Ansa, who met Harris early in his career, recalls their mutual support and her astonishment at the candid portrayal of love between African-American men in his writing. She highlighted how his work depicted such relationships as playful and loving, defying previous stereotypes. Harris later expressed how writing 'Invisible Life' helped him accept his own sexuality during a period when affirmation was lacking. He dedicated himself to supporting aspiring writers, hosting dinner gatherings, and enthusiastically engaging with fans at readings—frequently answering hundreds of emails daily. Harris was born in Flint, Michigan, grew up in Little Rock, Arkansas, and faced hardships including childhood abuse and a suicide attempt in 1990. Although he sometimes faced criticism—both for his writing style and portrayals—he still succeeded in reaching audiences who felt seen and heard through his work. He resisted labels, stating that his sexuality was only a small part of his identity. Fellow writers, including Tananarive Due, praise Harris's spirit and the relief his books brought to many. Through his life and stories, Harris eased some of the pain associated with homosexuality in the black community, helping many to 'breathe a little better.'
translated_content: Si E. Lynn Harris, isang rebolusyonaryong African-American na nobelista, ang nagpakilala sa milyon-milyong mambabasa sa madalas na hindi nakikitang buhay ng mga itim na gay na lalaki. Inaalala siya ng mga kaibigan at kasamahan para sa kanyang kabaitan at tapang. Si Harris, 54, ay pumanaw noong Huwebes ng gabi sa isang business trip sa Los Angeles, California, ayon sa kanyang publicist na si Laura Gilmore. Nagsulat si Harris ng mga nobelang nagbigay liwanag sa mga karakter na bihirang makita sa panitikan: mayayaman, maskulado, at komplikadong mga itim na gay na lalaki. Sinabi ni Keith Boykin, isang manunulat at kaibigan, na pinalakas ni Harris ang pagbubukas ng usapin tungkol sa homoseksuwalidad sa black community, tinutulungan itong lampasan ang 'don't ask, don't tell' na pananaw. Sa mga akdang tulad ng 'Invisible Life,' 'A Love of My Own,' at ang best-selling memoir na 'What Becomes of the Brokenhearted,' nagbukas si Harris ng bagong genre. Tumimo sa mga mambabasa ang mga kwentong ito ng mga itim na gay na lalaki na namumuhay ng doble, kaya't naging patok ang kanyang mga libro sa mga beauty salon, bookstore, at book club ng African-American community—lalo sa mga kababaihan. Nagsimula ang karera ni Harris noong 1991 bilang dating executive ng IBM, nagbebenta ng kanyang libro mula sa trunk ng kanyang kotse. Sa kalaunan, naging isa siya sa mga pinakasikat na manunulat sa Amerika, may tinatayang apat na milyong kopya ng kanyang mga libro ang nakaimprenta. Si Tina McElroy Ansa, isang manunulat na nakilala si Harris sa simula ng kanyang karera, ay naalala ang kanilang pagtutulungan at pagka-gulat sa tapat na paglalarawan ng pagmamahalan ng mga African-American na lalaki. Binigyang-diin niya kung paano naging masaya at puno ng pagmamahal ang pagportray ni Harris sa ganitong relasyon, taliwas sa mga nakasanayang stereotype. Ibinahagi ni Harris na ang pagsusulat ng 'Invisible Life' ay tumulong sa kanya sa pagtanggap ng sariling sekswalidad sa panahong kulang ang suporta. Lubos siyang tumulong sa mga baguhang manunulat, nagho-host ng dinner, at masigasig na kinikilala ang kanyang mga fans—madalas sumasagot ng daan-daang email araw-araw. Ipinanganak si Harris sa Flint, Michigan, lumaki sa Little Rock, Arkansas, at dumaan sa mahihirap na karanasan tulad ng abusong naranasan sa kamay ng amain at pagtatangkang magpakamatay noong 1990. Kahit kritikal ang iba—sa paraan ng pagsusulat at pagportray niya—naabot niya pa rin ang maraming mambabasa na nakahanap ng suporta sa kanyang kwento. Ayaw niyang malabelan, at sinabing maliit na bahagi lamang ng kanyang pagkatao ang kanyang sekswalidad. Pinuri siya ng mga co-writer gaya ni Tananarive Due para sa kanyang masiglang personalidad at sa kung paano nabawasan ang sakit ng isyu ng homoseksuwalidad sa black community dahil sa kanyang mga libro at buhay. Natulungan niyang 'makahinga' ang maraming tao.
post_content: E. Lynn Harris changed the game—bringing black gay men's stories to light & inspiring millions. His courage, kindness, and books touched lives everywhere. Gone too soon, but never forgotten. #ELynnHarris #RepresentationMatters #LGBTQinLit

article_content: Global sugar supplies are tightening as shipping backlogs build up at Brazilian ports already running at full capacity. Experts point out the situation increasingly resembles the severe shortages seen in 2010–2011 when sugar prices soared. Mauro Angelo, CEO of Alvean—one of the largest sugar trading firms globally—cautions that poor weather in India is worsening the supply forecast, with another worldwide deficit likely this season. India’s sugar industry has been hit by inadequate rainfall and low water reservoirs, making the upcoming harvest highly uncertain. Unlike prior years, India is unlikely to export sugar in the current season, a sharp drop from the 11 million tons exported just two years ago. As a result, Brazil is under added pressure, but it faces its own hurdles: record soy and corn harvests are competing for space at ports and on railways, and heavy rains have further delayed shipments. According to Angelo, logistical bottlenecks prevented Brazil from exporting at least one million tons of sugar in October—a gap unlikely to be bridged soon, with ongoing congestion and another soybean crop on the way. Import-dependent countries are maintaining low sugar inventories, causing buyers to postpone purchasing and driving governments to intervene with procurement and tax reductions. "The entire system is stressed," Angelo warned, emphasizing the risks of more disruptions and volatile prices ahead.

Ayon kay Mauro Angelo, CEO ng Alvean—isa sa pinakamalalaking sugar trading company—lalo pang lumalala ang sitwasyon dahil sa masamang panahon sa India, na posibleng magdulot ng panibagong pandaigdigang kakulangan ngayong season. Tinamaan ang industriya ng asukal ng India ng kakapusan sa ulan at mababang antas ng tubig sa reservoir kaya’t hindi tiyak ang susunod na anihan. Hindi tulad ng mga nakaraang taon, hindi inaasahang mag-e-export ng asukal ang India ngayon, malayo mula sa 11 milyong toneladang iniluwas nito dalawang taon na ang nakalilipas. Dahil dito, nabibigatan ang Brazil habang hirap din sa sarili nitong problema: record harvest ng mais at soya ang sumisikip sa ports at riles, kasabay pa ng pagbagal ng shipments dahil sa malalakas na ulan. Ayon kay Angelo, ang mga isyu sa logistics ay pumigil sa Brazil na makapag-export ng hindi bababa sa isang milyong toneladang asukal nitong Oktubre—at malabong makabawi agad dahil patuloy ang siksikan at may paparating na namang ani ng soybean. Sa mga bansang umaasa sa pag-aangkat, mababa na lang ang stock ng asukal kaya’t naaantala ang pagbili ng mga mamimili, dahilan para pumasok na ang mga pamahalaan sa procurement at pagbaba ng buwis. "Napapasa-ilalim na sa matinding pressure ang buong sistema," babala ni Angelo, at binigyang-diin ang banta ng dagdag pang aberya at pabago-bagong presyo.

article_content:
The auction of the Marussia F1 team’s remaining assets has been cancelled, as the team is reportedly in advanced discussions with a potential buyer. GA European Valuations, based in Birmingham, previously held an auction in December, selling minor assets such as steering wheels, manufacturing and office equipment, and drivers’ race suits. Marussia entered administration in October with debts approaching £60 million, resulting in the team missing the final three races of last season.

Marussia’s efforts to return to the 2015 F1 grid continue behind the scenes, though a critical deadline is looming. GAEV had scheduled an auction for Wednesday to sell last season’s race cars, components, spares, race-day equipment, and the team’s GP3 vehicles. If these assets had been sold, it would have marked the end of the team—provisionally listed as ‘Manor’ on the FIA’s 2015 entry list—as an ongoing concern.

During their last race at the Russian Grand Prix in October, only Max Chilton drove for Marussia, as his teammate Jules Bianchi remained hospitalized following a serious accident at the previous race in Japan. GAEV has now confirmed the auction will not proceed and has not provided a new date or a reason for the cancellation. Reportedly, sporting director Graeme Lowdon and team principal John Booth are leading last-ditch negotiations to save the team. A potential incentive is the $40 million (£26 million) in prize money available if the team competes again after its 10th-place finish in the 2014 constructors’ championship.

Pumasok ang Marussia sa administration noong Oktubre dahil sa utang na umabot sa halos £60 milyon, dahilan para hindi sila makasali sa huling tatlong karera ng nakaraang season.

Tuloy-tuloy ang pagsisikap ng Marussia na muling makabalik sa F1 grid ngayong 2015, kahit papalapit na ang deadline. Nakatakda sanang ipa-auction ng GAEV sa Miyerkules ang mga kotse ng nakaraang season, mga piyesa, ekstrang kagamitan, mga gamit para sa araw ng karera, pati na rin ang mga GP3 na sasakyan ng team. Kung natuloy ito, tuluyan nang mawawala ang team na pansamantalang tinawag na ‘Manor’ sa entry list ng FIA para sa 2015 bilang isang aktibong koponan.

Sa huling karera nila sa Russian Grand Prix nitong Oktubre, si Max Chilton lamang ang tumakbo para sa Marussia, dahil nananatili sa ospital si Jules Bianchi matapos ang matinding aksidente sa Japan. Kinumpirma na ng GAEV na hindi na matutuloy ang auction at walang binigay na bagong petsa o dahilan ng pagkakansela. Sa ngayon, pinangungunahan nina sporting director Graeme Lowdon at team principal John Booth ang huling negosasyon para maisalba ang team. May malaking insentibo na nasa $40 milyon (£26 milyon) na premyo kung sila'y makakabalik matapos ang ika-10 puwesto nila sa 2014 constructors’ championship.

article_content: Confronted with a sex scandal among his ranks, Australia's army chief, Lt. Gen. David Morrison, delivered a direct message to his troops: treat your female colleagues with respect, or leave the army. Morrison announced last week that three soldiers had been suspended and disciplinary action was being considered against five more in connection with the distribution of videos he described as 'demeaning, explicit, and profane.' In a statement posted on the army's YouTube page, Morrison emphasized that female soldiers 'are vital to us maintaining our capability now and into the future.' He added, 'If that does not suit you, then get out. You may find another employer where your attitude and behavior is acceptable, but I doubt it. The same goes for those who think toughness means humiliating others.' Australian women first served in auxiliary roles and as nurses in the early 20th century, then became integrated into the noncombat military in the 1970s and 1980s. Since 2011, women have been eligible for combat roles, and Morrison lauded female troops as 'worthy of the best traditions of the Australian army.' Morrison also stated, 'No one has ever explained to me how the exploitation or degradation of others enhances capability or honors the traditions of the Australian army.' He pledged to be 'ruthless' in removing those who cannot uphold the army's values and called on all personnel to support this effort. According to Australian news reports, at least 17 soldiers shared videos of themselves engaging in sexual acts with women, reportedly without the women's knowledge. Some materials circulated through military computer networks and implicated senior officers. Morrison said these incidents date back to 2010 and that up to 90 people may have been on the periphery of the email exchanges. Both military investigators and the New South Wales state police are involved in the inquiry, and Morrison confirmed he has apologized to some of the affected women. The controversy has raised public concern about the culture and safety of women in the military, potentially impacting recruitment.

Ganun din sa mga naniniwalang pagiging matatag ay nangangahulugang manghusga o manghiya ng iba.' article_content: Hundreds of European fintech start-ups could be at risk of a major collapse, according to new research by credit fund WinYield. The report warns there is a significant possibility of systemic issues in the case of such a crash. By this year, European fintechs had raised more than $12 billion to lend to small and medium-sized businesses and consumers. This funding came from venture capital investors (providing equity) and institutional investors like insurers (providing loan capital). However, WinYield points out that many fintechs have little practical experience managing credit through different economic cycles, and their advanced technology may not be able to handle the risks involved. Interviews with around 100 fintech lenders across Europe revealed that fewer than one in ten start-ups had staff with relevant experience in credit markets. WinYield also found that many lenders used basic technology-driven underwriting models, which failed to properly test loans under varying market conditions. 'In the past 18 months, our interviews gave us a sense of déjà vu,' said Fabricio Mercier, WinYield’s founder and CEO. 'It felt like the conversations before the 2007 global financial crisis.' A key issue is that many fintechs may have overestimated the size of their target markets. For instance, lending to ecommerce businesses is increasingly popular, but these loans tend to be repaid quickly, meaning fintechs have less outstanding credit on their books than anticipated. Mercier also suggests that many fintechs follow business models that may not be economically sustainable. 'Many European fintech lenders are adopting a multi-product approach and aggressive marketing budgets similar to their US counterparts,' he said. 'But that doesn’t work in Europe’s fragmented market, where break-even portfolio sizes are much higher.' There are particular concerns for venture capital backers, who have invested about $550 million into these companies. If fintechs don’t become profitable, this money could be at risk. Institutional lenders, on the other hand, usually have more security because of the priority claim they have on loans made by these companies. Despite the smaller scale of fintechs compared to banks, a collapse could still have significant effects. Regulators have become increasingly concerned about 'shadow banking,' which refers to non-bank institutions involved in lending, such as fintechs. The Financial Stability Board, the Bank of England, and the US Securities and Exchange Commission have recently warned about potential risks in this sector. While fintechs aren’t the direct target of new regulations, problems with technology-led lenders could attract greater oversight. Nonetheless, Mercier argues that regulation is not the best solution. Instead, he calls for fintechs and their investors to review and improve their business models, focusing on risk management, especially as venture capital funding has dried up. 'The bull market of 2020 created an irrational bubble in fintech lending,' said Mercier. 'While there are still problematic players, the decline of venture capital might help bring more discipline and rationality to the industry.'
translated_content: Maaaring malagay sa panganib ang daan-daang European fintech start-ups na mabangkarote, ayon sa bagong pananaliksik ng credit fund na WinYield. Ayon sa ulat, may malaking posibilidad na magkaroon ng sistemikong problema kung sakaling magtuloy-tuloy ang pagbagsak. Sa taong ito, nakalikom na ng higit $12 bilyon ang mga fintech sa Europa para ipautang sa maliliit at katamtamang laking negosyo at mga mamimili. Galing ang pondo mula sa mga venture capital investor (na nagbibigay ng equity) at mga institutional investor gaya ng mga insurance company (na nagbibigay ng kapital para sa pautang). Gayunpaman, binigyang-diin ng WinYield na marami sa mga fintech na ito ang kulang sa praktikal na karanasan sa pamamahala ng credit sa iba’t ibang siklo ng ekonomiya, at maaaring hindi sapat ang kanilang makabagong teknolohiya para tugunan ang mga panganib na kaakibat. Sa mga panayam sa humigit-kumulang 100 fintech lender sa Europa, napag-alaman na mas mababa sa isa sa sampung start-up ang may empleyadong may karanasan sa credit markets. Natuklasan din ng WinYield na marami sa mga lender ang gumagamit ng simpleng technology-driven underwriting models na hindi sapat upang masuri nang mabuti ang mga loans sa iba’t ibang sitwasyon sa merkado. 'Sa loob ng nakaraang 18 buwan, ramdam namin ang déjà vu sa mga naging panayam,' sabi ni Fabricio Mercier, tagapagtatag at CEO ng WinYield. 'Parang ganito rin ang naging usapan bago ang global financial crisis noong 2007.' Isa sa mga pangunahing isyu ay maaaring napalaki ang pagtantiya ng mga fintech sa laki ng market na tina-target nila. Halimbawa, patok ngayon ang pagpapautang sa mga ecommerce business, pero dahil mabilis mabayaran ang mga loan, mas maliit ang naiwan na credit sa kanilang books. Dagdag pa ni Mercier, marami sa mga fintech ay gumagamit ng business model na maaaring hindi sustainable sa pananalapi. 'Maraming European fintech lender ang sumusubok ng multi-product approach at agresibong marketing budget tulad ng ginagawa sa US,' aniya. 'Ngunit hindi ito gumagana sa pira-pirasong market sa Europa, kung saan mataas ang required na portfolio size bago mag-break-even.' May pag-aalala rin para sa mga venture capital backer na nag-invest ng tinatayang $550 milyon sa mga kumpanyang ito. Kapag hindi kumita ang mga fintech, posibleng maapektuhan ang investment nila. Samantala, mas may seguridad ang mga institutional lender dahil may priyoridad sila sa mga koleksiyon ng loan. Bagamat mas maliit ang scale ng mga fintech kumpara sa mga bangko, maaari pa ring magdulot ng malaking epekto ang pag-collapse ng sektor. Nagpapakita ng pangamba ang mga regulator sa 'shadow banking', na tumutukoy sa mga non-bank na tagapagpautang tulad ng fintech. Kamakailan, nagbigay babala ang Financial Stability Board, Bank of England, at US Securities and Exchange Commission tungkol sa mga panganib sa sector na ito. Bagaman hindi direktang tinatarget ng bagong regulasyon ang mga fintech, ang mga problema sa technology-led lenders ay maaaring magdulot ng masusing pagsusuri. Sa kabila nito, naniniwala si Mercier na hindi regulasyon ang solusyon. Sa halip, hinihikayat niya ang mga fintech at investor na suriin at paghusayin ang kanilang business models, at mag-focus sa risk management, lalo na’t nabawasan na ang venture capital funding. 'Ang bull market noong 2020 ay nagdulot ng hindi makatwirang bubble sa fintech lending,' sabi ni Mercier. 'Habang may ilan pa ring mga pasaway na kumpanya, ang pagbaba ng venture capital ay makatutulong upang magkaroon ng mas disiplina at rasyonalidad sa industriya.'

article_content: Racism continues to cast a shadow over English football, a problem made starkly clear by the long-running controversy between Chelsea’s John Terry and QPR’s Anton Ferdinand. Even a year after their tense Premier League encounter, debates about how to address player misconduct—both on and off the field—remain unresolved. John Terry was suspended for four games and fined by the FA after being found guilty of racially abusing Anton Ferdinand, despite being cleared by a criminal court, which requires a higher standard of evidence. Prior to Terry's punishment, Liverpool’s Luis Suarez was similarly disciplined for racist comments toward Manchester United’s Patrice Evra. These and other incidents have fueled a larger discussion about how sporting authorities should punish discriminatory behavior. Critics argue that standard penalties, such as suspensions and financial penalties, are insufficient and inconsistent across sports and organizations. Some, like the PFA’s Clarke Carlisle and Football Against Racism in Europe’s Piara Powar, have suggested a focus on rehabilitation instead of simple punishment. For example, they proposed that offenders should be required to engage in community work or education aimed at promoting inclusion. However, this idea has been met with skepticism by some players, who question whether it would be effective or appropriate for victims and communities. The article notes similar debates beyond football. For instance, the NBA has started penalizing players who fake fouls with escalating fines and possible suspensions, aiming to change player culture. In U.S. soccer, MLS reviews games after the fact and issues penalties for behavior missed during matches, which has spurred tension with players over 're-refereeing' outcomes. Despite ongoing criticism, the FA states that all its income supports football at all levels, and it remains open to considering new forms of discipline, such as rehabilitation, in the future. Meanwhile, the broader question of how best to address racism in football and whether current penalties are enough remains unsettled.
translated_content: Patuloy na malaking isyu ang rasismo sa English football, lalo na sa kontrobersyang kinasangkutan nina John Terry ng Chelsea at Anton Ferdinand ng QPR. Isang taon matapos ang kanilang mainit na laban sa Premier League, hindi pa rin tapos ang usapan kung paano dapat parusahan ang mga manlalarong nagkakamali—sa loob at labas ng laro. Sinuspinde si John Terry ng apat na laro at pinagmulta ng FA matapos mapatunayang nilapastangan niya si Anton Ferdinand sa pamamagitan ng rasistang pananalita, kahit na napawalang-sala siya ng korte, na mas mataas ang hinihinging ebidensya. Bago nito, pinarusahan din si Luis Suarez ng Liverpool para sa rasistang komento laban kay Patrice Evra ng Manchester United. Dahil dito, lumaki ang diskusyon kung tama na ba ang kasalukuyang parusa gaya ng suspensyon at multa, at kung sapat o pare-pareho ba ang pagpapatupad nito sa iba't ibang sports at organisasyon. May mga panukala gaya ng galing kina Clarke Carlisle ng PFA at Piara Powar ng Football Against Racism in Europe na bigyan-diin ang rehabilitasyon kaysa basta parusa. Halimbawa, iminumungkahi nilang magtrabaho o dumaan sa mga edukasyonal na programa ang mga lumabag, upang lalo silang matuto sa isyu ng diskriminasyon. Ngunit may alinlangan din ang ilan, kabilang ang ibang manlalaro, kung epektibo o tama ba ito para sa mga biktima at komunidad. Pinag-uusapan din ang ganitong isyu sa ibang sports. Sa NBA, nagpapataw na ng parusa sa mga nagpapanggap ng fouls, simula sa mga multa at posibleng suspensyon para baguhin ang kultura ng mga manlalaro. Sa U.S. soccer, iniimbestigahan ng MLS ang mga laro pagkatapos at nagpapataw ng parusa sa mga paglabag na hindi nakita ng referee, na minsan ay nagiging dahilan ng tensyon sa pagitan ng mga manlalaro at liga. Sa kabila ng mga batikos, sinasabi ng FA na lahat ng kita nito ay ibinabalik sa football at bukas itong subukan ang mga bagong uri ng disiplina tulad ng rehabilitasyon. Samantala, nananatiling magulo ang tanong kung paano tunay na malulutas ang rasismo sa football at kung sapat na nga ba ang mga kasalukuyang parusa.

article_content: Approximately 140,000 unionized auto workers are expected to ratify new contracts with Detroit’s biggest automakers, securing wage and benefit increases of up to 33% and bringing top hourly pay to around $42. The agreements were reached after a six-week strike that concluded in late October, already prompting responses from other automakers beyond Ford and General Motors. In the wake of the UAW’s achievement, several non-union automakers are boosting pay for their workers. Hyundai recently announced a 25% wage increase for about 4,000 employees at its Alabama and Georgia facilities by 2028, with the initial raises starting in January. The company cited the need to stay competitive and attract talented workers as motivation. Hyundai is not the first to react: Toyota revealed that employees at its Kentucky plant will see a 9% wage increase on January 1, raising top hourly pay to $34.80, according to Reuters. Honda also plans an 11% wage bump beginning in January. Both Toyota and Honda are shortening the time for workers to reach maximum pay, bringing them closer to the improvements seen in the new UAW deals. Industry experts believe these decisions from non-union plants are closely tied to the recent UAW agreements. Harry Katz, a collective bargaining professor at Cornell University, said non-union automakers want to remain that way but feel compelled to match Detroit’s wage standards due to a robust labor market and strong company performance. Meanwhile, the UAW is openly seeking to organize more plants, including Tesla, despite previous failed efforts and resistance from CEO Elon Musk. Some believe smaller, international companies might be easier for unionization campaigns. “When we return to the bargaining table in 2028, it won’t just be with the Big Three,” UAW President Shawn Fain stated this month. “We could be looking at the Big Five or Big Six.” Labor analysts like Art Wheaton from Cornell note that quick raises by non-union companies can strengthen the UAW’s message—they can now point to the wage increases at places like Toyota as proof that their efforts are already paying off and encourage more workers to join the movement.
translated_content: Tinatayang 140,000 na unyonadong manggagawa sa industriya ng sasakyan ang malapit nang magratipika ng mga bagong kontrata kasama ang malalaking automaker sa Detroit, na magdadala ng hanggang 33% pagtaas sa sahod at benepisyo, na magtataas ng pinakamataas na orasang bayad sa humigit-kumulang $42. Ang mga kasunduang ito ay naabot matapos ang anim na linggong welga na nagtapos noong huling bahagi ng Oktubre, at nagdudulot na ng mga tugon mula sa iba pang automaker bukod kina Ford at General Motors. Dahil sa tagumpay ng UAW, ilang di-unyonadong kumpanya tulad ng Hyundai ay nag-angat din ng sahod ng kanilang mga empleyado. Inanunsyo ng Hyundai na tataasan nila ng 25% ang sahod ng mga nasa 4,000 manggagawa sa kanilang mga planta sa Alabama at Georgia pagsapit ng 2028, at magsisimula na ang unang taas-sahod ngayong Enero. Sabi ng kumpanya, layunin nilang manatiling kompetitibo at makahikayat ng de-kalidad na empleyado. Hindi lang Hyundai ang agad na tumugon; sinabi ng Toyota na ang mga manggagawa nito sa planta sa Kentucky ay tatanggap ng 9% taas-sahod sa Enero 1, na magdadala ng top pay rate sa $34.80 kada oras, ayon sa Reuters. Ang Honda ay magbibigay din ng 11% dagdag na sahod simula Enero. Parehong pinaikli ng Toyota at Honda ang panahon bago maabot ng mga empleyado ang pinakamataas na sahod—mas pinapadali ayon sa mga bagong kontrata ng UAW. Ayon sa mga eksperto sa industriya, tuwirang kaugnay ng mga hakbang na ito ang mga naging resulta ng UAW negotiations. Binanggit ni Harry Katz, propesor ng collective bargaining mula Cornell University, na nais manatiling di-unyonado ng mga kumpanyang ito ngunit napipilitang sumabay sa taas ng sahod ng Detroit dahil sa malakas na labor market at magagandang kita ng mga kumpanya. Patuloy naman ang layunin ng UAW na unionahin ang mas maraming planta, kabilang ang Tesla, kahit ilang beses nang nabigo at may matinding pagtutol mula kay CEO Elon Musk. Naniniwala ang ilan na mas madaling unionahin ang mga mas maliit at dayuhang kumpanya. "Pagbalik natin sa bargaining table sa 2028, hindi lang ito sa Big Three," ani UAW President Shawn Fain ngayong buwan. "Baka Big Five o Big Six na ang kasunod." Ayon kay Art Wheaton ng Cornell, ang mabilis na taas-sahod ng di-unyonadong kumpanya ay nagpapalakas sa kampanya ng UAW—maipapakita nilang may epekto agad ang kanilang pagkilos, at higit pang benepisyo ang posibleng makamit.

article_content: The value of Nigeria’s pension funds has dropped by 45.18% in US dollar terms following the devaluation of the naira. According to data from the National Pension Commission, the net asset value of pension funds was N17.35 trillion as of September, equating to $19.83 billion using the official exchange rate of 874.71 naira per dollar. Before the naira’s devaluation in mid-June, when the Central Bank of Nigeria unified the exchange rates, pension funds were valued at N16.76 trillion and worth $36.17 billion at the exchange rate of 463.38 naira per dollar on June 9. A memo dated June 14, 2023, signed by Angela Sere-Ejembi, Director of Financial Markets, announced the merger of foreign exchange segments into the Investors and Exporters window, later renamed the Nigerian Autonomous Foreign Exchange Rate Fixing window. Since the harmonization, the naira has continued to weaken against the dollar despite government efforts to stabilize the currency. To boost investor confidence, the Central Bank began clearing foreign exchange backlogs in banks this month. The harmonization was triggered by President Bola Tinubu’s call to unify Nigeria’s exchange rates in his inauguration speech. Rising inflation, accelerating from 22.79% in June to 26.72% in September, has further eroded the value of pension funds. Abdulqadir Dahiru, Head of Corporate Communications at PenCom, told The PUNCH that devaluation has impacted not just pension funds but the wider economy. Dahiru explained that both inflation and devaluation diminish the value of savings, as more currency is required to purchase the same goods and services. He noted that pension funds are diversified, being invested in both fixed-income and variable-income assets. Returns on variable-income assets are adjusted for inflation, and investments include securities, infrastructure, private equity, and real estate investment trusts, offering some protection against inflation. Nigeria’s pension funds are major players in the capital market and have garnered attention from international investors. In October, institutional investors from the US visited Nigeria, advocating regulatory changes to allow pension funds greater participation in the equities market. Cameron Khosrowshahi, Investment Team Lead at Prosper Africa, encouraged collaboration between Nigerian stakeholders and the pension regulator to channel more pension fund liquidity into equities.
translated_content: Bumaba ng 45.18% ang halaga ng mga pondo ng pensyon ng Nigeria kapag tiningnan sa US dollars, matapos ang pagbaba ng halaga ng naira. Ayon sa datos mula sa National Pension Commission, ang net asset value ng mga pondo ng pensyon ay N17.35 trilyon noong Setyembre, na katumbas ng $19.83 bilyon gamit ang opisyal na palitan na 874.71 naira kada dolyar. Bago bumaba ang halaga ng naira noong kalagitnaan ng Hunyo, nang pag-isahin ng Central Bank of Nigeria ang palitan ng bansa, ang halaga ng pondo ng pensyon ay N16.76 trilyon at nagkakahalaga ng $36.17 bilyon sa palitang 463.38 naira kada dolyar noong Hunyo 9. Isang memo na may petsang Hunyo 14, 2023 at nilagdaan ni Angela Sere-Ejembi, Director of Financial Markets, ang nag-anunsyo ng pagsasama-sama ng mga segment ng foreign exchange market sa Investors and Exporters window, na kalaunan ay tinawag na Nigerian Autonomous Foreign Exchange Rate Fixing window. Simula ng pag-harmonize, patuloy ang paghina ng naira laban sa dolyar kahit may mga hakbang ang gobyerno para patatagin ito. Bilang pagtaas ng kumpiyansa ng mga mamumuhunan, nagsimulang magbayad ang Central Bank ng mga naipong utang sa foreign exchange ng mga bangko nitong buwan. Ang harmonization ay sinimulan matapos himukin ni President Bola Tinubu sa kanyang inauguration speech na pag-isahin ang exchange rates ng Nigeria. Lalong naapektuhan ang halaga ng pondo ng pensyon dahil sa lumalalang inflation—mula 22.79% noong Hunyo ay umabot ito sa 26.72% noong Setyembre. Ayon kay Abdulqadir Dahiru, Head ng Corporate Communications ng PenCom, sa panayam ng The PUNCH, apektado hindi lamang ang pondo ng pensyon kundi pati ang ekonomiya sa kabuuan dahil sa devaluation. Paliwanag ni Dahiru, pareho raw ng epekto ang inflation at devaluation—bumababa ang halaga ng ipon dahil mas marami nang salapi ang kailangan upang makabili ng parehong produkto at serbisyo. Binanggit niyang ang mga pondo ng pensyon ay may iba’t ibang pinaglalagakan—may fixed-income at variable-income. Ang kita sa variable-income assets ay naa-adjust batay sa inflation, at kasama sa mga investment nito ang securities, infrastructure, private equity, at real estate investment trusts, kaya’t may proteksiyon sa epekto ng inflation. Isa ang mga pondo ng pensyon sa pinakamalalakas na manlalaro sa capital market ng Nigeria at napapansin din ito ng mga internasyonal na mamumuhunan. Noong Oktubre, bumisita ang mga institutional investor mula US sa Nigeria at hinikayat ang mga pagbabago sa regulasyon para palawakin ang partisipasyon ng pension funds sa equities market. Bunsod nito, nanawagan si Cameron Khosrowshahi, Investment Team Lead ng Prosper Africa, ng mas malapit na pagtutulungan sa pagitan ng mga stakeholder ng Nigeria at ng pension regulator upang mas marami pang pondo ang mailagay sa equities.

article_content: American President Barack Obama is expected to have extensive security measures during his arrival at the G20 world summit in Brisbane this November. Sources say Obama may be the only world leader not traveling from the Brisbane airport by car. Instead, according to the Courier Mail, he is considering being escorted by a private helicopter entourage for security reasons. Obama's arrival could involve traveling in his high-tech helicopter, Marine One, accompanied by several identical helicopters acting as decoys. While most other world leaders and about 4,000 delegates are expected to use motorcades along closed lanes that won’t stop at red lights, Obama's plans are more elaborate. It is anticipated that Obama will fly into the country aboard his customized aircraft, Air Force One, for the summit on November 15 and 16. There is still uncertainty over whether his armored limousine, known as 'The Beast,' will also be brought for his use during the event. The Secret Service vehicle is equipped with armored plating, 5-inch multi-layered windows, and is sealed against biochemical threats. Obama is also rumored to be the only leader reserving an entire hotel for himself and his entourage while in Australia. To prepare, police and the Queensland government have already begun major simulation exercises covering security from airport arrival to city transportation.

article_content: Jim Karr, a well-known Chicago coffee expert, died after being accidentally crushed by a coffee brewing machine he was dismantling. Karr, 48, had previously served as the director of brewing technology at Intelligentsia Coffee for many years, earning respect throughout the industry. He left Intelligentsia in 2012 to found his own company, SteamVolt, which provided technical support and innovative solutions for coffee businesses. The incident occurred as Karr was dismantling a commercial coffee maker after an outside event at the city’s charity Bike the Drive. He suffered serious head and chest injuries, which proved fatal. An autopsy confirmed that Karr died from multiple injuries due to being crushed. The death was ruled an accident, according to the Chicago Tribune. Colleagues and friends quickly paid tribute to Karr. Jesse from Dark Matter Coffee described him as 'an inspiration' and 'a legend and mentor to the entire specialty coffee community.' Nicholas Cho of Wrecking Ball Coffee Roasters in San Francisco called Karr 'one of the very few in the country known as a top expert at what he did.' Trey Elder, a former colleague at Intelligentsia, said, 'Most people serious about coffee ran into Jim at some point.' Karr was known for being quick-witted, quiet, and kind-hearted. His significant impact on the coffee community, both in Chicago and nationally, is widely recognized.

Umalis siya sa Intelligentsia noong 2012 upang itayo ang sariling kumpanya, ang SteamVolt, na nagbibigay ng technical support at makabagong solusyon sa mga negosyo ng kape. Nangyari ang insidente habang binabaklas ni Karr ang isang commercial coffee maker matapos ang charity event na Bike the Drive. Nagtamo siya ng seryosong pinsala sa ulo at dibdib na naging sanhi ng kanyang pagkamatay. Ayon sa autopsy, namatay si Karr dahil sa maraming pinsalang dulot ng pagdadagan. Idineklara ng Chicago Tribune na aksidente ang insidente. Agad na nagparangal ang mga kasamahan at kaibigan kay Karr. Sabi ni Trey Elder, dating kasamahan sa Intelligentsia, 'Halos lahat ng seryoso tungkol sa kanilang propesyon sa kape ay nakatagpo si Jim.' Kilala si Karr bilang mabilis mag-isip, tahimik, at mabait. Malaki ang naging ambag niya sa coffee community sa Chicago at sa buong bansa.

article_content: Bodie, once a bustling gold rush town in Mono County, California, now stands deserted. Though many buildings are abandoned, they still contain personal belongings left by former residents. The town was named after Waterman S. Bodey, who discovered gold there in 1859. Bodie reached its peak in the 1880s with a population of about 10,000. After the 1880s, Bodie's population started to decline as new gold sources were found elsewhere and miners moved away. A weathered sign in Bodie points to Maiden Lane and Virgin Alley, locations where the town's prostitutes once worked in small cabins known as cribs. The town was severely damaged by a fire in 1892, and by 1910, its population had dropped to 698. The last local newspaper ceased publication shortly after, in 1912. Despite another devastating fire in the 1930s, a small number of residents stayed for a few more decades. In the 1960s, Bodie was designated a state park to preserve its remaining buildings. English photographer Cat Burton visited Bodie to capture its eerie and well-preserved interiors, including classrooms with chalk writing still on the blackboards and personal items left in homes. Burton described seeing interiors full of possessions, from workshops with tools to shops with products still on display. She was particularly intrigued by the school, where textbooks, a globe, and other teaching materials remain. Burton remarked that the presence of these belongings makes it seem as if residents left suddenly. She found the morgue, filled with dusty coffins, both morbid and captivating. Other notable sites in Bodie include the deserted Swazey Hotel, the old jail and lockup, and the remains of the Bank of Bodie, whose vault still stands despite the building's destruction by fire in 1932. Photographs show decaying cars, workshops filled with rusty tools, homes complete with personal effects, and a schoolroom ready for students who will never return. Today, Bodie stands as a state park, its ghostly remains offering visitors a glimpse into its rich and turbulent past.
translated_content: Ang Bodie, na dating masiglang bayan ng gold rush sa Mono County, California, ay ngayon ay tiwangwang na. Bagaman marami sa mga gusali ay inabandona, naroon pa rin ang mga personal na gamit ng mga dating residente. Pinangalanan ang bayan mula kay Waterman S. Bodey, na unang nakatuklas ng ginto dito noong 1859. Naabot ng Bodie ang rurok nito noong 1880s na may populasyon na humigit-kumulang 10,000. Pagkatapos ng 1880s, nagsimulang bumaba ang populasyon ng Bodie habang nadiskubre ang bagong mga pinagkukunan ng ginto at nagsimulang lumisan ang mga minero. May isang luma at kupas na karatula sa Bodie na tumuturo sa Maiden Lane at Virgin Alley, mga lugar kung saan dati nagtatrabaho ang mga prostitute ng bayan sa maliliit na silid na tinatawag na cribs. Matindi ang naging pinsala ng isang sunog sa bayan noong 1892, at pagsapit ng 1910, bumaba na ang populasyon nito sa 698. Ang huling lokal na pahayagan ay nagsara kalaunan, noong 1912. Kahit nagkaroon ng panibagong malakas na sunog noong 1930s, may iilang residente pa ring nanatili sa loob ng ilang dekada. Noong 1960s, ginawang state park ang Bodie upang mapanatili ang natitirang mga gusali. Bumisita si English photographer Cat Burton sa Bodie upang kunan ng larawan ang kakaiba at napakagandang kalagayan ng mga interior, kabilang ang mga classroom na may nakasulat pa sa pisara at mga personal na gamit na naiwan sa mga bahay. Ikinuwento ni Burton na nakita niya ang mga interior na punô ng kagamitan: mula sa mga workshop na may kasangkapang bakal hanggang sa mga tindahan na may naka-display pa ring mga produkto. Lubos siyang naaliw sa eskuwelahan, kung saan naroon pa ang mga libro, globo, at iba pang gamit panturo. Sabi ni Burton, parang biglang naglaho ang mga nanirahan dahil sa dami ng mga gamit na naiwan. Natagpuan din niya ang morgue na puno ng maalikabok na kabaong—kakila-kilabot pero nakakaakit pa rin. Kabilang sa mga tampok na lugar sa Bodie ang inabandunang Swazey Hotel, ang dating kulungan, at ang Bank of Bodie na ang vault ay nakatayo pa rin kahit nawasak na ng sunog noong 1932 ang buong gusali. Makikita sa mga larawan ang mga sirang sasakyan, workshop na puno ng kalawangin na kagamitan, mga bahay na kompletong may gamit pa, at classroom na tila naghihintay pa rin ng mga estudyanteng hindi na babalik. Sa kasalukuyan, nananatiling state park ang Bodie, na ang kakaibang kalagayan nito ay nagbibigay-daan sa mga bisita na pasyalan at pagmasdan ang makulay at magulong nakaraan ng bayan.

article_content: Dr. Abdul Qadir Hammad, a British surgeon with the Liverpool International Transplant Initiative, had to abandon all his scheduled surgeries in Gaza after heavy Israeli attacks made it unsafe to operate. Dr. Hammad originally traveled to Gaza to perform urgent kidney transplants at Al-Shifa Hospital, the area’s main public medical center, not knowing that violence would soon erupt. On the day of his surgeries, Hamas launched a major attack on Israel, which quickly led to intense Israeli airstrikes on Gaza. Dr. Hammad said he woke to the sound of explosions and, after talking to the hospital director, realized it was too dangerous to continue. With the situation escalating, he contacted the World Health Organization, who recommended he leave his hotel for safety reasons. Dr. Hammad, along with about 20 other foreign nationals, has been staying at a UN facility since Sunday. He voiced serious concerns about the worsening shortages of electricity, food, and water for Gaza’s population and hospitals, warning that this could lead to a humanitarian disaster. Human rights groups have condemned the initial Hamas attack but have also criticized Israel’s decision to block essential supplies like food and fuel from entering Gaza, highlighting the toll on civilians. Dr. Hammad explained that kidney failure is deadly in Gaza because of limited treatment options, making his planned transplants particularly urgent. He is also worried for his own safety and his family in the UK. The UN has told Dr. Hammad and other foreigners that getting out of Gaza is nearly impossible, with the only option being to negotiate safe passage into Egypt, which will require talks with both Israeli and Egyptian authorities. Although the UN facility provides basic needs and internet, Dr. Hammad remains distressed about ordinary Gazans without such access. Reflecting on the crisis, Dr. Hammad wondered about the point of his efforts to save a few lives through surgery when violent conflict causes thousands of deaths in a matter of days.
translated_content: Kinailangang ihinto ni Dr. Abdul Qadir Hammad, isang British na siruhano mula sa Liverpool International Transplant Initiative, ang lahat ng nakatakda niyang operasyon sa Gaza matapos maging delikado dahil sa matitinding pag-atake ng Israel. Nakarating si Dr. Hammad sa Gaza upang magsagawa ng mga mahalagang kidney transplant sa Al-Shifa Hospital, ang pangunahing pampublikong ospital doon, na hindi alam na biglang sasabog ang karahasan. Noong araw ng kanyang mga operasyon, nagsimula ang pag-atake ng Hamas sa Israel, na agad sinundan ng matitinding airstrike ng Israel sa Gaza. Kwento ni Dr. Hammad, nagising siya sa ingay ng mga pagsabog at, matapos makausap ang direktor ng ospital, napagtantong napakapanganib para magpatuloy. Dahil lumala pang lalo ang sitwasyon, nakipag-ugnayan siya sa World Health Organization na nagsabing mas ligtas kung lalabas siya sa hotel. Kasama ang mahigit 20 pang dayuhang nasyonal, nagpalipat si Dr. Hammad sa isang pasilidad ng UN simula Linggo. Mabigat ang kanyang pag-aalala sa lumalalang kakulangan ng kuryente, pagkain, at tubig para sa mga taga-Gaza at mga ospital, at nagbabala siyang maaaring humantong ito sa malaking krisis pangtao. Kinondena ng mga grupo ng karapatang pantao ang unang atake ng Hamas at binatikos din ang hakbang ng Israel na pigilan ang mahahalagang suplay tulad ng pagkain at gasolina papasok ng Gaza, na nagpapabigat sa kalagayan ng mga sibilyan. Ipinaliwanag ni Dr. Hammad na ang pagkakaroon ng kidney failure ay napakadelikado sa Gaza, kaya mahalaga sana ang kanyang mga planong transplant. Nag-aalala rin siya sa sarili niyang kaligtasan at sa kanyang pamilya sa UK. Ayon sa UN, halos imposibleng makalabas sina Dr. Hammad at iba pang dayuhan mula Gaza, maliban na lang kung matiyak ang ligtas na daan patungong Egypt—isang prosesong mangangailangan ng kasundoan sa mga awtoridad ng Israel at Egypt. Bagamat may sapat na suplay at internet sa UN facility, nananatili ang pag-aalala ni Dr. Hammad para sa mga ordinaryong Gaza na wala ring access sa mga ito. Sa kanyang pagninilay, ibinahagi ni Dr. Hammad ang kanyang pagkadismaya—na habang sinusubukan niyang magligtas ng ilan sa pamamagitan ng operasyon, libo-libong tao naman agad ang namamatay dahil sa kaguluhan.

article_content: Anne Bulford, who currently serves as Chief Operating Officer at Channel 4, has been named the BBC’s Managing Director of Finance and Operations with a salary of £395,000. The incoming director-general, Lord Hall, appointed her directly without posting the job publicly. Scheduled to begin leading the BBC in April, Lord Hall previously worked alongside Bulford at the Royal Opera House and Channel 4, and emphasized her extensive experience as the reason for his decision. This direct appointment follows a similar process used for James Purnell, former Labour culture secretary, who was chosen as head of strategy and digital at the BBC, also without an open job posting. These decisions have prompted criticism over transparency and the possibility of favoritism at the BBC, especially from MP John Whittingdale, who questioned the substantial salaries being paid amidst budget reductions. Bulford has held previous senior roles at the BBC and could become the organization’s first female director-general. She succeeds Zarin Patel, and will absorb responsibilities from former Chief Operating Officer Caroline Thomson. Bulford expressed her enthusiasm about returning to the BBC and collaborating with Lord Hall again.
translated_content: Si Anne Bulford, na dating Chief Operating Officer ng Channel 4, ay itinalaga bilang bagong Managing Director of Finance and Operations ng BBC na may sahod na £395,000. Direktang itinalaga siya ng papasok na director-general na si Lord Hall, nang hindi na isinapubliko ang posisyon. Magsisimula si Lord Hall bilang pinuno ng BBC sa Abril, at dati na silang nagkasama ni Bulford sa Royal Opera House at Channel 4, kaya’t inilahad niyang ang malawak na karanasan nito ang naging batayan ng kanyang pagpili. Kapareho ito ng naging proseso kay James Purnell, dating Labour culture secretary, na hinirang ding head of strategy and digital ng BBC kahit walang opisyal na aplikasyon. Nagdulot ang mga pagkilalang ito ng batikos ukol sa transparency at posibleng paboritismo sa BBC, lalo na mula kay MP John Whittingdale na bumatikos sa mataas na sahod sa kabila ng pagputol ng budget. Dati nang humawak ng mataas na posisyon si Bulford sa BBC at maaaring siya ang maging unang babaeng director-general ng organisasyon. Papalitan niya si Zarin Patel at kukunin din ang ilan sa mga tungkulin ni Caroline Thomson, ang dating Chief Operating Officer. Sinabi ni Bulford na nasasabik siyang bumalik sa BBC at muling makatrabaho si Lord Hall.

article_content: The Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) has called on the Chief Justice of Nigeria, Justice Olukayode Ariwoola, to establish a judicial panel of inquiry into allegations of All Progressives Congress (APC) influence on a recent Court of Appeal judgment. On Sunday in Abuja, a three-member panel of the Court of Appeal, led by Justice Elfrieda Williams-Dawodu, overturned the election of Plateau State Governor Caleb Mutfwang (PDP) and named APC candidate Muntawe Goshwe as the rightful winner of the March 18 governorship election. In a Monday statement, PDP National Publicity Secretary Debo Ologunagba voiced the party’s dismay at a viral video featuring APC leader and Plateau State House of Representatives member Yusuf Gagdi, who allegedly claimed to have connections within the Supreme Court. Ologunagba argued that Gagdi's comments support growing public suspicions that the APC formed a special team—including two former governors now serving as cabinet ministers and a major party figure from the North-East—tasked with influencing judicial decisions against the PDP. The PDP further alleges that a former APC governor bribed members of the Plateau State Election Appeal Court Panel with $5 million, resulting in a biased judgment against Governor Mutfwang, contrary to legal precedents. Ologunagba claimed that the statements by Gagdi may explain why PDP victories in Plateau State’s National Assembly elections were overturned in favor of APC candidates following conflicting and contradictory court rulings. Warning that the situation risks escalating into a wider political crisis, the PDP insists that the judiciary is the last line of defense for Nigeria's democracy, and demands that the Chief Justice set up a high-level investigative panel into alleged APC court influence and bribery. In response, APC National Publicity Director Bala Ibrahim dismissed the PDP’s allegations, labeling them as results of poor sportsmanship. He argued that PDP is attempting to dictate judicial processes, and cautioned the party against inflammatory language that could undermine Nigeria's democracy.
translated_content: Nanawagan ang Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) kay Punong Mahistrado ng Nigeria, Justice Olukayode Ariwoola, na bumuo ng judicial panel upang imbestigahan ang umano'y impluwensiya ng All Progressives Congress (APC) sa desisyon ng Court of Appeal kamakailan. Noong Linggo sa Abuja, isang panel na binubuo ng tatlong miyembro ng Court of Appeal na pinamumunuan ni Justice Elfrieda Williams-Dawodu ang bumaligtad sa pagkapanalo ni Plateau State Governor Caleb Mutfwang (PDP) at idineklara si Muntawe Goshwe (APC) bilang tunay na nagwagi sa March 18 na gubernatorial election. Sa isang pahayag noong Lunes, ipinaabot ni PDP National Publicity Secretary Debo Ologunagba ang pagkadismaya ng partido ukol sa isang viral na video na nagpapakita kay APC leader at Plateau State House of Representatives member Yusuf Gagdi, na aniya'y may koneksyon sa Supreme Court. Ipinahayag ni Ologunagba na pinapalakas ng mga pahayag ni Gagdi ang mga hinala ng publiko na bumuo ang APC ng isang espesyal na grupo—kabilang ang dalawang dating gobernador na ngayon ay cabinet ministers at isang kilalang lider mula North-East—na layuning impluwensyahan ang mga desisyon ng hudikatura laban sa PDP. Dagdag ng PDP, may alegasyon na isang dating gobernador ng APC ay nanuhol umano ng $5 milyon sa mga kasapi ng Plateau State Election Appeal Court Panel para makamit ang desisyong pumapabor sa APC at laban kay Governor Mutfwang—na kabaligtaran ng mga umiiral na legal na patakaran. Ayon pa kay Ologunagba, maaaring mas malinaw naipaliwanag ng pahayag ni Gagdi kung bakit napunta sa mga kandidato ng APC ang tagumpay sa halalan na dapat sana'y PDP ang nagwagi, bunsod ng magkakasalungat at magulong takbo ng mga desisyon ng korte. Nagbabala ang PDP na maaaring humantong sa mas malalaking kaguluhan ang sitwasyon kung hindi agad maaaksyunan, kaya't iginiit na ang hudikatura ang huling pananggalang ng demokrasya sa Nigeria. Nanawagan din itong bumuo ng imbestigasyon ukol sa umano'y impluwensiya at panunuhol ng APC sa mga korte. Sa pagtugon, mariing itinanggi ng APC National Publicity Director na si Bala Ibrahim ang mga paratang, at iginiit na ito ay produkto lamang ng hindi pagtanggap ng PDP sa pagkatalo. Binalaan niya ang partido laban sa paggamit ng pananalitang maaaring makasira sa demokrasya ng bansa.

article_content:
Military snipers stationed on board helicopters will patrol the skies above London during the 2012 Olympic Games as part of heightened security measures. According to sources, these highly-trained RAF marksmen—dubbed ‘heli-snipers’—will monitor the city from the air to counter any possible terrorist threats targeting this international event.

The snipers have recently undergone training at the restricted Lydd military live-firing range in Kent to prepare for Olympic deployment. Operating from Merlin and Lynx MK7 helicopters—types used in previous operations in Iraq and Afghanistan—the snipers are equipped with Barrett ‘Light Fifty’ .50-caliber rifles, capable of neutralizing threats more than a mile away and penetrating both engine blocks and concrete barriers. Their training includes night operations, utilizing night-vision sights and infrared lasers for accurate targeting, while maintaining secure communications with ground commanders.

Previously deployed in Iraq as a ‘special weapon’ against insurgent threats, these airborne sharpshooters provided round-the-clock protection and surveillance. The Olympics will mark the first time they may see operational duty over UK cities, specifically to safeguard key venues such as the Olympic Stadium and Aquatic Centre in East London.

In addition to helicopter-based snipers, surface-to-air missiles are under consideration for Olympic security, as confirmed by Defence Secretary Philip Hammond in response to questions in Parliament. This disclosure follows news that the US may deploy up to 1,000 armed security agents, including 500 FBI officers, to safeguard its athletes during the Games.

A Ministry of Defence spokesperson stated that the MoD is deeply involved in security planning for the Olympics, with the armed forces expected to provide specialist support as needed. However, the operation will be led by the police, with military assistance in a supporting capacity. While detailed information on personnel numbers or specific plans has not been released, officials emphasized that preparations address a range of possible contingencies. These actions are not in response to any identified threat, but are part of comprehensive measures to ensure the safety and security of the London Olympic Games.

Ang mga sniper ay sumailalim kamakailan sa pagsasanay sa Lydd military live-firing range sa Kent bilang paghahanda sa Olympic deployment. Gagamit sila ng Merlin at Lynx MK7 helicopters—mga uri ng helikopter na nagamit na sa mga operasyon sa Iraq at Afghanistan. May dala silang Barrett ‘Light Fifty’ na .50-caliber rifles na kayang tumama sa target mula mahigit isang milya ang layo at makalusot sa makina ng sasakyan o kongkretong pader. Kasama sa kanilang pagsasanay ang night operations gamit ang night-vision sights at infrared lasers para sa tamang pagpuntirya habang naka-komunika sa mga commander sa lupa gamit ang secure na military radio.

Nagamit na rin ang mga sniper na ito sa Iraq bilang ‘special weapon’ laban sa mga rebelde, kung saan sila ay nagbibigay ng tuloy-tuloy na proteksyon at surveillance. Unang pagkakataon itong gagamitin sila sa tungkulin sa mga siyudad ng UK, lalo na para protektahan ang mga pangunahing lugar gaya ng Olympic Stadium at Aquatic Centre sa East London.

Bukod sa mga heli-sniper, pinag-aaralan din ang paggamit ng surface-to-air missiles para sa seguridad ng Olympics, ayon kay Defence Secretary Philip Hammond noong tinanong sa Parliament. Kasunod nito ang balitang magpapadala rin ang US ng hanggang 1,000 armado at trained na security agents, kasama na ang 500 mula sa FBI, upang bantayan ang kanilang mga atleta sa palaro.

Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng Ministry of Defence, aktibong kasama ang MoD sa paghahanda para sa seguridad ng Olympics at magbibigay ng espesyalistang suporta kung kinakailangan. Gayunpaman, pamumunuan pa rin ng pulisya ang operasyon at susuportahan lang ng militar. Hindi pa inilalabas ang eksaktong bilang ng mga personnel o detalye ng plano, ngunit nilinaw ng opisyal na ito ay bahagi ng masusing paghahanda para sa iba't ibang sitwasyon. Wala umanong partikular na banta, kundi bahagi lang ito ng pagtitiyak sa seguridad at kaligtasan ng London Olympic Games.

article_content: When Susan Patton, a Princeton graduate, publicly encouraged Princeton women to find husbands before finishing college, her statement quickly sparked heated discussion, ranging from support to strong opposition. But what should young women really take from this advice? Decades of research suggest that waiting to get married actually benefits both women and men. Women who marry later are less likely to experience divorce, more likely to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families, and often report higher satisfaction in balancing work and family life. Even reports focused on the potential downsides of delayed marriage, such as one by the National Marriage Project titled 'Knot Yet,' acknowledge that postponing marriage generally helps women and their future families by increasing socioeconomic prospects, particularly among privileged groups, and reducing the risk of divorce. This trend is partly a reflection of the evolving economic landscape. In today’s world, developing the insights and skills needed to succeed as adults takes longer. It's not just about acquiring practical knowledge for a changing job market—it's also about understanding one's values and what qualities matter in a life partner. Based on interviews with young women from diverse backgrounds, many agree that it's essential to know yourself before making a lifelong commitment. For instance, one respondent who was the first in her family to complete college said, 'you need to figure out who you are first before settling down.' Whether attending elite universities or balancing community college with work, these women recognize the complexities of modern relationships. Most aspire to long-lasting partnerships but believe that building personal independence gives them the best foundation for a successful marriage. As one put it, finishing her education and building financial security were priorities before considering marriage: 'I want to be stable for myself, so I'm not rushing.' Perhaps unsurprisingly, the age at first marriage has steadily climbed over the years, now averaging around 27 for women and 29 for men. Young people increasingly realize that opportunities don't disappear after graduation; they can take their time to develop their sense of self and make important life decisions—even if that means delaying marriage. So why did Patton's advice receive so much attention? It's possible that, despite progress in gender equality and greater access for women to institutions like Princeton, many traditional ideas still persist. Patton's letter does not question the assumption that women should marry someone more accomplished, educated, or older—nor does it address the assumption of only heterosexual partnerships. A meaningful shift toward gender equity requires examining and discarding these longstanding beliefs about choosing a partner. True equality means moving past the idea that all women should seek partners who are superior in age or achievement. Instead, many young women value mutual support, respect, and genuine connection in relationships. Ultimately, decisions about marriage are deeply personal, and broad, generalized advice is more likely to cause stress than to be genuinely helpful. Rather than prescribing choices for the next generation, a better approach is to ensure they have access to the resources and opportunities needed to create balanced, fulfilling relationships and careers—regardless of when or if they decide to marry.
translated_content: Nang inanyayahan ni Susan Patton, isang nagtapos sa Princeton, ang mga babaeng estudyante sa Princeton na humanap ng mapapangasawa bago magtapos, agad itong nagdulot ng malawak na usapan—mula sa suporta hanggang sa pagtutol. Pero ano nga ba ang dapat isaalang-alang ng mga kabataang babae sa payong ito? Ipinapakita ng maraming taon ng pananaliksik na ang pagpapaliban ng kasal ay mas kapaki-pakinabang, hindi lang sa mga babae kundi pati na rin sa mga lalaki. Ang mga babaeng nagpapakasal ng mas huli ay mas mababa ang tsansa na maghiwalay, mas may pagkakataon na magkaroon ng pinansiyal na katatagan para sa sarili at pamilya, at mas malaki ang tsansa na makamit ang kasiyahan sa trabaho at tahanan. Kahit ang mga ulat na tumatalakay sa posibleng negatibong dulot ng late marriage, tulad ng 'Knot Yet' mula sa National Marriage Project, ay nagkakaisa na ang pagpapaliban ng kasal ay kadalasang nagdudulot ng mas magandang socioeconomic prospects, lalo para sa mga mas may pribilehiyo, at nagpapababa ng tsansang maghiwalay. Ang trend na ito ay kaugnay na rin ng pagbabago sa ekonomiya. Sa panahon ngayon, mas matagal bago ganap na ma-develop ang mga kakayahan at kaalaman na kailangan sa pag-adult. Hindi lang ito tungkol sa kung paano makakuha ng trabaho sa nagbabagong mundo, kundi pati na rin sa pag-unawa sa sariling mga pagpapahalaga at kung anong katangian ang mahalaga sa paghahanap ng kasama sa buhay. Batay sa mga panayam sa iba’t ibang kababaihan, marami ang nagsasabing mahalaga munang kilalanin ang sarili bago magdesisyon na magpakasal. Halimbawa, isang nagrespondeng siya ang kauna-unahang nagtapos sa kanilang pamilya, ang sabi, 'kailangan mo munang malaman kung sino ka bago magsettle.' Maging galing man sila sa sikat na unibersidad o nagtatrabaho habang nag-aaral sa community college, nauunawaan nila ang mga hamon ng relasyon sa ngayon. Gusto pa rin ng karamihan ang panatagalang pagsasama, ngunit alam nila na mas mainam munang maging independent. Sabi pa ng isa, inuna niyang tapusin ang pag-aaral at makaipon bago ang kasal: 'Gusto ko munang maging stable bago maagapan ang kasal.' Hindi na nakakagulat na tumaas ang edad ng unang pagpapakasal—ngayon, nasa 27 taon gulang na sa babae at 29 sa lalaki ang average. Napapansin na ng mga kabataan na hindi naman sa pagtatapos ng pag-aaral natatapos ang mga oportunidad—they can take their time para paghandaan ang mga mahahalagang desisyon sa buhay. Bakit nga ba naging malaking isyu ang payo ni Patton? Maaaring dahil, sa kabila ng pag-usbong ng binibigay na pagkakataon sa kababaihan, lalo na sa mga institusyon gaya ng Princeton, may nananatiling mga tradisyonal na pananaw. Hindi tinutukoy ni Patton ang usaping dapat bang piliin ng babae ang mas may accomplishment, mas edukado, o mas matanda—o ang assumption na laging heterosexual ang relasyon. Ang tunay na pagbabago tungo sa gender equality ay nangangailangan ng pagkwestyon at pagtakwil sa luma nang mga pamantayan pagdating sa pagpili ng partner. Ang tunay na pagkakapantay-pantay ay pagtanggap na hindi dapat pare-parehas ang batayan at mas mahalaga ang mutual support, respeto, at tunay na koneksyon. Sa huli, napaka-personal ng desisyon pagdating sa kasal, at ang mga general na payo ay kadalasang nagdadala lang ng stress kaysa totoong tulong. Imbis na idikta ang pamantayan, mas mainam na bigyang suporta ang kabataan upang makapili ng balanse at fulfilling na buhay at karera—kahit kailan o kung nais man nilang magpakasal.

article_content: Britons spend more online per person than any other country, averaging £1,175 annually. This is significantly higher than spending in Australia (£867) and the USA (£663). The shift to online shopping is impacting UK high streets, leading to increased empty shops and prompting calls for redevelopment into housing, schools, gyms, and community spaces. Recent studies show that 73% of UK residents with internet access buy goods online for delivery at least once a month, and one in four does so every week. Online grocery shopping is especially advanced in the UK. The popularity of smartphones like the iPhone and Samsung Galaxy has contributed to this trend, with 71% of mobile users accessing the internet via their devices—second only to Spain's 75%. Advertisers targeting shoppers through smartphones spend more per person in the UK (£8.04) than anywhere else; Japan comes second at £7.50, and the US averages £6.74. Amazon is a major beneficiary of the UK's online shopping growth, although its employment practices and delivery operations have been criticized. Its Peterborough fulfilment center is often highlighted, and the company is reportedly considering using delivery drones. Amazon staff pick up an order every 33 seconds on average. TV viewing habits are also changing: 36% of Britons access TV content online weekly. Social networks, especially Facebook, and the photo-sharing platform Instagram are among the top and fastest-growing search terms in the UK. The Ofcom study compared internet, mobile, and TV services across 17 countries, including much of Europe, the US, and the Far East. YouTube is the most popular site for online video, with two-thirds of UK laptop and desktop users visiting each month. Ofcom reports that UK online shopping spend in 2012 averaged £1,175 per person, ahead of Australia (£867), the USA (£663), Spain (£180), and Italy (£126). Total UK online spending reached £74.3 billion in 2012 and is expected to rise by at least 10% the following year. Survey responses found 59% of British shoppers believe it's cheaper to shop online, 58% say it is easier, 50% say it is quicker, and 47% appreciate the greater choice. Online clothing and shoe sales are growing rapidly, supported by companies like Asos and department stores with easy return policies. Trust in online retailers is high among Britons, with many confident that goods will be delivered promptly. However, 40% see delivery charges as too high, 30% worry purchases may not arrive, and 19% avoid shopping online due to concerns about collecting items after missed deliveries. Issues have been reported about parcels left in insecure places. One in seven high street shops in the UK is empty—a figure expected to increase as online sales expand.

article_content: Ahead of the Madhya Pradesh assembly elections, former dacoit Malkhan Singh has joined the Congress party in the presence of State Congress President Kamal Nath. The names of infamous dacoits such as Gabbar, Phoolan Devi, and Dadua remain rooted in the local naming traditions of the regions they once influenced. As reported by the Times of India, the Chambal and Vindhya regions—historically notorious as the badlands of Madhya Pradesh—continue to reflect the legacy of these outlaws. Many residents in Chambal still bear names such as Phoolan Devi, Malkhan Singh, and Paan Singh Tomar, while in the Vindhya region, the name Dadua is prevalent, with approximately 300 voters sharing it. Shivkumar Patel, also known as Dadua, was a notorious dacoit who once terrorized the Vindhya region. The frequency of these names is typically confined to the areas where the respective outlaws were active. For example, Gabbar Singh is rarely found as a name in the Vindhya region, while few individuals named Dadua live in the Chambal area. This pattern extends to other well-known dacoits as well. In previous years, some of these figures influenced elections, with family members of Dadua winning parliamentary and legislative assembly elections in neighboring Uttar Pradesh. Importantly, Malkhan Singh has now transitioned into mainstream politics with the Congress party and has campaigned for them, after previously supporting the BJP during the 2014 elections. According to former Madhya Pradesh Director General of Police Surendra Sinh, who served extensively in the Chambal region, the continued use of dacoit-related names is due to tradition, not any admiration for former criminals. He explains that certain names become common in specific areas, more from habit than hero-worship. Sinh notes that some names, like 'Latkhor' in Chhattisgarh, may even be considered derogatory elsewhere. Overall, the prevalence of these names highlights longstanding regional customs rather than support for the individuals themselves.
translated_content: Bago ang eleksyon sa Madhya Pradesh, sumali ang dating tulisan na si Malkhan Singh sa partido ng Congress sa harap ni State Congress President Kamal Nath. Ang mga pangalan ng mga kilalang tulisan tulad nila Gabbar, Phoolan Devi, at Dadua ay nananatiling bahagi ng lokal na tradisyon sa pagpapangalan sa mga rehiyong dati nilang naiimpluwensyahan. Ayon sa ulat ng Times of India, patuloy na nararamdaman sa mga rehiyon ng Chambal at Vindhya—na dati'y tinuturing na mapanganib sa Madhya Pradesh—ang impluwensya ng mga dating tulisan. Maraming taga-Chambal ang may mga pangalan tulad ng Phoolan Devi, Malkhan Singh, at Paan Singh Tomar; habang sa Vindhya, laganap ang pangalan na Dadua, at humigit-kumulang 300 botante ang may ganoong pangalan. Si Shivkumar Patel, kilala rin bilang Dadua, ay dating kinakatakutang tulisan sa rehiyon ng Vindhya. Madalas, ang paggamit ng mga pangalang ito ay limitado sa mga lugar kung saan sila aktibo noon. Halimbawa, bihirang may Gabbar Singh sa Vindhya at konti lang ang Dadua sa Chambal. Makikita rin ang ganitong pattern sa iba pang dating tulisan. Noon, nakontrol pa ng ilan sa kanila ang takbo ng eleksyon, at ang pamilya ni Dadua ay nanalo ng posisyon sa parliamentary at legislative assembly elections sa kalapit na Uttar Pradesh. Mahahalagang tandaan na si Malkhan Singh ay pumalaot na sa mainstream na pulitika sa pamamagitan ng Congress at aktibo niyang sinusuportahan ito, matapos magbigay suporta sa BJP noong 2014 elections. Ayon kay dating Director General of Police ng Madhya Pradesh na si Surendra Sinh, na naging matagal sa serbisyo sa Chambal, ang paglaganap ng mga pangalan ng tulisan ay bunga lamang ng tradisyon at hindi pagpapakita ng paghanga. Paliwanag niya, may mga pangalan talaga na naging uso dahil sa lokal na kaugalian, hindi bilang pagsuporta sa mga dating tulisan. Dagdag niya, may mga pangalan tulad ng 'Latkhor' na pwede palang derogatory depende sa lugar. Sa kabuuan, ang pagkalat ng mga pangalan ng tulisan ay nagpapakita ng malalim na kasaysayang pampangalan sa rehiyon at hindi ng pagsuporta sa mga taong pinagmulan ng mga ito.

Replanting trees, grasses, and other vegetation is vital for restoring degraded ecosystems. However, a new survey of nearly 2,600 restoration projects from diverse ecosystems worldwide reveals that most of these efforts overlook a crucial threat: plant-eating animals, or herbivores.

"While most projects took steps to eliminate competing plant species, only about 10% took actions to control or temporarily exclude herbivores, even though young plants are especially vulnerable to grazing," said Brian Silliman, Rachel Carson Distinguished Professor of Marine Conservation Biology at Duke University's Nicholas School of the Environment. This oversight, he added, means conservationists miss out on significant opportunities to make restoration faster, more successful, and more cost-effective.

"Our analysis shows that bringing in predators to limit herbivore populations, or using barriers to keep herbivores away until plants are established, can boost plant regrowth by an average of 89%," said Silliman, a co-author of the study.

These gains are as high or higher than those seen from excluding competing plant species, according to the survey. "It raises the question: why aren't we controlling herbivores more often?" Silliman noted.

The survey involved an international team from 20 universities and institutions, and the results were published in the journal Science. The study was co-led by Qiang He, a coastal ecology professor at Fudan University and former postdoc at Duke, along with Changlin Xu of He's Coastal Ecology Lab.

Qiang He pointed out that herbivores' impacts are strongest in hot, dry regions. This finding has major implications for restoring vegetation in the face of climate change.

Silliman emphasized, "If we want more plants, we need to restore predator populations or let more predators in." The decline of large predators like wolves, lions, and sharks, which naturally control herbivore numbers, likely contributes to overgrazing.

"Traditional restoration methods are slowing losses but not expanding vegetation in many areas, and climate change could make this tougher," Silliman said. "Adding predator management to restored sites is a promising but underused strategy that could accelerate ecosystem recovery and reduce costs—like finding a gardening tip that doubles your yield."

Silliman stressed that herbivores are crucial for long-term ecosystem health once plants are established. "Plants just need a break from grazing to get started. After that, herbivores help maintain diversity and ecosystem function."

Ang muling pagtatanim ng mga puno, damo, at iba pang halaman ay mahalaga sa pagpapanumbalik ng mga nasirang ecosystem. Ngunit ayon sa isang bagong pag-aaral ng halos 2,600 na proyekto ng pagpapanumbalik mula sa iba’t ibang ecosystem sa buong mundo, madalas na hindi nabibigyang-pansin ng mga proyektong ito ang isang mahigpit na banta: ang mga hayop na kumakain ng halaman, o herbivore.

"Bagama't karamihan sa mga proyekto ay gumagawa ng hakbang upang alisin ang mga kalabang halaman, nasa 10% lang ang umaksyon para kontrolin o pansamantalang pagbawalan ang mga herbivore, kahit napaka-delikado pa ng mga batang halaman sa pagkain ng mga hayop," ayon kay Brian Silliman, Rachel Carson Distinguished Professor of Marine Conservation Biology ng Nicholas School of the Environment sa Duke University. Dahil dito, nawawala ang malaking tsansa ng mga tagapagtaguyod ng kalikasan na mapabilis, mapaganda, at mapamura ang pagpapanumbalik.

"Ayon sa aming pagsusuri, ang pagdadala ng mga predator para kontrolin ang populasyon ng mga herbivore, o paggamit ng mga harang para maprotektahan ang mga tanim habang mahina pa, ay kayang magpataas ng paglago ng mga halaman ng halos 89% sa karaniwan," ani Silliman, isa sa mga may-akda ng pag-aaral.

Ang mga benepisyong ito ay katumbas o mas mataas pa sa naidudulot ng pagtanggal ng mga kalabang halaman, ayon sa survey. "Ito ang tanong: bakit hindi pa natin mas napagtutuunan ng pansin ang pagkontrol sa mga herbivore?" dagdag niya.

Ang survey ay isinagawa ng grupong internasyonal mula sa 20 unibersidad at institusyon at inilathala sa journal na Science. Pinangunahan ito nina Qiang He, propesor ng coastal ecology sa Fudan University at dating postdoc sa Duke, at Changlin Xu ng Coastal Ecology Lab ni He.

Binanggit ni Qiang He na pinakamatindi ang epekto ng mga herbivore sa mainit at tuyong lugar. Mahalaga ito para sa pagpapanumbalik ng mga halaman lalo pa’t may pagbabago ng klima.

Binigyang-diin ni Silliman, "Kung gusto natin ng mas maraming halaman, dapat nating ibalik ang mga predator." Ang pagbaba ng bilang ng malalaking predator gaya ng lobo, leon, at pating—na natural na nagkokontrol sa populasyon ng mga herbivore—ay malamang na nagdudulot ng labis na pagkain sa mga halaman.

"Ang tradisyonal na restorasyon ay nagpapabagal ng pagkawala ng mga halaman pero hindi nagpaparami ng mga ito—at lalo pa itong palalalain ng climate change," ani Silliman. "Ang paggamit ng predators para magkontrol ng mga herbivore ay isa pang pamamaraan na hindi pa masyadong nagagamit pero pwedeng magpabilis ng ecosystem recovery at makatipid sa gastos—parang bagong teknik sa hardin na dumodoble sa ani."

Dagdag pa ni Silliman, mahalaga pa rin ang mga herbivore kapag lumalakas na ang tanim. "Ang mga halaman kailangan lang ng pahinga mula sa pagkain ng mga hayop para magsimula—pagkatapos noon, importante ang mga hayop para sa balanse at pagkakaiba-iba ng ecosystem."
