article_content: Just before she turned 22, Lauren Bradfield suffered two strokes that left her partially paralyzed on her left side. Her second stroke occurred exactly one year after the first. At 20, Lauren mistook her intense headache and dizziness for a hangover, not realizing she was experiencing a stroke. The event left her unable to move the left side of her body, and medical professionals doubted she would walk again. Following three months of intensive hospital care, Lauren endured a second stroke at age 21—on the same date as the previous year. Again, she was told her chances of walking were slim. However, within a year of her second stroke, she beat the odds, learning to walk again and even finishing a 10k race. Lauren’s journey highlights that strokes can affect any age group. The Stroke Association reports that a quarter of strokes in the UK occur in people under 65. Lauren shared how difficult it was to be told twice that she might never walk, yet she refused to give up. Her first stroke happened after a day mixing alcohol and heat, which led to a severe headache, then worsening dizziness and an inability to stand. Scans confirmed a brain bleed, and she was rushed for neurological treatment. Strokes result when blood supply to the brain is blocked or there’s a bleed, harming the affected brain cells. The results can affect movement, speech, thinking, emotions, and overall functioning. Stroke risk factors include age, genetics, chronic conditions such as high blood pressure and diabetes, plus lifestyle choices—diet, smoking, alcohol, drugs, and activity level. Lauren’s genetic background includes a family history of blood clots, which increase stroke risk. After the initial trauma, Lauren stayed in neurological rehab for months, facing an uncertain outcome—treatment options were risky but necessary. Despite warnings, Lauren remained resolute. The second stroke a year later was a huge setback. Still, with medical care and her family’s support, she recovered much faster. Rehab allowed her to walk unaided after just a few months. Inspired, she raised money for The Stroke Association by running a race. Now, Lauren is back to work, enjoying sports like hockey, and takes blood-thinning medication for life. She has raised hundreds of pounds for stroke research and advocates for greater awareness, stressing that strokes can happen to younger adults. Nikki Hill from The Stroke Association says that while strokes before age 25 are rare, many under 65 are affected—so managing health risks is essential.
translated_content: Bago sumapit ang kaniyang ika-22 kaarawan, dalawang beses na inatake ng stroke si Lauren Bradfield na nagdulot ng pagkaparalisa sa kaliwang bahagi ng kaniyang katawan. Ang ikalawang stroke ay nangyari eksaktong isang taon matapos ang una. Sa edad na 20, inakala ni Lauren na ang matinding sakit ng ulo at pagkahilo ay dahil lamang sa hangover, hindi niya namalayang stroke na pala iyon. Naparalisa ang kaliwang bahagi ng kaniyang katawan, at sinabi ng mga doktor na malabong makalakad siyang muli. Matapos ang tatlong buwan ng gamutan sa ospital, na-stroke muli si Lauren sa edad na 21—eksaktong isang taon pagkatapos ng naunang atake. Muling sinabi sa kaniya na maliit ang tsansang makalakad, ngunit sa loob lamang ng isang taon mula sa pangalawang stroke, nalampasan niya ang mga hamon: natutunan niyang maglakad muli at nakatakbo pa ng 10k run. Ipinapakita ng kwento ni Lauren na puwedeng magkaroon ng stroke ang kahit sinong edad. Sabi ng The Stroke Association, isang-kapat ng mga kaso ng stroke sa UK ay kabilang sa mga wala pang 65 taong gulang. Ikinuwento ni Lauren kung gaano kahirap ang masabihan ng dalawang beses na hindi na siya makalalakad, ngunit hindi siya sumuko. Nangyari ang una niyang stroke matapos ang isang araw ng pag-inom at pagbilad sa init—nagkaroon siya ng matinding sakit ng ulo, pagkahilo, at hirap tumayo. Nang isnagawa ang pag-scan, nakita ang pagdurugo sa kaniyang utak at agad siyang isinailalim sa gamutan. Ang stroke ay nangyayari kapag nahihinto ang daloy ng dugo sa utak, dulot ng pagbabara o pagdurugo. Nagdudulot ito ng iba’t ibang epekto depende sa apektadong bahagi ng utak—maaring makaapekto sa paggalaw, pananalita, kaisipan, at emosyon. Kabilang sa mga panganib sa stroke ang edad, lahi, mga karamdaman katulad ng high blood pressure at diabetes, at mga lifestyle choice gaya ng pagkain, paninigarilyo, pag-inom ng alak, paggamit ng droga, at antas ng physical activity. May kasaysayan ng blood clot ang pamilya ni Lauren kaya mataas din ang panganib niya. Pagkatapos ng unang stroke, ilang buwan siyang nag-rehab sa ospital at humarap sa hindi tiyak na resulta—risky pero kinakailangan ang mga gamutan. Kahit may pagdududa ang mga doktor, hindi bumitaw si Lauren. Ang ikalawang stroke makalipas ang isang taon ay naging mabigat na pagsubok. Pero sa tulong ng medikal na atensyon at suporta ng pamilya, mabilis siyang nakabawi. Sa tulong ng rehab, nakalakad siyang muli pagkalipas lang ng ilang buwan. Na-inspire siyang mag-fundraising para sa The Stroke Association. Ngayon, balik-trabaho at sports na si Lauren, at panghabambuhay nang iinom ng blood thinners. Nakalikom na siya ng malaking halaga para sa pananaliksik sa stroke at patuloy na nagbabahagi ng aral: kahit kabataan ay puwedeng ma-stroke. Sabi ni Nikki Hill ng The Stroke Association, bihira ang stroke bago mag-25, pero marami pa ring tinatamaan na mas bata sa 65—kaya napakahalagang pangalagaan ang kalusugan.

article_content: Sanjiv Bhasin, Director at IIFL Securities, is optimistic about India's pharma sector. He called Lupin his 'dark horse' pick, citing its strong recent performance and potential for further growth. Bhasin also recommended considering a basket including Cipla, which is viewed as a takeover target, alongside Dr. Reddy’s and Sun Pharma. For Divi’s Labs, he suggested buying on declines due to its leading role in API contract manufacturing. Bhasin noted that while most pharma companies saw improved earnings, Divi’s missed margin expectations. However, company management, including Divi’s, sounded confident about a better second half of the year. He highlighted strong recent results from Cipla, Sun Pharma, and Dr. Reddy’s, and reiterated that Lupin has benefited from changes in generic pricing, distribution, and new product launches. On smallcap opportunities, Bhasin observed that smallcaps are more volatile than largecaps and identified Idea and TTML as bargains. He recommended Devyani International as a small and midcap stock with strong management and business prospects. Regarding Nykaa, Bhasin did not offer a detailed view as he hadn’t fully reviewed its latest numbers, preferring Zomato, PB Fintech, and Paytm. He remains cautious due to competition in the sector. Responding to questions about Mamaearth and ASK IPOs, Bhasin declined to comment because of IIFL’s involvement as merchant banker. Bhasin attributed the pharma sector's revival to attractive generic pricing, expanded international reach, and the sector’s appeal during a weak rupee, positioning pharma as a strong alternative to IT investments. He advised investors to diversify with pharma-focused mutual funds, particularly SBI and Nippon, highlighting their strong fund management. On real estate, Bhasin stated that the sector is robust nationwide, with high demand and strong fundamentals, recommending investors hold until after the elections or budget, as asset prices are expected to rise. Discussing Zomato, Bhasin acknowledged its significant market cap relative to profits but emphasized its innovative role and sector leadership. He encouraged long-term holding in new-age companies like Zomato, Paytm, and PB Fintech, despite short-term volatility. Overall, Bhasin encouraged investors to ride momentum in sectors like pharma, real estate, and tech, keep diversified portfolios, and avoid market timing.

article_content:
Google has rolled out new accessibility features designed to make everyday technology more inclusive for people with disabilities. The updates, announced in October by Senior Director of Products Eve Andersson, include tools to locate disabled-owned businesses in Google Maps and Search, accessible walking directions, and expanded wheelchair accessibility information in public places.

Laura Allen, who heads accessibility partnerships and strategy at Google and lives with a rare visual impairment, leads efforts to bridge teams and build accessible tools. She works closely with internal groups and the Disability Alliance resource group to collect feedback and promote accessibility at all company levels.

Among the latest features, businesses can now voluntarily identify as disabled-owned on Google Maps and Search, a move that highlights disability representation alongside other minority-owned labels. This was launched during National Disability Employment Awareness Month. Another enhancement allows users to easily find out if a location has wheelchair-accessible entrances and restrooms—features available on Android and in cars via Android Auto.

Allen points out that while these updates primarily help disabled users, they benefit anyone who needs accessible routes, like parents with strollers or travelers carrying luggage. She also mentions features like Guided Frame, which assists blind or low-vision users in taking photos.

Positive feedback is coming from both the public and within Google. Initiatives like Accessibility and Disability Inclusion Week, which now runs for a month each October, demonstrate the company's sustained focus on making technology more inclusive. Allen stresses that accessibility work is ongoing and that building awareness and practical tools remains a priority at Google.

Pakistan has never secured a Test series victory in Australia, but new captain Shan Masood views the upcoming tour as a chance to 'change history.' Masood, 34, recently took over as Test skipper after Babar Azam stepped down from all captaincy roles. The tour to Australia will be Masood’s first series as leader.

"When you haven’t achieved something in history, you have the opportunity to change it," he said during a press conference in Lahore ahead of the team’s departure. "We’ll strive to deliver positive results for Pakistan and the World Test Championship."

Pakistan currently tops the World Test Championship 2023-25 cycle after wins in both Tests against Sri Lanka. India stands second, with Australia third in the nine-team table. However, Australia remains formidable after winning the last World Test Championship cycle and clinching the 50-over World Cup earlier this month.

The Test series begins with the first match in Perth on December 14, followed by Melbourne (December 26-30), and ends in Sydney (January 3-7). On their last tour to Australia in 2019, Pakistan lost both Tests by an innings—a series in which Masood participated.

"We need to score 400 and then take 20 wickets," Masood stated, outlining the team’s goals. "We couldn’t achieve this in 2019, so that’s our objective this time."

Masood acknowledged Australia’s high confidence. "The key is believing we can play well, and that everyone contributes to make things tough for Australia." He emphasized the team’s solid preparation, noting efforts to replicate Australian conditions at their Rawalpindi training camp, known for its bouncy pitch.

Masood also praised the appointment of former England captain Adam Hollioake, who coaches in Australia, as the team’s new batting coach. "Teams bring in people with local expertise—his knowledge of Australian conditions will help us adapt," Masood noted.

He expressed support for his predecessor, Babar Azam, predicting a strong tour from him and highlighting Azam’s central role in the batting lineup. "We want to play a brand of cricket that excites our fans—a determined and entertaining style," said Masood.

"Kapag hindi mo pa naabot ang isang tagumpay sa kasaysayan, may pagkakataon kang baguhin ito," pahayag ni Masood sa isang press conference sa Lahore bago umalis ang koponan. "Pagsisikapan naming magdala ng positibong resulta para sa Pakistan at sa World Test Championship."

Nangunguna ngayon ang Pakistan sa World Test Championship 2023-25 cycle matapos manalo sa parehong Test laban sa Sri Lanka. Pangalawa ang India at pangatlo ang Australia sa siyam na koponan sa table. Gayunman, matindi pa rin ang Australia matapos magwagi sa huling World Test Championship cycle at maiuwi ang 50-over World Cup ngayong buwan.

Magsisimula ang Test series sa unang laban sa Perth sa Disyembre 14, kasunod ang Melbourne (Disyembre 26-30), at magtatapos sa Sydney (Enero 3-7). Noong huling tour nila sa Australia noong 2019, natalo ang Pakistan ng parehong Test sa pamamagitan ng isang innings—siryeng sinalihan din ni Masood.

"Kailangan naming makapuntos ng 400 at makakuha ng 20 wickets," ani Masood sa kanilang layunin. "Hindi namin ito nagawa noong 2019, kaya ito ang inaasam namin ngayon."

Inamin ni Masood na mataas ang kumpiyansa ng Australia. "Mahalaga ang paniniwalang kaya naming maglaro nang maayos, at bawat isa ay mag-aambag para bigyan ng hamon ang Australia." Binigyang-diin din niya ang team preparation, pati na ang pagsubok na parehasin ang Australian conditions sa kanilang training camp sa Rawalpindi na may bouncy na pitch.

Pinuri rin ni Masood ang pagtatalaga kay dating England captain Adam Hollioake, na may karanasan sa Australia, bilang bagong batting coach. "Kinukuha ng mga teams ang mga may lokal na kaalaman—makakatulong ang expertise niya sa pag-aadjust namin," sabi niya.

Sinusuportahan niya si Babar Azam at naniniwalang may malaking magagawa pa ito sa tour at sentro pa rin ng kanilang batting lineup. "Gusto naming ipakita ang cricket na kinagigiliwan ng aming fans—palaban at masayang laro," ani Masood.

article_content: Nearly two weeks have gone by since 20-month-old Ayla Reynolds disappeared from her father's home in Waterville, Maine, leading to an ambitious search and ongoing public calls for information. Her mother, Trista Reynolds, appeared on national TV, pleading for Ayla’s father, Justin DiPietro, to communicate with her, since he was the last person to see Ayla before her disappearance on December 17, 2011. Trista expressed frustration and pain about Justin's lack of communication, wondering aloud about his reasons for distancing himself and questioning if something is being hidden. She admitted to being torn about whether Justin was involved but raised concerns about his past actions and attitude as a parent. Justin DiPietro released statements denying any wrongdoing, insisting he has worked closely with investigators and that he has chosen not to speak to the media to avoid interfering with the case. He maintains he is not in hiding. The search has attracted widespread attention: police, volunteers, and the community have rallied to find Ayla. Authorities announced a $30,000 reward—the highest of its kind in Maine—hoping for tips leading to her recovery. Police have received over 370 leads and are convinced Ayla was taken rather than having left on her own. Waterville Police Chief Joseph Massey emphasized that the effort and intensity of the investigation have remained consistent since the start. National media coverage, including features on programs like 'America’s Most Wanted,' has generated further tips for law enforcement. Ayla had been living with her father after child services intervened while Trista attended a rehabilitation program. Following her completion of rehab, Trista filed for custody, but Ayla disappeared the day after these court papers were submitted. Community support continues, with people leaving tributes at the DiPietro home and officials urging anyone with information to come forward. The investigation is ongoing, with Trista publically blaming Justin for failing to keep Ayla safe, while Justin calls for patience and wants investigators to uncover what happened. Police maintain that all resources remain dedicated to finding Ayla.

article_content: LOS ANGELES — Patrick Dempsey is now People's Sexiest Man Alive for 2023, adding yet another title to his fame as “McDreamy” from 'Grey's Anatomy.' The actor and professional race car driver succeeds Chris Evans, last year's honoree. The announcement was made Tuesday night on 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!'. Dempsey, 57, expressed surprise about the honor, telling People magazine, “I’d completely forgotten about it and never even contemplated being in this position. So my ego is good.” Dempsey will star in Michael Mann’s upcoming film, 'Ferrari,' where he plays Italian race car driver Piero Taruffi. Last year, he shared with the Associated Press that he performed all his own driving stunts, calling it “the best role I’ve ever had.” Beyond acting, Dempsey has participated in several professional races, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, and is part of the Wright Motorsports racing team. He noted that his three children are likely to tease him about his new title, saying they’ll 'pick on me and figure out every reason why I shouldn’t be.' The People magazine issue with Dempsey’s cover story will be released Friday. In addition to his entertainment and racing career, Dempsey founded the Dempsey Center in Maine, honoring his late mother by providing resources and care for cancer patients. Dempsey became a heartthrob as Dr. Derek Shepherd — nicknamed 'McDreamy' — on 'Grey's Anatomy,' appearing in over 250 episodes. 'Ferrari' hits theaters later this year and was granted a waiver, allowing the cast to promote the film amid the ongoing actors’ strike. Notable past Sexiest Man Alive recipients include Michael B. Jordan, John Legend, Paul Rudd, Brad Pitt, Harrison Ford, and Mel Gibson — who was the magazine’s first honoree in 1985.

A dramatic rescue in Escondido, California, was captured on a police officer’s body camera early Sunday morning. At around 1:30am, Officer Joseph Putulowski arrived at the scene of a car accident to find a vehicle engulfed in flames. The 21-year-old driver, Uriel Basurto Sierra, was unresponsive and bleeding heavily from a head injury. 

Initially, Officer Putulowski tried to use a fire extinguisher to put out the flames. When this failed, he bravely reached through the passenger-side window and pulled Sierra from the burning wreckage. The intense rescue was caught on his body camera, showing the car ablaze and the officer giving calm, clear instructions to his colleagues to block off the street.

Authorities say the crash occurred when Sierra allegedly ran a red light and collided with another vehicle at an intersection. Rescue crews had to cut free the driver of the second car, and both that driver and their passenger were hospitalized with injuries.

After being rescued, Sierra was taken to the hospital. He has been booked on suspicion of driving under the influence and is being held on $100,000 bail.

Ang 21-taong-gulang na driver na si Uriel Basurto Sierra ay walang malay at malubhang dumudugo mula sa ulo.

Una, sinubukan ni Officer Putulowski na apulahin ang apoy gamit ang fire extinguisher pero hindi ito nagtagumpay, kaya hinugot niya palabas si Sierra sa passenger-side window ng nasusunog na sasakyan. Kitang-kita sa body camera ang matindi at mapanganib na eksena, habang malinaw at kalmado niyang inutusan ang mga kasamahan na harangin ang kalsada.

Ayon sa mga awtoridad, nangyari ang aksidente matapos umanong lumabag si Sierra sa red light at bumangga sa isa pang sasakyan sa intersection. Kinailangang putulin ng mga rescuer ang sasakyan ng ikalawang driver para mailabas siya, at silang dalawa kasama ang kanyang pasahero ay isinugod sa ospital.

Matapos mailigtas, dinala si Sierra sa ospital. Siya ay inaresto sa suspisyon ng pagmamaneho nang lasing at nakakulong na ngayon na may piyansang $100,000.

article_content: Kotak Institutional Equities (KIE) has raised concerns about the current surge in midcap and smallcap stocks, suggesting that these segments are experiencing a bubble. According to their report, the ongoing rally in these stocks is largely not backed by strong fundamentals, and instead, unrealistic narratives are influencing the market. Over the past six months, midcap and smallcap stocks have significantly outperformed the broader market. The Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 indices delivered returns of more than 27% and 40%, respectively, while the Nifty 50 rose by just 8% in the same period. The report points out that despite little change in sector fundamentals, investor sentiment about midcap and smallcap equities remains exuberant. Major drivers behind this rally include substantial inflows into mutual funds focused on these segments and a surge in new retail investors, both of which have heightened return expectations. KIE also highlights that many midcap consumption stocks are trading at high valuations, well above their pre-pandemic levels. These stocks, especially in the investment and outsourcing sectors, have undergone significant re-rating. However, most financial stocks across market caps (including banks and NBFCs) are trading at more reasonable valuations and, in some cases, have even been downgraded from pre-pandemic highs. Within the Nifty Midcap 100, five stocks—Mazagon Dock (165%), REC (145%), FACT (135%), PFC (127%), and IRFC (120%)—posted multibagger returns in the past six months. Nineteen stocks generated returns between 99% (Vodafone Idea) and 50% (HDFC AMC), while 65 stocks yielded between 49% (Lupin) and 1% (AU Small Finance Bank). Eleven stocks, including Devyani International, Tata Chemicals, Biocon, Indraprastha Gas, and Navin Fluorine, recorded negative returns up to 22%. In the Nifty Smallcap 100 index, nine stocks became multibaggers, with Suzlon Energy leading at an impressive 391% return. Other major gainers include BSE (322%) and Kalyan Jewellers (210%). Angel One, Jyothy Labs, MCX, SJVN, Apar Industries, and Cochin Shipyard delivered returns between 132% and 104%. Seventy-nine stocks provided positive returns of up to 98%, while twelve experienced declines. The biggest losers were Campus Activewear (-29%), Anupam Rasayan (-21%), and Bajaj Amines (-15%). On the political front, Kotak does not foresee a significant market impact from upcoming state and general elections, expressing an expectation that the BJP-led government will return to power. However, the report notes that a different election outcome could prompt a swift correction, particularly in midcap and smallcap stocks. Elsewhere in financial news, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has tightened capital requirements for unsecured retail loans to curb rapid growth and manage risk in the sector. In the corporate realm, cricketer Mohammed Shami’s rising fame, due to his standout performance at the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup, has led to a significant increase in his endorsement fees, now estimated at around ₹1 crore per deal. Additionally, the Mines Ministry has informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) that any reorganization of the business requires formal government approval.

Sa nakalipas na anim na buwan, malaki ang naging lamang ng kita ng midcap at smallcap stocks kaysa broader market. Sa Nifty Midcap 100, lima ang top performing stocks—Mazagon Dock (165%), REC (145%), FACT (135%), PFC (127%), at IRFC (120%)—na nagdala ng multibagger returns nitong nakaraang anim na buwan. Labinsiyam pa ang nagbigay ng kita mula 99% (Vodafone Idea) hanggang 50% (HDFC AMC), habang 65 stocks ang nasa pagitan ng 49% (Lupin) at 1% (AU Small Finance Bank). Ngunit ayon sa ulat, kung iba ang magiging resulta ng halalan, posibleng mabilis na bumagsak ang midcap at smallcap stocks. Sa ibang pampinansyal na balita, pinalakas ng Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ang capital requirements para sa unsecured retail loans upang mapigilan ang mabilis na paglago at pamahalaan ang risk sa sektor. article_content: Violence broke out during a preseason NFL game between the San Francisco 49ers and the Oakland Raiders last night, resulting in two men being shot and several altercations among fans. A 24-year-old man is in critical condition after being shot up to four times in the stomach in the parking lot of Candlestick Park, reportedly due to wearing a T-shirt with a derogatory comment about the 49ers. In a separate incident outside the stadium, a 20-year-old man was hospitalized with facial injuries after being shot. He is expected to recover. Inside the stadium, a fistfight erupted among fans in the stands. In another incident, a man was left unconscious with life-threatening injuries after a fight in a restroom. According to police, the shootings occurred shortly after the 49ers’ 17-3 victory over the Raiders. The 24-year-old victim managed to drive his truck to a gate and seek help from security after being shot. Authorities detained a man in a Raiders jersey from a party bus and consider him a suspect. Police believe the two shootings are related, though it remains unclear if the fights inside the stadium are connected. All parties involved attended the game. The 49ers released a statement acknowledging the incidents and the ongoing investigation. The article also references a previous incident of sports-related violence: the severe beating of Giants fan Bryan Stow by two men in Dodgers’ gear outside Dodger Stadium earlier this year. Two suspects have been charged in that case.

Sa hiwalay na insidente sa labas ng stadium, isang 20 anyos na lalaki ang naospital matapos magtamo ng sugat sa mukha dahil din sa pamamaril. Inaasahan na siyang makaliligtas. Ayon sa pulisya, nangyari ang mga pamamaril ilang sandali matapos ang panalo ng 49ers kontra Raiders, 17-3. May inaresto ang mga awtoridad na lalaking nakasuot ng Raiders jersey mula sa party bus at itinuturing siyang suspek. Naniniwala ang pulisya na magkaugnay ang dalawang pamamaril, pero hindi pa matukoy kung konektado ito sa mga away sa loob ng stadium. Lahat ng sangkot ay dumalo sa laro. article_content: Minh Nguyen, 38, co-founder of the pre-Facebook social network Plaxo, has been charged with first-degree murder in the shooting of Corey Mattison, the husband of his ex-wife, Denise Nguyen. Authorities say Nguyen entered the couple’s townhouse in Ashburn, Virginia, and fatally shot Mattison two months after Mattison and Denise were married. Two of Nguyen’s three children with Denise were present during the incident, which occurred at about 9:30 p.m. on Thursday. Denise and their third child arrived home during the attack. No other injuries were reported. Nguyen was arrested without incident and is being held without bond. Mattison, a project manager with a glass construction firm in Washington, D.C., had two elementary-school-aged children. Colleagues said Mattison was devoted to both his children and Denise’s children. Rick Knutson, a colleague, told media that Mattison and Denise regularly did activities with the children, which sometimes caused conflict with Nguyen, who allegedly objected to certain family outings. Nguyen is a recognized figure in the U.S. technology industry. He co-founded Plaxo in 2002 alongside Sean Parker, who later became Facebook's first president. Plaxo was known as a leading online address book, amassing over 50 million address books and 3.7 billion contacts until it was acquired by Comcast. Nguyen graduated from George Mason University with a degree in Multimedia Design and is based in Washington, D.C. He started his career as an interface programmer at AOL, then took on advisory roles for several tech companies after leaving Plaxo. In 2012, he became founding CEO of App Press. Nguyen now serves as an advisor to several tech startups and is chairman of Syllabuster, a mobile platform for students and teachers.

Ayon sa mga otoridad, pumasok umano si Nguyen sa townhouse ng mag-asawa sa Ashburn, Virginia, at binaril si Mattison dalawang buwan matapos ikasal sina Mattison at Denise. Dalawa sa tatlong anak nina Nguyen at Denise ang naroroon noong naganap ang insidente bandang 9:30 ng gabi ng Huwebes. Dumating si Denise kasama ang isa pa nilang anak habang nangyayari ito. Walang ibang nasaktan. Naaresto si Nguyen nang walang gulo at kasalukuyang nakakulong na walang piyansa. Si Mattison, isang project manager sa isang glass construction firm sa Washington, D.C., ay may dalawang anak na elementarya. Sabi ng mga katrabaho, maalaga si Mattison sa kanyang mga anak at sa mga anak ni Denise. Ayon kay Rick Knutson, isang katrabaho, madalas mag-activity nang magkasama sina Mattison, Denise, at mga bata, bagay na minsan ay nagdulot ng alitan kay Nguyen, na sinasabing hindi pabor sa ilang lakad ng pamilya. Kilala si Nguyen sa tech industry sa U.S. Co-founder siya ng Plaxo noong 2002 kasama si Sean Parker, na naging unang presidente ng Facebook. Nakilala ang Plaxo bilang nangungunang online address book na may mahigit 50 milyong address books at 3.7 bilyong contacts bago ito nabili ng Comcast. Nagtapos si Nguyen sa George Mason University ng Multimedia Design at nakabase sa Washington, D.C. Nagsimula siya bilang interface programmer sa AOL, pagkatapos ay naging adviser sa iba't ibang tech companies. Noong 2012, naging founding CEO siya ng App Press. Ngayon, adviser siya sa ilang tech startups at chairman ng Syllabuster, na isang mobile platform para sa mga estudyante at guro.

article_content: Claudia Burkill, an eight-year-old girl from Market Rasen, Lincolnshire, is believed to be the first known person to survive metastatic pineoblastoma, a rare and aggressive brain cancer. Diagnosed at age five, Claudia’s family was told several times she only had weeks left to live. Exactly three years after her mother Andrea Burkill first contacted a hospital about Claudia’s health, the family learned that Claudia is now cancer-free and no longer considered terminally ill. Metastatic pineoblastoma is extremely rare, with a worldwide survival rate of less than five percent. Claudia underwent an experimental Italian treatment at Nottingham Children’s Hospital, including 44 sessions of radiotherapy. On the ‘Claudia’s Cause’ Facebook page, Mrs. Burkill shared: 'Claudia is cancer-free and no longer classed as terminally ill. A miracle has happened, it really has.' Doctors typically diagnose only three or four cases of metastatic pineoblastoma yearly, and there is still no known cure. Claudia first showed symptoms in June 2011 after a family vacation, beginning with vomiting. Initial tests suggested a virus, but further examinations and a transfer to Queen’s Medical Centre in Nottingham revealed a malignant brain tumour. During her treatment, the family faced multiple warnings to prepare for the worst. The latest MRI scans now confirm that Claudia is in remission, though she has some brain damage from her intensive treatment. Despite these challenges, Claudia’s family remains optimistic about her future. Mrs. Burkill wrote: 'After living with a terminal diagnosis for 694 days, today is the first day I can look at my children knowing I don’t have to plan a funeral. Claudia is believed to be the first child to survive metastatic pineoblastoma. The journey was difficult, but it has given her the chance to live a full life with her family.'
translated_content: Si Claudia Burkill, isang walong taong gulang na batang babae mula Market Rasen, Lincolnshire, ay pinaniniwalaang kauna-unahang nakaligtas mula sa metastatic pineoblastoma, isang bihira at agresibong uri ng brain cancer. Noong siya ay limang taong gulang pa lamang, ilang beses nang sinabi sa kanyang pamilya na ilang linggo na lang ang itatagal niya. Eksaktong tatlong taon mula noong unang tumawag sa ospital ang kanyang inang si Andrea Burkill tungkol sa kalusugan ni Claudia, nalaman ng pamilya na siya ay cancer-free na at hindi na itinuturing na terminally ill. Ang metastatic pineoblastoma ay napakabihira, at may survival rate lamang na mas mababa sa limang porsyento sa buong mundo. Dumaan si Claudia sa isang experimental na Italian treatment sa Nottingham Children’s Hospital, kabilang na ang 44 sessions ng radiotherapy. Sa Facebook page na 'Claudia’s Cause', ibinahagi ni Mrs. Burkill: 'Si Claudia ay cancer-free at hindi na itinuturing na terminally ill. Totoong parang himala ito.' Karaniwan, tatlo o apat lang ang mga kaso ng metastatic pineoblastoma kada taon, at wala pa ring kilalang lunas dito. Nagsimulang makaranas ng sintomas si Claudia noong Hunyo 2011 matapos ang isang bakasyon, at nagsimula siyang magsuka. Una, inakala ng mga doktor na virus lang ito, pero nang ma-examine pa at mailipat siya sa Queen’s Medical Centre sa Nottingham, natuklasan ang malignant na tumor sa kanyang utak. Maraming beses na hinanda ang pamilya para sa pinakamalala habang ginagamot si Claudia. Ngayon, kinumpirma ng pinakabagong MRI scan na siya ay cancer-free na, bagamat may epekto pa rin sa kanyang utak dahil sa matinding gamutan. Sa kabila ng lahat ng ito, nananatiling positibo at puno ng pag-asa ang pamilya ni Claudia para sa kanyang kinabukasan. Isinulat ni Mrs. Burkill: 'Matapos ang 694 araw na may terminal na diagnosis, ngayon ang unang araw na kaya kong tignan ang aking mga anak na hindi kailangang magplano ng lamay. Si Claudia ay pinaniniwalaang unang bata na nakaligtas sa metastatic pineoblastoma. Mahirap ang pinagdaanan, pero nagbigay ito ng pagkakataon kay Claudia na mabuhay at makasama ang pamilya.'

article_content: Egypt’s ambition to dominate as the main gas hub of the Eastern Mediterranean faces severe obstacles. In June, its LNG exports to Europe came to a halt, while households and businesses grappled with recurring power outages driven by a shortage of gas at power plants during the high-demand summer. Coupled with a worsening debt crisis, Egypt’s urgent need for foreign currency from gas exports has become even more apparent. This situation raises tough questions: Are these setbacks only temporary, or do they hint at deeper, structural issues? Strategically, Egypt hosts the only two gas liquefaction plants in the region, making it an essential partner for neighbors like Israel and Cyprus, who rely on Egypt’s facilities to access European markets. The gigantic Zohr gas field, discovered in 2015, once fulfilled both domestic needs and export ambitions, accounting for nearly 40% of Egypt’s gas. However, Zohr’s output has been dropping, and in 2022 LNG shipments peaked at 8.9 billion cubic meters, pulling in $8.4 billion, before declining due to falling global gas prices and reduced supply. Several factors have contributed to the current crisis: a surge in domestic demand from both heavy industry and an unusually hot summer; an ill-timed government pause on fuel imports, later reversed amid escalating power cuts; and a drop in gas production caused by natural field depletion, limited new discoveries, and insufficient investment—despite government denials of technical issues at Zohr. Industry voices stress the need for ongoing investments and new finds for recovery, and oil giants BP and Eni are planning to invest billions over the next years. To sustain LNG exports, Egypt has imported growing volumes of Israeli gas, enabled by a cross-border pipeline. Egypt, Israel, and the European Union inked a landmark export deal in 2022, and Israel’s exports to Egypt hit record levels. Plans to expand Israeli gas flows will demand major upgrades to infrastructure, expected only by mid-decade. Cyprus may contribute, but disputes over whether to build a pipeline to Egypt or a floating LNG facility mean decisions—and results—are years away. The U.S. supports channeling Cypriot gas to Egypt via pipeline, claiming it would strengthen regional stability and bolster energy supplies for Europe. However, such infrastructure will take significant time to come online. Though Egypt’s domestic gas supplies have waned, regional partnerships and investment could still help realize its ambitions. Experts believe Egypt might export some LNG in the winter months, but ongoing supply shortfalls during peak summer could bring further power cuts unless new reserves or imports materialize. In summary, Egypt’s quest to be a regional gas hub faces serious short-term and potentially long-term challenges. Yet, its position may be salvaged through fresh investment and deepening partnerships with neighboring gas-rich states.
translated_content: Nahaharap sa matinding balakid ang ambisyon ng Egypt na maging pangunahing gas hub sa Silangang Mediteraneo. Itinigil ng bansa ang LNG exports patungong Europa noong Hunyo, kasabay ng paulit-ulit na brownout dulot ng kakulangan ng gas sa mga planta ng kuryente ngayong tag-init. Dagdag pa rito ang lumalalang krisis sa utang, kaya mas kailangan ng bansa ang dolyar mula sa pag-export ng gas. Kaya lumilitaw ang tanong: Pansamantala lang ba ito o may mas malalim pang problema? Strategically na nakapuwesto ang Egypt—nag-iisa silang may dalawang gas liquefaction plants sa rehiyon. Dahil dito, importante silang partner para sa mga bansang tulad ng Israel at Cyprus dahil umaasa ang mga ito sa Egypt para maabot ang mga pamilihan sa Europa. Ang malawak na Zohr gas field, natuklasan noong 2015, ay dating sapat para sa pangangailangan ng bansa at pag-export, halos 40% ng kabuuang gas ng Egypt. Ngunit bumabagsak na ang produksyon dito. Noong 2022, umabot sa 8.9 bilyong cubic meters ang na-export na LNG at nagdala ito ng $8.4 bilyon, ngunit pagkatapos nito ay bumagsak ang kita dahil sa pagbaba ng presyo at supply. Iba’t ibang dahilan kung bakit may krisis: lumobo ang demand mula sa mga industriya at dahil sa matinding init; pagtigil ng gobyerno sa pag-angkat ng fuel na agad ding binawi matapos ang sunod-sunod na brownout; at pagbaba ng produksyon ng gas dahil sa pagkaubos ng field, kulang sa bagong mga nadiskubre, at hindi sapat na investment—kahit itinanggi ng gobyerno ang teknikal na isyu sa Zohr. Diin ng mga eksperto, kailangan ng tuloy-tuloy na investment at bagong mga tuklas upang makabawi; may inihahandang pamumuhunan ang BP at Eni. Upang mapanatili ang pag-export ng LNG, nakakatulong ang gas na ini-import mula Israel sa pamamagitan ng pipeline. Noong 2022, umabot sa record high ang export ng Israel sa Egypt kasunod ng kasunduan ng Egypt, Israel, at European Union. Planong dagdagan pa ito ngunit mangangailangan ng malalaking upgrade sa mga pipeline na pa lamang matatapos sa kalagitnaan ng dekada. Nakataya rin ang Cyprus, ngunit pinagdedebatehan pa kung magtatayo ng pipeline papuntang Egypt o floating LNG terminal sa Cyprus mismo—kapwa aabutin pa ng ilang taon. Suportado ng U.S. ang pipeline mula Cyprus patungong Egypt, para daw makatulong ito sa katatagan ng rehiyon at seguridad ng enerhiya ng Europa. Subalit aabutin ito ng panahon bago matapos. Kahit nabawasan ang sariling gas reserves ng Egypt, may pagkakataon pa ang bansa na maabot ang ambisyon sa tulong ng pamumuhunan at pakikipag-ugnayan sa mga karatig-bansa. Ayon sa mga eksperto, posibleng makapag-export uli ang Egypt kapag malamig na ang panahon ngunit maaaring asahan pa rin ang brownout tuwing tag-init kung walang bagong supply. Sa kabuuan, malaki ang pagsubok—pansamantala man o pangmatagalan—sa pangarap ng Egypt na maging regional gas hub. Pero maaring makabangon pa ito sa tulong ng bagong pamumuhunan at mas matibay na ugnayan sa mga karatig-bansa na mayaman sa gas.

article_content: Vedanta Limited's subsidiary, Malco Energy Ltd, has launched a new unit in Saudi Arabia dedicated to copper, with an investment of 100,000 Saudi riyals (about Rs 22.19 lakh). In a BSE filing, Vedanta revealed that the subsidiary is named Vedanta Copper International VCI Company Limited. The establishment of this company aims to explore growth in emerging international markets. Previously, Vedanta announced its intention to demerge five main businesses — aluminium, oil and gas, steel, power, and base metals — into independent, listed companies. This restructuring is designed to boost shareholder value. The process is simple: for each Vedanta Limited share held, shareholders will get a share in each newly listed company. The board has approved transitioning to a pure-play, asset-owner business model, which means these divisions will each become separately listed entities. On the financial side, Indian lenders are tightening rules on loans by requiring negative liens on assets backing personal guarantees from company promoters, aiming to stop assets from being shifted into bankruptcy-protected trusts. In broader business news, Indian companies achieved strong double-digit net profit growth in the September quarter, driven by automotive, banking, finance, cement, and metal sectors serving the domestic market, despite only modest gains in revenue. Meanwhile, although real money gaming apps are banned in several Indian states (including Telangana, Odisha, Arunachal Pradesh, and Sikkim), avid gamers continue to access these platforms using creative methods, according to legal and industry experts.
translated_content: Inilunsad ng Malco Energy Ltd, isang subsidiary ng Vedanta Limited, ang bagong yunit sa Saudi Arabia na tutok sa copper, na may puhunan na 100,000 Saudi riyals (tinatayang Rs 22.19 lakh). Sa isang filing sa BSE, inanunsyo ng Vedanta na ang pangalan ng subsidiary ay Vedanta Copper International VCI Company Limited. Layunin ng kumpanyang ito na tuklasin ang mga oportunidad para sa paglago sa mga bagong pandaigdigang merkado. Dati nang inanunsyo ng Vedanta ang plano nitong hatiin ang limang pinakamalalaking negosyo — aluminium, oil and gas, steel, power, at base metals — upang maging magkakahiwalay at nakalistang mga kumpanya. Layunin ng hakbang na ito na mapataas ang halaga ng shares ng mga shareholders. Simple lang ang proseso: para sa bawat share ng Vedanta Limited na pagmamay-ari, makakatanggap ng bagong share sa bawat isa sa mga bagong kumpanya ang shareholders. Inaprubahan na ng board ang paglipat sa isang pure-play, asset-owner business model, kaya't magiging magkakahiwalay na kumpanya ang mga division na ito. Habang tumitindi naman ang patakaran ng mga bangko sa India, nangangailangan na sila ng negative lien sa mga asset na ginagarantiya ng personal guarantee ng mga promoter ng kumpanya, para mapigilan ang paglilipat ng mga asset sa mga trust na protektado mula sa bankruptcy. Sa malawakang balita, malaki ang inangat ng netong kita ng mga kumpanyang Indian noong Setyembre, na hinatak ng automotive, banking, finance, semento, at metal sectors para sa lokal na merkado, kahit na minimal lang ang pagtaas sa kabuuang kita. Kahit na bawal na ang mga real money gaming app sa ilang state sa India (tulad ng Telangana, Odisha, Arunachal Pradesh, at Sikkim), nakakapaghanap pa rin ng paraan ang mga die-hard gamer para maglaro sa mga ito, ayon sa mga legal at industry expert.

article_content: At first glance, this Fiat 500 appears a bit unsteady. However, this striking car is actually an illusion, crafted from a group of meticulously body-painted nude models. More than a dozen female circus performers, models, and contortionists were carefully covered from head to toe in skin-safe body paint by New Orleans artist Craig Tracy. The participants positioned themselves precisely to form the shape of a Fiat 500, captured in a photograph by R. J. Muna. A team of 30 to 40 people spent five days perfecting the image in a San Francisco studio. This project was part of an advertising campaign for a new range of Fiat 500 cars. Craig Tracy shared, 'Initially, the concept was overwhelming, but with a strong supporting staff and crew, I was confident we would get it done.' The models practiced holding their poses for long periods, allowing Tracy to paint intricate details for the illusion. Tracy uses special paint designed to be safe on human skin, and he estimates he has painted around 400 people during his career. The finished image was featured in ESPN's Body Issue, which caused some controversy after Catholic tennis player Agnieszka Radwanska appeared on the cover.

Pero ang nakamamanghang kotse na ito ay isang ilusyon, gawa mula sa grupo ng mga nude model na detalyadong pininturahan ng body paint. Higit sa dose ang mga babaeng circus performer, modelo, at contortionist na maingat na pininturahan mula ulo hanggang paa ng body paint na ligtas sa balat ng artist na si Craig Tracy mula New Orleans. Maingat na pumwesto ang mga kalahok upang mabuo ang hugis ng Fiat 500, na kinunan ng larawan ni photographer R. J. Muna. Trenta hanggang apatnapung katao ang bumuo ng team at gumugol ng limang araw sa studio sa San Francisco para ma-perpekto ang imahe. Bahagi ng advertising campaign para sa bagong range ng Fiat 500 cars ang proyektong ito. Ayon kay Craig Tracy, 'Nakaka-overwhelm ang concept noong una, pero dahil mahusay ang staff at crew, kampante akong matatapos namin.' Nagpraktis ang mga modelo na manatili sa pose nang matagal kaya naipinta nang detalyado ni Tracy ang ilusyon. Espesyal at ligtas para sa balat ang ginagamit na pintura ni Tracy, at tinatayang higit 400 tao na ang kanyang napintahan sa kanyang karera. Ang natapos na larawan ay itinampok sa ESPN's Body Issue, na naging kontrobersyal matapos ilagay sa cover ang Catholic tennis player na si Agnieszka Radwanska.

article_content:
Independent economist Saugata Bhattacharya notes that overall demand in India's economy remains robust. The September Index of Industrial Production (IIP) growth was slightly below expectations at 5.8%, mainly due to shifts in consumer and non-consumer durable goods, but demand across sectors continues to be strong. This is reflected in robust consumption during the festive season and strong online sales—Amazon reports that 80% of its sales came from tier two and three cities, indicating broad-based demand. Automotive sales, including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and four-wheelers, also remain strong.

Bhattacharya emphasizes that while strong demand supports economic growth, it can lead to higher prices and inflation. However, the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) figures show headline inflation has eased to 4.9%, and core inflation has dropped further to around 4.2-4.3%. This indicates that manufacturers and service providers are not fully passing increased costs onto consumers. Despite these positive developments, food prices—particularly cereals and vegetables—are a persistent risk, though prices typically moderate during the winter unless severe weather intervenes.

On policy, the effective coordination between the government's fiscal policy and the Reserve Bank of India's monetary strategy has helped manage external threats to growth, although vigilance is still necessary—especially concerning external and financial market shocks. Merchandise exports are exposed to risks from the global economic slowdown, but steadier prices for important commodities like oil and metals provide some stability.

India’s economic resilience also stems from streamlined supply chains in sectors like automobiles and increased credit availability from banks, NBFCs, and microfinance institutions. The MSME sector is essential in supporting both supply and demand. Financial products such as 'buy now, pay later' schemes and expanded access to retail credit have further boosted consumption while reducing systemic stress.

Looking ahead, a median forecast from 10 economists predicts India’s GDP growth at 6.7% for the July-September quarter, largely due to strong performance in the services sector. To promote a better business environment, the government is also considering raising the threshold for arrest and prosecution in GST evasion cases to ₹3 crore, aiming to reduce harassment and improve ease of business.

Ayon sa independent economist na si Saugata Bhattacharya, nananatiling matatag ang pangkalahatang demand sa ekonomiya ng India. Ang growth ng Index of Industrial Production (IIP) noong Setyembre ay bahagyang mababa kaysa inaasahan sa 5.8%, na dulot ng pagbabago sa consumer at non-consumer durable goods, ngunit nananatiling malakas ang demand sa iba’t ibang sektor. Makikita ito sa mataas na konsumo tuwing panahon ng pista at malalakas na online sales—iniulat ng Amazon na 80% ng kanilang benta ay mula sa tier two at three cities, na nagpapahiwatig ng malawakang demand. Tuloy din ang malakas na benta ng mga sasakyan, kasama ang two-wheelers, three-wheelers, at four-wheelers.

Binigyang-diin ni Bhattacharya na bagamat pabor sa paglago ng ekonomiya ang malakas na demand, maaari rin itong magdulot ng pagtaas ng presyo at inflation. Gayunpaman, ipinapakita ng pinakabagong Consumer Price Index (CPI) figures na bumaba ang headline inflation sa 4.9% at lalo pang bumaba ang core inflation sa humigit-kumulang 4.2-4.3%. Ibig sabihin, hindi lubos na naipapasa ng mga tagagawa at service providers ang pagtaas ng gastos sa mga mamimili. Sa kabila ng magandang balita, nananatiling panganib ang presyo ng pagkain—partikular ang cereals at gulay—kahit kadalasang bumababa ito tuwing taglamig maliban na lang kung may di inaasahang masamang panahon.

Sa polisiya, malaki ang naitulong ng mahusay na koordinasyon ng fiscal policy ng gobyerno at monetary policy ng Reserve Bank of India upang mapangalagaan ang ekonomiya sa mga panlabas na banta, ngunit patuloy pa ring kinakailangan ang pagbabantay lalo na sa external at financial market shocks. Ang merchandise exports ay may panganib dahil sa bumabagal na pandaigdigang ekonomiya, ngunit nakakatulong ang mas stable na presyo ng mga pangunahing kalakal gaya ng langis at metal.

Ang katatagan ng ekonomiya ng India ay dahil din sa pinahusay na supply chain, partikular sa sektor ng sasakyan, at sa tumataas na access sa credit mula sa mga bangko, NBFCs, at microfinance institutions. Malaking papel ang ginagampanan ng MSME sector sa supply at demand. Bukod dito, nakatulong din ang mga financial innovations tulad ng 'buy now, pay later' schemes at pinalawak na retail credit upang pasiglahin ang konsumo at maiwasan ang malawakang stress sa sistema.

Sa mga darating na buwan, ayon sa median forecast ng 10 ekonomista, inaasahan ang GDP growth ng India sa 6.7% para sa Hulyo-Setyembre quarter, lalo na dahil sa malakas na performance ng services sector. Upang mapaganda ang business environment, pinag-aaralan din ng gobyerno na taasan sa ₹3 crore ang threshold bago maaresto at ma-prosecute sa mga kaso ng GST evasion, na layuning mabawasan ang panggigipit at mapadali ang pagnenegosyo.

article_content: Welcome to CNN Student News for August 25, 2010. Download PDF maps for today’s episode featuring Iraq, Los Angeles, and Japan. I’m Carl Azuz, and over the next 10 minutes, you’ll get the details on what makes the most expensive school in America. Let’s get started! First: The Economy – The latest report on the US housing market shows sales of existing homes dropping more than 27% in July, the lowest in over 10 years. The government’s homebuyer tax credit, which recently ended, is believed to have helped support sales prior to the drop. The Dow Jones Industrial Average also fell, as investors worry that declining home sales could slow the nation’s economic recovery. Iraq – For the first time since the war began in 2003, fewer than 50,000 US troops are now in Iraq. John Brennan, White House counter-terrorism advisor, says this transition is happening on America’s terms, as over 600,000 Iraqi security forces take on more responsibility. Despite this milestone, violence continues, with recent attacks killing at least five people. Operation Iraqi Freedom ends September 1, making way for Operation New Dawn, where US troops will shift to non-combat, advisory roles—though they’ll remain in a dangerous environment. Education: ‘Race to the Top’ – Ten states and the District of Columbia have been awarded funding from the federal 'Race to the Top' education program for their school reform plans. Winners—DC, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Maryland, Massachusetts, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, and Rhode Island—will share $3.4 billion, divided based on student population. The program’s criteria and impact have sparked some criticism and debate. Weather Corner – Wind speed is the key factor distinguishing a tropical storm from a hurricane: sustained winds must reach 74 mph for hurricane status. Tropical Storm Danielle became a hurricane earlier this week before weakening, making it the fourth named Atlantic storm this season and only the second to reach hurricane strength. It is not projected to make landfall. America’s Costliest School – The Robert F. Kennedy Community Schools in Los Angeles, opening next month, cost $578 million to build and will serve 4,200 K-12 students. The school features luxury amenities like a nightclub-style auditorium and a maple basketball court. While backers say it provides a top-quality environment for underserved students, critics question the expense in a district that’s cut programs and laid off nearly 3,000 teachers in the last two years. School officials say funding comes from voter-approved bonds, not the state’s budget. Yen vs. Dollar – Japan’s currency, the yen, is at a 15-year high against the US dollar. This benefits Japanese travelers abroad, but makes life harder for US expatriates in Japan whose incomes, paid in dollars or euros, now have less purchasing power. Major Japanese exporters like Toyota are also affected—losing approximately $250 million for each one-yen decline against the dollar. These currency shifts reflect broader changes in the global economy as countries such as India and China expand their influence. Before We Go: Tinkerbell the Rat – Finally, a fun story: an iReporter sent in a video of his rat, Tinkerbell, who seems to enjoy taking baths and grooming herself on camera. Whether she truly loves water or just tolerates it, her owner is happy to show off her hygiene habits. That wraps up today’s show. Share your thoughts on what makes a great school at CNNStudentNews.com, and join us again tomorrow!

article_content: North American song sparrows may be more resilient to climate change due to a remarkable adaptation: an impressive range of body sizes observed throughout the bird's westernmost range. Cornell researchers and their collaborators conducted whole genome sequencing of North American song sparrows, uncovering the genetic foundations behind their diverse body sizes. This study marks the first findings from a broader effort to sequence the genomes of song sparrows from nearly all of the 25 recognized subspecies across North America. The research, published in Nature Communications by scientists from the University of British Columbia, the Cornell Lab of Ornithology, Ouachita Baptist University, and the University of Alaska Fairbanks, supports Bergmann's Rule. This rule suggests that, in general, species that regulate their own body heat evolve larger bodies in colder climates and smaller bodies in warmer ones because larger forms retain heat more efficiently, while smaller forms dissipate heat better. For instance, song sparrows living year-round on Alaska's Aleutian Islands can be up to three times larger than those found near San Francisco Bay. "The size difference among song sparrows is incredible to consider," said co-author and researcher Jennifer Walsh at the Cornell Lab of Ornithology. "Our results show that song sparrows have a significant capacity for local adaptation to environmental changes, and the genetic mechanisms responsible for those changes are quite apparent. We expected a more complex genetic component, possibly involving many genes, to explain the substantial differences in size." In the study, researchers sequenced and compared 79 genomes from nine song sparrow subspecies originating from multiple locations. This work was done at the Fuller Evolutionary Biology Program at the Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Their analysis revealed genome-wide differentiation, especially between northern subspecies, using a genome-wide distribution of FST for pairwise comparisons between large- and small-bodied northern subspecies. Key divergent regions were found in certain chromosomes, identified by their positions on the zebra finch genome (chr 2, chr 3, and chr 17). Tissue samples were obtained from the University of Alaska Museum of the North, collected between 1997 and 2000, along with already-published genomic sequences for California subspecies. Because song sparrows are widespread and adapt to many environments, they serve as a valuable model for this type of study. "We found eight gene variations in the genomes we sequenced, all associated with body mass as predicted by Bergmann's Rule," said lead author Katherine Carbeck, a Ph.D. candidate at the University of British Columbia. "This demonstrates a genetic basis for song sparrow adaptation to local climate conditions, from the coldest northern areas to the warmest parts of California." Carbeck added that while evolution is often thought of over millions of years, microevolution—short-term changes—plays a critical role in helping song sparrows persist under new climate conditions. These findings point to a potentially resilient future for these birds, according to co-author Peter Arcese, professor in UBC's department of forest and conservation sciences. "Our research suggests that some, if not all, locally adapted song sparrow populations could continue adapting to climate change, provided we maintain habitats that promote movement and gene flow between populations," he said. Understanding the nuances of microevolution can impact conservation strategies. While song sparrows in Alaska and British Columbia show stable or growing populations, the West Coast populations in the continental United States, such as in San Francisco Bay, face decline, with some listed as threatened at the state level. A decline in any localized population could mean loss of genetic diversity, even if the species as a whole appears stable. Despite the sparrows' adaptability, limits exist. "Although microevolution can partly help offset the effects of climate change," Carbeck concluded, "a crucial question remains: can local adaptation keep pace with the rapid rate of climate change overall?"

Isinagawa ng mga mananaliksik mula sa Cornell at kanilang mga katuwang ang buong genome sequencing ng North American song sparrows at natuklasan ang mga genetic na dahilan ng kanilang iba-ibang laki ng katawan. Ito ang unang resulta mula sa mas malawak na pananaliksik na naglalayong i-sequence ang genomes ng halos lahat ng 25 na kinikilalang subspecies ng song sparrow sa North America. Ang pananaliksik na ito, na inilathala sa Nature Communications ng mga siyentista mula sa University of British Columbia, Cornell Lab of Ornithology, Ouachita Baptist University, at University of Alaska Fairbanks, ay sumusuporta sa Bergmann's Rule. Sinasabi ng patakarang ito na karaniwang mas malalaki ang mga hayop sa mas malamig na klima at mas maliit sa mainit na lugar, dahil mas mahusay magpanatili ng init ang mas malalaking katawan at mas madaling maglabas ng init ang mas maliliit. Halimbawa, ang mga song sparrow na naninirahan buong taon sa Aleutian Islands ng Alaska ay maaaring maging tatlong beses na mas malaki kaysa sa mga kapwa nila na matatagpuan malapit sa San Francisco Bay. "Ang laki ng pagkakaiba ng mga song sparrow ay nakakagulat isipin," sabi ni Jennifer Walsh, co-author at mananaliksik sa Cornell Lab of Ornithology. "Ipinapakita ng aming resulta na may malaking kakayahan ang song sparrow na umangkop sa mga pagbabagong pangkapaligiran sa kanilang lugar, at malinaw ang mga genetic na mekanismo sa likod nito. Inakala naming mas komplikado ang genetic na aspeto o may mas maraming genes na sangkot para sa malaking pagkakaiba sa laki." Sa pag-aaral, inisa-isa ng mga mananaliksik at inihambing ang 79 genomes mula sa siyam na subspecies ng song sparrow mula sa iba't ibang lugar. Ginawa ang gawaing ito sa Fuller Evolutionary Biology Program ng Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Lumabas sa kanilang pagsusuri na may genome-wide na pagkakaiba lalo na sa pagitan ng mga hilagang subspecies, gamit ang genome-wide distribution ng FST para sa paghahambing ng malalaki at maliliit na katawan ng hilagang subspecies. Natukoy ang mga mahalagang bahagi ng chromosome, batay sa kanilang posisyon sa zebra finch genome (chr 2, chr 3, at chr 17). Nakuha ang mga tissue sample mula sa University of Alaska Museum of the North, na nakolekta mula 1997 hanggang 2000, pati na rin ang mga nailathalang genome ng mga subspecies sa California. Dahil laganap ang song sparrow at kaya umangkop sa maraming kapaligiran, mahalaga silang pag-aralan para sa ganitong uri ng pananaliksik. "Natuklasan naming may walong gene variations sa mga genome na aming na-sequence at lahat ay kaugnay ng body mass tulad ng inaasahan sa Bergmann's Rule," ayon kay Katherine Carbeck, lead author at Ph.D. candidate sa University of British Columbia. "Ipinapakita nito na may genetic base ang pag-angkop ng song sparrow sa klima ng kanilang kinaroroonan, mula sa pinakamalamig na hilaga hanggang sa pinaka-mainit na bahagi ng California." Dagdag pa ni Carbeck, kahit madalas isipin na daan-daan o milyong taon ang kailangan para sa ebolusyon, malaki ang bahagi ng microevolutionary changes—o mga pagbabago sa maikling panahon—para sa survival ng song sparrow sa harap ng bagong kondisyon ng klima. Ayon sa co-author na si Peter Arcese, propesor sa departamento ng forest and conservation sciences ng UBC, nakapagbibigay pag-asa ang mga natuklasan sa kinabukasan ng mga ibong ito. "Sinasabi ng aming pananaliksik na maaaring magpatuloy ang ilang populasyon ng song sparrow na umangkop sa pagbabago ng klima, basta't mapanatili natin ang mga tirahan na nagpapadali sa paggalaw at pagpapalitan ng genes sa bawat populasyon," ayon sa kanya. Mahalaga ang pag-unawa sa microevolution sa paggawa ng conservation strategies. Bagama't ang song sparrow sa Alaska at British Columbia ay may matatag o lumalaking populasyon, humihina naman ang bilang ng mga ito sa West Coast ng continental United States, gaya ng sa San Francisco Bay, kung saan ang ilan ay itinuturing na threatened. Maaaring mauwi sa pagkawala ng genetic diversity ang pagbaba ng populasyon sa ilang lugar, kahit pa tila ligtas ang buong species. At kahit ipinapakita ng song sparrow ang pagiging adaptable, may hangganan pa rin ito. "Bagama't may kakayahan ang microevolution na bahagyang pigilan ang epekto ng climate change," pagtatapos ni Carbeck, "ang malaking tanong ay kung makakasabay ba ang lokal na pag-angkop sa bilis ng pagbabago ng klima ngayon."

MOHELA, a leading federal student loan servicer, is launching a new online platform for its borrowers. As part of this update, all borrowers will be required to set up new accounts, and MOHELA’s current mobile app will be discontinued after the transition. The company has confirmed that this change will not affect the existing terms, interest rates, loan discharge or forgiveness programs, or repayment plans available to borrowers.

Some payments sent to MOHELA that aren't posted before the switch could be delayed by as much as 30 business days, but these will ultimately be credited based on their original payment dates. Borrowers are advised to start using the new contact details immediately to avoid further delays. Aside from these potential delays, MOHELA expects no other negative consequences for borrowers during the transition.

This update comes shortly after the end of a more than three-year freeze on federal student loan payments. To ease this return, the Education Department, under President Biden, has introduced a 12-month 'on-ramp' period, during which missed payments aren’t reported to credit agencies, though interest continues to accrue. Despite these measures, borrowers are still facing lingering issues—such as incorrect bills and extended customer service wait times—raising concerns about whether the new MOHELA platform will improve the situation.

Scott Buchanan from the Student Loan Servicing Alliance commented that MOHELA’s upgrade is about making the most of limited resources to enhance borrower experience, adding that other servicers are also upgrading their systems as part of regular business improvements. The Education Department did not respond to requests for comment.

MOHELA will rebrand its auto-debit payment feature as 'auto pay.' Borrowers currently enrolled will remain so, but may need to allow three to four business days from their transition notification for updated billing and payment information to become available.

Technical problems have affected servicers across the board. MOHELA says its new platform should allow for better customer service, referencing similar technical outages and delays at other companies like Nelnet, which have caused frustrations for borrowers waiting on issue resolution.

Maaaring maantala hanggang 30 working days ang ilang bayad na ipinadala sa MOHELA na hindi pa nai-post bago ang paglilipat, ngunit kikilalanin pa rin ang orihinal na petsa ng pagbabayad. article_content: France progressed to the World Cup quarter-finals by defeating Nigeria with a steady and effective performance. Still mindful of their troubled 2010 campaign, France displayed resilience and composure. While initially lacking creativity, France's fortunes improved dramatically when Antoine Griezmann replaced Olivier Giroud in the 62nd minute, injecting new energy into their offense. Under pressure before the match, Paul Pogba rose to the occasion by heading in the first goal for France in the 79th minute, demonstrating his value to the team and to Juventus. France's calculated play paid off as Nigerian goalkeeper Vincent Enyeama, who had shone throughout the tournament, misjudged a corner—allowing Pogba to score. Later, Joseph Yobo’s own goal under Griezmann’s pressure sealed Nigeria’s fate. Head coach Didier Deschamps’ decisions paid dividends. 'Paul is young; criticism is normal in football,' Deschamps noted, praising Pogba's response to adversity. Nigeria started strongly, dominating parts of the match and even seemed to score early, but Emenike’s effort was ruled offside. Ogenyi Onazi’s injury from a tough challenge disrupted Nigeria’s rhythm in midfield. Coach Stephen Keshi voiced frustration over refereeing and unfortunate mistakes by his team, especially the handling error and Yobo’s own goal. Despite passionate play and fan support, Nigeria could not overcome late errors. France, unbeaten in World Cups under Deschamps, managed the final stages with confidence after Griezmann came on. Giroud endured a tough match, escaping sanction for an elbow. Ultimately, France took advantage of Nigerian lapses to win 2-0.

Bagama’t hindi masyadong creative sa simula, biglang nagbago ang daloy ng laro nang ipinasok si Antoine Griezmann para kay Olivier Giroud sa ika-62 minuto, at nabigyan ng panibagong buhay ang opensa. Dumaranas ng matinding pressure bago ang laban, sumagot si Paul Pogba sa hamon at naka-goal ng header sa ika-79 minuto, hindi lang para sa France kundi para patunayan ang kanyang halaga sa Juventus. Nagbunga ang maingat na pagpigil ng France nang magkamali si Vincent Enyeama, ang Nigerian goalkeeper na namukod-tangi buong tournament, kaya naipasok ni Pogba ang goal. Paglaon ay nagkaroon ng sariling goal si Joseph Yobo bunsod ng pressure ni Griezmann. Naging tama ang mga desisyon ni head coach Didier Deschamps. “Bata pa si Paul; natural lang ang mga batikos sa football,” ani Deschamps na pinuri ang tibay ni Pogba. Malakas ang pagsisimula ng Nigeria—kinontrol nila ang midfield at muntik makaiskor agad, ngunit na-offside si Emenike. Nawalan din sila ng momentum nang ma-injure si Ogenyi Onazi dahil sa matinding tackle. Dismayado si Coach Stephen Keshi sa mga tawag ng referee at sa mga pagkakamali ng kanyang team, partikular na sa error ng goalkeeper at sariling goal ni Yobo. Kahit todo ang effort at suporta ng mga fan, natalo ang Nigeria sa kanilang sariling mga pagkakamali. Nanatiling walang talo ang France sa World Cup games sa ilalim ni Deschamps. Sa huli, sinamantala ng France ang mga pagkakamali ng Nigeria at nanalo, 2-0.

article_content: Rice's whales are among the world's newest and most endangered whale species, living exclusively in the Gulf of Mexico. With only about 51 individuals remaining, conservationists warn they are at critical risk of extinction. Despite this, efforts to formally protect the species have faced repeated delays from U.S. authorities. The whales face multiple man-made threats, including oil and gas exploration, vessel strikes, and noise pollution. The Deepwater Horizon oil spill in 2010 dealt a major blow to their population, killing approximately one in five Rice's whales. Since the spill, researchers have confirmed that Rice's whales represent an entirely distinct species and possibly the last of their kind on the planet. Federal law requires that NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) list species as endangered and designate critical habitats within a year of such designation. However, NOAA has repeatedly missed these deadlines for Rice's whales. Conservation groups have filed multiple lawsuits urging the agency to comply with the law, but the process remains slow, and a recovery plan has yet to be released. Among the biggest risks are ship strikes. Environmental groups have recommended ship speed limits and nighttime travel bans in designated whale habitat to reduce fatal encounters. While similar speed limits have helped protect North Atlantic right whales, NOAA declined to adopt these measures for Rice's whales in 2023, citing the need to focus on other priorities. Most vessels continue to exceed speeds considered safe for the whales. Underwater noise further threatens Rice's whales, impacting their ability to communicate and navigate. Noise from fast-moving ships and seismic air gun surveys for oil and gas exploration are particularly disruptive. Although quieter technologies exist, they are expensive and not legally required, and most companies continue using conventional, noisier equipment. Industry leaders argue that additional regulations would hinder commerce and are not justified for such a small population. Conservationists, however, see the continued delay in protective actions as alarming, warning that lack of intervention could lead to the first human-caused extinction of a great whale species. Spotting Rice's whales remains exceedingly rare, but researchers and agencies encourage the public to report sightings to aid in conservation and data collection efforts.
translated_content: Ang Rice's whales ay isa sa mga pinakabagong natuklasan at pinaka-nanganganib na uri ng balyena sa mundo, na matatagpuan lamang sa Gulf of Mexico. Humigit-kumulang 51 lang ang natitirang balyena, kaya't babala ng mga tagapangalaga ng kalikasan na nasa malaking panganib ng pagkalipol ang mga ito. Sa kabila nito, paulit-ulit na nai-antala ng mga awtoridad sa U.S. ang mga pagsubok na bigyan sila ng proteksyon. Ilan sa mga panganib na gawa ng tao na kinakaharap ng balyenang ito ay ang pagsaliksik ng langis at gas, pagbangga ng mga sasakyang-pandagat, at polusyon ng ingay sa tubig. Ang Deepwater Horizon oil spill noong 2010 ay matinding nakapinsala sa populasyon nila, kung saan tinatayang isa sa bawat lima ay namatay. Mula noon, nakumpirma ng mga mananaliksik na ang Rice's whales ay isang ganap na kakaibang uri at sila na lang marahil ang natitira sa buong mundo. Inaatasan ng batas pederal na ang NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) ay agad na magtala ng mga uri bilang endangered species at tukuyin ang mga kritikal na tirahan sa loob ng isang taon. Ngunit madalas na nahuhuli ang NOAA sa pagtalima ng mga deadline na ito para sa Rice's whales. Maraming grupo ang nagsampa ng kaso para pilitin ang ahensya na sumunod sa batas, ngunit mabagal pa rin ang proseso at wala pang inilalabas na recovery plan. Isa sa pinakamalaking banta ay ang pagbangga ng mga sasakyang-pandagat. Inirekomenda ng mga grupong pangkalikasan na limitahan ang bilis ng barko at pagbawalan ang paglalayag sa gabi sa mga tirahan ng balyena para mabawasan ang nakamamatay na insidente. Habang nakatulong ang ganitong hakbang para sa North Atlantic right whales, tinanggihan ng NOAA ang speed limit para sa Rice's whales noong 2023, at sinabing magpopokus muna sila sa ibang prayoridad. Karamihan ng mga barko ay lumalagpas pa rin sa ligtas na bilis para sa mga balyena. Dagdag pa, ang ingay sa ilalim ng dagat ay lubhang nakakaapekto sa Rice's whales, lalo na sa kanilang komunikasyon at paglalakbay. Ang ingay mula sa mabilis na barko at seismic air gun surveys para sa langis at gas ay lubos na istorbo. Bagama't may mas tahimik na teknolohiya, magastos ito at wala namang batas na nag-uutos sa paggamit nito, kaya karamihan ay gumagamit pa rin ng dati at maingay na kagamitan. Sabi ng mga lider sa industriya, ang dagdag na regulasyon ay makakasama sa kalakalan, lalo pa't kakaunti lang naman ang mga balyena. Pero giit ng mga tagapangalaga ng kalikasan, nakakabahala ang patuloy na pag-antala ng mga kinakailangang proteksyon at baka humantong ito sa unang human-caused extinction ng isang malaking uri ng balyena. Bihirang-bihira nang makita ang Rice's whales, kaya hinihikayat ng mga mananaliksik at ahensya ang publiko na iulat kaagad kung may makitang balyena upang makatulong sa conservation at pagsasaliksik.

article_content: House of Raeford Farms, a poultry company based in Rose Hill, North Carolina, is recalling nearly 4,000 pounds of cooked chicken breasts due to a risk of Listeria monocytogenes contamination. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) announced that the recalled items are 18- to 22-pound boxes, each containing two boneless oven-roasted chicken breasts weighing between 9 and 11 pounds each. Consumers should look for packaging with serial number 'P-239A,' product code '94268,' and a package date of '1270,' representing September 27, 2011. These products were sent to food service providers and delicatessens in Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, and South Carolina. A positive test for Listeria monocytogenes was detected after a customer had the chicken tested in a lab. Neither the USDA’s Food Safety and Inspection Service nor the CDC has reported any illnesses linked to these products. Listeria infection (listeriosis) doesn't occur often, but when it does, it can be life-threatening, especially for people with weakened immune systems. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, and nausea, and in worst cases can lead to miscarriages, stillbirths, or fatal infections. The USDA advises anyone feeling sick or worried to consult their healthcare provider. The USDA also stresses the importance of good hygiene: wash your hands before and after handling raw poultry or meat, clean all kitchen tools and surfaces well, and use separate cutting boards for raw meat, poultry, vegetables, and eggs to prevent bacteria from spreading.

Ayon sa U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), ang mga apektadong produkto ay nasa 18- hanggang 22-libra na kahon, bawat isa ay may dalawang boneless oven-roasted chicken breast na may timbang na 9 hanggang 11 libra bawat isa. Siguraduhing tingnan ang packaging na may serial number na 'P-239A,' product code na '94268,' at packaging date na '1270,' na tumutukoy sa Setyembre 27, 2011. Naipamahagi ang mga produktong ito sa mga food service at delicatessen sa Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, at South Carolina. Natukoy ang Listeria monocytogenes nang magpa-laboratory test ang isang customer. Wala namang naiulat na nagkasakit ayon sa USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service at CDC. Ang impeksyon sa Listeria (listeriosis) ay bihira pero seryoso, lalo na sa mga may mahinang immune system. Sintomas nito ang mataas na lagnat, matinding sakit ng ulo, paninigas ng leeg, at pagkahilo o pagsusuka. Sa mga matitinding kaso, puwede itong magdulot ng pagkalaglag, stillbirth o malubhang impeksyon. Ayon sa USDA, mainam na kumonsulta agad sa doktor kung nakakaramdam ng sintomas o nangangamba. Ipinapayo ng USDA na siguraduhing malinis ang mga kamay bago at pagkatapos humawak ng hilaw na karne o manok, linisin nang maigi ang mga kagamitan sa kusina, at gumamit ng hiwalay na cutting board para sa karne, manok, gulay, at itlog upang maiwasan ang paglipat ng bakterya.

article_content: BANGKOK – The United States and the Philippines are conducting joint air and maritime patrols over the South China Sea as both countries strengthen cooperation amid increasingly assertive Chinese activities in the region. On Wednesday, the Philippine Air Force reported that its aircraft had participated in patrols the previous day near Batanes, the Philippines’ northernmost province, which is about 200 kilometers (125 miles) from Taiwan, a self-governed island claimed by China. The continuing patrols, scheduled through Thursday, involve both the U.S. and Philippine navies. The operations come only days after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. of the Philippines described the situation in the South China Sea as increasingly 'dire,' with China stepping up its presence in the disputed area. When asked about the patrols, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning stated that China’s position had been clearly conveyed to both the Philippines and the U.S., warning that 'the Philippines-U.S. joint patrol drill must not undermine China's territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests.' The U.S. 7th Fleet characterized the patrols as a standard part of American cooperation with allies and partners in maintaining a 'free and open Indo-Pacific region.' China claims virtually the entire South China Sea, leading to disputes not just with the Philippines but also with Vietnam, Malaysia, Taiwan, and Brunei. These overlapping claims have made the region a flashpoint and heightened U.S.-China rivalry. Earlier this month, Philippine officials reported that a Chinese coast guard ship used a water cannon against a Philippine supply boat in disputed waters. Last month, they said, a Chinese coast guard ship and an accompanying vessel rammed a Philippine coast guard vessel and a military-run supply boat near a contested shoal. During remarks in Honolulu on Sunday, President Marcos expressed concern that China has shown increased interest in atolls and shoals closer to the Philippine coast, the nearest of which is about 60 nautical miles (111 kilometers) away. 'Unfortunately, I cannot report that the situation is improving. The situation has become more dire than it was before,' he said. In announcing the start of the joint patrols on X (formerly Twitter), Marcos described them as a 'testament to our commitment to bolster the interoperability of our military forces.' He added, 'Through collaborative efforts, we aim to enhance regional security and foster a seamless partnership with the United States in safeguarding our shared interests.' Since taking office last year, President Marcos has deepened the Philippines’ alliance with the U.S., marking a departure from the China-friendly policy of his predecessor, Rodrigo Duterte. In February, Marcos approved an expansion of the U.S. military presence in the Philippines, adding four new bases to the five existing sites under a 2014 Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement. This move, which Marcos said would help strengthen the country’s coastal defense, aligns with the Biden administration’s aim to build a network of military alliances in the Indo-Pacific to counterbalance China. Marcos has also bolstered ties with Japan, signing a recent agreement allowing Japanese troops to participate in training exercises.

Noong Miyerkules, iniulat ng Philippine Air Force na lumahok ang kanilang eroplano sa mga patrol isang araw bago nito malapit sa Batanes, ang pinakahilagang probinsya ng Pilipinas na nasa humigit-kumulang 200 kilometro (125 milya) ang layo mula sa Taiwan, isang self-governed na isla na inaangkin ng Tsina.
