Nang tanungin tungkol sa mga patrol na ito, sinabi ng tagapagsalita ng Ministry of Foreign Affairs ng Tsina na si Mao Ning na malinaw nang naiparating sa Pilipinas at U.S. ang posisyon ng Tsina, na 'ang pagsasanay ng Pilipinas at U.S. ay hindi dapat makasira sa teritoryal na soberenya at karapatan ng Tsina sa dagat.' Inaangkin ng Tsina halos buong South China Sea, dahilan ng sigalot hindi lamang sa Pilipinas kundi pati Vietnam, Malaysia, Taiwan, at Brunei. Ang magkakapatong na pag-aangkin ay naging mitsa ng tensyon at nagpalala sa tunggalian ng U.S. at Tsina. Kamakailan, iniulat ng mga opisyal ng Pilipinas na binomba ng water cannon ng China coast guard ang isang supply boat ng Pilipinas sa pinagtatalunang bahagi ng dagat. Sa isang talumpati sa Honolulu nitong Linggo, ipinahayag ni Pangulong Marcos ang pag-aalala sa patuloy na interes ng Tsina sa mga atoll at shoal na papalapit nang papalapit sa baybayin ng Pilipinas, kung saan ang pinakamalapit ay nasa 60 nautical miles (111 kilometro) ang layo. 'Sa kasamaang palad, hindi ko masasabi na gumaganda ang kalagayan. Mas naging delikado pa ito ngayon,' aniya. Sa pag-anunsyo ng simula ng joint patrols sa X (dating Twitter), sinabi ni Marcos na ito ay 'patunay ng ating dedikasyon na palakasin ang ugnayan ng ating militar.' Dagdag pa niya, 'Sa tulong ng kooperasyon, nais natin palakasin ang regional security at itaguyod ang matibay na ugnayan sa Estados Unidos sa pagprotekta sa ating parehong interes.' Mula nang maupo noong nakaraang taon, pinalalim ni Pangulong Marcos ang alyansa ng Pilipinas sa U.S., na kabaligtaran ng China-friendly na polisiya ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte. Noong Pebrero, inaprubahan ni Marcos ang pagpapalawak ng presensya ng militar ng Amerika, dodagdagan pa ng apat ang base mula sa limang kasalukuyang under ng 2014 Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement. Ang hakbang na ito, na ayon kay Marcos ay magpapalakas sa coastal defense ng bansa, ay tumutugma sa layunin ng administrasyon ni Biden na bumuo ng network ng military alliances sa Indo-Pacific para kontrahin ang Tsina. Pinalalalim rin ni Marcos ang relasyon sa Japan at nilagdaan kamakailan ang kasunduan para makasali ang mga sundalong Hapon sa training exercises.

article_content: A large flightless rhea bird—which stands about six feet tall, has powerful claws, and can weigh up to 90 pounds—has escaped from a smallholding belonging to Jo Clark on the Essex/Hertfordshire border. Despite the bird’s size and potential danger, local residents are treating its escape with humor as sightings continue. The runaway rhea, a six-year-old female, was last seen near Barkway Park Golf Club in Nuthampstead, Hertfordshire, after escaping nearly four weeks ago. Owner Jo Clark believes the bird may have been spooked by a local hunt. Since then, the bird has been spotted several times in the area, including by golfers, residents, and passersby, some of whom have captured photos and video. While authorities like the RSPCA have warned people not to approach the rhea due to its speed and powerful claws, locals remain relaxed and even amused. The bird, nicknamed 'Chris' (after singer Chris Rea), has become a local celebrity. Many in the community express hope that she remains free, citing the area’s plentiful food and suitable cover for a bird of her size. Multiple sightings—at Barkway Park Golf Club, Astey, and near Brent Pelham—have been documented by locals such as Ray Murdoch and Tim Bradshaw. The media has been following the story, with jokes and wordplay circulating among the community. Jo Clark continues to care for three younger rheas on her property and notes that female rheas are not maternal, making it unlikely the escaped bird will miss her offspring. Some believe the rhea may be seeking a mate after a previous pair was sold to a nearby resident. The search for the rhea has drawn more attention from media and locals alike. Despite the warnings, no one seems eager to recapture her, and the community appears to enjoy following the bird’s latest antics, hoping it remains safe and undisturbed.

Sa kabila ng laki at posibleng peligro nito, tinuturing lang ito ng mga lokal na residente bilang nakakatawang kwento habang patuloy ang mga sightings. Ang tumakbong rhea, isang anim na taong gulang na babae, ay huling nakita malapit sa Barkway Park Golf Club sa Nuthampstead, Hertfordshire, matapos tumakas halos apat na linggo na ang nakalipas. Naniniwala si Jo Clark, ang may-ari, na baka natakot ang rhea sa dumaan na local hunt. Mula noon, ilang ulit na itong nakita sa paligid ng lugar ng mga golfers, residente, at mga dumadaan; marami na rin ang nakakuha ng litrato at video ng ibon. Bagamat nagbabala ang mga ahensya tulad ng RSPCA na huwag lapitan ang rhea dahil sa bilis at lakas ng mga kuko nito, kalmado at natutuwa pa rin ang mga lokal. Tinawag ng komunidad ang rhea na ‘Chris’ (mula kay singer Chris Rea) at naging lokal na celebrity na ito. Marami ang umaasang mananatiling malaya si Chris dahil sagana ang pagkain at tagong lugar dito para sa kanya. Iba’t ibang sightings—sa Barkway Park Golf Club, Astey, at malapit sa Brent Pelham—ang naitala ng mga taong tulad nina Ray Murdoch at Tim Bradshaw. Sinusundan din ng media ang istorya at kinagigiliwan ng komunidad ang mga biro tungkol dito. Inaalagaan pa rin ni Jo Clark ang tatlong mas batang rhea sa kanyang lupa at binanggit niyang hindi maternal ang mga babaeng rhea kaya malamang hindi hinahanap ng tumakas na rhea ang kanyang mga anak. article_content: Texas voters have approved Proposition 5, a constitutional amendment establishing the Texas University Fund—a $3.9 billion endowment designed to strengthen emerging research universities in the state. The measure passed with a 66% to 34% margin, with over 95% of votes counted. This amendment aims to make Texas more competitive nationally by increasing the number of top-tier research universities, rivaling states such as California and Florida. An editorial by two state senators in the Dallas Morning News described the initiative as "an investment in Texas’ future that we cannot afford to pass up." Proposition 5, a legislatively referred ballot initiative, renames the National Research University Fund to the Texas University Fund. The funding includes $3 billion from Texas’s budget surplus and $900 million from the former NRUF. Earnings from the state’s rainy day fund will also support it, with a fiscal 2024 spending cap of $100 million, adjusted annually for inflation with a 2% growth limit. Initially, four public universities are eligible for funding: Texas Tech University, Texas State University, the University of Houston, and the University of North Texas. Eligibility requires spending at least $20 million annually on federal or private research for three consecutive years and awarding an average of 45 doctoral degrees per year during the same period. Estimates indicate Texas Tech University will receive $44 million in the first year; University of Houston, $48 million; Texas State, $22 million; and University of North Texas, $21 million. In future years, up to 7% of the endowment’s investment assets will be distributed. Texas Tech and University of Houston will each receive one-third of three-fourths of the distribution, while Texas State and University of North Texas will split the remaining third. The final quarter will be divided based on research funding and doctoral degrees awarded. The University of Texas and Texas A&M University systems are not eligible, as they already benefit from the Permanent University Fund (PUF), a state endowment dating to 1876, valued at over $30 billion. The PUF is funded by leasing revenue from state-owned West Texas lands, with profits allocated annually to these two systems. Enabling legislation (House Bill 1595) requires the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board to determine annual distributions, identify eligible institutions, and report distributions to state authorities. The initiative, which does not require new taxes, received broad bipartisan and organizational support. Governor Greg Abbott celebrated the amendment’s passage online, stating that the measure will bolster Texas’s status as a leader in research universities.

Lumusot ang panukala sa botong 66% kumpara sa 34%, base sa mahigit 95% ng mga boto. Layunin ng susog na ito na gawing mas kompetitibo ang Texas sa buong bansa sa pagdami ng de-kalibreng research universities, katulad ng sa California at Florida. Isang editoryal mula sa dalawang state senator sa Dallas Morning News ang naglarawan dito bilang "pamumuhunan sa kinabukasan ng Texas na hindi natin dapat palampasin." Ang Proposisyon 5, na itinutulak ng lehislatura, ay magpapalit ng pangalan ng National Research University Fund bilang Texas University Fund. Kabilang sa pondo ang $3 bilyon mula sa sobrang badyet ng Texas at $900 milyon mula sa dating NRUF. Makakatulong din ang kita mula sa rainy day fund ng estado, na may spending cap na $100 milyon para sa 2024, na puwedeng i-adjust taon-taon, limitado sa 2% ang pagtaas. Sa simula, apat na pampublikong unibersidad ang kwalipikadong makinabang: Texas Tech University, Texas State University, University of Houston, at University of North Texas. Kailangan munang gumastos ng hindi bababa sa $20 milyon taon-taon sa federal o pribadong pananaliksik sa loob ng tatlong magkakasunod na taon at maggawad ng hindi bababa sa 45 doctoral degrees kada taon upang makwalipika. Ayon sa estima, tatanggap ang Texas Tech University ng $44 milyon sa unang taon; University of Houston, $48 milyon; Texas State, $22 milyon; at University of North Texas, $21 milyon. Sa mga susunod na taon, hanggang 7% ng investment assets ng endowment ay ipapamahagi. Kapwa makakakuha ng tig-iisang-katlo mula sa tatlong-kapat ng pondo ang Texas Tech at University of Houston habang paghahatian ng Texas State at University of North Texas ang natira. Ang natitirang isang-kapat ay pagbabatayan sa dami ng research funding at bilang ng mga naibigay na doctorate. Hindi sakop ang University of Texas at Texas A&M University systems dahil may sarili na silang endowment mula sa Permanent University Fund (PUF), isang pondo ng estado na sinimulan noong 1876 na ngayon ay may halaga nang mahigit $30 bilyon. Galing ang PUF sa kita mula sa pagrenta ng mga lupa ng estado sa West Texas at taunang ipinamamahagi ito sa dalawang sistemang ito. Ayon sa House Bill 1595, tungkulin ng Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board na tukuyin ang taunang distribusyon, alamin ang mga kwalipikadong institusyon, at iulat ito sa mga ahensya ng estado. Ang inisyatiba ay hindi nangangailangan ng bagong buwis at malawak na sinuportahan ng mga partido at organisasyon. Ibinahagi ni Governor Greg Abbott online ang kanyang kasiyahan sa pagpasa ng susog, na ayon sa kanya ay magpapatibay sa Texas bilang lider sa research universities.

article_content: Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas described a new agreement as 'historic.' Eighteen countries have signed the Guidelines for Secure AI System Development, based on the principle that AI should be secure by design. Developed by the UK’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) in collaboration with the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), these guidelines are considered the first global agreement of their type. The guidelines target AI system providers, especially those using models hosted by organizations or accessed via external application programming interfaces (APIs). The goal is to ensure cybersecurity is an essential part of AI development from the outset and throughout its lifecycle. Secretary Mayorkas stated, 'The guidelines jointly issued today by CISA, NCSC, and international partners, provide a common-sense path to designing, developing, deploying, and operating AI with cybersecurity at its core. By integrating secure by design principles, these guidelines represent a historic agreement. Developers must invest in protecting customers during every step of a system’s design and development.' The guidelines cover secure design—including risk assessment, threat modeling, and considering trade-offs in system and model design—as well as guidance on secure development such as supply chain security, documentation, and managing technical debt. Secure deployment includes protecting infrastructure and models, incident management processes, and responsible release. Safe operation and maintenance involve logging and monitoring, update management, and information sharing. They are largely based on previous guidance from the NCSC, NIST’s Secure Software Development Framework, and secure by design principles from CISA, the NCSC, and other international cyber agencies. The agreement has been approved by Australia, Canada, Chile, Czechia, Estonia, France, Germany, Israel, Italy, Japan, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Poland, South Korea, Singapore, as well as the UK and US. China, a leader in AI development, is not part of the agreement. The UK wants to build on the momentum from the recent AI safety summit at Bletchley Park. Like discussions at that summit, the new guidelines emphasize general principles but lack many specific details. However, efforts continue: Last month, President Biden ordered the Department of Homeland Security to promote global AI safety standards, and this month, CISA released its Roadmap for Artificial Intelligence to protect AI systems from cyber threats. CISA Director Jen Easterly said, 'The release of the Guidelines for Secure AI System Development marks a key milestone in our collective commitment—by governments across the world—to ensure the development and deployment of artificial intelligence capabilities that are secure by design. Domestic and international unity in advancing secure by design principles and building a resilient foundation for AI safety has never been more important.'

Labing-walong bansa ang lumagda sa Guidelines for Secure AI System Development, na nakabatay sa prinsipyo na ang AI ay dapat maging secure by design. Ang mga guidelines na ito ay binuo ng UK’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) kasama ang US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) at itinuturing na unang global agreement ng ganitong uri. Ang mga guidelines ay nakatuon sa mga provider ng AI systems, lalo na sa mga gumagamit ng models na naka-host sa mga organisasyon o ina-access gamit ang external application programming interfaces (APIs). Layunin nitong matiyak na ang cybersecurity ay mahalagang bahagi ng AI development mula umpisa hanggang katapusan ng proseso. Ayon kay Secretary Mayorkas, 'Ang mga guidelines na sabay na inilabas ng CISA, NCSC, at ng mga international partner ay nagbibigay ng common-sense na paraan sa pag-disenyo, pag-develop, pag-deploy, at paggamit ng AI na naka-sentro sa cybersecurity. Sa pamamagitan ng integration ng secure by design principles, ang mga guidelines na ito ay isang makasaysayang kasunduan. Dapat mag-invest ang mga developer sa pagprotekta sa mga customer sa bawat bahagi ng design at development ng system.' Sinasaklaw ng guidelines ang secure na disenyo—kabilang ang risk assessment, threat modeling, at pag-isip ng trade-offs sa system at model design—pati na rin ang gabay sa secure development tulad ng supply chain security, dokumentasyon, at pamamahala ng technical debt. Ang secure deployment ay sumasaklaw sa pagprotekta ng infrastructure at models, incident management process, at responsible release. Ang safe operation at maintenance ay naglalaman ng logging at monitoring, update management, at information sharing. Naka-base ang mga ito sa naunang gabay mula sa NCSC, NIST’s Secure Software Development Framework, at secure by design principles galing sa CISA, NCSC, at iba pang international cyber agencies. Inaprubahan ito ng Australia, Canada, Chile, Czechia, Estonia, France, Germany, Israel, Italy, Japan, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Poland, South Korea, Singapore, UK at US. Ang China, na isa sa mga nangungunang bansa sa AI development, ay hindi kasali sa kasunduan. Nais ng UK na ituloy ang momentum mula sa AI safety summit sa Bletchley Park. Tulad ng mga diskusyon roon, ang bagong guidelines ay nakasentro sa mga pangkalahatang prinsipyo pero kulang pa sa tiyak na detalye. Gayunpaman, tuloy-tuloy pa rin ang mga gawain: Noong nakaraang buwan, iniutos ni President Biden sa Department of Homeland Security na itaguyod ang global AI safety standards, at nitong buwan, naglabas ang CISA ng Roadmap for Artificial Intelligence para maprotektahan ang AI systems laban sa cyber threats. Ayon kay CISA Director Jen Easterly, 'Ang paglabas ng Guidelines for Secure AI System Development ay nagpapakita ng mahalagang milestone sa sama-samang pagsisikap—ng mga pamahalaan sa buong mundo—para matiyak na ang development at deployment ng artificial intelligence ay secure by design. Hindi pa naging ganito kahalaga ang pagkakaisa ng mga bansa para sa mga prinsipyo ng secure by design at matatag na pundasyon ng AI safety.'

article_content:
In an era where videoconferencing has become essential in work and education, a new study highlights the real phenomenon of videoconferencing fatigue. Austrian researchers, whose findings are published in the journal Scientific Reports by Nature, explored the measurable effects of lengthy videoconferences on individuals.

The research team conducted an experiment with 35 university students who attended a 50-minute lecture either via videoconference or in person. During the lectures, participants were connected to electroencephalograms (EEG) to monitor brain activity and electrocardiograms (ECG) to observe heart rate changes.

The results revealed that students attending the in-person lecture felt more energetic, positive, and engaged, while those participating online reported greater tiredness, drowsiness, and disengagement. These feelings were corroborated by the EEG results, which indicated increased cognitive effort among the online group, a sign of fatigue. Similarly, ECG readings suggested heightened fatigue and stress in students attending virtually, implying broader effects on their nervous system.

These findings have important implications for modern workplaces and educational institutions. The researchers recommend using videoconferencing as a complement rather than a replacement for face-to-face meetings. However, they acknowledge limitations in their study, including the academic setting and the relatively young age of participants. The study also did not compare videoconferencing fatigue to stress from in-person meeting logistics, such as commuting.

According to The Register, this research is part of Austria's Techno Stress initiative, which investigates the adverse effects of rising digital interaction. The initiative has produced 20 papers on topics like metaverse social interactions, digital detox, and electronic surveillance at work.

As society increasingly adopts digital tools, understanding their impact on well-being is critical. This Austrian study provides timely insights into how virtual environments influence our minds and bodies, and underscores the importance of balancing online and in-person interactions.

Gumawa ang research team ng eksperimento kung saan 35 estudyante sa unibersidad ang dumalo sa 50-minutong lektura—ang ilan ay online, at ang ilan naman ay harapan. Naka-hook up ang mga kalahok sa electroencephalogram (EEG) para masubaybayan ang aktibidad ng utak at electrocardiogram (ECG) para sa tibok ng puso.

Ayon sa resulta, mas masigla, mas masaya, at mas aktibo ang mga dumalo nang harapan, samantalang mas napagod, inantok, at na-boring ang mga sumali online. Kinumpirma ito ng EEG readings na nagpakita ng mas mataas na cognitive effort sa online group—senyales ng pagkapagod. Tulad ng inaasahan, mas mataas din ang stress at pagod ng online participants base sa ECG, na nagpapahiwatig ng mas malawak na epekto sa nervous system.

Mahalaga ang mga natuklasan lalo na para sa mga modernong opisina at paaralan. Iminumungkahi ng researchers na gumamit ng videoconferencing bilang karagdagan, hindi kapalit, ng harapang meeting. Aminado rin silang may limitasyon ang pag-aaral dahil puro mga bata at tagapag-aral ang kalahok. Hindi rin naikumpara ang pagod sa videoconferencing sa ibang stressors gaya ng pag-commute sa personal na meetings.

Ayon sa The Register, bahagi ito ng mas malaking programa ng Austria na Techno Stress, na nag-aaral sa negatibong epekto ng digital interactions. Naka-20 na research papers na ang inilathala ukol sa metaverse, digital detox, at workplace surveillance.

Habang lalo pang gumagamit ang lahat ng digital na teknolohiya, mas mahalaga ngayong maintindihan kung paano naapektuhan ng virtual environments ang katawan at isipan natin. Muling nagbibigay ang pag-aaral na ito mula Austria ng paalala na balansehin ang online at in-person na koneksyon.

article_content: Mario V Poluakan began his PhD in Economics at IIT Guwahati in 2022 at the age of 36. Currently on research leave, he is also affiliated with an educational institution in Indonesia. Poluakan holds undergraduate and master's degrees in economics and agricultural economics, respectively, both from Indonesian universities. His professional journey began in 2007 at a financial advisory firm, and since 2010, he has worked on economic empowerment projects for rural and coastal communities. He received funding through the Doctoral Fellowship for ASEAN, awarded by India's Ministry of Education exclusively to researchers from ASEAN countries wishing to study at Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs). After submitting his application and requisite documents via the scholarship portal, he was interviewed and subsequently offered the fellowship and admission. Using his admission letter, he obtained a study visa from the Indian Embassy in Jakarta and arrived in India in August 2022. At IIT Guwahati, Poluakan's research addresses sustainable economic empowerment for farmers and rural communities, exploring topics such as modeling climate change impacts on farmer resilience, gender dynamics in smallholder farming, and the adoption of agricultural technologies. He aspires to make a lasting contribution to these fields. Poluakan's interest in pursuing a PhD in India traces back to 2010. Though previously in contact with Indian universities, work commitments delayed his plans. He values India’s history, scientific advancements, and its shared agricultural and social challenges with Indonesia. Adjusting to India's environment presented challenges, such as coping with the hot climate—markedly different from Indonesia's moderate temperatures—and navigating language differences outside of campus, where English is less commonly spoken. However, he gradually acclimated and found his experiences enriching. Poluakan emphasizes the benefits of engaging with experts from technical fields at IIT, particularly for his interdisciplinary research involving mathematics, statistics, and spatial analysis. He believes that sustainable solutions arise through collaboration between social sciences and technical disciplines. Looking ahead, Poluakan plans to continue his research as scheduled with his supervisor in the Humanities and Social Sciences Department. Upon completing his studies, he intends to return to Indonesia and contribute to local communities using the knowledge and outcomes gained during his time at IIT.

Nakatanggap siya ng pondo mula sa Doctoral Fellowship for ASEAN, na ibinibigay ng Ministry of Education ng India para lamang sa mga mananaliksik mula sa ASEAN na nais mag-aral sa IIT. Matapos isumite ang kanyang aplikasyon at mga dokumento sa scholarship portal, na-interview siya at tuluyang tinanggap. article_content: KUALA LUMPUR – According to Malaysian police, 43 young Malaysians who traveled to Lima just a week earlier have been rescued from a human trafficking syndicate running telecommunication scams in Peru. Authorities say this operation is linked to syndicates from Taiwan and China, who often impersonate bank or government officials to trick victims into giving away personal financial information or transferring money. Hundreds of Malaysians have previously been lured overseas by phony job offers, particularly in other Southeast Asian countries, and have ended up being forced into online scams involving romance or cryptocurrency. Malaysian police chief Razarudin Husain said this is the first known case in Peru involving Malaysian victims. He added that efforts to educate the public about such scams continue, despite ongoing incidents.

Ayon sa mga awtoridad, ang operasyon ay konektado sa mga sindikato mula Taiwan at China na kadalasang nagpapanggap bilang mga opisyal ng bangko o gobyerno upang malinlang ang mga biktima na ibigay ang kanilang personal na impormasyon o magpadala ng pera. Daan-daang Malaysians na rin ang naloko ng mga pekeng alok sa trabaho sa ibang bansa—lalo na sa mga kalapit bansa sa Southeast Asia—at napilitang gumawa ng mga online scam gaya ng romance o cryptocurrency fraud. Sinabi ni Malaysian police chief Razarudin Husain na ito ang unang kilalang kaso sa Peru na may mga Malaysian na biktima. Dagdag pa niya, patuloy ang mga hakbang ng pulisya para bigyang-kaalaman ang publiko tungkol sa mga ganitong scam habang patuloy pa rin ang mga insidente.

article_content: Stars of David were found graffitied on buildings across Paris and several suburbs, prompting comparisons to antisemitic acts from the 1930s by political leaders. Around 60 Stars of David were painted on walls in Paris’ 14th arrondissement on Monday night. Authorities say France is currently facing a significant rise in antisemitic incidents. According to Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin, more than 850 such incidents have been reported in France since the Hamas attacks in Israel on October 7. Paris officials have announced an investigation into property damage, aggravated by racist intent. A resident of one of the graffitied buildings told BFMTV, 'I am crying because I am once again seeing the hate that we received when I was a child. I can't understand it.' The mayor’s office in the 14th arrondissement stated that these actions 'recall the events of the 1930s... which led to the extermination of millions of Jews.' Emmanuel Grégoire, deputy to Paris Mayor Anne Hidalgo, said the graffiti would be removed and an investigation launched. 'Antisemitism continues to kill. We will never give up the fight,' he said. Elsewhere, a woman was critically injured after being shot by police on Tuesday morning. Police reported that she was behaving in a threatening manner and refused to comply with orders. Similar graffiti appeared in the suburbs of Vanves, Fontenay-aux-Roses, Aubervilliers, and Saint-Ouen. Some graffiti included slogans such as, 'from the river to the sea, Palestine will win.' The Mayor of Saint-Ouen, Karim Bouamrane, called for the perpetrators of the 'antisemitic and racist' graffiti to be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law. Prosecutors, however, cautioned that the antisemitic nature of the stars remains under investigation. On Tuesday, Prime Minister Elisabeth Borne condemned these acts as 'disgraceful.' According to a poll for BFMTV, 83% of French people are concerned about the sharp increase in antisemitic incidents. Political leaders, including President Emmanuel Macron, have warned against 'importing' tensions from the Israel-Hamas conflict into France. Justice Minister Eric Dupond-Moretti stated that around 400 people have been arrested this month for antisemitic acts.

Humigit-kumulang 60 bituin ni David ang ipininta sa mga pader sa ika-14 na arrondissement ng Paris noong Lunes ng gabi. Ferrari’s Fernando Alonso stayed fifth in the drivers' standings but lost ground after earning no points, finishing 14th following a drive-through penalty for overtaking Renault’s Robert Kubica off the track. article_content: The National September 11 Memorial Museum will charge a $24 admission fee when it opens this spring, a move that has attracted criticism from some families of 9/11 victims. Sally Regenhard, assistant chairwoman of the group 9/11 Parents and Families of Firefighters and World Trade Center Victims, said the museum was not meant to become a profit-driven tourist attraction with expensive entrance fees. Regenhard urged government officials to revoke the fee and manage costs better, expressing concern that the fee could exclude lower- and middle-income families while allowing only wealthier visitors. Museum president Joe Daniels stated that the admission price, approved on Thursday, is necessary for the organization's financial stability and to cover operating expenses. Anthony Guido, communications manager, said the fee will help balance the museum's $63 million operating budget for 2014. Daniels noted that, unlike other national museums, the 9/11 Memorial does not currently receive federal support for its ongoing operations. The memorial is seeking federal funding to expand its educational programming, according to Guido. Relatives of 9/11 victims will be exempt from all fees. Discounts are available for students, seniors, and certain groups. Free general admission will be offered every Tuesday from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. New York Mayor Bill de Blasio has spoken out against charging an admission fee, stressing the site’s national importance and the need for federal government support. The underground museum at the World Trade Center is set to open in mid-May. The above-ground memorial plaza, which has had 11.5 million visitors since opening two years ago, will remain free. The memorial preserves the history of September 11, 2001, honoring nearly 3,000 victims through artifacts, exhibitions, and first-person accounts, according to Daniels. CNN's Lorenzo Ferrigno contributed to this report.

Ayon kay Sally Regenhard, assistant chairwoman ng grupong 9/11 Parents and Families of Firefighters and World Trade Center Victims, hindi dapat gawing profit-driven tourist attraction ang museo na may mataas na bayad sa pagpasok. Hinikayat ni Regenhard ang mga opisyal ng gobyerno na alisin ang fee at mas pamahalaan ang gastusin, dahil maaaring hindi makapasok ang mga pamilya mula sa mababa at gitnang antas ng kabuhayan, habang may kaya lamang ang makakabisita. Sinabi ni Joe Daniels, presidente ng museo, na ang admission price na naaprubahan nitong Huwebes ay kailangan para sa katatagan ng organisasyon at pambayad sa operasyon. Ayon kay Anthony Guido, communications manager, tutulong ang fee para mahawakan ang $63 milyong operating budget ng museo para sa 2014. Binanggit ni Daniels na hindi tulad ng ibang pambansang museo, ang 9/11 Memorial ay hindi pa rin nakakatanggap ng suportang pederal para sa operasyon nito. Nakatakdang magbukas sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo ang underground museum sa World Trade Center. Libre pa ring mabisita ang above-ground memorial plaza, na nakaabot na ng 11.5 milyong bisita mula nang ito'y magbukas dalawang taon na ang nakalilipas. Inaalala ng memorial ang kasaysayan ng Setyembre 11, 2001, bilang paggunita sa halos 3,000 biktima sa pamamagitan ng mga artifact, eksibisyon, at kwento ng mga nakaligtas, ayon kay Daniels. Nag-ambag si Lorenzo Ferrigno ng CNN sa ulat na ito.

article_content: Ben Worden, 33, from Welling in south-east London, was sentenced on September 28, 2012, to six years in prison for killing Paul Gunner, 32, outside a kebab shop in Bexley after an altercation involving insults. The incident took place last October after both men, who had been drinking at a nearby bar called Bar Lorca, encountered each other at the Charcoal Grill store. Paul Gunner, a lighting technician for Strictly Come Dancing hired by the BBC contractor Set and Strike, had been celebrating his 32nd birthday. Worden struck Gunner twice after Gunner insulted him, causing Gunner to fall and suffer fatal head injuries. After the attack, Worden left the scene with friends and allegedly boasted to others about what he had done instead of helping the injured man. During the trial at Inner London Crown Court, Worden admitted to hitting Gunner but claimed his friend James Parsons delivered the fatal blow. The jury, however, found Worden responsible and convicted him of manslaughter. Detective Inspector Rick Murphy described the attack as senseless and shocking, highlighting the tragic consequences for Mr Gunner's family and friends.

Naganap ang insidente noong Oktubre nang parehong uminom sina Worden at Gunner sa malapit na Bar Lorca bago sila nagkita sa Charcoal Grill store. Si Paul Gunner, isang lighting technician ng Strictly Come Dancing na kinuha ng BBC contractor na Set and Strike, ay nagdiriwang ng kanyang ika-32 kaarawan. Dalawang beses sinuntok ni Worden si Gunner matapos siyang bastusin nito, kaya bumagsak si Gunner at nagtamo ng matinding pinsala sa ulo na naging sanhi ng pagkamatay niya. Pagkatapos ng insidente, umalis si Worden kasama ang mga kaibigan at umano’y ipinagyabang pa ang ginawa niya kaysa tulungan ang sugatang biktima. Sa paglilitis sa Inner London Crown Court, inamin ni Worden na sinuntok niya si Gunner ngunit sinabi niyang ang kaibigan niyang si James Parsons ang tumama ng fatal blow. Pero ayon sa hurado, si Worden talaga ang responsable kaya’t nahatulan siya ng manslaughter. Inilarawan ni Detective Inspector Rick Murphy ang insidente bilang walang saysay at nakakagulat, na nagdulot ng matinding kalungkutan sa pamilya at mga kaibigan ni Mr. Gunner.

article_content: During his Senate confirmation hearing, Attorney General nominee Eric Holder addressed scrutiny over his involvement in the controversial pardon of financier Marc Rich. Holder admitted to serious errors in judgment during the process, acknowledging that he was not fully aware of Rich’s criminal record at the time. Describing the event as the most challenging of his legal profession, Holder stressed that the experience made him realize the need for thorough consultation with all involved legal experts before major decisions. He also advocated for improvements to the presidential pardon process to prevent similar issues, particularly as administrations transition. Republican members of the Judiciary Committee, especially Senator Arlen Specter, questioned Holder on his past decisions. While Specter recognized Holder’s qualifications, he expressed ongoing concerns about his judgment. Holder clarified that he did not suggest Rich’s attorney bypass the Justice Department in seeking the pardon. The hearing also covered Holder’s role in President Clinton’s 1999 clemency for 16 members of the Puerto Rican nationalist group FALN. Though the group had committed acts of violence, none resulted in injuries in these specific cases. Holder defended his support for clemency, pointing to endorsements from influential figures such as former President Jimmy Carter and civil rights leader Coretta Scott King. Other controversies included Holder's part in the 2000 federal action that returned Cuban boy Elian Gonzales to his father, a move that angered anti-Castro groups, as well as his firm support for stronger gun regulations. Former Senator John Warner spoke on Holder’s behalf, acknowledging some misjudgments in his career but emphasizing Holder’s capacity to learn and improve. Senator Patrick Leahy, leading the Democrats on the Judiciary Committee, encouraged senators to avoid partisanship and back Holder’s nomination, praising his respect for the rule of law and ability to rebuild morale at the Justice Department. If confirmed, Holder would become the first African-American Attorney General of the United States. The confirmation hearing revealed deep partisan divides, setting the stage for a heated debate over Holder’s appointment.
translated_content: Sa pagdinig ng Senado para sa kumpirmasyon, hinarap ni Attorney General nominee Eric Holder ang mga tanong tungkol sa kanyang naging papel sa kontrobersyal na pardon ng financier na si Marc Rich. Inamin ni Holder ang malalaking pagkakamali niya sa naging proseso at umaming hindi siya lubos na nakagawa ng masusing pagsisiyasat tungkol sa kaso ni Rich noon. Itinuring niya itong pinakamahirap na karanasan sa kaniyang karera bilang abogado at binigyang-diin ang pangangailangan ng konsultasyon sa lahat ng kaugnay na legal na eksperto bago gumawa ng mahahalagang desisyon. Nanawagan din siya ng reporma sa proseso ng presidential pardon, lalo na tuwing magpapalit ng administrasyon. Pinagtuunan din siya ng mga tanong mula sa mga Republican sa Judiciary Committee, partikular si Senator Arlen Specter, na bagama’t kinilala ang mga kwalipikasyon ni Holder ay nagpahayag pa rin ng agam-agam sa kanyang naging paghatol. Nilinaw naman ni Holder na hindi siya nagmungkahi na iwasan ng abogado ni Rich ang Department of Justice sa pagsumite ng kahilingan para sa pardon. Napag-usapan din sa pagdinig ang papel ni Holder sa 1999 clemency na ibinigay ni Pangulong Clinton sa 16 na miyembro ng Puerto Rican nationalist group na FALN. Kahit may mga kasaysayan ng karahasan ang grupo, nilinaw ni Holder na walang nasaktan sa mga kasong nabigyan ng clemency. Ipinagtanggol niya ang naging desisyon at binanggit ang suporta mula kina dating Pangulong Jimmy Carter at civil rights leader na si Coretta Scott King. Iba pang isyu ang naging bahagi rin ng pagdinig—tulad ng partisipasyon ni Holder sa federal operation ng 2000 na nagresulta sa pagbabalik kay Elian Gonzales, isang batang Cuban, sa kanyang ama—na ikinagalit ng mga kontra-Castro. Tampok din ang matibay niyang suporta sa mahigpit na regulasyon sa baril. Sa testimonya ni dating Senador John Warner, inamin niyang may ilang pagkakamali si Holder ngunit pinuri ang kakayahan nitong matuto mula rito. Hinikayat ni Senator Patrick Leahy ng mga Democrats na iangat ang diskusyon sa labas ng politika at suportahan si Holder, binigyang-diin ang kanyang dedikasyon sa batas at ang potensyal na maibalik ang moral ng Justice Department. Kapag naaprubahan, siya ang magiging unang African-American Attorney General ng Amerika. Ipinakita ng buong pagdinig ang malalim na hatiang politikal at inaasahan ang mainit at mahabang diskusyon tungkol sa nominasyon ni Holder.

article_content: Kate Meckler, a prominent real estate agent with Warburg Realty in New York, was arrested in April after Saks Fifth Avenue security staff observed her taking a top, a pair of jeans, and a jacket without paying. Prosecutors reported that the items were valued at approximately $1,700. Meckler was initially charged with grand larceny and criminal possession of stolen property but pleaded guilty to a single count of disorderly conduct, according to the Manhattan district attorney's office. The 39-year-old New York University graduate appeared in Manhattan Criminal Court and received a sentence of five days of community service at a soup kitchen under a plea deal. Meckler has a notable record in luxury real estate, including assisting in the sale of a Park Avenue apartment previously owned by club promoter Rachel Uchitel for $1.95 million in 2011. She formerly worked as a marketing executive at Bear Stearns and Estee Lauder. Frederick Warburg Peters, president of Warburg Realty, stated the company continues to have confidence in Meckler and values her association. Meckler did not comment to reporters upon leaving the courtroom. Her attorney, Adam Miller, said she is looking forward to moving on with her life and career. Recognized as one of Warburg Realty’s top-producing agents, Meckler reportedly has a condo sale in contract for $11.5 million on the Upper East Side. Her family is also prominent; her father, Alan Meckler, is a tech entrepreneur, and her grandfather, Herman Meckler, was an actor.

Ayon sa mga prosecutor, humigit-kumulang $1,700 ang halaga ng mga gamit. Una siyang kinasuhan ng grand larceny at ilegal na pagmamay-ari ng mga ninakaw na ari-arian, ngunit umamin sa isang bilang ng disorderly conduct, ayon sa opisina ng Manhattan district attorney. Ang 39-anyos na graduate ng New York University ay humarap sa Manhattan Criminal Court at hinatulan ng limang araw na community service sa isang soup kitchen sa ilalim ng plea deal. Maganda ang kanyang track record sa pagbebenta ng mga luxury real estate, kabilang ang pagtulong sa pagbenta ng Park Avenue apartment na dating pag-aari ng club promoter na si Rachel Uchitel sa halagang $1.95 milyon noong 2011. Dati rin siyang nagtrabaho bilang marketing executive sa Bear Stearns at Estee Lauder. Ayon kay Frederick Warburg Peters, presidente ng Warburg Realty, patuloy pa rin ang tiwala nila kay Meckler at pinahahalagahan nila ang ugnayan niya sa kumpanya. Hindi nagbigay ng pahayag si Meckler sa media paglabas ng korte. Sabi ng kanyang abogado na si Adam Miller, nais na raw ng kanyang kliyente na magpatuloy sa kanyang buhay at karera. Kilala si Meckler bilang isa sa pinakamahusay na agents ng Warburg Realty at iniulat na may condo sale siya ngayon na nagkakahalaga ng $11.5 milyon sa Upper East Side. Kilala rin ang kanyang pamilya: ang kanyang amang si Alan Meckler ay isang tech entrepreneur, at ang kanyang lolo na si Herman Meckler ay dating aktor.

article_content: Inteluck, a Singapore-based logistics startup, offers enterprise customers on-demand access to over 14,000 delivery trucks across the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam. On Tuesday, Inteluck announced it raised $34 million in a Series C funding round led by Philippine private equity firm Navegar, valuing the company at over $100 million. Existing investor East Ventures, a Jakarta-based venture capital firm, also participated, bringing Inteluck's total funds raised to $57 million. The new funding will support Inteluck's further expansion across Southeast Asia, one of the world’s fastest-growing logistics markets. Founded in 2014 by Chinese entrepreneur and Forbes 30 Under 30 alumnus Kevin Zhang in the Philippines, Inteluck started by providing solutions for companies to track their fleet of trucks. Today, it serves around 300 enterprise customers, offering access to more than 14,000 delivery vehicles in three countries. Among its early investors is Hong Kong-based logistics unicorn Lalamove. CEO Kevin Zhang said the company plans to continue investing in its existing markets, emphasizing significant potential in Thailand and the Philippines. He also mentioned the possibility of expanding into other Southeast Asian countries, such as Malaysia. Inteluck estimates Southeast Asia’s logistics market at over $300 billion and positions itself as a leading player modernizing B2B logistics using data and technology.

Sumali rin ang dating mamumuhunang East Ventures, isang venture capital firm mula Jakarta, kaya umabot na sa $57 milyon ang kabuuang nalikom ng Inteluck. Gagamitin ng Inteluck ang bagong pondo para sa karagdagang pagpapalawak sa Southeast Asia, isa sa pinakamabilis lumagong merkado ng logistics sa mundo. Itinatag noong 2014 ng Chinese na negosyanteng si Kevin Zhang, na kabilang sa Forbes 30 Under 30, sa Pilipinas, nagsimula ang Inteluck sa pagbibigay ng solusyon para matulungan ang mga kumpanya na ma-track ang kanilang fleet ng trucks. Sinabi ni CEO Kevin Zhang na patuloy ang plano ng kumpanya na mag-invest sa mga kasalukuyang merkado nito at binigyang-diin ang malaking potensyal sa Thailand at Pilipinas. Binanggit din niya ang posibilidad ng pagpapalawak sa iba pang bansa sa Southeast Asia, gaya ng Malaysia. Tinataya ng Inteluck na mahigit $300 bilyon ang halaga ng logistics market sa Southeast Asia, at inilalagay ang sarili bilang pangunahing tagapagmodernisa ng B2B logistics gamit ang data at teknolohiya.

article_content: After a long, stressful travel day, Jessie Frank was desperate to get home to Atlanta and pick up her daughter—who has type 1 diabetes—from a special camp. Facing numerous delays and cancellations due to weather and mechanical issues, Frank was eighth on the standby list for an overbooked Delta Air Lines flight. Just before departure, she was surprised to be offered a seat. She later learned that Delta CEO Richard Anderson had given up his own seat for her, choosing instead to ride in the cockpit jump seat with the pilots. Anderson helped Frank with her bag and did not reveal his identity during the flight. Frank shared the story in an open letter on Facebook, expressing gratitude to Anderson and the Delta staff for their kindness. Her letter highlighted the importance of Anderson’s leadership by example and praised the overall helpfulness of the airline’s employees. Frank explained in her post that her daughter’s time at Camp Kudzu—a camp for children with diabetes—lets her feel 'normal,' and that being able to pick her up was very special. Frank’s heartfelt letter quickly spread on social media, received personal thanks from Delta employees, and was shared over 1,700 times. Although Delta confirmed the story, Anderson declined to comment, preferring to avoid the spotlight. Frank stated that the experience solidified her loyalty to Delta Air Lines, expressing enduring gratitude for the kindness shown to her and her daughter.
translated_content: Matapos ang isang mahaba at nakaka-stress na araw ng pagbiyahe, sabik na makauwi si Jessie Frank sa Atlanta para sunduin ang anak niyang may type 1 diabetes mula sa isang espesyal na kampo. Dahil sa mga sunod-sunod na pagkaantala at pagkansela ng flight sanhi ng masamang panahon at problema sa eroplano, ikawalo si Frank sa standby list ng overbooked na Delta Air Lines flight. Bilang gulat niya, may nag-abot sa kanya ng upuan bago umalis ang eroplano. Nalaman niyang ang CEO ng Delta na si Richard Anderson ang nagbigay ng sarili niyang upuan at umupo na lang sa cockpit jump seat kasama ang mga piloto. Tinulungan pa niya si Frank sa kanyang bag at hindi niya ipinakilala ang sarili niya noong flight. Ibinahagi ni Frank ang kwento sa isang open letter sa Facebook, puno ng pasasalamat kay Anderson at sa mga staff ng Delta dahil sa kabutihan nila. Binanggit niya kung gaano kaganda ang pamumuno ni Anderson at pinuri ang tulong ng airline. Kwento niya pa, ang Camp Kudzu, na para sa mga batang may diabetes, ay nagbibigay ng pagkakataon sa kanyang anak na maramdamang 'normal,' kaya espesyal talaga ang oras ng pagsundo niya rito. Mabilis na kumalat ang liham ni Frank sa social media, umani ng personal na pasasalamat mula sa mga empleyado ng Delta, at na-share nang higit 1,700 beses. Kinumpirma ng Delta ang kwento, ngunit ayaw magpa-interview ni Anderson para hindi mapansin ang sarili. Ayon kay Frank, hindi niya malilimutan ang kabaitan ng Delta at ni Anderson, at dahil dito, lalo siyang naging forever loyal customer ng Delta Air Lines.

article_content: Nigeria's history is marked by deep divisions and persistent struggle. Major ethnic groups—the Fulani in the north, Yoruba in the west, and Igbo in the east—have long held their own regions, but political manipulation and resource control have fueled instability and resentment, particularly regarding the Niger Delta. Conflict escalated in 1966 with a military coup led by officers predominantly from the east, resulting in the assassination of Prime Minister Tafawa Balewa. Johnson Aguiyi-Ironsi briefly became head of state, but a countercoup six months later, led by mainly northern officers, resulted in more violence and his own assassination. These events triggered Nigeria’s bloody civil war, lasting from 1967 to 1970, which left around three million Igbo dead from violence and starvation. In the years following the war, Nigeria experienced a succession of military and civilian rulers, almost all stained by corruption and abuse of power. General Babangida's regime was especially notorious for its violent purges and deceit, while Sani Abacha became infamous for looting billions of dollars from state coffers—funds still being recovered today. The murder of journalist Dele Giwa in 1986, believed to be a politically motivated assassination, underscored the dangers faced by critics of those in power. A supposed return to democracy failed to end these patterns. Leaders such as Obasanjo, Buhari, and now Tinubu, have been accused of ongoing corruption, election manipulation, and worsening the economic crisis for ordinary citizens. Recently, as inflation and hardship have soared, President Tinubu approved the purchase of a $6.1 million yacht for personal use and authorized lawmakers to acquire N58 billion in SUVs, all as part of the 2023 supplementary budget. At the same time, underfunded universities have been ordered to turn over 40% of their internal revenue to the federal government. Amid this elite extravagance, most Nigerians face unemployment, poverty, and high living costs. Ordinary people are left struggling, while politicians continue to prosper. Frustration and hopelessness have grown among the population, with widespread doubt that positive change will come. The article uses biblical references to contrast past ideals of integrity and sacrifice with the current self-interest and greed among leaders. In the end, the writer strongly doubts that the current political leaders will change the system, despite sarcastically hoping that Tinubu will someday act for the good of all Nigerians.
translated_content: Ang kasaysayan ng Nigeria ay puno ng malalim na pagkakawatak-watak at patuloy na pagsubok. Lalong sumiklab ang kaguluhan noong 1966 nang maganap ang kudeta na pinangunahan ng mga opisyal mula sa silangan, na nauwi sa pagpatay kay Punong Ministro Tafawa Balewa. Saglit namuno si Johnson Aguiyi-Ironsi ngunit anim na buwan lang, pinatumba siya ng isang kontra-kudeta na pinangunahan naman ng mga opisyal mula hilaga, dahilan ng mas matinding karahasan. Dito nagsimula ang madugong digmaang sibil sa Nigeria mula 1967 hanggang 1970, na umabot sa tatlong milyong Igbo ang namatay dahil sa giyera at gutom. Pagkatapos ng digmaan, sunod-sunod ang mga namuno—militar at sibilyan—na halos lahat ay nadawit sa korupsiyon at pang-aabuso ng kapangyarihan. Lalo namang nabansagan ang pamahalaan ni General Babangida bilang mabagsik at mapanlinlang, habang si Sani Abacha ay sumikat bilang magnanakaw ng bilyong dolyar mula sa kaban ng bayan—mga pondong hanggang ngayon ay binabawi pa rin mula sa ibang bansa. Ang pagpatay kay mamamahayag na si Dele Giwa noong 1986, na itinuturong may kinalaman sa pulitika, ay nagpapakita ng panganib para sa mga kritiko ng gobyerno. Inaasahan sanang babalik ang demokrasya ngunit nagpatuloy lang daw ang ganitong sistema. Sina Obasanjo, Buhari, at ngayon si Tinubu ay iniuugnay pa rin sa korupsiyon, pandaraya sa eleksiyon, at paglala ng krisis pang-ekonomiya para sa karaniwang tao. Kamakailan lang, habang tumataas ang presyo ng bilihin at hirap na hirap ang masa, inaprubahan ni Pangulong Tinubu ang pagbili ng $6.1 milyong halaga ng yate para sa sarili at N58 bilyong halaga ng mga SUV para sa mga mambabatas—lahat ito ay bahagi ng 2023 supplementary budget. Kasabay nito, pinasasakop din ang mga hirap na unibersidad na ipasa ang 40% ng kita nila sa gobyerno. Habang nagtatamasa ng luho ang mga lider, halos matinding hirap ang dinaranas ng karaniwang mamamayan—unemployment, kahirapan, at mataas na presyo ng bilihin. Parang ang masa ay napag-iiwanan, habang todo ang pagyaman ng mga politiko. Dahil dito, palaki nang palaki ang pagkadismaya at kawalan ng pag-asa ng mamamayan, na hirap na ring maniwala na may pagbabago pang darating. Sa bandang huli, duda ang sumulat na may tunay na pagbabago pang mangyayari, kahit pa sarkastikong ipinagdarasal na sana isang araw, ay gisingin ni Tinubu ang konsensya niya at gawing tunay ang kabutihan para sa lahat ng Nigerian.

article_content: Recent fatal explosions at the Upper Big Branch coal mine in West Virginia and the Deepwater Horizon oil rig off Louisiana’s coast underscore important aspects of U.S. energy supplies. First, energy from these sources is so valuable that companies can pay premiums for workers to take substantial risks. For example, Massey Coal extracted coal at Upper Big Branch for $35 per ton and sold it for $60 per ton, while BP and Transocean extracted oil at Deepwater Horizon for $50 per barrel and sold it for $80 per barrel. Second, there are no easy solutions to America’s energy issues. Regardless of the source, energy comes at a high price. This is especially important to consider as the country discusses moving toward lower-carbon energy to address climate change—a transition that will be expensive and is unlikely to happen quickly. According to environmental think tank Resources for the Future, the pending Waxman-Markey bill (the American Clean Energy and Security Act) may increase the average ratepayer’s cost by $136 to $413 per year. The U.S. economy relies heavily on coal for electricity and gasoline for cars, making a shift away from these fuels challenging and time-consuming. Nearly half of U.S. electricity comes from coal, which is inexpensive, abundant, and secure, but brings significant costs, including risks to miners and environmental impacts. Burning coal produces sulfur dioxide, nitrous oxide, and carbon dioxide. Scientists and engineers are seeking cleaner coal solutions, like carbon sequestration, which involves capturing and storing carbon underground. This approach presents challenges, such as building pipelines to transport compressed carbon dioxide and addressing local opposition. For now, coal will remain a major energy source. Oil also poses environmental and safety risks. Burning oil creates pollution and carbon emissions, and disasters like the Deepwater Horizon spill show environmental threats associated with drilling. Despite this, oil currently powers most vehicles. While electric cars may someday be more viable, powering them will depend on an already overburdened electricity grid. Wind and solar energy are often seen as solutions but generate only about 2 percent of the country’s electricity and have their own drawbacks. Some wind projects have been canceled due to local objections, and Secretary of the Interior Ken Salazar faces decisions on contested projects like the one off Cape Cod, Massachusetts. No offshore wind turbines have yet been built in the U.S. Solar power is clean, but manufacturing solar technology relies on rare-earth elements like dysprosium and terbium, which are commonly sourced from China and require difficult, hazardous extraction processes. These elements are also used in hybrid car motors, and sourcing them gives China leverage over U.S. energy policy. Another major challenge for wind and solar is their intermittent nature—energy output depends on the weather and is non-storable, raising concerns about reliability for the electricity grid. Whether consumers are willing to pay more for green energy is unclear. In Pennsylvania’s electricity market, 5 to 10 percent of homeowners choose to pay 15 to 20 percent more for wind power. As demand rises, green energy is likely to become even costlier. The main point is that solving America’s energy challenges will not be cheap. Every option—fossil fuels or alternatives—will likely mean higher costs for electricity and gasoline. This commentary represents the views of Andrew Kleit.

Una, napakahalaga ng enerhiya mula sa mga pinagmulan na ito kaya handang magbayad ng malaking sahod ang mga kompanya kahit may panganib sa kanilang mga manggagawa. Halimbawa, nagmimina ang Massey Coal ng karbon sa Upper Big Branch sa halagang $35 kada tonelada at ibinebenta ito ng $60 kada tonelada, habang ang BP at Transocean ay nagkukuha ng langis sa Deepwater Horizon sa halagang $50 kada bariles at ibinebenta ito ng $80 kada bariles. Pangalawa, walang madaling solusyon sa mga isyu sa enerhiya ng Amerika. Anumang pinagmulan, mataas ang presyo ng enerhiya. Mahalaga itong isaalang-alang habang tinatalakay ng bansa ang paglipat sa low-carbon na enerhiya para labanan ang climate change—isang hakbang na magastos at hindi agad mangyayari. Ayon sa environmental think tank na Resources for the Future, ang Waxman-Markey bill (American Clean Energy and Security Act) na nakabinbin sa Senado ay maaaring magdagdag ng $136 hanggang $413 kada taon sa gastusin ng karaniwang nagpapakabit ng kuryente. Malaki ang pag-asa ng ekonomiya ng U.S. sa karbon para sa elektrisidad at gasolina para sa mga sasakyan, kaya mahirap at matagal ang paglayo sa mga ito. Halos kalahati ng elektrisidad sa bansa ay mula sa karbon—murang bilihin, maraming suplay, at siguradong mapagkukunan—ngunit may kalakip na matinding panganib at epekto sa kalikasan. Ang pagsunog ng karbon ay naglalabas ng sulfur dioxide, nitrous oxide, at carbon dioxide. Naghahanap ng mas malinis na paraan ang mga siyentipiko't inhinyero tulad ng carbon sequestration, kung saan kinukuha at iniimbak ang carbon sa ilalim ng lupa. Ngunit may hamon itong dala, tulad ng pagpapatayo ng mga pipeline para dalhin ang piniga at compressed na carbon dioxide, at pagtutol ng mga lokal. Sa ngayon, mananatiling pangunahing mapagkukunan ang karbon. May sariling mga panganib din ang langis sa kalikasan at kaligtasan. Ang pagsunog ng langis ay nagdudulot ng polusyon at carbon emissions, at ipinakita ng Deepwater Horizon oil spill ang panganib ng drilling. Gayunman, langis pa rin ang pangunahing nagpapaandar sa karamihan ng sasakyan. Kahit magamit man ang mga electric car sa hinaharap, kakailanganin pa rin ang kuryente mula sa national grid na labis nang nabibigatan. Tinitingnan ang wind at solar energy bilang mga solusyon ngunit bumubuo lamang ng 2 porsyento ng kuryente ng bansa at may sariling limitasyon. May ilang proyekto ng wind power na na-cancel dahil sa pagtutol ng mga lokal, at si Interior Secretary Ken Salazar ay may desisyon sa isyu ng wind project sa Cape Cod, Massachusetts. Wala pa ring offshore wind turbines sa U.S. hanggang ngayon. Malinis ang solar power, pero ang paggawa ng mga teknolohiya nito ay nangangailangan ng rare-earth elements gaya ng dysprosium at terbium, kadalasang galing China, at mahirap at mapanganib din kunin. Ginagamit din ang mga ito sa motors ng hybrid na sasakyan at ang pag-asa sa mga ito ay nagbibigay ng kontrol sa China sa enerhiya ng U.S. Isa pang pangunahing hamon sa wind at solar ang pagiging 'intermittent'—nakadepende ang power output sa panahon at hindi puwedeng itabi, kaya may agam-agam sa reliability nito para sa electricity grid. Hindi rin tiyak kung handang gumastos ng mas malaki ang mga consumer para sa green energy. Sa Pennsylvania, 5 hanggang 10 porsyento ng mga homeowner ang pinipiling magbayad ng 15 hanggang 20 porsyentong mas mataas para sa wind power. Kapag tumaas ang demand, malamang na mas tumaas pa ang halaga ng green energy. Ang pinakaimportanteng punto: Ang pagbibigay-solusyon sa problema sa enerhiya ng Amerika ay hindi magiging mura. Lahat ng option—fossil fuels o alternatibo—ay posibleng magtulak ng pagtaas ng singil sa kuryente at gasolina. Ang komentaryong ito ay mula kay Andrew Kleit.

article_content: Children's reactions to a Nintendo Game Boy were captured on camera, with many expressing surprise and sympathy for those who played such older video games in the past. Los Angeles-based filmmakers Benny and Rafi Fine asked volunteers aged 6 to 13 to guess what the bulky device was, leading to guesses such as 'telephone' or 'television.' Ten-year-old Caden commented, 'My dad had this,' while another, Morgan, said, 'I'm scared! I thought it was going to zap me.' Eight-year-old Samirah thought the large, gray Game Boy looked like an old telephone, while seven-year-old Evan said he 'kind of felt bad for people in the past.' Demonstrating how gaming has become more inclusive, Addy, age ten, asked, 'Why isn't it called Game Boy/Girl?' The children struggled to insert a game cartridge and to power on the device, with six-year-old Sydney pressing the start button, not realizing the on/off switch is at the top. Sydney thought the magnifying glass that comes with the Game Boy looked like a mini television. Emma, eight, was asked to show how she would react if given a Game Boy for her birthday. After figuring out how to turn it on, the children were asked to play, with mixed reactions: 'It's kind of boring,' said Evan; Sydney said, 'I actually like it but I also hate it,' and Dylan, twelve, said, 'I think my mom would be better at this.' Caden was surprised to learn that over 64 million Game Boys were sold—just a few million fewer than PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. Caden also had trouble figuring out how to put the magnifying glass over the Game Boy screen. The Nintendo Game Boy, an eight-bit, battery-operated handheld console released in 1989, was a major success, with more than 64 million units sold. Since being uploaded on July 6, the YouTube video has been viewed over 6.9 million times. Many older viewers commented that it was 'sad' or 'surprising' that today's kids are unfamiliar with older technology. User RedFlyer41117 expressed nostalgia—'You guys are making me feel old, and I'm only 20! I still remember blowing cartridges to make a game work on a Nintendo.' Another viewer, Legendarii14, wrote, 'I feel so sorry for the next generation.' The Fine Brothers have created several 'Kids React' videos, highlighting the responses of today's children to technology from the 1990s and earlier, including the Sony Walkman and rotary telephone.

article_content: Alphabet Inc.’s Google is reportedly in advanced discussions to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in Character.AI, a rising artificial intelligence chatbot startup. According to Reuters, this investment could greatly enhance Character.AI’s ability to meet increasing user demand and support further development of its AI models. Character.AI already uses Google’s cloud platform and Tensor Processing Units for training. The possible investment, which may be structured as convertible notes, would further strengthen their partnership. As of now, neither Google nor Character.AI has responded to requests for comment. Character.AI was founded by former Google engineers Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas, and is known for allowing users to interact with virtual versions of celebrities and anime characters, as well as create personalized chatbots and AI assistants. While the service is free, a subscription at $9.99 per month offers priority access to chatbots. According to Similarweb, about 60% of Character.AI’s website traffic comes from users aged 18 to 24, a demographic important to the company’s positioning as a provider of engaging AI companions and a key distinction from competitors like OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Google’s Bard. In its first six months, Character.AI attracted approximately 100 million monthly visits to its site. The company is also pursuing equity funding from venture capital firms that could value it over $5 billion. Earlier in March, Character.AI raised $150 million in a round led by Andreessen Horowitz, setting its valuation at $1 billion. Google’s possible investment in Character.AI reflects a broader trend of major tech companies such as Microsoft and Amazon making strategic investments in AI startups. These deals often encourage the adoption of certain cloud platforms or hardware as the field of AI model development and consumer services rapidly evolves. Regulatory agencies have taken notice of these investments; U.S. Federal Trade Commission chair Lina Khan recently stated that the agency is reviewing such deals for potential anti-competitive practices.

The owner of a UK taxi company is suspected of killing his wife before taking his own life in a suspected murder-suicide in California, according to police. Riverside County Sheriff's Office reported that Carl Ashcroft and his wife, Kathryn, were found with gunshot wounds at a property in Rancho Mirage on Sunday. Authorities confirmed there are no other suspects.

Carl Ashcroft, 61, who owned Pem Taxis in Wigan, and his 55-year-old wife, Kathryn, were residing in Simi Valley at the time of the incident. Sergeant Mike Kelleher stated that deputies responded to a report of an attempted suicide on Lyon Road at around 2:15 pm PST. Upon arrival, officers found both individuals with gunshot injuries. Mr. Ashcroft died at the scene, while Mrs. Ashcroft was transported to a hospital, where she later succumbed to her injuries. Sgt Kelleher emphasized that there are no outstanding suspects and that there is no ongoing threat to the community.

article_content: Kevin O'Leary has cautioned that pressure is mounting on regional banks, commercial real estate (CRE) developers, and small businesses. "It's getting worse by the week," O'Leary, an investor and 'Shark Tank' star, told Fox Business on Friday. "Many private equity firms are admitting there are cracks in the system." Over the past 18 months, the Federal Reserve has raised interest rates from near zero to more than 5% in an effort to cool inflation, which reached a 40-year high of over 9% last summer. Higher borrowing costs have led to falling commercial property values and have put stress on debt-heavy developers, leading to a credit crunch as banks become reluctant to lend to the sector. Regional banks are particularly strained as they are key lenders to the CRE market and have seen the value of the real estate and bonds they hold drop as rates have climbed. Smaller banks also play a major role in financing small businesses, which now face high inflation, more expensive debt, and ongoing concerns about a potential recession. "We're going to see more cracks in regional banks, and that's putting pressure on their loan books, which impacts small businesses," O'Leary said. Many CRE developers may need to refinance their loans within the next three years at interest rates between 9% and 14%, compared to initial rates of 3% to 5%, according to O'Leary. "That makes these buildings uneconomic," he stated, warning that CRE sector troubles could spill over to impact regional banks and small businesses. O'Leary, known as "Mr. Wonderful," warned that if banks experience difficulties, businesses with payroll accounts holding more than $250,000 might either withdraw their funds or be unable to pay employees. The Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. only insures up to $250,000 per account holder per bank in the event of a bank failure. "You don't want a regional bank to fail because you can't guarantee more than $250,000," O'Leary said, noting that payroll accounts often exceed this amount before paydays. The founder of O'Leary Funds and O'Leary Ventures urged lawmakers to support a $100 million guarantee for non-interest-bearing accounts, which would protect payroll funds. "They've got to have some plan for when these banks start failing," he said. Recently, O'Leary has promoted the S&P 500 as benefiting from government spending, warned about the multiple threats facing the US economy, and cautioned that mortgage rates could rise above 8% if the Fed increases interest rates above 6%.

"Lalong lumalala bawat linggo," sabi ni O'Leary, isang investor at 'Shark Tank' star, sa Fox Business noong Biyernes. "Maraming private equity firms ang umaamin na may bitak na sa sistema." Sa loob ng 18 buwan, itinaas ng Federal Reserve ang interest rates mula halos zero hanggang mahigit 5% para bawasan ang inflation na umabot sa mahigit 9% noong nakaraang tag-init—ang pinakamataas sa loob ng 40 taon. Bunga nito, bumaba ang halaga ng mga commercial property at mas nahirapan ang mga developer na may malalaking utang, kaya nagkaroon ng credit crunch dahil nag-aalangan ang mga bangko na magpautang sa sektor. Lalo ring naapektuhan ang mga regional bank na pangunahing nagbibigay ng pautang sa CRE, at bumaba ang halaga ng real estate at bonds sa kanilang portfolio habang tumataas ang interest rates. Mahalaga rin ang papel ng maliliit na bangko sa pagpapautang sa maliliit na negosyo—pero ngayon ay dumaranas sila ng mataas na inflation, mas mahal na utang, at takot sa recession. "Makikita pa natin ang mas maraming bitak sa regional banks, at itong pressure na ito ay sumasama sa loan books nila kaya apektado ang maliliit na negosyo," sabi ni O'Leary. Maraming CRE developers ang kailangang mag-refinance ng kanilang mga utang sa susunod na tatlong taon sa mas mataas na interest rates na 9% hanggang 14%, kumpara sa dating 3% hanggang 5%, ayon kay O'Leary. "Hindi na kumikita ang mga building na ito," diin niya, at nagbabala na pwedeng lumala ang epekto nito sa regional banks at maliliit na negosyo. Kilala bilang "Mr. Wonderful," nagbabala si O'Leary na kapag nagkaproblema ang mga bangko, maaaring mag-withdraw ng sabay-sabay ang mga negosyo na may payroll accounts na higit $250,000, o hindi na makabayad sa mga empleyado. Ang Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. ay tanging nagco-cover ng hanggang $250,000 bawat account holder kada bangko kung magsara ang bangko. "Ayaw mong bumagsak ang regional bank dahil hindi mo magagarantiyahan ang higit sa $250,000," sabi pa ni O'Leary, binanggit na madalas sobra sa halagang ito ang payroll accounts bago araw ng sweldo. Hinikayat niya bilang founder ng O'Leary Funds at O'Leary Ventures, ang mga mambabatas na aprubahan ang $100 milyon na garantiya para sa non-interest-bearing accounts para maprotektahan ang payroll funds. "Dapat may plano sila kung magsisimulang bumagsak ang mga bangko," dagdag niya. Nitong mga nakaraang buwan, binanggit din ni O'Leary ang epekto ng government spending sa S&P 500, nagbabala sa maraming panganib sa US economy, at sinabing maaaring lumampas sa 8% ang mortgage rates kung aakyat ang Fed rates nang lampas 6%.

article_content: Police believe Katharine Hooper, 24, took her own life and those of her two sons, Joshua, 5, and Samuel, 2. Katharine Hooper and Joshua died after reportedly falling about 100ft from Haytor, a popular landmark on Dartmoor. Samuel’s body was later discovered at their home in Paignton, about 20 miles away. Witnesses said Mrs Hooper placed Joshua on her shoulders before the fall. Emergency services were unable to save either upon arrival. A murder investigation has been launched, but police say they are not looking for other suspects. Friends reported that Mrs Hooper had significant relationship difficulties, and police had previously made a public appeal when she was missing. Some local residents questioned the responses from police and social services prior to the tragedy. Neighbors noted that the children had recently returned from a period in care following a domestic incident involving their parents. Hooper had lost her job during the relationship breakdown but had recently moved back home with her sons and was trying to rebuild her life. Neighbors described her as friendly and her children as well-behaved. The incident occurred on a day when temperatures approached 30°C at Haytor. Officials from Dartmoor National Park Authority noted that while accidents can happen in places like Haytor, such incidents are uncommon.
translated_content: Naniniwala ang pulisya na kinitil ni Katharine Hooper, 24, ang sarili at ang buhay ng kanyang dalawang anak na sina Joshua, 5, at Samuel, 2. Namatay si Katharine Hooper at Joshua matapos umano silang mahulog mula sa taas na halos 100 talampakan sa Haytor, isang tanyag na pook sa Dartmoor. Natagpuan naman ang katawan ni Samuel sa kanilang bahay sa Paignton, mga 20 milya ang layo. Ayon sa mga saksi, binuhat ni Mrs Hooper si Joshua sa balikat bago naganap ang insidente. Hindi naisalba ng mga rescuers ang dalawa pagdating nila. Naglunsad ng imbestigasyon ng pagpatay ngunit ayon sa pulisya, wala silang hinahanap na ibang sangkot. Ikinuwento ng mga kaibigan na may mabigat na problemang pangrelasyon si Mrs Hooper, at dati nang naglunsad ng public appeal ang pulisya nang nawala siya. May mga residente na nagtanong ukol sa naging tugon ng pulisya at social services bago nangyari ang trahedya. Napansin ng mga kapitbahay na kamakailan lang nakabalik ang mga bata mula sa protective care matapos ang isang nangyaring insidente sa kanilang mga magulang. Nawalan ng trabaho si Hooper noong nagkaroon ng problema sa relasyon, ngunit kamakailan ay nakabalik na sila ng kanyang mga anak at sinikap na magsimulang muli. Inilarawan siya ng mga kapitbahay bilang palakaibigan, at mababait ang kanyang mga anak. Naganap ang insidente sa araw na umabot sa halos 30°C ang temperatura sa Haytor. Ayon sa opisyal ng Dartmoor National Park Authority, bagaman may panganib sa mga paboritong pook gaya ng Haytor, bibihira ang ganitong mga insidente.

article_content: The United States stated on Monday that any withdrawal of Serbian soldiers from the Kosovo border would be a "welcome measure," following Belgrade’s announcement that it had reduced troop levels "to normal." “We are waiting to see confirmation of this. But if it is true, it would be a welcome step,” said US State Department spokesperson Matthew Miller. "We remain concerned by the cycle of increasing tensions and sporadic violence in northern Kosovo and we encourage both parties to resume the dialogue facilitated by the European Union," he added. Serbia does not recognize the independence of Kosovo, its former southern province. Rebels from Kosovo’s Albanian majority fought a war for independence against Serbian forces between 1998 and 1999, which ended after a NATO bombing campaign. Tensions have escalated in northern Kosovo, home to around 120,000 Kosovo Serbs. On September 24, a Kosovar Albanian police officer was killed in an ambush in an area with a Serb majority in several towns. A shootout then occurred between Kosovar special forces and a heavily armed group of Kosovo Serbs. Three of the gunmen were killed and three others arrested, while others escaped. Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti stated that the incident — one of the most serious escalations in Kosovo in recent years — was part of a "larger plan to annex northern Kosovo through a coordinated attack" on various positions. On Monday, he claimed the plan was to "set up a corridor towards Serbia" to "allow the supply of weapons and troops." Also on Monday, Serbian leaders announced a reduction of troops along the border with Kosovo, which they refer to as an "administrative line." Serbian Armed Forces Chief of Staff Milan Mojsilovic said the army had reduced the number of soldiers from 8,350 to 4,500, three days after the US warned against a “major military deployment.” On Sunday, NATO announced it would strengthen its presence in Kosovo with 600 additional British soldiers. NATO’s peacekeeping force, known as KFOR, comprises about 4,500 soldiers from 27 countries. The US-led military alliance has called once again for calm and demanded that Belgrade and Pristina return to dialogue as soon as possible. According to a NATO spokesperson, dialogue is "the only way to achieve lasting peace." During the recent outbreak of violence on September 24, a paramilitary group composed of dozens of men killed a Kosovar Albanian policeman and wounded another at a checkpoint near the village of Banjska, northern Kosovo. The group, reportedly supported by Belgrade, rejects the government in Pristina. On the day of the attack, Kosovar authorities claimed Serbia was behind the heavily armed group, an allegation Serbian authorities have denied. The US, Kosovo’s main international ally, called on Serbia to "withdraw [its] troops" from the border last Friday. Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic accused Washington of lying, but did not explicitly deny the presence of Serbian soldiers. He said troop numbers were well below those during a similar deployment in May. General Mojsilovic said he was “surprised” by concerns about the deployment of Serbian forces during the latest “security crisis.” According to him, the Serbian army had deployed around 14,000 soldiers in the region between December 2022 and May 2023 during "similar security crises." Serbian troops were then placed at the "highest level of alert," which, Mojsilovic emphasized, was not the case last week.
translated_content: Sinabi ng Estados Unidos nitong Lunes na anumang pag-atras ng mga sundalong Serb mula sa hangganan ng Kosovo ay magiging “magandang hakbang,” kasunod ng pahayag ng Belgrade na ibinaba na nila ang bilang ng tropa sa “normal.” “Naghihintay kami ng kumpirmasyon ukol dito. Pero kung totoo ito, magiging positibong hakbang ito,” ayon kay Matthew Miller, tagapagsalita ng US State Department. “Patuloy kaming nababahala sa tuloy-tuloy na tensyon at paminsang karahasan sa hilagang bahagi ng Kosovo, at hinihikayat naming bumalik sa diyalogo ang parehong panig na pinangungunahan ng European Union,” dagdag niya. Hindi kinikilala ng Serbia ang kasarinlan ng Kosovo, na dating lalawigan nito sa timog. Nakipaglaban ang mga rebelde mula sa mayoryang Albanian ng Kosovo para sa kalayaan laban sa mga puwersa ng Serbia noong 1998–1999, na natapos matapos ang pambobomba ng NATO. Lumalala ang tensyon sa hilagang Kosovo, kung saan humigit-kumulang 120,000 Kosovo Serb ang naninirahan. Noong Setyembre 24, napatay ang isang pulis ng Kosovar Albanian sa isang pananambang sa lugar na mayorya ay mga Serb sa ilang bayan. Nagkaroon ng palitan ng putok sa pagitan ng espesyal na pwersa ng Kosovo at isang armadong grupo ng mga Serb ng Kosovo. Tatlo sa mga armadong lalaki ang napatay at tatlo ang naaresto, habang nakatakas ang iba pa. Ayon kay Punong Ministro ng Kosovo na si Albin Kurti, ang insidenteng ito—na isa sa pinakamatinding paglala ng tensyon sa Kosovo nitong mga huling taon—ay bahagi ng "mas malaking plano na sakupin ang hilagang Kosovo sa pamamagitan ng koordinadong pag-atake" sa iba’t ibang posisyon. Noong Lunes, sinabi pa niya na layunin ng plano na "magbukas ng koridor papuntang Serbia" para "makapagpadala ng armas at tropa." Ipinahayag din ng mga lider ng Serbia noong Lunes na binawasan na nila ang mga tropa sa hangganan ng Kosovo, na tinawag nilang "administrative line." Ayon kay Milan Mojsilovic, Chief of Staff ng Serbian Armed Forces, nabawasan na mula 8,350 hanggang 4,500 ang sundalong nakadeploy, tatlong araw matapos bigyang-babala ng US ang isang “malaking pag-deploy ng militar.” Noong Linggo, inanunsyo ng NATO na magdadagdag sila ng 600 British soldiers sa puwersa nila sa Kosovo. Ang peacekeeping force ng NATO, na kilala bilang KFOR, ay binubuo ng humigit-kumulang 4,500 sundalo mula sa 27 bansa. Muling nanawagan ang US-led military alliance ng kapanatagan at pinapabalik sa diyalogo ang Belgrade at Pristina sa lalong madaling panahon. Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng NATO, ang diyalogo ang "tanging paraan para makamit ang pangmatagalang kapayapaan." Sa pinakahuling insidente ng karahasan noong Setyembre 24, isang paramilitaryong grupo na binubuo ng dose-dosenang lalaki ang pumatay ng isang pulis ng Kosovar Albanian at sugatan ang isa pa sa isang checkpoint malapit sa bayan ng Banjska, hilagang Kosovo. Ang grupong ito, na umano’y sinusuportahan ng Belgrade, ay tumatanggi sa pamahalaan sa Pristina. Noong araw ng pag-atake, inakusahan ng mga awtoridad ng Kosovo ang Serbia na nasa likod ng armadong grupo, bagay na itinanggi ng Serbia. Hinimok ng US, pangunahing alyado ng Kosovo, ang Serbia na "bawiin [ang kanilang] tropa" mula sa hangganan noong nakaraang Biyernes. Inakusahan ni Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic ang Washington na nagsisinungaling, pero hindi niya tahasang itinanggi ang presensya ng mga sundalong Serb. Sinabi niyang mas mababa ang bilang ng tropa ngayon kumpara sa kahalintulad na deployment noong Mayo. Sinabi ni General Mojsilovic na siya ay “nagulat” sa mga agam-agam kaugnay ng pag-deploy ng mga sundalong Serb sa pinakabagong “security crisis.” Ayon pa sa kanya, dati nang nakapag-deploy ang Serbian army ng humigit-kumulang 14,000 sundalo sa rehiyon sa pagitan ng Disyembre 2022 at Mayo 2023 sa panahon ng "katulad na mga krisis sa seguridad." Noon, itinaas sa "pinakamataas na antas ng alerto" ang mga puwersa ng Serbia, na ayon kay Mojsilovic, ay hindi nangyari noong nakaraang linggo.
